regions.name: 福州市
regions.overview: 福州是福建省省会，地处闽江下游，是一座拥有2200多年建城史的国家历史文化名城。福州古建筑以三坊七巷明清民居群、华林寺北宋大殿为代表，融合了中原传统建筑技艺与闽地特色。福州还是近代五口通商口岸之一，留存有大量中西合璧的近代建筑。
regions.overview_en: Fuzhou, the capital of Fujian Province, is a national historical and cultural city with over 2,200 years of urban history. Its ancient architecture is represented by the Ming-Qing residential complex of Sanfang Qixiang and the Northern Song main hall of Hualin Temple, blending Central Plains traditional techniques with Min regional characteristics. As one of the five treaty ports after the Opium War, Fuzhou also preserves numerous Sino-Western modern buildings.

projects.name: 华林寺
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 福州市鼓楼区省人民政府东侧
projects.address_en: East of Fujian Provincial People's Government, Gulou District, Fuzhou
highlights: 斗拱
拆换下来的老构件
长江以南最古木构
projects.content_zh: 华林寺位于福州鼓楼区北隅、屏山南麓，比邻福建省人民政府。寺门外省政府正对面一棵巨大的榕树，树龄应当早于华林寺大殿搬迁十几米到今址的1989年，却定然比不上北宋乾德二年（964年）吴越国王钱氏割据时，福州郡守为祈求国境安宁拆除闽王宫殿建造的"越山吉祥禅院"。禅院曾经得到宋高宗赵构御书，终于明正统九年（1444年）获得赐额"华林寺"。今天华林寺中真正的古建筑就只剩下了大殿，后增建的山门、左右配殿和廊庑无非是主题的陪衬。大殿歇山屋顶只用一层屋檐，但在斗拱层层叠叠的出挑之下透着深远；大殿屋架的形式叫作"抬梁式"，原非福建民居中惯常使用的穿斗屋架。综合斗拱和屋架的建造手法，尤其是斗拱出挑的式样，华林寺在全国唐宋木构建筑中堪称独具一格。顶尖建筑史学者更是认为它对日本镰仓时期的"大佛样"、"天竺样"建筑风格影响颇大。大殿经过历代多次重修，清朝的时候还在周围增建周廊下檐，使其看上去成为重檐的样式。不过，对比今昔影像，今天去除清代加建后的单檐样式要比为抬高等级而做的琐碎"增华"纯粹、大方得多了。逡巡之间，古树掩映下的华林寺大殿，别具风韵。虽然历尽沧桑，但余荫犹在。驻足于静谧宽敞的庭院中，华林寺大殿宏大又不失精巧的建筑结构映入眼中，不知为何总是给人一种异样的感觉，仿佛很熟悉，又那样的遥远，甚至一瞬间似乎身处异国。像这样唐宋之际中国的典型建筑，在现在的中国的文化中心地区已经是不多见了。南方濡湿，白蚁繁生，但华林寺的主要木构件却仍为九百多年前的原物，是我国长江以南最古者，不能不称为一绝。
projects.content_en: Hualin Temple is located in the northern part of Gulou District, at the southern foot of Pingshan Hill, adjacent to the Fujian Provincial Government. The main hall was originally built in 964 (the second year of Qiande reign, Northern Song) when the Wuyue Kingdom controlled Fuzhou. The local prefect constructed the "Yueshan Jixiang Chan Temple" by dismantling the Min King's palace to pray for national peace. The temple received imperial calligraphy from Emperor Gaozong of Song and was officially named "Hualin Temple" in 1444 during the Ming Dynasty. Today, only the main hall remains as genuine ancient architecture. The hall features a hip-and-gable roof with single eaves, but the layered bracket sets (dougong) create a profound sense of depth. Its roof framework uses the "tailiang" (beam-lifting) system, unlike the "chuandou" (column-and-tie) system common in Fujian residences. The combination of dougong and roof techniques makes Hualin Temple unique among Tang-Song timber buildings in China. Leading architectural historians believe it significantly influenced the "Daibutsu-yo" and "Tenjiku-yo" architectural styles during Japan's Kamakura period. Despite numerous repairs over the centuries, including Qing Dynasty additions that made it appear double-eaved, the restored single-eave form today is purer and more elegant. The main timber components remain original after over 900 years, making it the oldest surviving timber structure south of the Yangtze River — a remarkable achievement given the humid climate and termite pressure in southern China.

projects.name: 闽王祠
projects.address: 福州市鼓楼区庆城路
projects.address_en: Qingcheng Road, Gulou District, Fuzhou
highlights: 凭吊为先
历代碑刻
恩赐琅琊郡王德政碑
projects.content_zh: 五代闽国国王王审知逝世后，后晋开运三年（946年），人们把他的故居改为祠庙，永久奉祀。宋开宝七年（974年），吴越刺史钱显奉钱俶命重修府第为忠懿闽王庙。元代庙毁，明万历二十九年（1601年）奉旨重建，改称闽王祠，清末及民国初均重修。闽王庙东路为主庙，共四进，大门为福州传统祠庙常用的屏风式门楼墙，共三个拱门，中门上方嵌两块立式石碑，上面一块为"奉旨祀典"，说明着是一座列入官方祭祀的庙宇，下面一块为"唐闽忠懿王庙"；左侧门（东）上嵌横石碑书"崇德"，右侧门（西）上嵌横石碑书"报功"。门前有抱鼓石、石狮、石围栏等。进门首进为庭院，庭院正面为一平头墙，三个拱门与庙门相对应。旧时为春季仪式乞土之处，东墙嵌有"乞土胜地"石碑。过平头墙为第二进，正面围墙仅有左右侧门，中门已堵。左侧建有碑亭，内置"恩赐琅琊郡王德政碑"，碑高4.90米，宽1.87米，立于唐天复三年（960年），于兢撰文，王倜书写。碑文记述王审知家世及其治闽前期的军事、政治、经济、文化方面的政绩，还记载有当时福建与苏门答腊岛往来的史料，是研究闽国史、五代史的重要文物资料。20世纪六七十年代闽王庙首进被拆毁，后恢复维修，将平头墙拆除，使首进与第二进合为一进，按原样重建。
projects.content_en: After the death of Wang Shenzhi, King of Min during the Five Dynasties period, his former residence was converted into a memorial temple in 946 (the third year of Kaiyun reign, Later Jin). In 977 (the seventh year of Kaibao reign, Song), the Wuyue official Qian Xian rebuilt it as the Zhongyi King Min Temple under orders from Qian Chu. The temple was destroyed in the Yuan Dynasty and rebuilt in 1601 (the 29th year of Wanli reign, Ming) by imperial decree, renamed "King Min's Temple." It was further restored in the late Qing and early Republican periods. The main temple along the eastern axis has four courtyards. The entrance features a Fuzhou-style screen wall with three arched gates. Above the central gate are two vertical steles: "Fengzhi Sidian" (Imperially Approved Sacrifice) and "Tang Min Zhongyi Wang Miao" (Temple of the Loyal and Benevolent King of Min). The side gates bear horizontal inscriptions "Chongde" (Virtue Praised) and "Baogong" (Merit Recorded). The second courtyard contains a stele pavilion housing the "Enci Langya Jun Wang Dezheng Bei" (Stele of Virtuous Governance Bestowed upon the Prince of Langya), erected in 960. Standing 4.90 meters tall and 1.87 meters wide, this stele records Wang Shenzhi's family background and his military, political, economic, and cultural achievements, including historical records of contacts between Fujian and Sumatra. It is a crucial artifact for studying the history of the Min Kingdom and the Five Dynasties period.

projects.name: 三坊七巷之一——郭家大院
projects.name_en: Three Lanes and Seven Alleys I - Guo Family's Residential Complex
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 福州市鼓楼区南后街黄巷
projects.address_en: Huang Alley, Nanhou Street, Gulou District, Fuzhou
highlights: 门第家生
花厅小园
五子登科牌匾
projects.content_zh: 三坊七巷是福州南后街两侧十条坊巷的简称，包括衣锦坊、文儒坊、光禄坊，杨桥巷、郎官巷、安民巷、黄巷、塔巷、宫巷和吉庇巷。一遭走下来，感受的仅是古建筑的气氛和环境，却早已无法系统探究古建筑的设计和构造了。这种庆幸和遗憾并存的心情适用于很多考察经历，好在那些过往尘烟对个体心灵的触动并不完全依赖于尘烟是不是昨天的尘烟，只要提起那些名字。南后街黄巷郭柏荫故居门头房也挂有"五子登科"牌匾。郭柏荫是清道光十二年进士，累官至广西和湖北巡抚，署湖广总督。其父郭阶三生五子，皆登科第，民间有郭家"五子登科"的说法。看来有孩子要高考的人家除去拜文庙，似乎这里也该来拜一拜。"五子登科"牌匾的字仿咸丰皇帝的字题写；"入琼林玉树中皆宝，有仁心慈德者为祥"是郭柏荫写的；二进正厅"常惺惺法近理著己，活泼泼地吃紧为人"则是林则徐的行书八言联。林文忠公是清嘉庆年间的进士，属郭柏荫的前辈，两家的关系应该比较近。楹联的内容有谆谆教诲之意，亦可以看出林文忠公比较推崇理学正流，此人的特点是刚正不阿，但也比较守旧，从他的生平可以看出一二。不知道其后致使国家发生大变动的洋务运动，林文忠公若在世的话会支持否？郭家大院有着宏阔的格局，门板有巧妙的雕饰。书房前面小小的庭院，营造出一片安静的空间。休憩椅的做法，没有二梅书屋那么讲究。转至花厅，庭院之间，一厅、一廊、一亭、一墙、一山、一池、一桥、一树，于一人足矣。简单之处，或许才是"五子登科"要义所在。书香门第，规矩恬静，蔚然有温润之气。
projects.content_en: Three Lanes and Seven Alleys (Sanfang Qixiang) is the collective name for ten lanes and alleys on both sides of Nanhou Street in Fuzhou, including Yijin Fang, Wenru Fang, Guanglu Fang, Yangqiao Xiang, Langguan Xiang, Anmin Xiang, Huang Xiang, Ta Xiang, Gong Xiang, and Jibi Xiang. The Guo Family Mansion in Huang Alley was the residence of Guo Boyin, a jinshi (palace examination graduate) of 1832 (the 12th year of Daoguang reign), who rose to become Governor of Guangxi and Hubei and acting Viceroy of Huguang. His father Guo Jiesheng had five sons, all of whom passed the imperial examinations — giving rise to the popular saying "Five Sons Passing the Examinations." The mansion displays a "Five Sons Passing the Examinations" plaque in the style of the Xianfeng Emperor's calligraphy. The second hall features an eight-character couplet in running script by Lin Zexu, the famous Qing official and Guo Boyin's senior. The mansion's spacious layout includes an exquisitely carved door panel, a quiet courtyard before the study, and a flower hall with pavilion, corridor, wall, rockery, pond, bridge, and tree — a microcosm of scholarly refinement and temperate elegance.

projects.name: 三坊七巷之二——黄楼
projects.name_en: Three Lanes and Seven Alleys II - Yellow Tower
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 福州市鼓楼区南后街黄巷26号
projects.address_en: No. 26 Huang Alley, Nanhou Street, Gulou District, Fuzhou
highlights: 园林典故
造园手法
西花厅小黄楼
东园
projects.content_zh: 黄楼始建于唐代，崇文阁校书郎黄璞曾居于此。到了清代，林则徐的师兄、官至江苏巡抚的梁章钜，于清道光年间对黄璞旧居进行全面修葺，并建了西花厅小黄楼，以及与之配套的旧居东侧园林小筑"东园"。西花厅为双层楼阁，宽9米、深24米，面阔三间，进深五柱，穿斗式木构架，双坡顶；粉墙黛瓦、翘脊飞檐；梁架上描龙绘凤，楹门窗户都用楠木，而且做工讲究，雕刻精巧。楼上花格栏杆，檐口垂柱倒悬，雀替镂空。走廊两侧对向出挑露台，通连假山，楼下左右两侧通道小弄均塑制成雪洞。雪洞宽2米，深8米，高可容人。假山用天然的太湖石筑就，曲径盘旋通楼上。假山边点缀一座制作精巧的石拱桥，桥栏上刻有"知鱼乐处"四字，表现出入世求取功名的儒仕内心深处寄情于山水之间的一丝道家情怀。桥对岸假山内，沿石阶可登上假山之顶，东侧上有一座木构的半边亭，三面悬空，一面靠墙，宝珠结顶，四檐翘角。亭内的斗拱桥、垂柱上刻有松鼠、燕雀、蜻蜓、谷穗、玉米等动植物题材，亭周装饰有12个小悬钟。凉亭不大，可尽览整个园林。
projects.content_en: Yellow Tower was originally built in the Tang Dynasty, where Huang Pu, a proofreading official at the Chongwen Pavilion, once resided. In the Qing Dynasty, Liang Zhangju — a senior fellow of Lin Zexu who rose to Governor of Jiangsu — comprehensively restored the former residence during the Daoguang reign and added the Western Flower Hall (Little Yellow Tower) and the complementary garden complex "Eastern Garden" on the east side. The Western Flower Hall is a two-story pavilion measuring 9 meters wide and 24 meters deep, with three bays and five columns in depth, using a column-and-tie (chuandou) timber frame with a double-slope roof. It features white walls and black tiles, upturned ridges and flying eaves, with dragon and phoenix paintings on the beams and nanmu wood doors and windows with exquisite carving. The upper floor has lattice railings, inverted hanging columns under the eaves, and openwork spandrel brackets. Corridors on both sides open onto terraces connecting to a rockery, while the passageways below are shaped like snow caves (2m wide, 8m deep). The rockery, built from natural Taihu stones, has winding paths leading upstairs. A delicate stone arch bridge beside the rockery bears the inscription "Zhi Yu Le Chu" (Knowing the Joy of Fish), expressing a Daoist longing for landscape beneath the Confucian pursuit of official success. Atop the rockery stands a half-pavilion with three sides suspended, decorated with carvings of squirrels, swallows, dragonflies, grain, and corn, plus 12 small hanging bells around its perimeter.

projects.name: 三坊七巷之三——林觉民故居
projects.name_en: Three Lanes and Seven Alleys III - Former Residence of Lin Juemin
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 福州市鼓楼区杨桥路86号
projects.address_en: No. 86 Yangqiao Road, Gulou District, Fuzhou
highlights: 凭吊
黄花岗七十二烈士
冰心故居
林徽因
projects.content_zh: 也是在南后街一带，还有黄花岗七十二烈士之一的林觉民的故居。林觉民有一位兄长，林长民，其女则为建筑界皆知，林徽因。如此的机缘，使这个居所也曾留下林徽因的倩影。林觉民就义后，家人远遁。"福州城内南后街杨桥巷口万兴桶石店后"的居所为谢姓所购，那便是冰心一家，于是这里也便成为了冰心的故居。"我们这所房子，有好几个院子，但它不像北方的'四合院'的院子，只是在一排或一进屋子的前面，有一个长方形的'天井'，每个'天井'里都有一口井，这几乎是福州房子的特点。这所大房里，除了住人的以外，就是客室和书房。几乎所有的厅堂和客室、书房的柱子上，墙壁上都贴着或挂着书画。"这是冰心的描述。再说什么也是多余。徜徉檐下，却也不觉得悬挂宣传图像、文字的墙面如同先前一样的多余，也原谅了近年来油漆的"盖古烁今"，倒是由衷地感谢大院没有被拆掉，像磁铁一样地形成了个什么"场"，容得下你我含泪的追思。
projects.content_en: Also in the Nanhou Street area stands the former residence of Lin Juemin, one of the 72 Martyrs of the Huanghuagang Uprising. Lin Juemin's elder brother Lin Changmin was the father of Lin Huiyin, the renowned architect — a remarkable coincidence that links this residence to one of China's most celebrated architectural figures. After Lin Juemin's execution, his family fled, and the house was purchased by the Xie family — the family of the writer Bing Xin — making it also Bing Xin's former home. Bing Xin described it: "Our house had several courtyards, but unlike northern 'siheyuan,' each row or section of rooms had a rectangular 'tianjing' (sky well) in front, and every tianjing contained a well — this is characteristic of Fuzhou houses. Besides bedrooms, the house had guest rooms and a study. Almost all the pillars and walls of the halls, guest rooms, and study were covered with calligraphy and paintings." Wandering beneath the eaves, one feels grateful that this great courtyard was not demolished, that it remains like a magnet creating a "field" capable of holding tearful remembrance.

projects.name: 三坊七巷之四——二梅书屋
projects.name_en: Three Lanes and Seven Alleys IV - Studio of Two Plum Blossoms
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 福州市鼓楼区南后街郎官巷
projects.address_en: Langguan Alley, Nanhou Street, Gulou District, Fuzhou
highlights: 书屋
花厅
七星洞
掇石
书法碧纱橱
projects.content_zh: 二梅书屋名字听上去文雅可人，很有点小家碧玉的味道，实际上却是三坊七巷数得上的一座巨宅。这座巨宅位于福州市郎官巷，是清代凤池书院山长林星章的旧居，因书斋名"二梅书屋"，而成为这座宅院的代名词。二梅书屋始建于明末，迄今已有三百多年历史，清代道光、同治年间曾大修过，东、中、西三路毗连，是单层土木结构的建筑群。从位于郎官巷的大门进入，入眼便是宏大的格局。
projects.content_en: The name "Studio of Two Plum Blossoms" sounds refined and delicate, evoking the image of a modest scholar's retreat — yet it is actually one of the largest mansions in Three Lanes and Seven Alleys. Located in Langguan Alley, it was the former residence of Lin Xingzhang, headmaster of the Fengchi Academy during the Qing Dynasty, and takes its name from his study. Originally built in the late Ming Dynasty over 300 years ago, it was extensively renovated during the Daoguang and Tongzhi reigns of the Qing. The complex comprises three connected axes (east, central, west) of single-story earthen-wood structures. Entering through the gate on Langguan Alley, one is immediately struck by the grand scale of the layout.

projects.name: 三坊七巷之五——郑宅水榭戏台
projects.name_en: Three Lanes and Seven Alleys V - Waterside Pavilion and Theatrical Stage of Zheng's Residence
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 福州市鼓楼区南后街衣锦坊4号
projects.address_en: No. 4 Yijin Fang, Nanhou Street, Gulou District, Fuzhou
highlights: 戏台
表演与观赏
水榭
雪洞
女宾专用席
projects.content_zh: 水榭戏台位于三坊七巷衣锦坊东口北侧，创建于明万历间（1573—1620年），后经多次改建。清道光年间，成为三座相邻、全坊最大宅院，为郑氏所居。第一座为主座大院，第二座为杂院，第三座为花厅园林，四面围墙，皆用穿斗式木构架，双坡顶，面积达2000多平方米。主建筑大院坐北朝南，临街六扇大门，入门有门厅，左右耳房。进石框大门三面环廊，中有天井。厅堂面阔三间，进深七柱，大厅特大。第二、三进都是面阔三间，进深五柱，每进东侧都有小门可通第二座别院。别院由书斋、佛堂、厨房、饭厅、库房等构成。再往东，又有小门通第三座花厅园林。花厅最大特色是水榭、戏台，是府内聚会、演戏地方。水池面积56平方米，建在水池上面的戏台，坐南向北，面积约30平方米，台后有化妆室，池外左右两侧有酒楼，酒楼后有假山、雪洞。另外还专门修建了后台通向看台的通道，以备点戏之用，以免传唤之人跑来跑去影响观剧的心情，可谓独具匠心，也足见主人的品位对细节的要求都是很高的。戏台正面建楼阁，坐北向南，前廊后堂，穿斗式木构架，单檐歇山顶，可供聚会、观剧。墙头灰塑、屋脊等均精工细作，独具风格。值得一提的是观戏楼实际上是有二层的，但从戏台以外的任何视角看去，都很难发现楼上有楼。据说这是女宾专用席，这样她们既可以看戏，又不至于被不安分的男宾偷窥芳容。坐在观戏楼的台基上，下午的阳光照射过来，不时有导游带领旅游团进来用不同的声调把戏台的故事反复演讲，然后又是安静得只有鸟鸣。坐的时间长了，突然感觉人生也就是一场大戏，只是我们各自演得投入，不自知罢了。
projects.content_en: The waterside theatrical stage is located on the north side of the eastern entrance of Yijin Fang in Three Lanes and Seven Alleys. Originally built during the Wanli reign of the Ming Dynasty (1573-1620) and repeatedly modified, it became the largest mansion complex in the entire district during the Daoguang reign of the Qing, owned by the Zheng family. The complex comprises three adjacent courtyards: the main residence, a service courtyard, and a flower hall garden, all enclosed by walls with column-and-tie timber frames and double-slope roofs, covering over 2,000 square meters. The main hall faces south with three bays and seven columns in depth — exceptionally large. The flower hall's most distinctive feature is the waterside pavilion and theatrical stage, used for gatherings and performances. A 56-square-meter pond supports a stage of about 30 square meters facing north, with a dressing room behind it and viewing towers on both sides, followed by rockeries and snow caves. A dedicated passage connects the backstage to the viewing area for summoning performers — a thoughtful detail revealing the owner's refined taste. The viewing tower actually has two stories, but the upper level is nearly invisible from any angle outside the stage — said to be a private seating area for female guests, allowing them to watch performances without being seen by male guests. Sitting on the viewing platform in the afternoon sun, listening to tour guides recount the stage's stories in different tones, then falling silent with only birdsong, one suddenly feels that life itself is but a grand play — we all perform so earnestly, unaware of our own roles.

projects.name: 文庙
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 福州市鼓楼区圣庙路
projects.address_en: Shengmiao Road, Gulou District, Fuzhou
highlights: 早期石构件
石刻
市民文化生活气氛
如意斗拱
projects.content_zh: 福州文庙自唐大历起，宋明清各代踵事增华。清咸丰元年火灾毁坏之后，又重建于咸丰年间。按中轴线自南至北依次为外门垣、棂星门、泮池左右廊、大成门、东西庑、月台、大成殿、后照壁，不经意间，颇具古风的石刻在提醒人们这里悠久的历史。棂星门亦称先师门。现存石构件属明代所建。六柱三开间，对称布局，每根柱脚用两块夹杆石前后对夹锁固。东西两翼墙上镶嵌着"江汉秋阳"、"金声玉振"石刻，为楷书、阴文。夕阳西下，大成殿广场上已经很少有人，石柱林立，石月台清静，廊腰缦回，檐牙高啄，一切越发彰显建筑的肃穆端庄。和北京或山东的孔庙所不同，这里的文庙建筑群包括大成殿在内全部是灰瓦而非金色的琉璃瓦，这样反而更贴近儒家的精神实质，少了一些高高在上的威严，多了几分端庄儒雅的平民之气。对于寻访建筑而言，大成殿上层檐令人眼花缭乱的如意斗拱应当是主角；但这里真正的主角，却应当是今天的市民。古建筑，不是一个最有品位的容器吗？
projects.content_en: Fuzhou's Temple of Confucius dates back to the Dali reign of the Tang Dynasty, with successive additions and renovations through the Song, Ming, and Qing dynasties. After a fire in the first year of the Xianfeng reign (1851), it was rebuilt during the same period. Along the central axis from south to north stand the outer wall, Lingxing Gate, Pan Pond with side corridors, Dacheng Gate, east and west annexes, moon terrace, Dacheng Hall, and rear screen wall. The Lingxing Gate (also called Xianshi Gate) retains Ming Dynasty stone components — six columns in three bays with a symmetrical layout, each column foot secured by two clamping stones. The east and west wing walls bear carved stone inscriptions "Jianghan Qiuyang" and "Jinsheng Yuzhen" in regular script intaglio. Unlike the Confucius temples in Beijing or Shandong, all buildings here including the Dacheng Hall use grey tiles rather than golden glazed tiles — an arrangement that actually comes closer to the Confucian spirit, lessening lofty majesty and adding a dignified yet approachable scholarly atmosphere. For architectural visitors, the dazzling ruyi bracket sets on the upper eaves of the Dacheng Hall are the highlight; but the true protagonists today are the local citizens. Is not an ancient building the most tasteful of containers?

projects.name: 仓山林浦村
projects.address: 福州市仓山区
projects.address_en: Cangshan District, Fuzhou
highlights: 建筑群
尚书第木结构细节
斗拱和屋架
廉江书院
projects.content_zh: 林浦是一个小村镇，坐落在福州市区的仓山开发区，从满目的现代化高大建筑一转身来到林浦，看到坐落在村头的天后宫和太保祠，有一种闹中取静的感觉。村里保留了大量的古建筑，有行宫、戏台、祠堂、宅邸、牌楼、小桥、古井等，离福州城区近在咫尺有这么个所在，有些令人惊讶，也是古建筑爱好者不应错过的。作为闽江边的一个小村庄，林浦的发迹来源于一位落难皇帝。当时南宋被元朝攻打，皇帝由临安来到林浦，同时带来了很多文武官员、兵丁杂役等，在林浦的江边修建了一座御码头，今天虽然重修一新，但依稀可以看到一些宋代风格的石栏杆点缀其间。码头的旁边修建了一座行宫，这一组建筑现在成了林浦最醒目的地标。后来南宋的末代皇帝继续南迁，有些人留了下来，不少林浦人认为自己的先人就是那时跟着皇帝过来的。后来行宫被改成了寺庙，祭祀南宋的皇帝，虽然当时他还在世，现在人说因为他曾经开仓放赈，实际上可能是他的臣民为了表达对宋室的留恋，寄托一点国亡家破的愁思。但好景不长，元兵接踵而至，当地的军民又把行宫改成妈祖庙，使元军误以为他们是迎当地土著，才躲过一劫。再后来战乱结束了，国家迎来了大一统的空前繁荣稳定的局面，只是主人换成了蒙古大汗忽必烈。那些包括林浦人在内的先朝遗民、难民想要重回主流社会有两个途径：读书或经商。这在林浦这个小村的历史上都有体现。林浦的文风极盛，在天后宫的旁边又修建了规模比较大的有名的廉江书院，乡里也是人才辈出，很多进士的宅第就是明证。经商方面也有成就者，村里现在还有一处规模宏大的建筑，就是本地出身的商人"做了慈禧太后的生意"发了大财。慈禧太后当年重修颐和园，遇到的两大难题，一是没钱，国帑空虚，入不敷出；一是没物，到清末自然环境的破坏也是堪忧，各省已经难觅大量的可做栋梁之材的高大木植。这位商人的成功，大概是这两个问题都被他解决了，闽地当时可能还是盛产木材的。
projects.content_en: Linpu is a small village located in the Cangshan Development Zone of Fuzhou. Turning away from the surrounding modern high-rises into Linpu, one finds the Tianhou Temple and Taibao Shrine at the village entrance — a sense of tranquility amid bustle. The village preserves numerous ancient buildings, including imperial palaces, stages, ancestral halls, mansions, memorial arches, bridges, and wells. Its proximity to central Fuzhou makes this survival all the more surprising and essential for architecture enthusiasts. Linpu's rise traces back to a deposed emperor: when the Southern Song was attacked by the Mongols, the emperor fled from Lin'an to Linpu, bringing civil and military officials, soldiers, and servants. An imperial wharf was built by the Min River — today restored but still showing traces of Song-style stone railings. Beside the wharf stood an imperial palace, now Linpu's most prominent landmark. When the last Song emperor continued south, some remained; many Linpu families trace their ancestry to these followers. The palace was later converted into a temple worshipping the Song emperor. When Mongol troops arrived, locals converted it again into a Mazu temple to avoid persecution. After the wars ended and the Yuan Dynasty brought stability, the former refugees sought re-entry into mainstream society through two paths: scholarship or commerce. Both are evident in Linpu's history. The village had a strong scholarly tradition — the notable Lianjiang Academy was built beside the Tianhou Temple, producing many jinshi graduates whose mansions still stand. Commerce also flourished: one local merchant made a fortune supplying materials for Empress Dowager Cixi's restoration of the Summer Palace, solving both the funding and timber shortages of the late Qing — Fujian was then still rich in timber.

projects.name: 仓山龙瑞寺大殿
projects.name_en: Main Hall of Longrui Temple in Cangshan
projects.address: 福州市仓山区城门镇梁厝村
projects.address_en: Liangcuo Village, Chengmen Town, Cangshan District, Fuzhou
highlights: 千佛陶塔的老家
宋代石作
唐代须弥座
宋代古井石槽
projects.content_zh: 龙瑞寺始建于唐天复元年（901年），清光绪十六年（1890年）重建。寺坐北朝南，中轴线从南至北，主要建筑依次为山门、天王殿、大雄宝殿、观音阁（藏经楼）。天王殿与大雄宝殿间，东西分别设大士殿和伽蓝殿。今存建筑皆光绪后所建。大雄宝殿为晚近重修，歇山顶，面阔五间，副阶周匝，但廊柱系后补木柱。檐柱及金柱均为石柱，截面圆形，分为八瓣，柱头开卯口。殿基台明为石质须弥座，传为唐代遗物，但未见题款。束腰左右各六块浮雕，题材内容各异，从东到西依次解说为：双狮戏球、荣华富贵、椿萱双禄、怜子爱妻、封侯挂印、鲤跳龙门、士子游春、海族献宝、花荣枝茂、龟鹤同寿、四季长春、八蛮贡象。院里还有一口古井，以及两个大石槽。井口石上刻着"绍兴乙丑住山广客施财重建"、"众缘造井黄干舍石"的字样；石槽上则分别刻"绍兴乙丑"和"绍熙癸丑"的年号，是宋代的古物。寺内大殿前原有无价之宝千佛陶塔，今移至涌泉寺。大殿垂脊端头今尚有陶塔状饰件，或与之有某种联系。大殿前的院落被唤作"塔院"，是对亲人离去的纪念。古刹是名副其实的，但古朴非常的石作成了寺中仅有的长者。躁动着寻求致富机会的梁厝村，已然没有留住那一对珍贵的陶塔，她还能把这几位无言的长者挽留多久呢？
projects.content_en: Longrui Temple was founded in 901 (the first year of Tianfu reign, Tang) and rebuilt in 1890 (the 16th year of Guangxu reign, Qing). Facing south, its central axis from south to north comprises the gate, Heavenly King Hall, Mahavira Hall, and Guanyin Pavilion (Scripture Library). The Mahavira Hall, recently restored, has a hip-and-gable roof with five bays and surrounding ambulatory, though the corridor columns are later wooden replacements. The eave and interior columns are stone, octagonal in section with mortises at the tops. The hall's stone platform (xumizuo) is said to be a Tang relic, though without inscription. Its waist section features twelve relief carvings on each side, depicting from east to west: twin lions playing with a ball, glory and wealth, parental blessings, loving wife and children, conferring titles, carp leaping the dragon gate, scholars spring outing, sea creatures offering treasures, flourishing flowers, turtle and crane longevity, eternal spring, and eight barbarians paying tribute. The courtyard contains an ancient well and two large stone troughs. The well rim bears inscriptions "Shaoxing Yichou — Monk Guangke donated funds for reconstruction" and "Collective well construction — Huang Gan donated stone"; the troughs bear the reign dates "Shaoxing Yichou" and "Shaoxi Guichou" — all Song Dynasty artifacts. The temple's original priceless treasure, a pair of thousand-Buddha pottery pagodas, was moved to Yongquan Temple. The ends of the main hall's vertical ridges still bear pagoda-shaped ornaments, possibly related. The front courtyard is called "Pagoda Courtyard" — a memorial to what was lost. The ancient temple lives up to its name, but its rustic stonework is now the only true elder remaining.

projects.name: 晋安多亭桥
projects.address: 福州市晋安区日溪乡梓山村店坂
projects.address_en: Dianban, Zishan Village, Rixi Township, Jin'an District, Fuzhou
highlights: 木拱桥结构做法
追踪古道和木拱桥的演变
廊桥
projects.content_zh: 多亭桥位于福州市晋安区日溪乡梓山村店坂，事实上还是与闽侯的那些桥距离较近。到达日溪乡便可看到一个景点的指示牌"皇帝洞"，按其指示而行，多亭桥就在该景点的入口处。多亭桥又名店坂桥、状元廊桥，建于清嘉庆十六年（1811年），是一座木拱廊桥。桥全长约30米，宽约4米，单孔跨度约20米。桥屋为九开间，穿斗式木构架，双坡顶，桥屋两侧设板凳，供行人休憩。桥的木拱结构采用"八"字形拱架，由数十根圆木穿插搭接而成，不用一钉一铆，是中国传统木拱桥的典型做法。多亭桥是福州地区保存较为完好的木拱廊桥之一，对于研究中国古代木拱桥技术和闽浙地区廊桥文化具有重要价值。
projects.content_en: Duoting Bridge is located at Dianban, Zishan Village, Rixi Township, Jin'an District, Fuzhou — actually closer to the bridges of Minhou County. Upon reaching Rixi Township, a sign for the "Emperor's Cave" scenic area points the way; Duoting Bridge stands at the entrance. Also known as Dianban Bridge or Zhuangyuan Covered Bridge, it was built in 1811 (the 16th year of Jiaqing reign, Qing). It is a timber-arch covered bridge, approximately 30 meters long and 4 meters wide, with a single span of about 20 meters. The bridge house has nine bays with a column-and-tie timber frame and double-slope roof, with benches on both sides for resting travelers. The timber arch structure uses a "figure-eight" arch frame composed of dozens of logs interlocked without a single nail or rivet — a classic technique of traditional Chinese timber arch bridges. Duoting Bridge is one of the best-preserved timber-arch covered bridges in the Fuzhou area, of significant value for studying ancient Chinese timber bridge technology and the covered bridge culture of the Fujian-Zhejiang region.

projects.name: 晋安闽王墓
projects.name_en: Tomb of King Min in Jin'an
projects.address: 福州市鼓楼区庆城路
projects.address_en: Qingcheng Road, Gulou District, Fuzhou
highlights: 砖石结构
装饰纹样
王审知墓
projects.content_zh: 王审知（862—925年），字信通，又字详卿，光州固始（今属河南省）人。唐末，从其兄王潮随王绪起兵。唐光启元年（885年）入闽。唐光化元年（898年），任福州威武军节度使。五代梁开平二年（908年），封琅琊王。五代梁开平四年（910年），受封为闽王。王审知卒于后唐同光三年（925年），初葬于福州城北凤池山，后唐长兴三年（932年），迁葬今址。墓前有一条石墁神道，长63米，宽3.7米，两旁尚余文物石翁仲和石兽，凋零之感令人叹息。墓前有石供桌与石香炉，均晚近之物。墓经1981年重修，原为青砖，今改条石青砖混砌。墓室可进入，但室内已非原状陈列，甚至有垃圾杂陈。墓室为砖砌拱券，左右分别为王审知墓和王公夫人任氏墓。明嘉靖间墓室被盗。墓后今存"唐闽忠懿王墓"碑一通，笏头碣，系明万历三十年所立。石像意态沧桑，墓室破败，更添无奈，对比那些当代添加的牌楼和雕像，无端地在胸中激起了强烈的批判冲动，或可原谅远处的高压线，却无法原谅今天闽人心目中对闽王的伪敬意。
projects.content_en: Wang Shenzhi (862-925), courtesy name Xintong and also Xiangqing, was a native of Gushi, Guangzhou (now in Henan Province). In the late Tang, he followed his brother Wang Chao in the uprising led by Wang Xu, entering Fujian in 885. In 898 he became Military Commissioner of the Weiwu Army in Fuzhou. In 908 he was enfeoffed as Prince of Langya, and in 910 as King of Min. Wang Shenzhi died in 925 (the third year of Tongguang reign, Later Tang) and was initially buried at Fengchi Mountain north of Fuzhou, then reinterred at the present site in 932 (the third year of Changxing reign). A stone-paved spirit path, 63 meters long and 3.7 meters wide, leads to the tomb, flanked by remaining stone figures and animals in a state of poignant decay. The tomb was restored in 1981, originally of grey brick but now a mix of dressed stone and brick. The burial chambers are accessible but no longer in original condition, even containing litter. The brick-vaulted chambers hold the tombs of Wang Shenzhi and his wife Lady Ren on left and right. The tomb was robbed during the Jiajing reign of the Ming. A stele behind the tomb reads "Tomb of the Loyal and Benevolent King of Min of Tang," erected in the 30th year of Wanli reign (1602). The weathered stone figures and dilapidated chambers evoke helplessness; in contrast, the contemporary memorial arches and statues provoke a strong critical impulse — one might forgive the distant power lines, but not the false reverence for King Min in the hearts of Fujian people today.

projects.name: 晋安涌泉寺·千佛陶塔
projects.name_en: Yongquan Temple and Thousand-Buddha Pottery Pagoda in Jin'an
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 福州市晋安区鼓山风景区
projects.address_en: Gushan Scenic Area, Jin'an District, Fuzhou
highlights: 千佛陶塔
陶体结构
宋元丰五年原物
全国现存孤品
projects.content_zh: 涌泉寺位于福州著名的鼓山风景区半山腰，沿着曲折的盘山公路驱车而上，沿途树木葱郁，闽江风光尽收眼底。涌泉寺始建于唐代，后经多次重修，仍保持着明清的建筑风格。寺依山偎谷，槛廊连缀，25座大小殿堂簇拥着大雄宝殿。大雄宝殿巨柱耸立，飞檐凌空，雄伟辉煌。走近涌泉寺门，看到的是真正的宝贝，一对"千佛陶塔"。东边一座是"庄严劫千佛宝塔"（庄严劫指过去佛之意），西边为"贤劫千佛宝塔"（贤劫即现代佛之意）。双塔形制全同，系捏制陶构件叠累而成。八边形平面，仿楼阁式，塔身九层，通体土红色。下承须弥座，最下层为八边形双层石基座。须弥座八角各设力士，造型生动别致，装束简单，具世俗乡土特征。塔刹为金属制，仰覆莲花，冠以宝珠。塔身各层层出七铺作斗拱，单杪双下昂，补间铺作用一朵。塔身贴塑小佛像，共1078尊。各层出檐皆做出筒瓦、瓦当、椽飞等构件，工艺精巧。塔的制作时间及工匠姓名有铭文为证。东塔座铭文曰："当山比丘造乾恭寮四恩三有法界含生，时发诚心敬造庄严千佛宝塔一座，安于大殿前，永为四众瞻礼，然愿当值。时元丰五年，岁次壬戌年谨识。院僧岏若观，住持传法，沙门载文，匠人高成"；西塔铭为："闽县永盛里清信弟子郑富与室中谢三十一娘，各为四恩、三有、法界含生同发心敬造贤劫千佛宝塔一座，舍入龙瑞殿大殿前，永充供养。然愿今生宿世罪业消除，合家男女新妇孙侄等，现处当来，善牙增长，次希有情俱沾利乐。时大宋元丰五年，岁次壬戌十月初一日谨识。缘化僧若观，劝首住持传法，沙门载文，匠人高成。"足证双塔确是宋元丰五年（1082年）原物，放眼全国，二塔更是现存孤品。对于研究宋代建筑、制陶艺术来说，如何评价这一对宝物都是不过分的。双塔本来是南郊龙瑞寺的，能够移驻至此，确实是涌泉寺的福分。
projects.content_en: Yongquan Temple sits halfway up Mount Gu, Fuzhou's famous scenic area. Winding up the mountain road, one enjoys lush trees and panoramic views of the Min River. Founded in the Tang Dynasty and repeatedly restored, the temple retains its Ming-Qing architectural style. Nestled against the mountain and valley, its corridors connect 25 halls of various sizes clustered around the Mahavira Hall, whose giant columns and flying eaves create a majestic presence. Approaching the temple gate, one encounters the true treasure: a pair of "Thousand-Buddha Pottery Pagodas." The eastern pagoda is the "Thousand-Buddha Treasure Pagoda of the Glorious Eon" (referring to past Buddhas), and the western is the "Thousand-Buddha Treasure Pagoda of the Worthy Eon" (referring to present Buddhas). Identical in form, both are assembled from hand-molded pottery components. Octagonal in plan, pavilion-style, nine stories tall, and entirely terracotta-red. They rest on xumizuo pedestals above octagonal double-tiered stone bases. Each corner of the xumizuo features a lively guardian figure in simple, vernacular attire. The metal finials feature upturned and downturned lotuses crowned with jewels. Each story displays seven-tier bracket sets (dougong) with single huaigong and double ang, with one intermediate set per bay. The pagoda bodies bear 1,078 small attached Buddha figures. Every eave reproduces tube tiles, eaves tiles, and rafters with exquisite craftsmanship. Inscriptions confirm the date and artisans: the eastern pagoda was made in 1082 (the fifth year of Yuanfeng reign, Northern Song) by monk Ruoguan, abbot monk Zaiwen, and craftsman Gao Cheng; the western by lay disciple Zheng Fu and his wife, with the same artisans. Both are verified originals from 1082 — the only surviving examples of their kind in all of China. For the study of Song architecture and ceramic art, their value cannot be overstated. Originally from Longrui Temple in the southern suburbs, their relocation here is indeed Yongquan Temple's good fortune.

projects.name: 马尾迥龙桥
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 福州市马尾区亭江镇闽安村
projects.address_en: Min'an Village, Tingjiang Town, Mawei District, Fuzhou
highlights: 石桥形式
早期石构件
六块古碑
齐天府
projects.content_zh: 福州的迥龙桥，历史文献中反映也曾被称为飞盖桥和沈公桥，有着古老的身世。古人称迥龙桥始建于唐代，千百年来水患频繁，南宋至清代，乃至民国间对桥体屡有重修。现状则为1931年再修的结果。迥龙桥为石构平梁式，六墩五孔，全长66米，宽4.8米，船型桥墩。桥北端有跨街桥头亭，亭间有碑3通，桥北连圣王庙，南端有玄帝亭。不知何时桥头的圣王庙成了齐天府，供奉齐天大圣。当地人心目中或许还是认为能够七十二般变化的猴子法力大些，各种本领也来得更加实际。桥梁本体之外，在其桥头南、北侧现共立有六块石碑尤其值得珍视。桥南侧两块石碑分别为"飞盖桥碑"及"沈公桥碑"（康熙）；桥北侧两块石碑为"沈公桥碑"（道光）和捐款人名碑，另两块石碑为"民国尊王庙碑"。环顾人行桥上，日日如昨，碑文无声，岁岁漫灭。或者哪天，在近旁起架新桥的时候，没人能想得起模糊的石兽还到底是不是石兽，即使大家依然津津乐道着齐天大圣的武功。
projects.content_en: Fuzhou's Jionglong Bridge, also known in historical records as Feigai Bridge and Shengong Bridge, has an ancient pedigree. According to tradition it was first built in the Tang Dynasty; over the millennia, frequent floods led to repeated repairs from the Southern Song through the Qing and even the Republican period. The present form results from a 1931 restoration. A stone beam bridge with six piers and five spans, it measures 66 meters long and 4.8 meters wide, with boat-shaped piers. At the north end stands a street-spanning bridgehead pavilion containing three steles, connected to the Shengwang Temple; the south end has the Xuandi Pavilion. At some point the Shengwang Temple became a Qitian Temple worshipping the Great Sage Equal to Heaven (Sun Wukong) — locals apparently found the 72-transformations monkey's powers more practical. Beyond the bridge itself, six ancient steles erected at both ends are especially precious: on the south side, the "Feigai Bridge Stele" and "Shengong Bridge Stele" (Kangxi reign); on the north, the "Shengong Bridge Stele" (Daoguang reign), a donor name stele, and two "Republican Era Zunwang Temple Steles." Walking the bridge day after day, the inscriptions remain silent, slowly eroding with the years. Perhaps one day, when a new bridge is built nearby, no one will remember whether the blurred stone beasts were ever stone beasts at all — even as everyone continues to delight in the martial prowess of the Great Sage.

projects.name: 马尾罗星塔
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 福州市马尾区罗星塔公园内
projects.address_en: Luoxing Pagoda Park, Mawei District, Fuzhou
highlights: 石结构与装饰
比例尺度设计
中国塔
国际公认航标
projects.content_zh: 罗星山在闽江下游三水合汇处，罗星塔正在罗星山山顶。回望江心，若恰逢潮涨，江流与海水冲激于塔下，便会自然理解罗星塔原为古代港口航海灯塔的标志。早在明初，此塔就标绘在郑和航海图和以后的航海针经图册里，也是国际公认的海上重要航标之一，世界邮政地名称之为"中国塔"。罗星塔传为宋代柳七娘所建，是一段烈女奠夫的故事。可以肯定的是明万历年间罗星塔毁，至天启年间，得到著名学者徐渤等人倡议，在宋代塔座的基础上复建。清末一次台风毁坏塔顶，重建之时以一颗直径近7米的铁球嵌为顶，遂成今貌。石塔为仿楼阁式样，塔高31.5米，八边形，七层，收分明显，塔身素朴无饰，不做浮雕，仅开门窗洞口。塔身向西开门，中有石阶，可盘旋登顶。二层有石龛，龛内有塔铭，终无树字可辨，据文献则有"中流砥柱，险要绝伦，以靖海疆，以御外侮"等语。各层塔身之上也每面或龛或门，角部立方石柱，突出墙面，柱头安栌斗，其上各角更斜出一华拱，做法颇有古风。逐层檐口其余部位则并不再做装饰，仅施出挑，轮廓圆和，沧桑出棱角磨灭，恰似片片莲瓣。每层塔栏杆为1961年加固塔身时增设的。塔顶原有一小窗，供守塔人点灯导航之用。
projects.content_en: Luoxing Mountain stands at the confluence of three rivers in the lower Min River, and Luoxing Pagoda crowns its summit. Looking back at the river center at high tide, as river current and sea surge collide beneath the pagoda, one naturally understands that Luoxing Pagoda was originally a navigation beacon for the ancient port. As early as the early Ming, it appeared on Zheng He's nautical charts and subsequent navigation manuals; it is also internationally recognized as one of the most important maritime landmarks, known in world postal geography as the "China Tower." Tradition attributes its founding to Liu Qiniang of the Song Dynasty in a story of a loyal wife honoring her husband. What is certain is that the pagoda was destroyed during the Wanli reign and rebuilt in the Tianqi reign (1621-1627) on the Song foundation, advocated by the renowned scholar Xu Bo. A late Qing typhoon destroyed the top; reconstruction capped it with an iron ball nearly 7 meters in diameter, giving it its present appearance. The stone pagoda is pavilion-style, 31.5 meters tall, octagonal, seven stories, with pronounced tapering. The body is plain without relief carving, pierced only by door and window openings. A door on the west side leads to stone steps spiraling to the top. The second story has a stone niche with a pagoda inscription, now illegible; records cite phrases such as "pillar of the midstream, unparalleled in strategic importance, pacifying the maritime frontier, resisting foreign aggression." Each story features niches or doors on every face; square stone columns project at the corners, topped with cap blocks (ludou) from which diagonal huaigong bracket arms extend — a technique of considerable antiquity. The remaining eave areas are unadorned, simply overhanging with rounded contours; weathered edges resemble lotus petals. The railings on each story were added during a 1961 reinforcement. The top originally had a small window for the keeper to light a navigation lamp.

projects.name: 东关寨
projects.address: 福州福清市一都镇东山村
projects.address_en: Dongshan Village, Yidu Town, Fuqing City, Fuzhou
highlights: 建筑群
石木夯土构造
防御性寨子
穿斗式构架
projects.content_zh: 东关寨的历史可以上溯到清乾隆元年（1736年），为当地何姓家族兴建。这是一座坐东朝西的、由高大宽广的石砌台基托举起来的寨子。主入口面向西偏南15度方向，寨前有石铺埕地，矮墙围合，埕中设阶台通寨门。东关寨平面呈长方形，宽55米，长76米，环寨一周260米。寨墙高约10米，厚约2米，墙体下半部以花岗岩石块砌建，其上再筑土墙，墙上开窗和小孔，供瞭望及射击之用。寨子呈中轴线对称布局，三进院，上下两层，剖面呈阶梯状，依山势层层叠落。中路为主要公共空间，东西两路为横厝。环寨有回廊四合，连通各进院落。沿廊布置美人靠，可供休憩。二进院正房为祠堂，是寨中最重要的公共空间，承担婚丧庆典等功能。悬山式屋顶，正脊两端微微起翘，曲线尤为优美。两山做封火山墙，屋面铺仰合板瓦。祠堂为穿斗式构架，面阔五间，保存完好。月梁看面及底面满做镂雕，斗拱、雀替、垂花柱、额枋出头等部位俱有繁复雕饰，纹样包括花卉植物、人物故事等，造型灵动，做工精美。前檐柱础如坐斗形，四面浮雕人物故事。徜徉其间，淳朴古旧的屋瓦、木构件多得以保留，格局更是出乎意料的完好，算来距今也有近300年的历史了——清代自有清代的味道。叩开屋门，交谈之间得知现在寨中仍有六户人家共约60口居住寨中。
projects.content_en: Dongguan Stockade dates back to 1736 (the first year of Qianlong reign, Qing), built by the local He clan. It is a west-facing stockade elevated on a tall, broad stone platform. The main entrance faces 15 degrees south of west; before it lies a stone-paved courtyard enclosed by a low wall, with steps leading to the gate. Rectangular in plan, 55 meters wide and 76 meters long, with a perimeter of 260 meters. The stockade walls stand about 10 meters high and 2 meters thick; the lower half is built of granite blocks, with rammed earth above, pierced by windows and small holes for observation and shooting. The layout is symmetrical along a central axis, with three courtyards and two stories, the section stepping down the hillside in tiers. The central axis serves as the main public space, with side wings on east and west. A surrounding cloister connects all courtyards, lined with "beauty rests" (meirenkao) for resting. The main hall of the second courtyard is the ancestral hall, the most important public space for weddings, funerals, and celebrations. It has an overhanging gable roof with gracefully upturned ridge ends and fire-sealing gable walls, covered with overlapping flat tiles. The hall uses a column-and-tie (chuandou) frame with five bays, well preserved. The crescent beams (yueliang) are fully carved on face and underside; bracket sets, spandrel brackets (queti), pendant columns, and beam ends all bear elaborate carvings of flowers, plants, and narrative scenes, lively and exquisitely wrought. The front-eave column bases are shaped like sitting cap blocks, with narrative reliefs on all four sides. Wandering through, the plain old tiles and timber components are largely preserved, and the layout is surprisingly intact after nearly 300 years — the Qing Dynasty has its own flavor. Knocking on doors and chatting, one learns that six families totaling about 60 people still live within the stockade.

projects.name: 黄阁重纶石坊
projects.address: 福州福清市利桥街
projects.address_en: Liqiao Street, Fuqing City, Fuzhou
highlights: 石仿木结构
石雕装饰
故事表现
叶向高
projects.content_zh: 黄阁重纶石坊，得名于坊上那四个大字。建坊由来，则写在大匾之下的"诰封牌"上。这座黛青花岗石牌坊是明崇祯元年（1628年）叶长青为纪念其祖叶向高两任皇帝首辅而建。石坊仿木结构，三开间十二柱，明间单檐高举，左右重檐，高10.07米，通面宽11米，通进深两间3米。门洞跨街，本是为了过往人等经行于下，仰慕于心。结构之外，石坊的特色在于雕刻装饰。明间门额硕大，双面均浅浮雕鳌头、牡丹、双凤、丹书等图案。梁下有透雕神鳌的雀替承托。梁上置青石雕隔扇，双面镂空透雕人物故事三组，分别是"琴棋书画"的主题。东西次间前后是上下枋间置透雕花板，分别为"苏武牧羊"、"秉笔直书"、"杨震拒金"、"千里单骑"4组历史故事。明间顶楼之下，四根浮雕蟠龙方形角柱立于次间屋顶。楼阁正中嵌一竖式龙匾，阴刻"恩荣"。匾左右更施斗拱配合垂莲柱承托屋架，屋架月梁造。坊顶正脊中置宝葫芦，两端为鸱尾朝天。黄阁重纶石坊是福清市现存规模最大、保存最为完整的石牌坊，讲述着明代的故事，等待着驻足聆听的人。
projects.content_en: The Chonglun Stone Archway takes its name from the four large characters inscribed upon it. Its origins are recorded on the "imperial grant plaque" beneath the main banner. This dark granite archway was built in 1628 (the first year of Chongzhen reign, Ming) by Ye Changqing to commemorate his grandfather Ye Xianggao, who served twice as Grand Secretary to the emperor. Imitating timber construction, the archway has three bays and twelve columns, with a single high eave over the central bay and double eaves on the sides. It stands 10.07 meters tall, 11 meters wide overall, and 3 meters deep across two bays. The gateway spans the street, designed for passersby to walk beneath in admiration. Beyond structure, the archway's distinction lies in its carved decoration. The large central lintel bears shallow relief carvings on both sides: mythical fish-turtles (ao), peonies, paired phoenixes, and imperial edicts. Openwork spandrel brackets in the form of divine ao support the beams. Above the beams are stone lattice panels with three groups of openwork narrative carvings on both sides, themed around the "four arts" (qin, qi, calligraphy, painting). The side bays feature openwork floral panels between upper and lower beams, depicting four historical stories: "Su Wu Tending Sheep," "The Honest Scribe," "Yang Zhen Rejecting Gold," and "A Thousand Li Alone." Beneath the central top pavilion, four square corner columns with coiled-dragon reliefs rise from the side-bay roofs. The pavilion center holds a vertical dragon plaque intaglio-carved with "Imperial Grace." On either side, bracket sets with pendant lotus columns support the roof frame with crescent beams. The main ridge is crowned by a precious gourd, with owl-tail ornaments (chiwei) at both ends pointing skyward. This is the largest and best-preserved stone archway in Fuqing, telling Ming Dynasty stories to those who pause to listen.

projects.name: 龙江桥
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 福州福清市海口镇江口
projects.address_en: Jiangkou, Haikou Town, Fuqing City, Fuzhou
highlights: 石桥结构
桥头石塔
福建古代四大桥梁
宋代石梁桥
projects.content_zh: 龙江桥坐落在福清海口镇，又名螺江桥、永平桥，俗称海口桥，建于北宋政和至宣和年间，或经明清至民国间历代修缮。大桥横跨龙江下游，是福清最长的一座古代石梁。它与龙海江东桥、泉州洛阳桥、晋江安平桥合称福建省古代四大桥梁，是省内目前保存最完整的宋代石梁桥。龙江桥是座梁式结构的石桥，上至石栏和独具匠心的横铺石板，下至填基架梁，均以石为材。现龙江桥有40孔，孔径9米至13米，桥宽4.2米至5.2米，全长476米。桥墩高6米，成舟形，两分水尖间长为10米，墩宽3.3米至4.2米。6条石梁并排铺设在墩顶帽石上。石梁宽60厘米至75厘米，厚60—90厘米，每条石梁约重15吨。在石梁之上再横铺石桥板，这在古代石桥中并不多见。桥南还建造镇桥塔2座，分列左右，塔七级六角，古拙朴素，像一对无言的丽人，平添无尽寻味。微风习习，江中成群的野鸭悠闲地往来游弋，白色的水鸟随意落在渔船上；暮色降临，摇曳的桥灯拉长了过客的身影。也许龙江桥带给人们的不只是交通的便利，也保佑着一方幸福平静的生活。
projects.content_en: Longjiang Bridge, located in Haikou Town, Fuqing, is also known as Luojiang Bridge or Yongping Bridge, commonly called Haikou Bridge. Built during the Zhenghe-Xuanhe reigns of the Northern Song and repaired through the Ming, Qing, and Republican periods, it spans the lower Longjiang River and is Fuqing's longest ancient stone beam bridge. Together with the Jiangdong Bridge in Longhai, Luoyang Bridge in Quanzhou, and Anping Bridge in Jinjiang, it is known as one of the Four Great Ancient Bridges of Fujian and is the best-preserved Song Dynasty stone beam bridge in the province. A beam-type stone bridge, everything from the stone railings and ingeniously laid transverse deck slabs to the foundation and beams is made of stone. It currently has 40 spans with openings of 9 to 13 meters, a width of 4.2 to 5.2 meters, and a total length of 476 meters. The piers, 6 meters tall, are boat-shaped, 10 meters long between the two water-cutting tips, and 3.3 to 4.2 meters wide. Six stone beams are laid side by side on the pier capstones; each beam is 60-75 cm wide, 60-90 cm thick, and weighs about 15 tons. Transverse stone slabs are laid above the beams — a feature uncommon in ancient stone bridges. At the south end stand two bridge-suppressing pagodas, one on each side, seven stories and hexagonal, simple and unadorned like a pair of silent beauties, adding endless charm. In the gentle breeze, flocks of wild ducks swim leisurely in the river, white water birds rest on fishing boats; as dusk falls, the swaying bridge lamps elongate the shadows of passersby. Perhaps Longjiang Bridge brings more than just transportation convenience — it blesses the peaceful happiness of the local people.

石柱

江南第一佛
福建石雕二绝
projects.content_zh: 到达弥勒造像公园已是傍晚时分，公园中空无一人，只有夕阳照射在树木繁茂的园林中。过了一片碧绿的池水，里面有很多好看的小鱼，抬头看到巨大的弥勒造像就在眼前。元代尊崇佛教，因此元兵入闽时虽大肆破坏，但各地的寺观却未受损害。被誉为"江南第一佛"的瑞岩弥勒石像于元代至正年间（1341—1368年），由邑人吕伯恭召集工匠精心雕琢而成。该巨型弥勒造像，高6.4米，宽8.9米，厚约8米，盘腿而坐，双耳垂肩，笑容可掬，其腰腹间还有三尊小罗汉。瑞岩弥勒佛像是福建省最大的佛教造像，也是中国现存最大的布袋弥勒造像，与泉州的道教老君岩并称福建石雕二绝。要看的还有佛像四周的石柱。石柱共有10根，当为洪武二十三年（1390年）僧人悟普为弥勒佛遮风避雨而建堂的遗物，后来万历十一年（1583年）重建弥勒阁或许也是因此石柱而修的。所怪柱身并不高大，须得配合复杂的木结构方能配得起一阁。大佛面向一汪池水，虽不乏人工雕琢，总体气氛还是相得。
projects.content_en: Arriving at the Maitreya Statue Park at dusk, the park was empty, with only the evening sun shining through the lush garden. Past a green pond full of pretty little fish, one looks up to see the giant Maitreya statue before one's eyes. The Yuan Dynasty revered Buddhism, so although Yuan troops caused widespread destruction upon entering Fujian, temples and monasteries were spared. Known as the "Number One Buddha South of the Yangtze," the Ruiyan Maitreya stone statue was carved during the Zhizheng reign of the Yuan (1341-1368) by local Lü Bogong, who gathered craftsmen for the meticulous work. This colossal Maitreya statue stands 6.4 meters tall, 8.9 meters wide, and about 8 meters deep, seated in lotus position with long earlobes touching the shoulders and a beaming smile; three small arhats are carved on its belly. It is the largest Buddhist statue in Fujian Province and the largest surviving cloth-bag Maitreya statue in China, paired with the Daoist Laojun Rock in Quanzhou as the two masterpieces of Fujian stone carving. Also worth seeing are the ten stone pillars surrounding the Buddha. They are likely remains of a hall built in 1390 (the 23rd year of Hongwu reign) by monk Wupu to shelter the Maitreya from wind and rain; the reconstruction of the Maitreya Pavilion in 1583 (the 11th year of Wanli reign) may have been prompted by these pillars. Curiously, the pillars are not tall, requiring a complex timber structure to support a proper pavilion. The great Buddha faces a pond; though not without artificial carving, the overall atmosphere is harmonious.

projects.name: 瑞云塔
projects.address: 福州福清市瑞云街
projects.address_en: Ruiyun Street, Fuqing City, Fuzhou
highlights: 石结构
石雕
南天玉柱
石仿木结构
四百多幅浮雕
projects.content_zh: 在龙江北岸有一座号称"南天玉柱"的瑞云塔。该塔始建于明万历三十四年（1606年），竣于万历四十三年（1615年），费时10年。传说卜基之日，五色云自太保山来覆其上，故塔成后名为瑞云塔。瑞云塔用雕琢精致的花岗石砌建，塔高34.6米，七层八角，外形仿木构楼阁式，底基为单层八角须弥座，周长24米。第一层北面开门，塔门额竖匾上镌刻"凌霄玉柱"四个遒劲大字，其余七面设佛龛。第二至第七层两面开门，六面设佛龛。各层转角倚柱成海棠状，并有曲尺形登临石阶，供游人拾级而上。柱顶斗拱二层，叠涩出层檐，檐面浮雕瓦垅，顶为葫芦塔刹。塔身内外每层皆有浮雕，内容丰富多彩，有武士、比丘、罗汉、菩萨、力士等浮雕和佛教故事图案，还刻有花卉、龙、麒麟、狮子、鹿、凤凰、奔马、兔、猴、鹤等飞禽走兽浮雕共四百多幅，大小不一，大的高达1.5米，小的只有20厘米。这些浮雕千姿百态，形象逼真，栩栩如生。从第四层起，门楣上开始出现飞天浮雕，看上去神态安详，衣带飘飘；复有骑马的胡人，伴之以雕刻得细入羽毛的仙鹤，呼之欲出的梅花鹿；更有大量的飞天、菩萨造像。该塔采用石仿木结构，表现了高超的制塔工艺，内部的雕刻手法传神，雄浑古朴，虽是明代所雕，大有上古遗风。在塔中观赏这些浮雕，仿佛徘徊于古代石窟之中，令人目不暇接，久久不忍离去。
projects.content_en: On the north bank of the Longjiang River stands Ruiyun Pagoda, known as the "Jade Pillar of the Southern Sky." Construction began in 1606 (the 34th year of Wanli reign, Ming) and was completed in 1615, taking ten years. Legend says that on the day the foundation was chosen, five-colored clouds came from Taibao Mountain and covered the site, hence the name "Auspicious Cloud Pagoda." Built of exquisitely carved granite, the pagoda stands 34.6 meters tall with seven stories and eight sides, imitating a timber pavilion-style structure. Its base is a single-story octagonal xumizuo with a circumference of 24 meters. The first story has a door on the north side, with a vertical plaque above the door bearing the four powerful characters "Lingxiao Yuzhu" (Jade Pillar Reaching the Clouds); the other seven sides have Buddhist niches. Stories two through seven have doors on two sides and niches on six. Corner engaged columns are shaped like crabapple blossoms, with zigzag stone steps for visitors to climb upward. Two tiers of bracket sets atop the columns support corbelled eaves with relief tile rows; the finial is a gourd-shaped spire. Each story, inside and out, bears rich relief carvings: warriors, monks, arhats, bodhisattvas, and strength deities, plus Buddhist narrative scenes; also over four hundred reliefs of flowers, dragons, qilin, lions, deer, phoenixes, galloping horses, rabbits, monkeys, and cranes, ranging from 1.5 meters down to 20 centimeters. These reliefs are varied, vivid, and lifelike. From the fourth story, apsara (flying celestial) reliefs appear above the door lintels, serene with flowing ribbons; there are also riding Hu peoples, cranes carved with feather-level detail, and sika deer that seem about to leap forth, plus numerous apsara and bodhisattva figures. The pagoda's stone-imitation-timber construction demonstrates superb pagoda-building technique; the interior carvings are expressive, powerful, and archaic — though Ming Dynasty work, they evoke ancient styles. Viewing these reliefs inside the pagoda feels like wandering through an ancient cave temple, overwhelming the eye and making visitors reluctant to leave.

projects.name: 显济庙
projects.address: 福州福清市一都镇东山村
projects.address_en: Dongshan Village, Yidu Town, Fuqing City, Fuzhou
highlights: 地方寺庙格局
清代藻井民间做法
清代色彩装饰
戏台
八角牡丹藻井
projects.content_zh: 显济庙面朝西南，坐落于赤鲤河北岸，早年属永泰县，今属福清。庙始建于宋，复建于清，具体年代无碑记可考。《永福县志》中有记载："显济庙，在龙屿溪，祀二神，长神张氏名大郎，次神秀氏名大敷。唐末自固始来闽，乐兹地山水居之，轻赀急义，时能赋之。乡人德之，设为立庙祀焉。水旱疾疫，祷祈辙应。宋状元黄定有记。"庙门前有石香炉一座。平面布置沿中轴线依次为戏台、献亭及大殿，两侧有回廊相连。戏台背靠庙门，面朝内院，单檐歇山顶。舞台约1.3米高，下空，以木柱支承。舞台两侧有楼梯通后侧回廊，作后台之用。献亭单檐悬山顶，进深面阔各一间，中央有八角形牡丹藻井，雕饰精美，为整座建筑最有特色的装饰部位。1995年民众募资重修，除戏台和献亭外，其余建筑均经大修，更换木构件及屋面瓦件，并重做室内大部分油漆彩绘。现存建筑整体保留清代风貌。寺内至今香火不断，尤以每月初一十五为盛。农历二月初二相传为二神生日，庙中有隆重祭祀活动。此外，元宵节庙前大埕有舞龙活动。硕果仅存的戏台和献亭中各一座藻井，其木构表面彩绘均系原始遗存，或是追寻清代装饰色彩材料和工艺变化的样本。唯愿乡民的审慎和踊跃一同成长，为研究者留下一些原始证据。
projects.content_en: Xianji Temple faces southwest, standing on the north bank of the Chili River. Formerly in Yongtai County, it is now in Fuqing. Founded in the Song and rebuilt in the Qing, its exact date is unrecorded on any stele. The Yongfu County Gazetteer records: "Xianji Temple, at Longyu Stream, worships two deities: the elder, surnamed Zhang and named Dalang, and the younger, surnamed Xiu and named Dafu. At the end of the Tang they came from Gushi to Fujian, delighted in the local landscape and settled there. They were generous with wealth and quick to righteousness, and could compose poetry. The grateful villagers built a temple to worship them. Prayers for drought, flood, or plague were always answered. Song zhuangyuan Huang Ding wrote a record." Before the temple gate stands a stone incense burner. Along the central axis stand, in order, the stage, offering pavilion, and main hall, connected by side corridors. The stage backs against the temple gate and faces the inner courtyard, with a single-eave hip-and-gable roof. The platform is about 1.3 meters high, open beneath and supported by timber columns. Stairs on both sides lead to the rear corridor, serving as backstage. The offering pavilion has a single-eave overhanging gable roof, one bay in both depth and width, with an octagonal peony caisson (zaojing) at its center — exquisitely carved and the most distinctive decorative feature of the entire complex. In 1995, local residents raised funds for restoration; except for the stage and offering pavilion, all buildings were extensively repaired with replaced timber components and roof tiles, and most interior paint and decoration was redone. The existing buildings overall retain their Qing Dynasty appearance. Incense continues to burn, especially on the first and fifteenth of each lunar month. The second day of the second lunar month is said to be the two deities' birthday, with grand sacrificial ceremonies. During Lantern Festival, dragon dances are performed in the square before the temple. The two surviving caissons — one in the stage and one in the offering pavilion — retain their original painted timber surfaces, serving as samples for studying Qing decorative materials and techniques. One hopes that villagers' caution and enthusiasm grow together, leaving original evidence for researchers.

projects.name: 高应松祠堂
projects.name_en: Ancestral Temple Complex for Gao Yingsong
projects.address: 福州长乐市古槐镇屿中村
projects.address_en: Yuzhong Village, Guhuai Town, Changle City, Fuzhou
projects.type: 民居·礼制建筑·木结构建筑群
projects.type_en: Residential · Ritual Architecture · Timber Building Complex
highlights: 未经过度干扰的木作样本
凭吊
忠烈祠
穿斗屋架
projects.content_zh: 这里是名人纪念堂，也是典型的古建筑样本。高应松是福建长乐人，南宋开庆元年（1259年）进士。后来成为重臣，官居工部侍郎、端明殿学士、签书枢密院事兼参知政事等职。德祐二年（1276年），元兵至都城临安，朝中文武官员纷纷奔逃，留者仅应松等9人。三月，元兵俘获赵显、谢道清、全氏等北去，应松随往，于闰三月抵达燕京。应松绝不语七日，殉国。明洪武年间（1368—1398年），知县王遵道建祠纪念，全称"锦屿高氏忠烈祠"。这座可以追溯到明代的古建筑在清代及民国时期均有修葺。祠堂现状或者保留明代祠堂建筑规制，建筑结构的年代则更接近清代以来福州民居的常见做法，需要进一步形制、构造和材料学方面的研究。现存建筑包括门墙、戏台、厅堂和二层回廊。厅堂规模较弘敞，面阔五间进深三间，穿斗屋架，硬山封火墙。村中还有称为"枢密第"的高应松故居，面貌早已是半毁半非了。
projects.content_en: This is both a memorial hall for a famous figure and a typical ancient architectural specimen. Gao Yingsong was a native of Changle, Fujian, who passed the jinshi examination in 1259 (the first year of Kaiqing reign, Southern Song). He rose to become a senior official, serving as Vice Minister of Works, Academician of the Duanming Hall, and Vice Grand Councilor. In 1276 (the second year of Deyou reign), when Yuan troops reached the capital Lin'an, civil and military officials fled; only nine remained, including Gao. In the third month, the Yuan forces captured the emperor, empress dowager, and empress and took them north; Gao accompanied them and reached Yanjing in the intercalary third month. He refused to speak for seven days and died for his country. During the Hongwu reign of the Ming (1368-1398), County Magistrate Wang Zundao built a shrine in his memory, formally called the "Loyal and Martyr Shrine of the Gao Clan of Jinyu." This ancient building, traceable to the Ming, was repaired during the Qing and Republican periods. Its current form may retain Ming ancestral hall regulations, while its structural details are closer to common Qing-era Fuzhou residential practices — requiring further study in form, construction, and materials. Existing buildings include the gate wall, stage, main hall, and two-story cloister. The hall is spacious, with five bays wide and three deep, using a column-and-tie (chuandou) roof frame with flush gable fire-sealing walls. The village also contains Gao Yingsong's former residence known as the "Privy Council Residence," now half-ruined.

projects.name: 南阳陈氏祠堂
projects.address: 福州长乐市江田镇友爱村
projects.address_en: You'ai Village, Jiangtian Town, Changle City, Fuzhou
highlights: 建筑群
木结构
油饰研究样本
6000平方米
牌匾楹联
projects.content_zh: 陈氏在福建的分布广而人众，乃有《闽台陈氏文化》的编纂。长乐江田一地，山海相连，农业资源比较丰富；同时地处海域风口，每有台风袭扰。陈氏居此，因利避害，不知多少年了。南宋庆元初年，理学家朱熹寓寓长乐，曾在江田的灵峰寺授徒讲学，也成了当地文化积淀的一件要事。南阳陈氏祠堂位于长乐市江田镇的友爱村，占地宏大，居然达到6000平方米。史料说明，祠堂始建于明永乐十六年（1418年），明万历九年（1581年）重修。走进祠堂三进深的院落中，追寻明代做法的痕迹，确是一桩饶有趣味的挑战。祠堂建筑以悬山顶为主，多采用穿斗式木构架。堂内第一进为门厅，中间设戏台；二进为主厅；三进为祭祖厅。雕刻不繁，反添庄重。各座建筑的檐下斗拱往往在第三跳上远远伸出，承托遮檐板；斗的造型也颇有福州华林寺以来一脉相承的古义。祠堂油饰黑、红、黄色搭配，气氛肃穆，而到底这样的调色板能够上溯到什么年代，不取得些许样本，不做一做深入分层的研究是没有答案的。牌匾、楹联众多是南阳陈氏祠堂的又一特色，其中有御赐"家传孝友，世笃忠贞"匾，以及明大学士叶向高、刑部侍郎郑世威、近代徐世昌、萨镇冰等题写的匾额、楹联。楹联的色彩即使经过晚近的涂刷，边角底层难免残留久远的痕迹，这就仿佛一块磁石，吸引我做好准备下次再来。
projects.content_en: The Chen clan is widely distributed and populous in Fujian, giving rise to the compilation of "Chen Clan Culture of Fujian and Taiwan." The Jiangtian area of Changle, where mountains meet the sea, has relatively rich agricultural resources; at the same time, located at a coastal wind gap, it is frequently hit by typhoons. The Chen clan settled here, leveraging advantages and avoiding harms, for who knows how many years. In the early Qingyuan reign of the Southern Song, the Neo-Confucian philosopher Zhu Xi resided in Changle and taught disciples at Lingfeng Temple in Jiangtian — an important event in local cultural accumulation. Nanyang Chen Ancestral Hall, located in You'ai Village, Jiangtian Town, Changle, occupies an expansive site of 6,000 square meters. Historical records show it was founded in 1418 (the 16th year of Yongle reign, Ming) and rebuilt in 1581 (the ninth year of Wanli reign). Walking through its three-courtyard complex to trace traces of Ming techniques is a fascinating challenge. The buildings primarily use overhanging gable roofs and column-and-tie timber frames. The first courtyard contains the entrance hall with a stage in the center; the second is the main hall; the third is the ancestor-worship hall. Carvings are not excessive, adding to the solemnity. The eave bracket sets of each building often extend far on the third tier to support the eave-sheltering board; the bracket forms carry an ancient lineage traceable to Fuzhou's Hualin Temple. The hall's paint scheme combines black, red, and yellow for a solemn atmosphere — but exactly how far back this palette dates cannot be answered without samples and detailed stratigraphic study. Numerous plaques and couplets are another hallmark, including an imperially bestowed plaque reading "Family Tradition of Filial Piety and Friendship, Generations of Loyalty and Integrity," plus plaques and couplets by Ming Grand Secretary Ye Xianggao, Vice Minister of Justice Zheng Shiwei, and modern figures Xu Shichang and Sa Zhenbing. Even after recent repainting, traces of older layers remain at the corners — like a magnet, drawing me to prepare for a return visit.

projects.name: 九头马民居
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 福州长乐市鹤上镇岐阳村
projects.address_en: Qiyang Village, Heshang Town, Changle City, Fuzhou
projects.type_en: Residential Architecture · Timber and Stone Structure
highlights: 建筑群
木结构
木雕
石雕
22座主体建筑
5列轴线
projects.content_zh: "九头马"古民居坐落在长乐市鹤上镇岐阳村福庭自然村，由陈利焕父子历经数十载陆续建成。第一座建于清嘉庆年间，大部分建于道光（1821—1850年）年间，最西侧轴线建造时间最迟，清同治十一年（1872年）竣工。这一带处于沿海地区，比较富裕，村中家家都在盖大高楼，置身村中发现老式民居已经不多了，唯"九头马"还有自己的一方领地，也令人依稀想起当年此地风光，那番众星捧月的样子。初见"九头马"感觉作为民居而建成如此规模有些令人惊讶，不过细想这里曾经有大片的土地，大量的木材和能工巧匠，建设成本相对低廉，也就不足为奇了。"九头马"建筑群坐北朝南，平面基本呈正方形，东西宽、南北深各120米，分5列。建筑群前有广场，四周石基高砌，后有深沟，两侧近溪。主体建筑22座，四周有6米高的围墙，开放十多个门洞，设有望楼、枪眼。五路建筑之间，隔有防火墙或夹弄，相互之间有框门相通。沿左右五条轴线，分别布置门廊、厅堂、厢房、亭榭、仓库、书斋、花园等各类建筑。这里的大木作讲求变化，多用抬梁减柱，或平面布局变，或高低变、大小变、主次变，达到建筑艺术与便利生活的完美结合。这里的小木作精巧别致，达到一流的艺术水准，藻井形式多样，轩顶、悬钟、斗拱、插屏、门窗户扇几乎无处不雕。雕刻的形式有浅雕、浮雕、镂空雕、双面雕，阴刻、阳刻、镶刻；内容有自然物、民间戏文典故、三教九流故事。许多作品把诗词歌赋、金石书法、绘画雕刻等诸多艺术形式有机融为一体。这里的石刻大多用于柱础，砖雕用于门楼亭、墙饰、窗格，泥塑用于墙头饰，壁画则广泛用于内墙壁。这里的装饰题材多采用象征、寓意、谐音等传统手法，给人祥瑞吉利的美好意念，如和合（荷）二仙、升平（瓶）景象、吉庆（罄）有余（鱼）、福（蝙蝠）禄（鹿）寿（松鹤）喜（梅雀）。
projects.content_en: The "Nine-Headed Horse" ancient dwellings stand in Futing Natural Village, Qiyang Village, Heshang Town, Changle. Built successively over several decades by Chen Lihuan and his son, the first structure dates to the Jiaqing reign of the Qing, most were built during the Daoguang reign (1821-1850), and the westernmost axis was completed latest, in 1872 (the 11th year of Tongzhi reign). This coastal area was relatively prosperous, with every family building tall new houses; walking through the village, few old dwellings remain — only "Nine-Headed Horse" retains its territory, faintly evoking its former glory surrounded by admirers. At first sight, the scale of this residential complex is surprising, but considering the abundant land, timber, and skilled craftsmen that were once available, with relatively low construction costs, it becomes understandable. The complex faces south, with a basically square plan 120 meters east-west and 120 meters north-south, arranged in five rows. A plaza lies in front; high stone foundations surround it, with deep ditches behind and streams on both sides. There are 22 main buildings within a 6-meter-high enclosure wall, with over ten gateways, watchtowers, and gun ports. Fire walls or alleyways separate the five building rows, connected by framed doors. Along the five axes are arranged gate porches, halls, wing rooms, pavilions, warehouses, studies, and gardens. The major timberwork emphasizes variation, often using beam-lifting with column reduction, changing layout, height, size, and hierarchy to achieve a perfect blend of architectural art and convenient living. The minor timberwork is exquisite, reaching first-rate artistic standards: diverse caisson ceilings, raised ceilings, pendant bells, bracket sets, inserted screens, and doors/windows carved almost everywhere. Carving techniques include shallow relief, high relief, openwork, double-sided carving, intaglio, relief, and inlay; subjects include natural forms, folk opera stories, and tales of various traditions. Many works organically integrate poetry, calligraphy, painting, and carving. Stone carving is mostly used for column bases, brick carving for gate pavilions, wall decorations, and window grilles, clay modeling for wall ornaments, and murals for interior walls. Decorative themes use traditional methods of symbolism, allegory, and homophones to convey auspicious meanings: the Two Immortals of Harmony (lotus), peace (vase), surplus celebration (qing and fish), and fortune (bat), prosperity (deer), longevity (pine and crane), and joy (plum and sparrow).

projects.name: 琴江满族村
projects.address: 福州长乐市西北琴江
projects.address_en: Northwest Qinjiang, Changle City, Fuzhou
highlights: 建筑群
凭吊
满族聚居村
水师旗营
中国海军摇篮
projects.content_zh: 琴江是福建省唯一的满族聚居村，为首批省级历史文化名村之一。琴江位于闽江南岸，与福州马尾隔江相望，距长乐市区4公里，距闽江口15公里。流经这一段的闽江宛如一把古琴，故名琴江，为古代控马江卫省城的重要港口。清雍正六年（1728年），镇闽将军阿尔赛奏请朝廷从老四旗中抽调513名官兵携眷进驻琴江，围地筑城，建立"福州三江口水师旗营"。这是当时全国沿海四大水师旗营之一，比马尾的福建水师还早151年，是中国海军的摇篮。琴江水师最辉煌的一页是参与甲申中法马江海战。统领黄恩录以率部奋勇杀敌，600名官兵中壮烈牺牲100多位。琴江村地灵人杰，名人辈出。洋务运动后，水师旗营中青年人纷纷投入船政学堂，毕业后成长为中国海军的栋梁之材，其中将级3名，上校级4名。据琴江志载，林则徐多次来到琴江，江滨照壁曾书林公墨宝"海国屏藩"。萨镇冰为贾氏海军世家墓园题写"江城海域"碑刻至今犹存。村中敕建有"忠魂堂"，设置水师烈士灵牌。这里至今每年七月初三举行公祭活动，村民们自发来到江边放送水灯，剪纸焚香，祭奠先烈英灵。这里的建筑军营一般地排列。祠堂不大，要的是肃穆。木雕装饰花哨的不多，只是偶有的点缀。行走在琴江村的街道上，非常的安静，到处是鸟语花香，让人联想不到当年炮火的喧嚣。这些祖上来自己遥远北方的满族八旗的后人们也在这优美的村镇中过着安逸的生活。
projects.content_en: Qinjiang is Fujian Province's only Manchu settlement village and one of the first provincial-level historical and cultural villages. Located on the south bank of the Min River, facing Mawei across the water, it is 4 kilometers from Changle city center and 15 kilometers from the Min River mouth. This stretch of the Min River resembles a guqin (ancient zither), hence the name Qinjiang — historically an important port controlling Majiang and defending the provincial capital. In 1728 (the sixth year of Yongzheng reign, Qing), General Aersai of Fujian petitioned the court to dispatch 513 officers and soldiers with their families from the original Four Banners to garrison Qinjiang, where they walled an area and established the "Fuzhou Sanjiangkou Naval Banner Camp." It was one of the four major coastal naval banner camps of the time, predating the Fujian Navy at Mawei by 151 years — the cradle of the Chinese Navy. Its most glorious chapter was participation in the 1884 Sino-French Battle of Majiang; Commander Huang Enlu led his troops in fierce combat, with over 100 of 600 officers and men sacrificing their lives. Qinjiang has produced many notable figures. After the Self-Strengthening Movement, young men from the naval camp entered the Naval Academy and grew into pillars of the Chinese Navy, including 3 flag officers and 4 captains. According to Qinjiang records, Lin Zexu visited multiple times; a riverside screen wall once bore his calligraphy "Sea Nation Bulwark." Sa Zhenbing's inscription "River City Sea Domain" on the Jia family naval cemetery still exists. The village has an imperially built "Hall of Loyal Souls" housing spirit tablets of naval martyrs. Every year on the third day of the seventh lunar month, villagers spontaneously gather at the river to release water lanterns, cut paper, burn incense, and honor the martyrs. The buildings are arranged in military-barracks fashion. The ancestral hall is small but solemn; wood carving decoration is sparse, only occasional accents. Walking Qinjiang's streets is very quiet, filled with birdsong and flowers, belying the roar of cannon fire from years past. Descendants of the Manchu Eight Banners, whose ancestors came from the far north, now live a peaceful life in this beautiful village.

projects.name: 三峰寺塔
projects.address: 福州长乐市区郑和公园内
projects.address_en: Zhenghe Park, Changle City, Fuzhou
highlights: 石塔形制
比例尺度
石雕装饰
北宋政和七年原物
仿木结构
projects.content_zh: 位于长乐城区塔坪山之巅的三峰寺塔，原称圣寿宝塔，又称雁塔。建造年代可以追溯到北宋政和七年（1117年），证据就是塔的第七层南门旁的题刻"圣寿宝塔 时政和丁酉十月二十三日圆满同掌会陈致乾、戴顺、郑康、周寿、林柏材"。石塔美轮美奂，令人想起福清的瑞云塔，雕刻虽略精简，但同样细腻，仿木构件也相当丰富。塔高27.4米，共七层，是八角仿木结构石砌建筑。塔内有石梯，各层的塔壁浮雕及壁龛内的圆雕佛像，皆精美绝伦。三峰寺塔是研究宋代石塔建筑艺术的重要实物资料，也是长乐古城的标志性建筑。
projects.content_en: Sanfeng Temple Pagoda, standing atop Taping Mountain in downtown Changle, was originally called the Holy Longevity Pagoda, also known as the Wild Goose Pagoda. Its construction dates to 1117 (the seventh year of Zhenghe reign, Northern Song), evidenced by the inscription beside the south door on the seventh story: "Holy Longevity Pagoda — Completed on the 23rd day of the 10th month of the Dingyou year of Zhenghe, by co-managers Chen Zhiqian, Dai Shun, Zheng Kang, Zhou Shou, Lin Bocai." The stone pagoda is exquisite, reminiscent of Ruiyun Pagoda in Fuqing; though its carvings are slightly more restrained, they are equally refined, and its imitation-timber components are quite rich. Standing 27.4 meters tall with seven stories, it is an octagonal stone structure imitating timber architecture. A stone staircase leads inside; the wall reliefs on each story and the round-carved Buddha statues in the niches are all exquisitely wrought. Sanfeng Temple Pagoda is important physical material for studying Song Dynasty stone pagoda architectural art and a landmark of ancient Changle city.

projects.name: 三溪村
projects.address: 福州长乐市江田镇西北
projects.address_en: Northwest of Jiangtian Town, Changle City, Fuzhou
projects.type_en: Residential Architecture · Timber and Stone Structure
highlights: 民居建筑群
古桥梁
寺庙遗迹
石作
5座宋代石桥
projects.content_zh: 江田的三溪村背面靠山，山上的岩石各具形态。宋代江田的经济文化相当发达。宰相郑性之、气节名臣高应松、理学宗师朱熹等，都在江田留下足迹。作为人文荟萃之地，本村自己培养出不少名人。在宋朝，仅潘姓一族就有59人考中进士。无怪乎村中留存许多唐宋以来寺庙、道观。顾名思义，三溪村有溪水穿村而过，溪上有5座宋代修建的石桥，其中的一座名曰"大桥"，也是一座石板桥。其形制精巧古朴，桥边保留着建桥和历次重修留下的石碑，桥头高大的榕树，桥下潺潺的溪水，构成一幅小桥流水人家的优美画面。三溪村是一座安静的小村镇，村子里行人稀少，漫步在古村石板铺就的道路上，两旁的房屋有很多不是砖砌的而是用整块竖条的石板拼接而成，应算当地民居的一个特色。大户人家的祠堂，可以看出也是以石料为主，而且工艺很讲究；观音庙前的石刻雕像，工艺娴熟，古意盎然。只因此村并不显见于经传，我们也是匆匆而过，其实值得多花些时间仔细品味。
projects.content_en: Sanxi Village in Jiangtian backs onto mountains whose rocks each have their own character. Jiangtian's economy and culture were quite developed in the Song Dynasty: Chancellor Zheng Xingzhi, principled official Gao Yingsong, and Neo-Confucian master Zhu Xi all left their traces here. As a place of cultural concentration, the village itself produced many notable figures — in the Song, the Pan clan alone produced 59 jinshi graduates. Small wonder that many temples and Daoist abbeys from the Tang and Song survive. As its name suggests, three streams flow through the village, with five Song Dynasty stone bridges spanning them; one called "Great Bridge" is a stone slab bridge. Its form is exquisite and ancient, with steles recording its construction and successive repairs beside it, tall banyan trees at the bridgehead, and gurgling water below — a beautiful scene of small bridge, flowing water, and人家. Sanxi is a quiet village with few pedestrians. Walking its stone-paved roads, many houses on both sides are not brick-built but constructed from whole vertical stone slabs — a distinctive local residential feature. The ancestral halls of prominent families are also primarily stone, with refined craftsmanship; the stone carvings before the Guanyin Temple are skilled and full of ancient atmosphere. Because this village is not mentioned in historical records, we passed through quickly, but it truly deserves more time for careful appreciation.

projects.name: 天妃灵应之记碑
projects.name_en: Stele to Record the Theophany of Goddess
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 福州长乐市吴航镇郑和公园
projects.address_en: Zhenghe Park, Wuhang Town, Changle City, Fuzhou
highlights: 纹饰
凭吊
郑和碑
1177字碑文
明早期云纹
projects.content_zh: 把一座碑登录为全国重点文物保护单位，那碑定然是弥足珍贵。长乐郑和公园三峰寺塔脚下，便保存着这样一通碑记，"天妃灵应之记"碑，俗称郑和碑。碑体采用黑色页岩，高1.62米，宽0.78米，厚0.16米。明宣德六年（1431年）十一月重修天妃宫时，由正使太监郑和、王景弘和副使太监李兴、朱良等刻立。碑额正中篆书"天妃灵应之记"，饰以祥云捧日图案，两旁阴刻如意云水纹。碑体边框刻缠枝卷草。碑文楷书，全文共1177字，记载了郑和船队从永乐三年到宣德六年历次航行时间、船只、人员等内容，是中国仅存的记述郑和下西洋的碑刻。作为搞建筑的，明代天后宫的痕迹已经难寻了，纯正的明早期云纹、如意纹样、缠枝卷草才是我们最为瞩目的。诵读着"是用著神之德于石，并记诸番往回之岁月，以贻永久焉"的语句，胸中荡漾起时间的海涛。600年后，郑和的名字依然，而这石碑是否还是这般模样呢？
projects.content_en: For a stele to be listed as a National Key Cultural Heritage Site, it must be extraordinarily precious. At the foot of Sanfeng Temple Pagoda in Zhenghe Park, Changle, stands such a stele: the "Stele Recording the Theophany of the Heavenly Consort," commonly known as the Zhenghe Stele. Carved from black shale, it stands 1.62 meters tall, 0.78 meters wide, and 0.16 meters thick. It was erected in the 11th month of the sixth year of Xuande reign (1431) during the reconstruction of the Tianfei Palace, by chief envoys and eunuchs Zheng He and Wang Jinghong, and deputy envoys Li Xing and Zhu Liang. The stele header bears seal script "Record of the Theophany of the Heavenly Consort," decorated with an auspicious-cloud-embracing-sun motif, flanked by intaglio ruyi cloud-water patterns. The border is carved with scrolling vines. The inscription, in regular script, totals 1,177 characters, recording the dates, ships, and personnel of Zheng He's voyages from the third year of Yongle to the sixth year of Xuande — the only surviving stele in China documenting Zheng He's western voyages. For architecture enthusiasts, traces of the Ming Tianfei Palace are hard to find; what draws our attention most are the pure early-Ming cloud patterns, ruyi motifs, and scrolling vines. Reading the words "Thus we record the deity's virtue in stone, and note the years of voyages to and from the foreign lands, to leave a permanent record," one feels the waves of time surging in the chest. Six hundred years later, Zheng He's name remains — but is this stone stele still as it was?

projects.name: 显应宫泥塑
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 福州长乐市漳港镇仙岐村
projects.address_en: Xianqi Village, Zhanggang Town, Changle City, Fuzhou
highlights: 纹饰
色彩
凭吊
44尊彩绘泥塑
巡海大臣
郑和纪念猜想
projects.content_zh: 长乐是郑和下西洋庞大舟师的驻泊基地和开洋起点，在长乐发现与郑和有关的大量遗迹和文物不是偶然的。1992年6月，长乐漳港镇仙岐村的村民在挖基建房时，探到了一座古庙。考古发掘证实，这座古庙就是清光绪年间因风沙灾害被掩埋的显应宫。显应宫即妈祖庙，其始建年代可以上溯到南宋绍兴八年（1138年）。当时的考古发掘还清理出泥塑50余尊，其中基本完整的有44尊，可分为妈祖、巡海大神、大王等五组，其年代可较明显地分为明和清，少量可早至元代。现在这些较完整的彩绘泥塑44尊，分布在前后殿的五个神台上。最引人注目的是前殿西侧神台上供奉的群塑，居中者坐像高88厘米，人们称之为"巡海大神"或"巡海大臣"。福州话中"神"与"臣"同音，一时间令人浮想联翩。神像左侧一尊为番人形象，余尊与居中者一样均着明代太监特有的服饰。莫非又是对三宝太监的纪念？这样的猜想在2003年2月得到了文物专家的考察认定。于是，宫观遗迹、泥塑的手法、工艺特征、色彩信息等，都成为我们考察建筑和造像地域特征的参照系和标准样。
projects.content_en: Changle was the anchorage base and departure point for Zheng He's vast fleet on its western voyages, so it is no accident that numerous relics and artifacts related to Zheng He have been found there. In June 1992, villagers in Xianqi Village, Zhanggang Town, Changle, discovered an ancient temple while excavating foundations for housing. Archaeological excavation confirmed it was Xianying Temple, buried by wind-blown sand during the Guangxu reign of the Qing. Xianying Temple is a Mazu temple, its founding traceable to 1138 (the eighth year of Shaoxing reign, Southern Song). The excavation uncovered over 50 clay sculptures, 44 of them essentially intact, divided into five groups including Mazu, Sea-Patrolling Deities, and Great Kings, dating clearly to the Ming and Qing, with a few as early as the Yuan. These 44 painted clay sculptures are now distributed across five altars in the front and rear halls. Most striking is the group on the west altar of the front hall: the central seated figure, 88 cm tall, is called the "Sea-Patrolling Deity" or "Sea-Patrolling Minister." In the Fuzhou dialect, "deity" (shen) and "minister" (chen) are homophones, sparking immediate speculation. The figure to its left has a foreign appearance, while the rest, like the central figure, wear attire distinctive of Ming Dynasty eunuchs. Could this be another memorial to the Three-Jewel Eunuch (Zheng He)? This conjecture was confirmed by cultural relic experts in February 2003. Thus, the temple remains, clay sculpture techniques, craft characteristics, and color information all become reference standards for studying the regional features of architecture and statuary.

projects.name: 蕉溪桥
projects.address: 福州市闽侯县廷坪乡蕉溪村
projects.address_en: Jiaoxi Village, Tingping Township, Minhou County, Fuzhou
highlights: 木拱桥结构
桥村关系
古道线索
八字木架
廊桥
projects.content_zh: 蕉溪桥是个额外惊喜，本不知尚有此桥，是当地乡人临时指引的。蕉溪桥位于闽侯县廷坪乡蕉溪村，从坑坪村走大约6公里村际公路便到。蕉溪桥位于路边，廊屋顶施以灰瓦，未作装饰，防雨板全封闭。蕉溪桥建于民国十九年（1930年），1951年重修。单孔木拱廊桥，东西走向。全长27.3米、宽4.33米、净跨9.2米、离涧底约10米。桥堍用条石垒筑，上用圆杉木分三节穿插成八字形木拱，上顺铺圆木为梁，再铺木板和砖块为桥面。从桥的底部结构看，蕉溪桥的做法并非典型的三节苗、五节苗编木架构，而是两组八字木架重叠而成，因此蕉溪桥未被列入正式的"木拱廊桥"。不过这种结构承重如何，是否更加节省木料，与典型的木拱结构相比哪个更合理，有待进一步探讨。廊屋歇山顶，穿斗式木构架，面阔九间，进深四柱。两侧设长木凳与护栏，外施遮雨板。明间设神龛，祀玄天大帝。蕉溪桥基本完好，风雨板略有破损，反倒能透点光线。桥周边环境尚好，只是离村庄太近，未免受些影响。村民对该桥实施保护，足见重视，不过称谓不是"亭桥"倒是"桥亭"，看来在他们心目中蕉溪桥是一座大亭子。
projects.content_en: Jiaoxi Bridge was an unexpected surprise — we had no idea it existed until a local villager pointed it out. Located in Jiaoxi Village, Tingping Township, Minhou County, it is about 6 kilometers from Kengping Village along a rural road. Standing by the roadside, its covered roof uses grey tiles without decoration, and the rain boards are fully enclosed. Built in 1930 (the 19th year of the Republic) and restored in 1951, it is a single-span timber-arch covered bridge running east-west. It measures 27.3 meters long, 4.33 meters wide, with a clear span of 9.2 meters and about 10 meters above the stream bed. The bridge abutments are built of dressed stone; above them, round Chinese fir logs are interlocked in three sections to form figure-eight timber arches, with round logs laid lengthwise as beams, then wooden planks and bricks as the deck. Viewed from below, Jiaoxi Bridge's construction is not the typical three-seedling or five-seedling woven timber frame, but rather two overlapping figure-eight timber frames — hence it is not classified as a formal "timber-arch covered bridge." However, how this structure bears load, whether it saves more timber, and whether it is more rational than typical timber-arch structures warrant further study. The covered hall has a hip-and-gable roof with a column-and-tie timber frame, nine bays wide and four columns deep. Long wooden benches and railings line both sides, with rain boards outside. The central bay has a shrine worshipping the Xuan Tian Great Emperor. Jiaoxi Bridge is essentially intact, with slightly damaged wind-and-rain boards that actually let in some light. The surrounding environment is good, though its proximity to the village brings some impact. Villagers protect the bridge, showing their regard — though they call it "bridge pavilion" rather than "pavilion bridge," suggesting that in their minds Jiaoxi Bridge is a large pavilion.

projects.name: 坑坪桥
projects.address: 福州市闽侯县廷坪乡坑坪村
projects.address_en: Kengping Village, Tingping Township, Minhou County, Fuzhou
highlights: 木拱桥结构
桥村关系
古道线索
廷坪乡五座古廊桥之一
projects.content_zh: 对于廊桥的考察寻踪来说，位于闽侯县最北部也是福州地区最北部的廷坪乡是一个很特殊的地方，在该乡下辖的数个村落方圆几公里范围内，现已发现保存完好的古廊桥五座，分别是坑坪桥、龙津桥、泰山桥、塘里桥和蕉溪桥。坑坪桥位于闽侯县廷坪乡坑坪村，走过一处当地农家的房子和田地，坑坪桥的倩影便依稀可见。坑坪桥本也应当有个更好点的名字，可能是年久湮没了，才采用地名直接作为桥的名字。
projects.content_en: For those seeking and studying covered bridges, Tingping Township — in the northernmost part of Minhou County and also the northernmost part of the Fuzhou region — is a very special place. Within a few square kilometers of its several villages, five well-preserved ancient covered bridges have been discovered: Kengping Bridge, Longjin Bridge, Taishan Bridge, Tangli Bridge, and Jiaoxi Bridge. Kengping Bridge stands in Kengping Village, Tingping Township. Walking past a local farmhouse and fields, its graceful silhouette comes into view. Kengping Bridge should have had a more elegant name, but perhaps lost to time, it simply takes the village name as its own.

projects.name: 灵济宫
projects.address: 福州市闽侯县青口镇青圃村
projects.address_en: Qingpu Village, Qingkou Town, Minhou County, Fuzhou
projects.type_en: Religious Architecture · Timber and Stone Structure
highlights: 碑亭木结构
遗留早期石作线索
灵济宫碑
明永乐御碑亭
projects.content_zh: 灵济宫深藏在小村之中，甚至躲在咸丰十年"升平人瑞"牌坊之后。此道宫始建于五代闽国后晋开运二年（945年），祥符元年（1008年）又立庙于横溪，政和七年（1117年）迁今所。南宋嘉熙元年（1237年）金书敕额"灵济宫"。永乐十五年（1417年）奉旨拓而新之，春秋致祭。新建的宫殿坐东朝西，从金鳌峰下一直建到山顶，当时规模在福建是没有宫观可与之比拟的。清代，灵济宫几经重修，规模逐渐缩小。中轴线上由西到东计有门楼、前殿、酒楼、中殿、后殿等建筑。宫正门上方青石横行楷书阴刻"金鳌门"三字。门楼后面为石埕，左侧石埕中为明永乐年间建的御碑亭。该亭外形简洁而内部构造较为复杂，内部所立灵济宫石碑为国家级文物。前、中、后三殿紧相联，前中两殿为清末建筑，面阔七间，抬梁式木构架。灵济宫为砖木结构，梁架穿斗式，前开一大四小五个砖拱券门。室内空间装修改造明显，原为戏台—献亭—大殿结构。正殿有圆形藻井，彩画壁画俱晚近。正门上方有民国庚辰年重修题刻。事实上御碑亭是灵济宫中真正长者，亭建于明永乐十五年（1417年），为16柱重檐攒尖顶木构方亭，历经清康熙和民国两次修葺，现存木构。
projects.content_en: Lingji Temple is hidden deep in a small village, even behind the "Shengping Renrui" archway of the tenth year of Xianfeng reign. This Daoist temple was founded in 945 (the second year of Kaiyun reign, Later Jin, during the Five Dynasties Min Kingdom). A temple was established at Hengxi in 1008 (the first year of Xiangfu reign) and moved to the present site in 1117 (the seventh year of Zhenghe reign). In 1237 (the first year of Jiaxi reign, Southern Song), it received an imperial gold-ink plaque reading "Lingji Temple." In 1417 (the 15th year of Yongle reign, Ming), it was expanded and renovated by imperial decree, with seasonal sacrifices. The new palace complex faced east, extending from the foot of Jin'ao Peak to the mountaintop — at the time, no other temple in Fujian could match its scale. During the Qing, Lingji Temple was repeatedly restored but gradually diminished in size. Along the central axis from west to east stand the gate tower, front hall, opera tower, central hall, and rear hall. Above the main gate, a blue stone bears intaglio regular script "Jin'ao Men" (Golden Turtle Gate). Behind the gate is a stone courtyard; on its left stands the imperial stele pavilion built during the Yongle reign of the Ming. Externally simple but internally complex, the pavilion houses the Lingji Temple stele, a national-level cultural relic. The front, central, and rear halls are closely connected; the front and central halls are late Qing buildings, seven bays wide with beam-lifting timber frames. Lingji Temple is a brick-timber structure with column-and-tie beam frames, featuring one large and four small brick arched doors at the front. The interior has been明显 modified, originally a stage-offering hall-main hall configuration. The main hall has a circular caisson ceiling; paintings and murals are all late. Above the main gate is a restoration inscription from the Gengchen year of the Republic. In fact, the imperial stele pavilion is the true elder of Lingji Temple: built in 1417, it is a 16-column double-eave pyramidal-roof timber square pavilion, surviving after two repairs in the Kangxi reign of Qing and the Republican period.

projects.name: 龙津桥
projects.address: 福州市闽侯县廷坪乡流源村
projects.address_en: Liuyuan Village, Tingping Township, Minhou County, Fuzhou
highlights: 木拱桥结构
桥村关系
古道线索
宋绍定元年摩崖题刻
明代木雕神像
projects.content_zh: 龙津桥位于闽侯县廷坪乡流源村东南约1公里，离坑坪桥所在的坑坪村大约6公里。龙津桥始建于宋代，明崇祯四年（1631年）改建为木拱廊屋桥，清乾隆二十年（1755年）、道光二十三年（1843年）及1998年重修。东西走向。全长33米、宽4.3米。以峭壁巨岩为桥堍，上架由圆杉木穿插而成的木拱架，再顺铺圆木为梁，上横铺木板为桥面，其上建廊屋。廊屋歇山顶，抬梁式木架构，面阔11间，进深4柱。桥两旁置长凳和直棂栏杆。明间北部设神龛，主祀玄天上帝，并保存有明代木雕神像。梁架衔接处施以大量精巧的斗拱，明显有别于其他的廊桥。桥东南侧近处有高1.2米、宽1.8米的天然山岩，上有宋绍定元年（1228）楷书摩崖题刻一段，曰："古田县长官陈□/舍财结东畔道头乞/保合家平安者/绍定元年立"，字径0.12米。该桥修建年代有明确纪年，是研究木拱廊桥发展史的重要实物资料。龙津桥的一大奇怪之处是该桥不是两边畅通的，桥的一端几乎被岩石堵住，只在侧面留有仅容一人通过的狭窄通道。看来当初耗费如此人力的庞然大物，并非用于舟车之便，而只是供行人通过的村际桥梁而已，那人们耗费钱财，聘请高明的师傅修建此桥的初衷到底是什么呢？如果单纯的作为交通设施，是否有些浪费，有些大材小用？如果不是，那么这个桥的其他用途甚至说更重要的功能是什么呢？跋山涉水之余，坐在桥中小憩，饱览这一片山水，难免要感谢修桥人的绸缪周至。
projects.content_en: Longjin Bridge stands about 1 kilometer southeast of Liuyuan Village, Tingping Township, Minhou County, about 6 kilometers from Kengping Village where Kengping Bridge is located. First built in the Song Dynasty, it was converted to a timber-arch covered bridge in 1631 (the fourth year of Chongzhen reign, Ming), and restored in 1755 (the 20th year of Qianlong reign), 1843 (the 23rd year of Daoguang reign), and 1998. Running east-west, it is 33 meters long and 4.3 meters wide. Using sheer cliff boulders as abutments, a timber arch frame of interlocked Chinese fir logs supports round log beams, with wooden planks laid across as the deck and a covered hall above. The hall has a hip-and-gable roof with beam-lifting timber frame, 11 bays wide and 4 columns deep. Long benches and lattice railings line both sides. A shrine in the north of the central bay worships the Xuan Tian Great Emperor and preserves a Ming Dynasty wood-carved deity. The beam joints feature numerous exquisite bracket sets (dougong), clearly distinct from other covered bridges. Near the southeast side, a natural rock 1.2 meters high and 1.8 meters wide bears a Song Dynasty (1228, first year of Shaoding reign) regular-script cliff inscription: "Magistrate Chen of Gutian County / donated to build the east path / praying for family peace / erected in the first year of Shaoding," with characters 0.12 meters in diameter. With its clearly dated construction, this bridge is important physical material for studying the development history of timber-arch covered bridges. One oddity of Longjin Bridge is that it is not open at both ends: one end is almost blocked by rock, with only a narrow side passage for one person. It seems this massive structure, built at such labor cost, was not for vehicles but merely for pedestrian passage between villages — so what was the original intention? If purely for transportation, was it wasteful, over-engineered? If not, what other, perhaps more important, function did it serve? After trekking through mountains and waters, resting in the bridge and taking in the landscape, one cannot help but thank the bridge builders for their thorough foresight.

projects.name: 泰山桥
projects.address: 福州市闽侯县廷坪乡后溪村
projects.address_en: Houxi Village, Tingping Township, Minhou County, Fuzhou
highlights: 木拱桥结构
工匠线索
桥村关系
古道线索
全封闭风雨板
projects.content_zh: 泰山桥位于廷坪乡后溪村，从尾桥村的岔路口到后溪大约4公里。泰山桥因桥头有泰山庙而得名，风雨板全封闭，屋顶施以灰瓦，未作装饰，看上去厚重朴实。泰山桥始建年代不详，民国二十二年（1933年）重建，建桥的木匠为古田路上人徐添春。传说泰山桥原为藤桥，周围各乡到罗源县都要经此。后毁，村民在原址重建泰山桥。今天的桥梁是单孔木拱廊桥，东西走向。全长27.9米、宽4.3米、拱跨约21.6米、离水面11.9米。桥堍以天然的岩石为基，用块石垒砌而成。用圆木穿插交错成多组拱架，上顺铺圆木为梁，再横铺木板为桥面。廊屋悬山顶，穿斗式木构架，8间36柱。桥两侧设有木栏杆，外加挡雨板。因风雨板全封闭的缘故，廊屋内光线比较暗。这是泰山桥唯一的对外视角，仅有一处与外界相通。桥屋内明间设神龛，主祀玄天大帝。泰山桥周边环境极佳，没有任何现代建筑的痕迹，溪水潺潺，大石林立，坐在石上仰观虹桥，确是别样享受。
