projects.content_zh: 开车出了工地林立的莆田市，向木兰溪入海口进发，大约半个小时，就能看到鼎鼎大名的宁海桥。大桥位于涵江区镇前村与莆田县黄石镇桥兜村之间，是真正架在海上的石梁桥，在国内也没有几座。有些遗憾的是古桥实际上是藏在新桥桥面下边的。那是1983年的工程，虽是无奈之举，也不知机动车的振动对老结构有多大影响，所幸桥墩、石梁、望柱等构件保存完整，或许也是一条保留古桥的新思路。元元统二年（1334年），龟山寺僧越浦始募捐建桥，历十数年落成。既然是桥梁，日日使用，后代修缮也是必然之举。大桥南北走向，通长225.7米，宽5.8米，以巨大石梁架设桥面，架桥条石上刻有捐施者的姓名和捐资数额。桥共有14墩，分水15门，墩为两头尖的船形，墩上砌三层悬臂，以减少石梁跨度。桥面两旁设石扶栏，望柱上雕刻石狮。桥两端各设有两尊高约3米、戴盔披甲执长剑的护桥将军石像，其中桥北两尊为明代原物。远远望去，桥北岸有吉祥寺，桥南端有观音楼。吉祥寺是当年越浦和尚筹资营建宁海桥的落脚处。斗转星移，只不知当年的海水是不是比今天的清澈些呢？和尚化缘的技巧是不是比今天的笨拙些呢？
projects.content_en: Driving out of Putian City with its forest of construction sites, heading toward the estuary of the Mulan River, in about half an hour one can see the famous Ninghai Bridge. The bridge is located between Zhenqian Village in Hanjiang District and Qiaodou Village in Huangshi Town, Putian County — a stone beam bridge truly spanning the sea, of which there are few in the country. It is somewhat regrettable that the ancient bridge is actually hidden beneath the deck of a new bridge. That was a 1983 project; though a last resort, and it is unknown how much the vibration of motor vehicles affects the old structure, fortunately components such as piers, stone beams, and baluster posts are well preserved — perhaps this is also a new approach to preserving ancient bridges. In 1334 (the second year of Yuantong reign, Yuan), Monk Yuepu of Guishan Temple began fundraising to build the bridge, which took over ten years to complete. Since it is a bridge used daily, restoration by later generations was inevitable. The bridge runs north-south, with a total length of 225.7 meters and width of 5.8 meters, with the deck laid with giant stone beams; the stone beams for the bridge are engraved with the names and donation amounts of donors. The bridge has 14 piers and 15 water openings; the piers are boat-shaped with pointed ends, and three layers of cantilevers are built on the piers to reduce the span of the stone beams. Stone railings are set on both sides of the deck, with stone lions carved on the baluster posts. At each end of the bridge there are two stone statues of bridge-protecting generals about 3 meters high, wearing helmets and armor and holding long swords; the two on the north side of the bridge are original Ming works. From afar, on the north bank of the bridge there is Jixiang Temple, and at the south end there is Guanyin Tower. Jixiang Temple was the place where Monk Yuepu stayed when raising funds to build Ninghai Bridge. As time passes, I only wonder whether the seawater of that day was clearer than today's? And whether the monk's alms-begging skills were clumsier than today's?

projects.name: 黄石文庙
projects.address: 莆田市莆田县黄石镇水南村
projects.address_en: Shuinan Village, Huangshi Town, Putian County, Putian
highlights: 格局
木结构
遗址
唐创建红泉宫
明代改为文庙
清康熙二十四年重建
黄石镇中心小学内
大成殿重檐歇山顶
前檐明间廊柱浮雕盘龙
如翚斯飞起翘
projects.content_zh: 古时地方官学和文庙往往在一起，民国以来用文庙来作公立学校也是常有的做法。仿佛只要老夫子还有一口气在，乱世乱掉的教育就总还有救。可叹拿"旧道德"管束族人的乡绅们被斩草除根了，摩登的教育基本把孔夫子的游丝之气扼断了，即便成立了再多的孔子学院，也很少有人真心相信孔子的学说。时代或者真的进步了？黄石文庙就在黄石镇中心小学内，部分建筑用作校舍。史料记载，此庙创建于唐，称红泉宫，明代改为文庙，今存建筑为清康熙二十四年（1685年）重建。文庙坐东北朝西南，现存建筑包括大成殿、廊庑、泮池、下马碑等。大成殿是最重要的建筑，重檐歇山顶，面阔五间，前檐明间开间宽阔，明间左右缝的廊柱还浮雕盘龙，是孔庙大成殿常有的做法。上层檐正脊和檐口两端都有非常明显的起翘，如翚斯飞；下层檐要舒缓很多，翼角还是南方典型的做法；檐下斗拱只在柱头，石柱间并无过多枋木连缀。不想再重复看到其他文庙时候的感慨了，只是因为它们还在，觉得自己几十年来念书积淀下的情感牵挂也还在。
projects.content_en: In ancient times, local government schools and Confucian temples were often together; since the Republic of China, using Confucian temples as public schools has also been a common practice. As if as long as the Old Master still had a breath left, the education disrupted in troubled times would always have hope. It is lamentable that the local gentry who used "old morality" to discipline their clans were eradicated root and branch, and modern education has basically cut off Confucius's gossamer-thin influence; even if more Confucius Institutes are established, few people truly believe in Confucius's teachings. Has the era truly progressed? Huangshi Confucian Temple is inside Huangshi Town Central Primary School, with some buildings used as schoolhouses. Historical records show that this temple was founded in the Tang, called Hongquan Palace, and converted to a Confucian temple in the Ming; the existing buildings were rebuilt in 1685 (the 24th year of Kangxi reign, Qing). The Confucian temple faces southwest from the northeast; the existing buildings include the Dacheng Hall, side corridors, Pan Pond, and Dismount-from-Horse Stele. The Dacheng Hall is the most important building, with a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, five bays wide; the central bay of the front eave is wide, and the corridor columns on the left and right sides of the central bay also have coiled dragons in relief — a common practice in Confucian temple Dacheng Halls. Both the main ridge and the ends of the eave of the upper eave have very obvious upward curves, "like a pheasant in flight"; the lower eave is much more gentle, and the wing corners are still a typical southern method; the bracket sets under the eaves are only at the column tops, with no excessive timber lintels connecting between the stone columns. I don't want to repeat the lament I had when seeing other Confucian temples; it is just because they are still there, I feel that the emotional attachment I have accumulated from decades of studying is still there.

projects.name: 湄洲妈祖庙
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.dynasty_en: Song to Qing to Modern Era
projects.address: 莆田市湄洲镇湄洲岛宫下村
projects.address_en: Gongxia Village, Meizhou Island, Meizhou Town, Putian
highlights: 寺院格局
早期石作遗迹
晚期木结构
妈祖信仰祖庙
宋初灵惠夫人
明永乐初郑和奉旨建正殿
清康熙二十二年重修改正殿
透雕龙柱
明洪武七年寝殿
圣父母祠宋代天井遗迹
projects.content_zh: 信仰之于出生入死的人，那就是能够出生入死的理由；妈祖信仰之于出海的渔民和岸上翘首以盼的家人，那就是相互眺望的寄托。湄洲妈祖庙被列为"国保"，在某种程度上是对活着的妈祖信仰的尊重。要拜谒湄洲妈祖庙，要先从文甲码头乘轮渡到湄洲岛。20分钟的旅途仿佛是远行的前奏，心绪早已不在是不是要看古建筑上了。今天妈祖庙留下来的建筑事实上经过了"文革"的严重破坏和1978年的大规模重修。追溯始建历史，则一直到宋朝，起初庙宇供奉的或许不是妈祖，还是《潜说友临安志》里提到的"灵惠夫人"。渔民代代繁衍，重修历代不辍，至清乾隆后，得以基本定型为今天的妈祖庙制度——以正殿为主体，尚存正殿、寝殿、圣父母祠三座院落。正殿系明永乐初（1403年）郑和奉旨建造，原本是朝天阁，清康熙二十二年（1683年）重修并改为正殿。重檐歇山顶，面阔三间、进深三间，抬梁式结构，前檐廊下有一对透雕龙柱。寝殿最早由明洪武七年（1374年）重建于北宋妈祖纪念祠旧址上，明、清及民国年间均有重修。由门殿、主殿和两庑组成，今尚存古老的天井地面。圣父母祠始建于宋初，现存的是清初重修的结果，正堂面阔三间、进深一间，悬山顶穿斗式木构架，专家称天井也是宋代的遗迹。
projects.content_en: For people who risk life and death, faith is the reason they can risk life and death; for fishermen who go to sea and their families waiting anxiously on shore, Mazu faith is the sustenance of mutual gazing. Meizhou Mazu Temple being listed as a "National Key Cultural Heritage Site" is, to some extent, respect for the living Mazu faith. To visit Meizhou Mazu Temple, one must first take a ferry from Wenjia Wharf to Meizhou Island. The 20-minute journey seems like a prelude to a long journey, and one's mind is no longer on whether to see ancient architecture. The buildings remaining at Mazu Temple today have in fact undergone severe destruction during the Cultural Revolution and large-scale restoration in 1978. Tracing back the founding history, it goes all the way to the Song Dynasty; initially the temple may not have enshrined Mazu, but rather the "Lady Linghui" mentioned in Qian Shuoyou's "Lin'an Annals." As fishermen multiplied generation after generation, restorations continued through successive dynasties; after the Qing Qianlong reign, it was basically finalized as today's Mazu Temple system — with the main hall as the主体, three courtyards still surviving: the main hall, the sleeping hall, and the Holy Parents Shrine. The main hall was built by Zheng He by imperial order in the early Yongle reign of the Ming (1403), originally as Chaotian Pavilion; in 1683 (the 22nd year of Kangxi reign, Qing), it was restored and converted to the main hall. It has a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, three bays wide and three deep, with beam-lifting structure, and a pair of openwork-carved dragon columns under the front eave corridor. The sleeping hall was first rebuilt in 1374 (the seventh year of Hongwu reign, Ming) on the old site of the Northern Song Mazu Memorial Shrine, with restorations in the Ming, Qing, and Republican periods. It consists of a gate hall, main hall, and two side wings; the ancient skylight ground still survives today. The Holy Parents Shrine was first built in the early Song; what exists now is the result of early Qing restoration, with the main hall three bays wide and one deep, with an overhanging gable roof and column-and-tie timber frame; experts say the skylight is also a Song Dynasty relic.

projects.name: 平海天后宫
projects.name_en: Temple of the Queen of Heaven in Pinghai
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 莆田市秀屿区平海镇平海村
projects.address_en: Pinghai Village, Pinghai Town, Xiuyu District, Putian
highlights: 寺院格局
早期石作遗迹
晚期木结构
北宋咸平二年始建
清康熙二十二年施琅奏请重建
百柱宫108根杉木柱
师泉井淡水距海百米
师泉井记重修碑记
重檐歇山顶抬梁穿斗混合
projects.content_zh: 不管是天后，还是天妃，还是妈祖，都是在海上法力无边的。《元史》上说："南海女神灵惠夫人……护海运有奇应，加封天妃神号……"官方自有官方的角度和口气。平海天后宫的历史则与另一位历史名人有关——施琅。清康熙二十二年（1683年），清政府收复台湾。为了抚恤沿海民众，施琅奏请朝廷重建此宫。至于此宫始建于北宋咸平二年（999年）的痕迹，则只有寻找石构件中的蛛丝马迹了。此宫的布局是很隆重的，沿中轴线依次有照壁、外大埕、师泉井、山门、内埕及东西廊、瞻拜亭前祭台、瞻拜亭、正殿等。据说全宫加在一起用了108根杉木柱，所以又俗称"百柱宫"。外埕上山门外有一口师泉井，是施琅踏破铁鞋终在眼下觅得的水源，满潮时，此淡水井距大海不过一百来米。此处《师泉井记》和《平海天后宫重修碑记》记载了此宫的来龙去脉，是重要史料证据。天后宫的正殿面阔五间，进深五间，采用重檐歇山顶，为抬梁、穿斗混合木构。至于近年来重修的屋面和彩绘，应当是国家级的专家监管下的产物。到底新的有什么工艺上的超凡之处，能否向我们介绍一下？或者是保留上下一代沧桑的做法有什么技术上的困难？还是之前的做法过于简单破败，与大庙的身份不相称？抑或是民情激昂，非要一身新装和油彩来掩盖皱纹和老年斑？
projects.content_en: Whether called the Queen of Heaven, the Heavenly Consort, or Mazu, all are boundlessly powerful at sea. The "History of Yuan" says: "The South Sea Goddess Lady Linghui... had miraculous responses in protecting sea transport, and was conferred the title of Heavenly Consort..." Officials have their own perspectives and tone. The history of Pinghai Tianhou Palace is related to another historical figure — Shi Lang. In 1683 (the 22nd year of Kangxi reign, Qing), the Qing government recovered Taiwan. To console the coastal people, Shi Lang petitioned the court to rebuild this palace. As for traces of its original founding in 999 (the second year of Xianping reign, Northern Song), one can only search for clues in the stone components. The layout of this palace is very grand; along the central axis there are依次 the screen wall, outer great courtyard, Shiquan Well, mountain gate, inner courtyard and east-west corridors, sacrificial platform in front of the worship pavilion, worship pavilion, and main hall. It is said that the entire palace together used 108 fir columns, hence it is also commonly called the "Hundred-Column Palace." Outside the mountain gate in the outer courtyard there is a Shiquan Well, the water source that Shi Lang finally found after searching everywhere; at high tide, this freshwater well is only about a hundred meters from the sea. The "Record of Shiquan Well" and "Stele Record of the Restoration of Pinghai Tianhou Palace" here record the history of this palace and are important historical evidence. The main hall of Tianhou Palace is five bays wide and five deep, with a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, using a mixed beam-lifting and column-and-tie timber structure. As for the roof and paintings restored in recent years, they should be products under the supervision of national-level experts. What extraordinary craftsmanship does the new version have, could you introduce it to us? Or is there some technical difficulty in preserving the weathered appearance of the previous generation? Or was the previous method too simple and dilapidated, incompatible with the status of a great temple? Or is it that public sentiment is so passionate that it insists on a new outfit and paint to cover wrinkles and age spots?

projects.name: 莆禧城墙
projects.address: 莆田市莆田县山亭乡莆禧村西南
projects.address_en: Southwest of Puxi Village, Shanting Township, Putian County, Putian
highlights: 城市格局
气氛
忠门半岛南端湄洲岛隔海相望
防御海上倭寇
福建明代三大抗倭古城之一
明洪武二十年建成
嘉靖年间戚继光抗倭据点
projects.content_zh: 位于忠门半岛南端与湄洲岛隔海相望的，用来保护渔民一家老小的，有一座莆禧古城。从地利的角度来看，古城不是防御来自陆地上的进攻，而是防御来自海上的威胁。不错，敌人会乘船而来，敌人是倭寇。与惠安崇武古城、霞浦大京城齐名，莆禧古城为福建省现存明代三大抗倭古城之一。从明洪武二十年（1387年）起，城墙就已经建成，到了嘉靖年间，这里成为戚继光的军队与倭寇作战的重要据点，并曾在此取得过战...
projects.content_en: Located at the southern tip of the Zhongmen Peninsula, facing Meizhou Island across the sea, there is an ancient Puxi city built to protect fishermen and their families. From a geographical advantage perspective, the ancient city was not defending against attacks from land, but against threats from the sea. Indeed, the enemy would come by boat — the enemy was the Japanese pirates (wokou). Ranking alongside the ancient Chongwu city in Hui'an and Dajing city in Xiapu, the ancient Puxi city is one of the three surviving Ming Dynasty anti-Japanese-pirate ancient cities in Fujian Province. From 1387 (the 20th year of Hongwu reign, Ming), the city wall had already been built; by the Jiajing reign, this place became an important stronghold for Qi Jiguang's army fighting the Japanese pirates, and battles were won here...

projects.name_en: Ancestral Hall of the Queen of Heaven in Xianliang Port
projects.address: 莆田市山亭乡港里村东北500米

妈祖出生地
林默螺港生人

梁启超楹联
奉旨春秋谕祭木牌
projects.content_zh: 到了文甲不去码头，搭一辆摩托车，就能去看看贤良港的天后祖祠。唤作"祖祠"，是因为人们说这里是海上女神妈祖的出生地。妈祖的本名叫作林默，是螺港生人，螺港就是贤良港的古称。潜说友《临安志》里说，林默的父亲是五代闽王统军兵马使林愿，她排行第六，能乘席渡海，云游岛屿，人呼龙女。到了宋雍熙四年（987年），妈祖"升仙羽化"了。尔后，乡人开始修祠祭祀。今天的祖祠建于明初，新成的北京太和殿遭雷劈的那年，永乐十九年（1421年）祠毁。清康熙二十三年（1684年）重建。近年又有修葺扩建。于是我们看到的是牌坊、山门、拜亭、正殿、父母祠等一串建筑，以及祠内的梁启超等名人撰写的楹联，还有重修碑记、历朝褒封徽号碑刻和"奉旨春秋谕祭"木牌等珍贵文物资料。
projects.content_en: Arriving at Wenjia without going to the wharf, taking a motorcycle, one can go see the Tianhou Ancestral Hall at Xianliang Port. It is called "Ancestral Hall" because people say this is the birthplace of the sea goddess Mazu. Mazu's original name was Lin Mo, born in Luogang — Luogang is the ancient name of Xianliang Port. Qian Shuoyou's "Lin'an Annals" says that Lin Mo's father was Lin Yuan, the military commander of the Min King in the Five Dynasties; she was the sixth child, could cross the sea riding a mat, wander among islands, and was called the Dragon Maiden. In 987 (the fourth year of Yongxi reign, Song), Mazu "ascended as an immortal." Thereafter, villagers began to build a shrine for worship. Today's ancestral hall was built in the early Ming; in the year the newly completed Beijing Hall of Supreme Harmony was struck by lightning — 1421 (the 19th year of Yongle reign) — the shrine was destroyed. It was rebuilt in 1684 (the 23rd year of Kangxi reign, Qing). In recent years it has again been repaired and expanded. Thus what we see is a string of buildings including the paifang, mountain gate, worship pavilion, main hall, and Parents' Shrine, as well as couplets written by famous people such as Liang Qichao inside the hall, and precious cultural relics such as restoration stele records, stele carvings of imperial honorary titles through successive dynasties, and the wooden plaque of "Imperially Ordered Spring and Autumn Sacrificial Offerings."

projects.name: 永兴岩寺
projects.address: 莆田市莆田县大洋乡院埔村东北500米
projects.address_en: 500 meters northeast of Yuanpu Village, Dayang Township, Putian County, Putian
highlights: 寺院格局
石作仿木作遗迹
瑞云山丹崖峭壁
刘克庄董其昌邓石如书法
石窟寺依天然石穴而造
三个并排连拱券顶门洞
永兴祖殿观音殿五海龙王殿
花岗石梭形柱卷杀
覆盆式莲花柱础
一斗三升式斗拱
宋绍兴始建元贞三年重建至正二年重修
projects.content_zh: 瑞云山永兴岩景区，是绿色渲染的丹崖峭壁。我们今天看到的景色曾经迷住了南朝大词人刘克庄、明朝的名臣大书法家董其昌、清朝陕甘总督荣英昌、清代大书法家邓石如等。巨石之上，满是绝妙的书法，说的是大山对自己的矜夸。永兴岩石窟寺建在壁立千仞的绝壁之下，依天然石穴而造，远远望去，是山水画中不可少的一笔。洞坐南朝北，建造也是紧贴岩壁，用规整的条石砌成三个并排大小不一的连拱券顶门洞，划分为三间，面积420平方米，门券中各筑一殿，从左到右依次为永兴祖殿、观音殿、五海龙王殿。三殿之间有壁门相通。柱、梁、枋、斗拱等构件均为花岗石。石柱大多呈梭形，下端有明显的卷杀，覆盆式莲花柱础，柱高4米。柱头铺作一斗三升式，斗有欹，斗底有皿板痕迹。补间铺作一朵，石梁两端多有卷杀。寺内尚存宋、元石刻对联，元、明、清重修碑刻，多尊及元代石雕神像。寺是宋绍兴年间（1131—1162年）始建的，在元贞三年（1297年）重建，至正二年（1342年）又重修，到了清代才筑外墙加以保护，成了我们看到的立面效果。所以说殿内仿木石构是原汁原味的元朝手法。
projects.content_en: The Yongxing Rock scenic area of Ruiyun Mountain is a red cliff precipice rendered in green. The scenery we see today once fascinated the great Southern Song ci poet Liu Kezhuang, the Ming dynasty famous official and great calligrapher Dong Qichang, the Qing dynasty Shaan-Gan Governor Rong Yingchang, and the Qing dynasty great calligrapher Deng Shiru, among others. On the giant rocks, there is exquisite calligraphy everywhere, speaking of the mountain's own boastfulness. Yongxing Rock Cave Temple was built beneath a thousand-ren precipice, constructed according to a natural stone cave; from afar, it is an indispensable stroke in a landscape painting. The cave faces north from the south, and its construction also clings tightly to the rock wall, using neatly dressed stone blocks to build three side-by-side connected arch-vaulted doorways of varying sizes, divided into three bays with an area of 420 square meters; each doorway contains a hall, from left to right依次 the Yongxing Ancestral Hall, Guanyin Hall, and Five-Sea Dragon King Hall. The three halls are connected by wall doors. Components such as columns, beams, lintels, and bracket sets are all granite. Most stone columns are spindle-shaped, with obvious entasis (juansha) at the lower ends, and inverted-basin lotus column bases, with columns 4 meters high. The column-top bracket sets are of the one-bracket-three-arm (yidou sansheng) type, with the bracket block having a sloped side and traces of a base plate at the bottom. There is one intermediate bracket set per bay, and both ends of the stone beams mostly have entasis. The temple still preserves Song and Yuan stone-carved couplets, Yuan, Ming, and Qing restoration stele carvings, and multiple Yuan Dynasty stone-carved deity statues. The temple was first built during the Shaoxing reign of the Song (1131–1162), rebuilt in 1297 (the third year of Yuanzhen reign, Yuan), and restored again in 1342 (the second year of Zhizheng reign); only in the Qing was an outer wall built for protection, resulting in the facade effect we see. Therefore, the imitation-timber stone structure inside the halls is authentic Yuan Dynasty technique.

projects.name: 镇海堤
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 莆田县黄石镇木兰溪下游
projects.address_en: Lower reaches of Mulan River, Huangshi Town, Putian County
highlights: 古堤坝
凭吊
原名东甲堤
唐元和元年闽浙观察使裴次元创建
3.4公里福建省第一大堤
明洪武年间石堤被拆
清雍正道光年间两次重修石堤
1952年整修1961年加高
明代镇海塔朱慧虚先生墓
projects.content_zh: 镇海堤，原名东甲堤，在木兰溪下游两岸。最早在唐元和元年（806年）由闽浙观察使裴次元创建。当时的做法是加建石堤。在莆田南洋围垦东北角，有最易被风潮冲毁的土堤需要加固，这一做就是3.4公里，自黄石镇东甲村至遮浪村，至今仍是福建省第一大堤。后来经过历代兴废，明洪武年间石堤被拆，此后仅余土堤，屡修屡毁，清雍正、道光年间两次重修石堤。解放后，1952年整修，1961年加高。今天到镇海堤，与其说是做什么学术观察，不如说是纯粹的放松。堤坝远处泥泞难行，索性站在石条铺就的堤面上感受人工的渺小和伟大。天边积云滚滚，存在是最大的生计。忘却了本来的计划，周边还有坐落在赤屿的明代镇海塔和朱慧虚先生墓。
projects.content_en: Zhenhai Dam, originally named Dongjia Dam, is on both banks of the lower reaches of the Mulan River. It was first built in 806 (the first year of Yuanhe reign, Tang) by Pei Ciyuan, the Surveillance Commissioner of Fujian and Zhejiang. The method at that time was to add a stone dam. At the northeast corner of the Putian Nanyang reclamation area, there was an earthen dam most easily destroyed by wind and tide that needed reinforcement; this work stretched 3.4 kilometers, from Dongjia Village to Zhelang Village in Huangshi Town, and it remains the largest dam in Fujian Province to this day. Later, through the rise and fall of successive dynasties, the stone dam was dismantled during the Hongwu reign of the Ming; thereafter only the earthen dam remained, repeatedly repaired and repeatedly destroyed; during the Yongzheng and Daoguang reigns of the Qing, the stone dam was restored twice. After liberation, it was renovated in 1952 and raised in 1961. Visiting Zhenhai Dam today is less an academic observation than pure relaxation. The far end of the dam is muddy and difficult to walk on, so one might as well stand on the dam surface paved with stone strips to feel the smallness and greatness of human effort. Clouds roll at the horizon, and existence is the greatest livelihood. Forgetting the original plan, nearby there are also the Ming Dynasty Zhenhai Tower and the tomb of Mr. Zhu Huixu located on Chiyu.

projects.name: 东门石坊
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 莆田市仙游县城东镇东门村东150米
projects.address_en: 150 meters east of Dongmen Village, Chengdong Town, Xianyou County, Putian
highlights: 石仿木结构
石雕装饰
清代石牌坊
高16米宽8米三开间
重檐三滴水
浮雕圆雕透雕
乐善好施
道光五年陈天高遗命子涵辉捐助金石书院
projects.content_zh: 东门石坊是清代的石牌坊。石构仿木，高16米，宽8米，三开间，重檐三滴水。遍饰人物、瑞兽等，雕刻手法包括浮雕、圆雕、透雕，雕工细腻，是福建地方石雕艺术之典型代表。雕刻玲珑，棱角平直，却少了岁月的痕迹。牌坊上书"乐善好施"四字，其下有铭文牌："诰赠奉直大夫候选州同陈天高遗命子 诰授奉直大夫候选州同加二级涵辉捐助金石书院经费事特旨扁奖赐帑金建坊"，年代是"道光五年（1825年）桂月毂旦"。用语远不古奥，也没有值得回味之处，但所做却是实实在在的教育事业。
projects.content_en: Dongmen Stone Archway is a Qing Dynasty stone paifang. Stone structure imitating timber, 16 meters high and 8 meters wide, with three bays and double eaves with three water-drips. It is decorated throughout with figures and auspicious beasts, with carving techniques including relief, round carving, and openwork carving; the carving is exquisite and is a typical representative of Fujian local stone carving art. The carving is delicate with straight edges and corners, but lacks the traces of time. The archway bears the four characters "Leshang Haoshi" (Delighting in Goodness and Being Generous), below which there is an inscription plaque: "By imperial decree, posthumously granted Fengzhi Dafu and candidate Zhou Tong Chen Tiangao's dying command to his son; by imperial decree, granted Fengzhi Dafu and candidate Zhou Tong plus second rank Han Hui donated funds for the Jinshi Academy; by special imperial decree, awarded a plaque and granted treasury gold to build the archway," dated "An auspicious day in the eighth month of the fifth year of Daoguang (1825)." The language is far from archaic and has nothing worth savoring, but what was done was a tangible educational endeavor.

projects.name: 龙华双塔
projects.address: 莆田市仙游县龙华镇灯塔村
projects.address_en: Dengta Village, Longhua Town, Xianyou County, Putian
highlights: 石塔形制
比例尺度
风景环境
北宋大观政和年间郭勇为母寿建
石砌仿木结构五层楼阁式
八角形平面通高44.8米
每层开四门内设四龛位置逐层互换
相轮塔刹
塔内佛像须弥宝座石雕
明嘉靖倭寇烧损烟熏黑色
清康熙五十八年重修
projects.content_zh: 给母亲做寿，孝子总会拿出令人惊喜的礼物。北宋大观、政和年间（1107—1118年）郭勇为母七十和八十寿诞，先后建了两座塔，一东一西，位于仙游县龙华镇的龙华寺前，合称龙华双塔。双塔皆坐北朝南，石砌仿木结构，五层楼阁式，八角形平面，通高44.8米。底层由石柱、鹅卵石及不规则石块砌筑。以上各层，东西两塔材料构造有异。双塔每层开四门，内设四龛，位置逐层互换；各层有石阶可直达顶层。塔檐层层叠涩出挑，塔顶装相轮塔刹。塔身表面虽朴实无华，塔内佛像、须弥宝座、台阶等处有大量的石雕，内容丰富，工艺精湛。明嘉靖年间（1522—1566年）塔座曾经被倭寇烧损，至今能看到双塔底层有显著烟熏而成的黑色。清康熙五十八年（1719年），双塔得到了重修。20世纪五六十年代又有重新整修的举措。
projects.content_en: For a mother's birthday, a filial son will always拿出 surprising gifts. During the Daguan and Zhenghe reigns of the Northern Song (1107–1118), Guo Yong built two pagodas successively for his mother's 70th and 80th birthdays, one east and one west, located in front of Longhua Temple in Longhua Town, Xianyou County, collectively called the Longhua Double Pagodas. Both pagodas face south from the north, with stone masonry imitating timber structure, five-story multi-story style, octagonal plan, and a total height of 44.8 meters. The bottom layer is built of stone columns, cobblestones, and irregular stone blocks. Above each layer, the east and west pagodas differ in materials and construction. Each layer of both pagodas has four doors and four niches inside, with positions alternating layer by layer; each layer has stone steps leading directly to the top. The pagoda eaves project layer by layer with corbelling (diese), and the top is fitted with a相轮 finial. Although the pagoda body surface is plain and unadorned, there are大量 stone carvings at the Buddha statues, xumi thrones, and steps inside the pagoda, with rich content and exquisite craftsmanship. During the Jiajing reign of the Ming (1522–1566), the pagoda bases were once burned and damaged by Japanese pirates; to this day, significant smoke-blackened areas can be seen at the bottom layers of both pagodas. In 1719 (the 58th year of Kangxi reign, Qing), both pagodas were restored. In the 1950s and 1960s, there were further renovation measures.

projects.name: 龙纪寺
projects.address: 莆田市仙游县盖尾乡昌山村
projects.address_en: Changshan Village, Gaiwei Township, Xianyou County, Putian
highlights: 木构六角亭
德化白瓷五百罗汉
始创于汉佛教最早痕迹
清末重修
清光绪二十五年上帝殿
木构二层楼阁式
上层歇山顶下层六角形出檐
清代德化白瓷雕塑神态各异栩栩如生
projects.content_zh: 龙纪寺始创于汉，那是佛教在中国最早的痕迹之一。不过历代兴废之后——或许历代人都怀揣着类似当代人"再塑金身"的心态，或许反之——今天保存下来的就主要是清末重修的结果了。直奔主题，寺内最有代表性的建筑为上帝殿，又称六角亭，建于清光绪二十五年（1899年），那是在西方现代建筑流派已然蠢蠢欲动的年代建造的一座木构二层楼阁式建筑。此殿上层歇山顶，下层为六角形出檐，故名。更精确地聚焦主题，就是五百罗汉瓷雕。入得六角亭内，周围壁柜祀供着五百罗汉。细观之则为清代德化白瓷雕塑，神态各异，栩栩如生。虽说每一件罗汉单独拿出来都堪称珍贵文物，但是只有在这里，在人们本来为他们准备好的环境中，用人们认为最得体的工艺制造出来，才是他们真正的价值所在。
projects.content_en: Longji Temple was first founded in the Han Dynasty, one of the earliest traces of Buddhism in China. However, after successive rises and falls — perhaps people of every generation harbored a mentality similar to contemporary people's "re-gilding the golden body," or perhaps the opposite — what survives today is mainly the result of late Qing restoration. Going straight to the point, the most representative building in the temple is the Shangdi Hall, also called the Hexagonal Pavilion, built in 1899 (the 25th year of Guangxu reign, Qing), a two-story timber pavilion-style building constructed in an era when Western modern architectural movements were already stirring. This hall has a hip-and-gable roof on the upper level and hexagonal projecting eaves on the lower level, hence its name. More precisely focusing on the theme, it is the five hundred arhat porcelain carvings. Entering the hexagonal pavilion, the surrounding wall cabinets enshrine five hundred arhats. Examining closely, they are Qing Dynasty Dehua white porcelain sculptures, each with a different expression, lifelike. Although each arhat taken alone can be called a precious cultural relic, only here, in the environment originally prepared for them, manufactured with the craftsmanship people considered most appropriate, is their true value found.

projects.name: 三会寺
projects.address: 莆田市仙游县大济镇三会村
projects.address_en: Sanhui Village, Daji Town, Xianyou County, Putian
highlights: 木结构
隋唐始创
明嘉靖年间重修
天王殿大雄宝殿
大雄宝殿明代风格单檐歇山式
面阔五间进深三间
梁架简洁斗拱有力
殿内藻井毗连清代彩画
北宋崇宁三年石槽盆
元大德九年大钟
projects.content_zh: 仙游聚集了规模化的传统手工业制造者，侧面说明了当地传统工艺的生机。龙山下的三会寺也是这个文化传统的见证者。寺始创于隋唐时期，历代多有兴废，今存建筑为明嘉靖年间重修，从现状面貌来看，晚近应有修缮。三会寺主要建筑包括天王殿和大雄宝殿。其中最具历史价值者为大雄宝殿。大殿主体结构尚保留有明代风格特征，单檐歇山式，面阔五间，进深三间，梁架简洁，斗拱有力。殿内藻井毗连，藻井内保存了大量清代彩画，内容丰富，颇具特色。寺内现存文物甚多，其中有北宋崇宁三年（1104年）的石槽盆。钟楼上立有一口大钟，为元代大德九年（1305年）所铸。
projects.content_en: Xianyou has gathered large-scale traditional handicraft manufacturers, which indirectly illustrates the vitality of local traditional crafts. Sanhui Temple at the foot of Long Mountain is also a witness to this cultural tradition. The temple was first founded during the Sui-Tang period, with many rises and falls through successive dynasties; the existing buildings were restored during the Jiajing reign of the Ming, and judging from the current appearance, there should have been recent repairs. The main buildings of Sanhui Temple include the Heavenly King Hall and the Mahavira Hall. Among them, the most historically valuable is the Mahavira Hall. The main structure of the hall still retains Ming Dynasty stylistic features, with a single-eave hip-and-gable style, five bays wide and three deep, with a simple beam frame and powerful bracket sets. The caisson ceilings inside the hall are adjacent, and a large number of Qing Dynasty painted decorations are preserved within the caissons, with rich content and distinctive features. There are many existing cultural relics in the temple, including a stone trough basin from 1104 (the third year of Chongning reign, Northern Song). A large bell stands in the bell tower, cast in 1305 (the ninth year of Dade reign, Yuan).

projects.name: 天中万寿塔
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 莆田市仙游县枫亭镇塔斗山
projects.address_en: Tadou Mountain, Fengting Town, Xianyou County, Putian

五代末始创
石构实心四方形五层
高7.4米边长5.1米
塔表面布满浮雕
第一层力神顶塔双龙相戏
第二层折枝花卉
第三层拱门浅龛佛像武士
