projects.content_zh: 深藏在一片苍翠中，尤溪县西滨镇西部山中的厚丰村原本默默无闻，让它出名的是村中的一座构筑奢华的郑氏大厝，也叫（郑）孔时公大厝。大厝始建于乾隆四十五年（1780年），历时十余年完成，道光年间增建护厝数间，并进行了维修，后亦有增容维护之举。大厝平面呈方形圆角，通面阔45米，通进深50米，建筑最高处三层，至高点13米，平实无华大门丝毫也不会给整体的巍峨壮观减色半分。很有幸在大厝的大门口遇到了郑氏大厝的管理者季先生，一位和善的老者，如果60岁算老的话。他当时正在忙于竖立"国宝碑"，因为郑氏大厝作为最新一批国家级文保单位已经获批了，季先生掩饰不住的高兴。看我远道而来，季先生热情地进行讲解，他对大厝的里里外外可说是如数家珍。很奇怪他虽自称是一普通农人，但他的普通话讲得很好，而且条理清楚，时不时让我感觉是一位大学里常见的操着南方口音的老师。建筑为歇山顶控制全局，坐北朝南。主体建筑由正厝、横厝和左右壁舍所组成。平面由一横厝、二壁舍、二厢房、三厅堂及九个过水亭连接，构成一个建筑整体。里面近祖堂、远祖堂、后楼、后花园，...
projects.content_en: Deeply hidden in a sea of green, Houfeng Village in the western mountains of Xibin Town, Youxi County, was originally unknown; what made it famous was a luxuriously constructed Zheng Clan Mansion in the village, also called (Zheng) Kongshi Gong Mansion. The mansion was first built in the 45th year of Qianlong reign (1780), taking over ten years to complete; during the Daoguang reign, several side wings (hucuo) were added and repairs were carried out, with later expansions and maintenance as well. The mansion plan is square with rounded corners, with a total width of 45 meters and total depth of 50 meters; the highest point of the building is three stories, reaching 13 meters at the apex. The plain and unadorned main gate in no way detracts from the overall majestic grandeur. I was fortunate to meet Mr. Ji, the manager of the Zheng Mansion, at the main gate — a kind elderly gentleman, if 60 counts as old. He was busy erecting the "National Treasure Stele," because the Zheng Mansion had just been approved as the latest batch of national-level cultural heritage protection units, and Mr. Ji could not hide his joy. Seeing me come from afar, Mr. Ji enthusiastically gave explanations; he knew the mansion inside and out like the back of his hand. Strangely, although he called himself an ordinary farmer, his Mandarin was very good and well-organized, from time to time making me feel like a common university teacher with a southern accent. The building uses a hip-and-gable roof (xieshan ding) to control the overall composition, facing south. The main building consists of the central residence (zhengcuo), side residences (hengcuo), and left and right wall houses (bishe). The plan is connected by one side residence, two wall houses, two wing rooms, three halls, and nine water-passing pavilions (guoshui ting), forming an architectural whole. Inside there are the near ancestral hall, far ancestral hall, rear building, and rear garden...

projects.name: 安良堡
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 三明市大田县桃源镇东坂村
projects.address_en: Dongban Village, Taoyuan Town, Datian County, Sanming
highlights: 利用地形的设计
防御设施
结构和装饰
大田土堡群特色强烈真正堡垒
防御为主居住为辅
距离平时民居聚集点50至150米方便村民危险时躲入
山区生活艰辛和艰辛生活中情趣淋漓尽致
现存年代最早土堡明洪武初年最晚民国三十七年
面积最大好几千平方米最小十几平方米
楼层最高7层最低2层
安良堡琵琶堡芳联堡泰安堡广崇堂列入全国重点文保大田土堡代表作品
坐西北向东南依山而建前方后弧
规模不大气势无法掩盖的强大
气势来自前后14米高差
因山起筑层叠而上阶状跑马道
门前护濠高台阶门洞内门前厅后厅三层建筑廊庑满足居住生活功能
始建于明末清中早期匪寇破之
清嘉庆十一年1806年重建历经战事百余起无损
山地环境建堡构造设计施工难度大施工质量要求高
设计和施工检验员是实实在在抵抗流寇的战斗
projects.content_zh: 大田的土堡群特色是很强烈的，是真正的堡垒，防御为主，居住为辅，仅距离平时的民居聚集点在50至150米，方便村民在出现危险时躲入堡内。在这里，山区生活的艰辛和艰辛生活中的情趣一同表现得淋漓尽致。现存年代最早的土堡是明洪武初年，最晚的是民国三十七年。面积最大的好几千平方米，最小的十几平方米，楼层最高的7层、最低的2层。这个安良堡和下文中的琵琶堡、芳联堡、泰安堡及广崇堂都已列入全国重点文物保护单位，是大田土堡的代表作品。安良堡，坐西北向东南，依山而建，前方后弧，规模不大，气势却是无法掩盖的强大。安良堡的气势来自于前后的14米高差，和它因山起筑、层叠而上的阶状"跑马道"。至于门前护濠、高台阶、门洞、内门、前厅、后厅三层建筑、廊庑则满足最基本的居住生活功能。据记载安良堡始建于明末，清中早期匪寇破之，清嘉庆十一年（1806年）重建，历经战事百余起无损。这样的山地环境建堡，构造设计和施工难度都很大，对于施工质量的要求也很高。况且，设计和施工的检验员将是实实在在的抵抗流寇的战斗。
projects.content_en: The earthen fort cluster of Datian has very strong characteristics — they are true fortresses, with defense as the primary function and residence as secondary, located only 50 to 150 meters from the usual residential gathering points, making it convenient for villagers to take shelter inside when danger arises. Here, the hardships of mountain life and the情趣 within hard life are both expressed to the fullest. The earliest surviving earthen fort dates to the early Hongwu reign of the Ming, and the latest to the 37th year of the Republic. The largest covers several thousand square meters, the smallest just over ten square meters; the tallest has 7 stories, the lowest 2. This Anliang Fort, along with Pipa Fort, Fanglian Fort, Taian Fort, and Guangchong Hall mentioned below, have all been listed as National Key Cultural Heritage Sites, and are representative works of Datian earthen forts. Anliang Fort faces southeast from the northwest, built against the mountain, with a square front and curved rear; it is not large in scale, but its imposing aura cannot be concealed. Anliang Fort's aura comes from the 14-meter height difference between front and rear, and its stepped "horse-running road" (paomadao) built up the mountain in layers. As for the moat in front of the gate, high steps, gate opening, inner gate, front hall, rear hall three-story building, and corridors — these satisfy the most basic residential living functions. According to records, Anliang Fort was first built in the late Ming, breached by bandits in the early-to-mid Qing, and rebuilt in the 11th year of Jiaqing reign (1806), surviving over a hundred battles without damage. Building a fort in such a mountain environment involves great difficulty in structural design and construction, with high requirements for construction quality. Moreover, the inspectors of design and construction would be the actual battles against roaming bandits.

projects.name: 芳联堡
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 三明市大田县均溪镇许思坑村
projects.address_en: Xusikeng Village, Junxi Town, Datian County, Sanming
highlights: 防御设施
排水系统
结构和装饰
没有依赖山体进行防御
建在舒缓地段上坐北向南好朝向
注重堡内生活品质
前方后圆规模较大建筑面积3000平方米
防御设施主体三合土堡墙
环堡跑马道对外布置射孔
堡门双重角落专门设置角楼
安全方位设计确保从清嘉庆十一年1806年始建一直没有大修过
印象最为深刻反而是堡内生活设施设计和装饰设计
无法掩饰的对生活的热爱
堡内两进三堂加后楼后院左右都有水井
建筑周边都有良好排水设施
厅堂斗拱和木雕
门窗花格和彩绘
檐头瓦作和泥塑
柱础和门枕上石雕
没有战争年代吸引村民流连于此的理由
projects.content_zh: 芳联堡没有依赖山体进行防御，与其他地区的土堡类似，建在舒缓的地段上，选得坐北向南的好朝向，也非常注重堡内的生活品质。此堡前方后圆，规模也属于较大者，建筑面积达到3000平方米。防御设施的主体是三合土堡墙，环堡跑马道对外布置射孔；堡门也为双重，角落专门设置了角楼。安全的方位设计确保芳联从清嘉庆十一年（1806年）始建一直就没有大修过。不过这里给人印象最为深刻的反而是堡内生活设施设计和装饰设计，那是一种无法掩饰的对生活的热爱。堡内两进三堂加后楼，后院左右都有水井，建筑周边都有良好的排水设施。还有就是厅堂的斗拱和木雕，门窗的花格和彩绘，檐头的瓦作和泥塑，柱础和门枕上的石雕，在没有战争的年代一定是吸引村民流连于此的理由。
projects.content_en: Fanglian Fort did not rely on the mountain for defense; similar to earthen forts in other regions, it was built on gently sloping terrain, chosen with a good south-facing orientation, and also paid great attention to the quality of life inside the fort. This fort has a square front and round rear, and is relatively large in scale, with a building area of 3,000 square meters. The main body of defensive facilities is the sanhetu (triple-mixed earth) fort wall, with shooting holes arranged outward along the encircling horse-running road; the fort gate is also double, with corner towers specially set at the corners. The safe orientation design ensured that Fanglian, from its first construction in the 11th year of Jiaqing reign (1806), has never undergone major repairs. However, what leaves the deepest impression here is instead the design of living facilities and decorative design inside the fort — an undisguised love of life. Inside the fort there are two courtyards, three halls, plus a rear building; in the rear courtyard there are wells on both left and right, and good drainage facilities around the buildings. There are also the dougong (bracket sets) and wood carvings in the halls, the lattice patterns and painted decorations on doors and windows, the tile work and clay sculptures on the eaves, and the stone carvings on the column bases (zhuchu) and door pillows — in times without war, these must have been the reasons attracting villagers to linger here.

projects.name: 琵琶堡
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 三明市大田县建设镇建国村
projects.address_en: Jianguo Village, Jianshe Town, Datian County, Sanming
highlights: 土堡造型设计
造型与环境的结合
存心要一个琵琶形平面土堡还是顺应地形自然而然
始建明洪武七年1374年明末重修清康熙咸丰年间修葺
不知道哪一代风水先生或是村子主人动的这番灵机
大山中一座孤傲的山冈上
按堡内正房朝向坐北朝南
从地面上领略建筑与地形随意而恰当的结合
自由的曲面夯土墙
不经意间抹在墙上的深灰色瓦顶
好一座中国古代的朗香教堂
规模不大占地面积3500平方米建筑面积近2000平方米
防卫起见门显得更小门洞前还辟一小方池
堡内跑马道一周
中轴线上建有三圣祠前楼观音阁等
更高山顶上俯瞰土堡整体布局一览无余
吉祥完美的琵琶造型令人感慨老天爷的暗示和古人的聪慧
堡外梯田层层仿佛仙人画下的等高线
农人劳作不辍怕是早已熟识了祖宗的高明甚至遗忘了子孙膜拜的责任
projects.content_zh: 是存心要一个琵琶形平面的土堡吗？还是顺应地形的呼声，自然而然地得到了这样的方案？琵琶堡始建明洪武七年（1374年），明末重修，清康熙、咸丰年间修葺。真不知道是哪一代的风水先生或是村子主人动的这番灵机。土堡在大山中的一座孤傲的山冈上，若按堡内正房的朝向，应该是坐北朝南。从地面上只领略到建筑与地形随意而恰当的结合，自由的曲面夯土墙，还有不经意间"抹"在墙上的深灰色瓦顶。好一座中国古代的朗香教堂！琵琶堡规模不大，占地面积3500平方米，建筑面积近2000平方米。防卫起见门就显得更小，门洞前还辟一小方池。堡内跑马道一周，中轴线上建有三圣祠、前楼、观音阁等。在更高的山顶上俯瞰土堡，整体布局一览无余，吉祥完美的琵琶造型，令人感慨老天爷的暗示和古人的聪慧。堡外梯田层层，仿佛仙人画下的等高线；农人劳作不辍，怕是早已熟识了祖宗的高明，甚至遗忘了子孙膜拜的责任吧？
projects.content_en: Was it intentional to have an earthen fort with a pipa (Chinese lute)-shaped plan? Or was this scheme naturally arrived at by following the call of the terrain? Pipa Fort was first built in the 7th year of Hongwu reign of the Ming (1374), rebuilt in the late Ming, and repaired during the Kangxi and Xianfeng reigns of the Qing. One really does not know which generation's fengshui master or village owner had this inspiration. The earthen fort sits on a solitary hillock in the great mountains; according to the orientation of the main house inside, it should face south. From the ground, one only appreciates the casual yet appropriate combination of architecture and terrain, the free curved rammed-earth walls, and the dark gray tile roof casually "smeared" onto the walls. What a Chinese ancient Ronchamp Chapel! Pipa Fort is not large in scale, covering 3,500 square meters with a building area of nearly 2,000 square meters. For defense, the gate appears even smaller, and a small square pond is opened in front of the gate opening. Inside the fort, the horse-running road encircles once; on the central axis are built the Three Sages Shrine, front building, Guanyin Pavilion, and others. Overlooking the earthen fort from a higher mountain top, the overall layout is fully visible — the auspicious and perfect pipa shape, making one感慨 at the hints of heaven and the wisdom of the ancients. Outside the fort, terraced fields layer upon layer, as if contour lines drawn by immortals; farmers toil without cease, perhaps already familiar with the brilliance of their ancestors, even forgetting the responsibility of descendants to worship them?

projects.name: 泰安堡·广崇堂
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 三明市大田县太华镇小华村
projects.address_en: Xiaohua Village, Taihua Town, Datian County, Sanming

排水系统
结构和装饰
泰安堡和广崇堂同在小华村
泰安堡建设得早清乾隆年间就有了
清中期被匪寇破坏清咸丰丁巳年1857年重建
此堡三层依缓坡而建略显得更加高大
主要建筑主朝向西北方形圆角规模不大建筑面积1000多平方米
和其他土堡一样门洞窄小堡墙厚实跑马道联络四角更建碉式角楼
堡内空旷仅余大坪水井再无厅堂之设备
广崇堂始建于清末至民国初年
从防御性而言或者可以说是泰安堡的附属建筑
设计方针与泰安堡形成鲜明对比
此堂两层朝向西南建筑面积约1000平方米
虽然也外墙厚实防御森严但是厅堂敞亮

projects.content_zh: 泰安堡和广崇堂同在小华村。泰安堡建设得早，清乾隆年间就有了，清中期被匪寇破坏，清咸丰丁巳年（1857年）重建。此堡三层，依缓坡而建，于是略显得更加高大一些。主要建筑的主朝向是西北，方形圆角，规模不大，建筑面积1000多平方米。和其他土堡一样，门洞窄小，堡墙厚实，跑马道联络，四角更建碉式角楼。堡内空旷，仅余大坪、水井，再无厅堂之设备。广崇堂始建于清末至民国初年，从防御性而言或者可以说是泰安堡的附属建筑，但是设计方针与泰安堡形成鲜明对比。此堂两层，朝向西南，建筑面积约1000平方米，虽然也外墙厚实防御森严，但是厅堂敞亮，房屋隔间丰富，木雕、石雕、彩绘把建筑装饰人情味十足。
projects.content_en: Taian Fort and Guangchong Hall are both in Xiaohua Village. Taian Fort was built early, already existing during the Qianlong reign of the Qing; it was destroyed by bandits in the mid-Qing and rebuilt in the Dingsi year of Xianfeng reign (1857). This fort is three stories, built on a gentle slope, thus appearing slightly taller. The main orientation of the primary building is northwest, square with rounded corners, not large in scale, with a building area of over 1,000 square meters. Like other earthen forts, the gate opening is narrow, the fort wall is thick, the horse-running roads connect, and watchtower-style corner towers are built at all four corners. Inside the fort is open and empty, with only a large flat area and a well, with no hall facilities remaining. Guangchong Hall was first built from the late Qing to the early Republican period; in terms of defensiveness, it could perhaps be called an附属 building of Taian Fort, but its design philosophy forms a stark contrast with Taian Fort. This hall is two stories, facing southwest, with a building area of about 1,000 square meters; although it also has thick exterior walls and strict defense, the halls are bright and open, the room partitions are rich, and wood carvings, stone carvings, and painted decorations make the architectural decoration full of human warmth.

projects.name: 赤水天后宫
projects.address: 龙岩市龙门镇赤水村东北
projects.address_en: Northeast of Chishui Village, Longmen Town, Longyan
highlights: 木结构
规模和形式
登临

projects.content_zh: 赤水天后宫是我们唯一在龙岩市郊区选择的一点。从龙岩市区到龙门镇，走回了山田相间的乡村环境，做好了在村落中寻找寺庙的准备。完全没有想到的是，距离目的村落还有个把公里的地方，就看到了一座安定从容、俯瞰四野的高阁。震撼之余，甚至没有猜到它就是天后宫。赤水天后宫始建于清乾隆三十五年（1770年）。据现存宫内的碑文记载，只是因为宫的规模太宏大了，费用不敷，只好"观成有待"；后来"风雨所侵"、"众虑其圮"，于是凑集银两一百七十两七钱有奇，"通体修理，保前功于勿坠"；工程历时一年有余，在乾隆五十年（1786年）修理完成，终于"焕然可观"。要说天后宫的平面规模并不大，坐北朝南，一进院子，大门后有戏台，两侧回廊，正宫是一座前带抱厦的大阁。而就是这座正宫，四层屋檐，歇山顶，内部可以看出四层楼板的痕迹，现存三层；两侧的扶楼也是四层檐而比正楼矮一层。黛瓦白墙、素木精石之间，古朴气氛尤存。看庙主人大声欢迎着我们，看门的"小黑"也就止住了警惕的咆哮。不是祭祀的日子，这里没有看到游客的香火，只闻到主人炊烟。炊烟和肃穆建筑形成对比，反而让人领略到宗教的本意。想起沿海热闹的天后宫，这里的品位正对了我们的胃口。
projects.content_en: Chishui Tianhou Palace is the only site we selected in the suburbs of Longyan. From Longyan city to Longmen Town, we returned to a rural environment of interspersed fields and mountains, preparing to search for the temple in the village. Completely unexpected, while still about a kilometer from the target village, we saw a tall pavilion, calm and composed, overlooking the surrounding fields. Amazed, we did not even guess it was Tianhou Palace. Chishui Tianhou Palace was first built in the 35th year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1770). According to the surviving stele inscription inside the palace, simply because the palace's scale was too grand, the funds were insufficient, so it had to "await completion"; later, "invaded by wind and rain" and "all worried about its collapse," they gathered 170 taels and 7 mace of silver, "repairing it entirely to preserve the previous achievement from falling"; the project took over a year, and was completed in the 50th year of Qianlong reign (1786), finally "becoming splendidly visible." The plan of Tianhou Palace is not large, facing south, with one courtyard; behind the main gate is a stage, with corridors on both sides, and the main palace is a large pavilion with a front portico (baosha). It is this main palace, with four layers of eaves and a hip-and-gable roof (xieshan ding), that shows traces of four floor slabs inside, with three stories surviving; the side auxiliary buildings also have four layers of eaves but are one story shorter than the main building. Between the black tiles, white walls, plain wood, and fine stone, an ancient atmosphere persists. The temple keeper loudly welcomed us, and the watchdog "Xiao Hei" stopped its alert barking. Not a sacrificial day, there was no tourist incense here, only the smell of the keeper's cooking smoke. The contrast between cooking smoke and the solemn building instead allows one to appreciate the true meaning of religion. Thinking of the bustling Tianhou Palaces along the coast, the taste here is exactly to our liking.

projects.content_zh: 《宁洋县志》载："虎符岩在赖家山，有真君殿，每岁七月间，岩、平、永、大四邑远来祷，辄应。"这是纪念唐代张、吴、萧三"真人"智斗"山魅"得道成仙的小庙，虎符殿的名气远大于它的规模。这里是村边山上车辆难行的密林，千年的古树荫翳和忘忧泉水的甘甜能够扫除一切寻找虎符殿路途的艰辛。一切都是机缘吧。正午到达南丰村赖山脚，巧遇行走在路上的年届六十的赖大姐。她的家距离上山的道路最近。早五分钟她还在劳作，晚五分钟她会照常午休。"没有我，你们找不到的。"后来方知此言不虚。路面已经全部是碎石。冲动的驱使下，我们咬牙前行。"我的儿子不敢开车上来的。"其实若非大姐坐在车上，我们也是早早掉头了。大约6公里步行速度的颠簸，再加上1里路的步行，到了灵验不怕庙宇深的虎符祖殿。这是一座三间小殿，歇山顶，穿斗抬梁混合式木结构。宋代始建，明嘉靖十六年（1537年）重建，根据捐款木牌的记载，清嘉庆间或有修缮之举。殿内斗拱细腻、月梁舒展、藻井精致、覆盆式柱础则古朴无华。殿中有铁钟二口，系明弘治三年（1490年）和万历廿四年（1596年）所铸，"虎符祖殿"牌匾也是落款隆庆五年（1571年）。庙前泉水不绝，庙后复建廊桥一座。桥内凉风习习，正是恢复体力的好地方。
projects.content_en: The "Ningyang County Gazetteer" records: "Hufu Rock is at Lai Family Mountain, with a Zhenjun Hall; every year in the seventh month, people from the four counties of Yan, Ping, Yong, and Da come from afar to pray, and their prayers are always answered." This is a small temple commemorating the three "Perfected Ones" (Zhenren) Zhang, Wu, and Xiao of the Tang Dynasty, who outwitted the "mountain demon" and attained immortality; the fame of Hufu Hall far exceeds its scale. Here is a dense forest on the mountain beside the village where vehicles cannot pass; the shade of thousand-year-old ancient trees and the sweetness of Wangyou Spring water can sweep away all the hardships of the journey to find Hufu Hall. Everything is fate, perhaps. Arriving at the foot of Lai Mountain in Nanfeng Village at noon, we happened to meet Sister Lai, nearly sixty years old, walking on the road. Her home is closest to the path up the mountain. Five minutes earlier she was still working, five minutes later she would be taking her usual nap. "Without me, you wouldn't find it." Later we realized this was no exaggeration. The road surface was already entirely gravel. Driven by impulse, we gritted our teeth and pressed on. "My son doesn't dare drive up here." In fact, if Sister Lai hadn't been sitting in the car, we would have turned back long ago. After about 6 kilometers of bumping at walking speed, plus another li of walking, we arrived at Hufu Ancestral Hall — efficacious and unafraid of being deep in the mountains. This is a three-bay small hall, with a hip-and-gable roof, and a mixed chuan-dou (column-and-tie) and tai-liang (post-and-lintel) timber structure. First built in the Song Dynasty, rebuilt in the 16th year of Jiajing reign of the Ming (1537), and according to the donation wooden plaque, there may have been repairs during the Jiaqing reign of the Qing. Inside the hall, the dougong (bracket sets) are delicate, the moon beams (yueliang) are舒展, the caisson ceiling (zaojing) is exquisite, and the inverted-bowl column bases (fupen zhuchu) are simple and unadorned. There are two iron bells in the hall, cast in the third year of Hongzhi reign of the Ming (1490) and the 24th year of Wanli reign (1596); the "Hufu Ancestral Hall" plaque is also dated the fifth year of Longqing reign (1571). In front of the temple spring water flows without cease, and behind the temple a covered bridge has been rebuilt. The cool breeze inside the bridge makes it a perfect place to recover one's strength.

projects.content_zh: 漳平以北的山中古村密布，木耳种植对老屋风貌影响不大，却是木耳带来的收入促使一些人把老屋换作新砖房。好在也有人延续着传统，总体景观还在。穿行村间道路已经不似过去艰辛了，只是最好选择柏油路面的线路，否则行车便成为不可能完成的任务。华唐阁所在的义宅村很好找，入村询问便可顺利到达。这是一座两层的殿阁，背靠山岩，面向东方正襟危坐。华唐阁又名观音阁，明成化年间（1465—1487年）始建，倡建的名字叫作陈云隐，后代屡有重修。这两层的楼阁基本是一座二层的五开间正楼；前面带一层抱厦五间，屋顶廊庑一样地与正楼咬接、转折；两侧再各加挟屋一座，靠北一侧挟屋做亭式处理，是室外石阶登临上层的入口；正楼顶上更加歇山屋顶，只一间，斗拱支撑，檐下悬"华唐阁"匾额。最为难得的是，楼中一些古老工艺和痕迹尚存，非常耐人寻味。其一，正楼和抱厦屋檐之下，有"板引檐"，构造设计合理精细，与大木作结合紧密，是难得一见的做法；其二，楼上正厅之内藻井做法大方精美，绝非一般堆砌之作，配合雕刻人物、瑞草图案的斗拱，一堂装饰，一堂庄重；其三，侧墙装修、侧厅顶棚之上保留人物山水图、异兽图案，是研究装饰和涂层装饰的珍贵样本。须得提醒一下不愿走回头路的行者，出村一段路程石土交加，左山右田，摩托车行进无碍，汽车却多有不便。感叹新砖楼和柏油路，褒贬之间，我们是不是太自私了，尤其是在民生和传统的夹缝中找到出路之前，在当世的欲望和对子孙的责任的天平上认清轻重之前……
projects.content_en: Ancient villages are densely distributed in the mountains north of Zhangping; wood ear (mushroom) cultivation has little impact on the appearance of old houses, but the income from wood ears has prompted some people to replace old houses with new brick houses. Fortunately, some people continue the tradition, and the overall landscape remains. Traveling through village roads is no longer as hard as in the past, but it is best to choose asphalt routes, otherwise driving becomes an impossible task. Yizhai Village, where Huatang Pavilion is located, is easy to find — just ask upon entering the village and you can arrive smoothly. This is a two-story hall-pavilion, backed against mountain rock, facing east with dignified composure. Huatang Pavilion, also known as Guanyin Pavilion, was first built during the Chenghua reign of the Ming (1465–1487); the name of the initiator was Chen Yunyin, and descendants repeatedly repaired it. This two-story pavilion is basically a two-story five-bay main building; in front is a one-story portico (baosha) of five bays, whose roof and corridors connect and turn with the main building; on both sides an additional wing (xiewu) is added each, with the north-side wing treated in pavilion style, serving as the entrance via outdoor stone steps to the upper floor; on top of the main building is an additional hip-and-gable roof, only one bay, supported by dougong, with the "Huatang Pavilion" plaque hanging under the eaves. Most rare is that some ancient craftsmanship and traces remain in the building, very thought-provoking. First, under the eaves of the main building and portico, there is a "board-led eaves" (ban yinyan), with合理 and refined structural design, tightly integrated with the major timberwork — a rarely seen construction method. Second, the caisson ceiling (zaojing) in the upper main hall is generously and exquisitely made, by no means a commonplace堆砌,配合 dougong carved with figures and auspicious grass patterns — one hall of decoration, one hall of solemnity. Third, on the side wall finishes and above the side hall ceilings, figures, landscape paintings, and exotic beast patterns are preserved, a precious sample for studying decoration and coating decoration. It must be reminded to travelers unwilling to retrace their steps: for a stretch after leaving the village, the road is mixed stone and earth, with mountains on the left and fields on the right; motorcycles pass without hindrance, but cars have much inconvenience. Sighing at new brick buildings and asphalt roads, between praise and blame, are we being too selfish — especially before finding a way out in the夹缝 between people's livelihood and tradition, before recognizing the balance on the scale between worldly desires and responsibility to descendants...

projects.content_zh: 古宁洋县文、武庙、先农坛、妈祖庙俱全，古桥民众多，麒麟山上还有麟山塔。麟山塔俗称白塔，始建于明万历三十年（1602年），清康熙十八年（1679年）重建，光绪元年（1875年）重修。双洋镇上老屋保存状况不是很好，颇令人担心而惋惜。旧县城的痕迹还是依稀可寻的。走过青云桥沿着石阶上山。在闽西山中日最后的暑意，尤其在一早一晚，已经所剩无几，这是百公里之外沿海地区所深深嫉妒的。麟山塔虽不甚高大，但在麟山公园围墙和大门等建筑的衬托下依然气势十足。塔是仿楼阁式的砖体结构，内部空心，平面八角，共计七层，顶层做重檐处理；总高22米，底层宽7.2米，向上逐层内收。塔的每层两面开券门，位置变换设置，另六面外设佛龛；底层开拱券塔门，内设木质楼板及扶梯；塔内墙面有彩绘壁画、墨书题记等历史遗存。只要到了双洋，人们就会告诉你徐霞客也到过这里。崇祯元年（1628年）和崇祯三年（1630年），他两次乘舟顺流而下游览考察，并在宁洋溪的记述中做出了"程俞迫则流俞急"的科学论断。人们还会告诉你朱德将军也到过这里。那时他率领红四军二、三纵队2000余人至此，今天还保留着红军布告、标语等痕迹。祝愿双洋受到国家文物部门的重视，祝愿双洋首先得到当地民众的重视。
projects.content_en: The ancient Ningyang County had complete civil and military temples, Xiannong Altar, and Mazu Temple, with many ancient bridges and residents; on Qilin Mountain there is also Linshan Pagoda. Linshan Pagoda, commonly known as White Pagoda, was first built in the 30th year of Wanli reign of the Ming (1602), rebuilt in the 18th year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1679), and repaired in the first year of Guangxu reign (1875). The preservation of old houses in Shuangyang Town is not very good, quite worrying and regrettable. Traces of the old county seat can still be faintly found. Crossing Qingyun Bridge and going up the mountain along stone steps. In the western Fujian mountains, the last summer heat, especially in the early morning and evening, has almost disappeared — something deeply envied by coastal areas a hundred kilometers away. Although Linshan Pagoda is not very tall, it still has full imposing aura against the backdrop of buildings such as the Linshan Park walls and main gate. The pagoda is a pavilion-style brick structure, hollow inside, with an octagonal plan, totaling seven stories, with the top story treated with double eaves; total height 22 meters, bottom width 7.2 meters, tapering inward story by story upward. Each story has arched doors on two sides, with positions alternating, and Buddhist niches on the other six sides; the bottom story has an arched pagoda gate, with wooden floor slabs and stairs inside; the interior walls have historical remains such as painted murals and ink inscriptions. As long as you arrive in Shuangyang, people will tell you that Xu Xiake also came here. In the first year of Chongzhen reign (1628) and the third year of Chongzhen reign (1630), he twice traveled downstream by boat for sightseeing and investigation, and in his account of Ningyang Stream made the scientific assertion that "the more constrained the course, the more rapid the flow." People will also tell you that General Zhu De also came here. At that time he led over 2,000 people of the 2nd and 3rd Columns of the Red Fourth Army here, and today traces such as Red Army notices and slogans remain. May Shuangyang receive the attention of national cultural heritage authorities, and may Shuangyang first receive the attention of local people.

projects.content_en: According to the "Genealogy of the Xu Clan" of Yiping Village, Taian Fort was founded by Xu Guobang in the 57th year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1792). At that time bandits and robbers were rampant; Xu Guobang, who had become wealthy by acquiring land and collecting rent, decided to build a fort to protect the people. Starting from the 33rd year of Qianlong reign (1768), it took fifteen years to finally complete the building. It is said that later whenever bandit trouble arose, the whole village would hide in the fort to avoid disaster. Because the earthen building's anti-theft facilities were complete, the building walls were solid, and armed with weapons such as stones, earth guns, and earth cannons, the bandits returned empty-handed every time. Like Taian Fort in Datian, Lingdi Taian Fort also protected the peace of a whole village. Taian Fort is 37.3 meters wide east-west and 37.3 meters long north-south, with a square front and round rear plan, facing south; the encircling fort is two stories, the rear building is three stories, and inside the fort is built...

projects.content_zh: 最早是听说同济大学路秉杰先生曾经考察文明塔，并指出，土塔在我国十分罕见，适中文明塔可能是中国第一土塔。我们怎能错过呢？还没有到达仁和村，远远地望见村南的山巅，文明塔安静屹立在那里。还需要多远的攀登呢？据说适中镇形如一艘船，船头向着闽南大海，为拴住这艘大舟，须在高山之巅建塔；还传说朱熹当年在适中讲学，教化百姓要"文明作魁"，于是古塔取名文明，书楼取名魁楼，塔和楼远远地在一条子午线上。谋划如何登山，必须求助当地乡人。遇到二位林先生，好客爽朗，拍着胸脯说要开自己的"高底盘车"载我们上去。"2016年或许路就修好了，到时候来的人会更多的。"言语间，他们对未来还是充满信心的。前几日的大雨冲坏了本来就沟壑纵横的碎石路，20分钟的颠簸，老林一直在兴致勃勃地谈论当地的风情，也说起此路还联系着大山另一侧的村庄。路边新近搭好的放羊人的吊脚楼和一段段刚刚填平的小台地说明聪明的乡民正为今后的开发积极筹备着。车停在了一处略为宽广的平地上，拜访古塔还需要爬五分钟的山路。哦，它就在那里了！文明塔又称长塔或白叶塔，当地百姓常用它最短的名字。塔建于宋代，八角形平面，空心筒体结构，楼阁式。原有十三层，经明代和1958年两次雷电袭击后塔顶已毁，现存八层半；一层至七层土体，以上明代砌砖补修所成；塔通高23.26米，周长25.73米，底层内直径4.95米，底部墙厚1.64米；每层券窗四洞，交错布置，券门上方正中原有石刻"文明塔"，今或已异地保护。下部塔身采用当地的版筑技术，就地取材，以灰、沙、土为原料夯筑而成。现状来看模板加工精细、夯艺高超，塔身表面至今光滑；塔身外部每层均留二层架木孔洞，尚无法解释是脚手架还是木檐所依；塔内原有的木制楼面、承重木、楞木和楼梯均无存，仅留夯土之上的孔洞。
projects.content_en: I first heard that Mr. Lu Bingjie of Tongji University had investigated Wenming Pagoda and pointed out that earthen pagodas are very rare in China, and that Shizhong Wenming Pagoda may be China's first earthen pagoda. How could we miss it? Before reaching Renhe Village, from afar we saw on the mountain peak south of the village, Wenming Pagoda standing quietly. How much further climbing was needed? It is said that Shizhong Town is shaped like a ship, with its bow facing the southern Fujian sea; to moor this great vessel, a pagoda must be built on the high mountain peak. It is also传说 that Zhu Xi once lectured in Shizhong, teaching the people to be "civilized and outstanding," so the ancient pagoda was named Wenming (Civilization), and the study building was named Kuilou (Outstanding Building), with the pagoda and building far apart on the same meridian line. Planning how to climb the mountain required seeking help from local villagers. We met two Mr. Lins, hospitable and straightforward, patting their chests saying they would drive us up in their own "high-chassis car." "Maybe the road will be repaired by 2016, and more people will come then." In their words, they were still full of confidence in the future. The heavy rain a few days earlier had damaged the already gully-crisscrossed gravel road; during 20 minutes of bumping, Old Lin was enthusiastically talking about local customs, also mentioning that this road connects to villages on the other side of the mountain. Newly built stilt houses for shepherds by the roadside and sections of just-filled small terraces showed that the clever villagers were actively preparing for future development. The car stopped at a slightly wider flat area; visiting the ancient pagoda still required a five-minute climb up the mountain path. Oh, there it was! Wenming Pagoda, also called Chang Pagoda or Baiye Pagoda, local people commonly use its shortest name. The pagoda was built in the Song Dynasty, with an octagonal plan, hollow cylinder structure, and pavilion style. It originally had thirteen stories; after two lightning strikes in the Ming Dynasty and in 1958, the top was destroyed, and now eight and a half stories remain; the first to seventh stories are earthen, above which are Ming Dynasty brick repairs; the pagoda is 23.26 meters high, 25.73 meters in circumference, with an inner diameter of 4.95 meters at the bottom and a bottom wall thickness of 1.64 meters; each story has four arched windows, alternately arranged; above the arched gate in the center there was originally a stone carving "Wenming Pagoda," now perhaps relocated for protection. The lower part of the pagoda body uses local rammed-earth (banzhu) technology, using local materials of lime, sand, and earth. The current condition shows fine template processing and superb ramming technique, with the pagoda body surface still smooth to this day; each story on the exterior of the pagoda body leaves two layers of wooden frame holes, which cannot yet be explained as either scaffolding or supports for wooden eaves; the original wooden floors, load-bearing timbers, joists, and stairs inside the pagoda are all gone, leaving only holes in the rammed earth.

projects.content_zh: 永定县多土楼，很大程度上反映在永定这个名字上。期冀"永远安定"的地方往往因为历史上的动乱。永定地处闽西、粤东交界，"八山一水一分田"。明成化十四年（1478年）才从上杭县分置永定县。初溪土楼群随着申报世界文化遗产的成功，名声大噪，保护和利用也已相当成熟了。站在今人建成的观景平台上，从层层梯田望去，溪流两岸舒缓平坦，视野中大大小小、方方圆圆的土楼散布开来，人烟稠密，望日作息。这里大小土楼有50多座，代表性的十余座被选入了世界文化遗产名录...
projects.content_en: Yongding County has many earthen buildings (tulou), which to a large extent is reflected in the name Yongding itself. Places that hope for "eternal peace" are often so because of historical turmoil. Yongding is located at the border of western Fujian and eastern Guangdong, described as "eight mountains, one water, one field." It was only in the 14th year of Chenghua reign of the Ming (1478) that Yongding County was separated from Shanghang County. With the success of its application for World Cultural Heritage status, the Chuxi Earthen Building Cluster has become famous, and its protection and utilization are already quite mature. Standing on the observation platform built by modern people, looking out from the layered terraced fields, both banks of the stream are gently sloping and flat, and in the field of vision earthen buildings of all sizes, square and round, are scattered about, with dense population living by the sun's schedule. There are over 50 earthen buildings here, large and small, with more than ten representative ones selected for the World Cultural Heritage list...

projects.content_zh: 抚溪河南岸，有一大片土楼计有106座，绵延3公里，绝对是密度最高的土楼区。之所以含混地称呼"土楼"、"土堡"，是因为专家把这里的土楼称为府第式方楼，并没有特别贴切的界定，或者说永隆昌楼的形制介于常规意义上的土楼和土堡之间——具体的方法就是在传统宅第的平面上树立起大型楼阁。这里最为突出的是永隆昌楼和永豪楼；而土楼土堡之外，这里还有天后宫、古渡口码头遗址、断墙遗址等古迹。永隆昌楼，是利用附属建筑将两座独立楼阁组合在一起形成土楼的，一座"老楼"位于中心，叫"福盛楼"；另一座"新楼"作为后楼，叫"福善楼"。当地居民黄姓，"永隆昌"原是烟业商号楼主黄万斗、黄万才、黄万鹏三兄弟为纪念他们的父亲黄永昌，取得此名。此楼临近小溪，利用沙滩地，挖基、填方、筑堤，自清咸丰元年至清同治十三年（1851—1874年）终于完成。建筑群由外大门、门埕、内院、高六层的老楼、老楼后门、中院坪、高五层的新楼、后院坪等组成，纵向两侧还有两层、三层不等的横楼，占地面积达到23300平方米。"大世界基尼斯"将永隆昌楼评为最高的土楼。永豪楼又名五福楼，也被冠以"府第式方楼"之名。《黄氏族谱》记载："十三世黄宽斋，子五，于道光十一年（1831年）辛卯岁二月初八日在抚溪桥村大洋塅上坝建造五福楼，主楼高六层，坐南朝北，并右片烟棚一所，统计四百余间。道光十八年戊戌岁（1838年）十一月十五日丑时进宅入火，越10余载始臻完备。门首砌堤，左至园埧，右至榕树头下，基础巩固，厥工颇巨。"此楼事实上是坐西南朝东北，由外大门、门埕、内大门、门厅、中厅、正楼、后楼等组成。主楼高四层；左右两侧横楼高四层，各建四个单元，大门雨坪两侧建有高二层砖木结构的文馆和武馆。说起土楼生活，永豪楼的这个楹联说得最为深刻：上联"礼门通义路"，下联"智水近仁山"，横批"德为邻"。不然诺大的一个家族可怎么共处呢？
projects.content_en: On the south bank of the Fuxi River, there is a large cluster of 106 earthen buildings stretching 3 kilometers — absolutely the highest-density earthen building area. The reason for vaguely calling them "earthen buildings" (tulou) and "earthen forts" (tubao) is that experts call the earthen buildings here "mansion-style square buildings," without a particularly precise definition; or rather, the form of Yonglongchang Building lies between conventional earthen buildings and earthen forts — the specific method is to erect large pavilions on the plan of a traditional residence. The most prominent here are Yonglongchang Building and Yonghao Building; besides earthen buildings and forts, there are also Tianhou Palace, ancient ferry dock ruins, broken wall ruins, and other historic sites. Yonglongchang Building was formed by using附属 buildings to combine two independent pavilions into one earthen building; one "old building" is in the center, called "Fusheng Building"; the other "new building" serves as the rear building, called "Fushan Building." Local residents are surnamed Huang; "Yonglongchang" was originally a tobacco business name, and the building owners Huang Wandou, Huang Wancai, and Huang Wanpeng, three brothers, took this name to commemorate their father Huang Yongchang. This building is near a small stream, using beach land, with foundation digging, filling, and embankment building; from the first year of Xianfeng reign to the 13th year of Tongzhi reign of the Qing (1851–1874), it was finally completed. The building complex consists of an outer main gate, gate courtyard, inner courtyard, six-story old building, old building rear gate, middle courtyard, five-story new building, rear courtyard, etc., with two- and three-story side buildings of varying heights on both longitudinal sides, covering 23,300 square meters. "Great World Guinness" rated Yonglongchang Building as the tallest earthen building. Yonghao Building, also known as Wufu Building, is also called a "mansion-style square building." The "Genealogy of the Huang Clan" records: "The 13th generation Huang Kuanzhai, with five sons, on the eighth day of the second month of the Xinmao year, the 11th year of Daoguang reign (1831), built Wufu Building at Shangba, Dayangduan, Fuqiaoqiao Village; the main building is six stories high, facing south, with a tobacco shed on the right side, totaling over 400 rooms. On the fifteenth day of the eleventh month of the Wuxu year, the 18th year of Daoguang reign (1838), at the chou hour, the house was entered and lit; after more than 10 years it was finally complete. An embankment was built at the gate, extending left to the garden dam and right to under the banyan tree head; the foundation is solid, and the work was quite massive." This building in fact faces northeast from southwest, consisting of an outer main gate, gate courtyard, inner main gate, entrance hall, middle hall, main building, rear building, etc. The main building is four stories high; the side buildings on both left and right are four stories high, each with four units; on both sides of the gate rain courtyard are built two-story brick-wood civil and military halls. Speaking of life in earthen buildings, this couplet of Yonghao Building says it most profoundly: upper scroll "The gate of ritual connects the road of righteousness," lower scroll "Wise water is near benevolent mountain," horizontal scroll "Virtue as neighbor." Otherwise, how could such a large clan live together?

projects.name: 高北土楼群
projects.address: 漳平市永定县高头乡高北村
projects.address_en: Gaobei Village, Gaotou Township, Yongding County, Zhangping
highlights: 土楼类型
土楼结构形式
明代遗迹
和其他土楼地区一样高北的居民也是客家人
当地江姓世代农耕辅植烟茶人满则侨
高头溪自西而东流过高北村溪岸土楼农田交错狭长延展2公里
高北的代表土楼主要有五云楼世泽楼承启楼侨福楼等
五云楼建于明隆庆年间1567至1572年是这里最古老的建筑
楼是长方形的高4层面阔25.8米9开间进深24.3米底层外墙厚1.3米
全楼设一个大门公用楼梯4道
门外以矮墙围合天井并形成一个院落外大门正对楼门
内部采用通廊式中心院落建一厅堂水井二眼
楼内墙体做法木结构石雕古朴或多明代遗存
体量巨大的圆形土楼承启楼
全楼由四圈环形建筑组成内通廊式交通组织
外环为主楼高4层直径73米
第二环高2层砖木结构每层40间
第三环单层砖木结构32开间
内环为厅堂单层供族人议事婚丧喜庆等活动之用

此楼堪称环数最多规模最大的客家圆形土楼
鼎盛时期居住800余人现仍居住300余人被誉为圆楼王
projects.content_zh: 和其他土楼地区一样，高北的居民也是客家人。当地江姓，世代农耕，辅植烟茶，人满则侨；高头溪自西而东流过高北村，溪岸土楼农田交错，狭长延展2公里。高北的代表土楼主要有五云楼、世泽楼、承启楼、侨福楼等。五云楼建于明隆庆年间（1567—1572年），是这里最古老的建筑。楼是长方形的，高4层，面阔25.8米，9开间，进深24.3米，底层外墙厚1.3米。全楼设一个大门，公用楼梯4道，门外以矮墙围合天井并形成一个院落，外大门正对楼门。内部采用通廊式，中心院落建一厅堂，水井二眼。楼内墙体做法、木结构、石雕古朴，或多明代遗存。还必须详细介绍的是体量巨大的圆形土楼承启楼。全楼由四圈环形建筑组成，内通廊式交通组织。外环为主楼，高4层，直径73米；第二环高2层，砖木结构，每层40间；第三环单层，砖木结构，32开间；内环为厅堂，单层，供族人议事、婚丧喜庆等活动之用。各环建筑外高内低、逐环递减；该楼环与环之间以鹅卵石砌天井相隔，以石砌廊道或小道相连。据江氏族谱记载，该楼始建于明崇祯年间（1628—1644年），先有的是外环，而后依次建造第二环、第三环和第四环，清康熙四十八年（1709年）最终落成，形成今天的面貌。此楼堪称环数最多、规模最大的客家圆形土楼，鼎盛时期居住800余人，现仍居住300余人，被誉为"圆楼王"。
projects.content_en: Like other earthen building regions, the residents of Gaobei are also Hakka people. The local surname is Jiang, farming for generations, with supplementary cultivation of tobacco and tea; when population is full they emigrate overseas. Gaotou Stream flows from west to east through Gaobei Village, with earthen buildings and farmland interlaced along the stream banks, stretching narrowly for 2 kilometers. The representative earthen buildings of Gaobei mainly include Wuyun Building, Shize Building, Chengqi Building, Qiaofu Building, etc. Wuyun Building was built during the Longqing reign of the Ming (1567–1572), and is the oldest building here. The building is rectangular, 4 stories high, 25.8 meters wide with 9 bays, 24.3 meters deep, with a bottom exterior wall thickness of 1.3 meters. The whole building has one main gate and 4 common staircases; outside the gate, a low wall encloses a courtyard and forms a compound, with the outer main gate directly facing the building gate. The interior uses a corridor-style layout, with a hall built in the central courtyard and two wells. The wall construction, timber structure, and stone carvings inside the building are simple and ancient, perhaps mostly Ming Dynasty remains. What must be introduced in detail is the massive round earthen building Chengqi Building. The whole building consists of four rings of annular architecture, with interior corridor-style traffic organization. The outer ring is the main building, 4 stories high, 73 meters in diameter; the second ring is 2 stories high, brick-wood structure, 40 rooms per floor; the third ring is single-story, brick-wood structure, 32 bays; the inner ring is a hall, single-story, for clan meetings, weddings, funerals, and celebrations. Each ring of buildings is higher outside and lower inside, decreasing ring by ring; between the rings, courtyards are paved with cobblestones, connected by stone-paved corridors or paths. According to the Jiang clan genealogy, this building was first built during the Chongzhen reign of the Ming (1628–1644), with the outer ring built first, then the second, third, and fourth rings in sequence, finally completed in the 48th year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1709), forming its present appearance. This building can be called the Hakka round earthen building with the most rings and largest scale; at its peak it housed over 800 people, and still houses over 300 people today, known as the "King of Round Buildings."

projects.content_zh: 洪坑土楼群的主人姓林，土楼一建就是几百年。这里较大的明代土楼有峰盛楼、永源楼等十余座；较大的清代土楼有福裕楼、奎聚楼、阳临楼、中柱楼等三十余座，另有天后宫、日新学堂、林氏宗祠、关帝庙等公共建筑。这些土楼中奎聚楼、福裕楼、振成楼、如升楼列入全国重点文物保护单位，可以说是洪坑土楼的代表。奎聚楼建成于清道光十四年（1834年），是有清晰正、厢配置的方形大楼。土楼依山而建，气势恢宏；楼的内部也是高低错落，主次井然。值得注意的是，奎聚楼的设计人是翰林学士巫宜福，与楼主林奎扬是结拜兄弟。福裕楼也是晚清作品，由楼主林仲山、林仁山、林德山三兄弟的朋友汀州知府张星炳设计。三人还捐巨资兴办了当地的"日新学堂"，也是由张星炳的设计作品。此楼为方形，形制与奎聚楼相类，在主楼的中轴线上有前低后高两座横屋，主次分明。楼前有三个大门，在主楼和横屋之间有小门相隔，外观连成一体、内则分为三大单元。振成楼是圆形土楼，被誉为土楼王子。楼由双环组成，外环夯土墙连带木结构高4层，直径57.2米，内部通廊联络；楼房呈辐射状8等分，底层...
projects.content_en: The owners of the Hongkeng Earthen Building Cluster are surnamed Lin, and earthen buildings have been built here for hundreds of years. The larger Ming Dynasty earthen buildings here include Fengsheng Building, Yongyuan Building, and over ten others; the larger Qing Dynasty earthen buildings include Fuyu Building, Kuiju Building, Yanglin Building, Zhongzhu Building, and over thirty others, plus public buildings such as Tianhou Palace, Rixin School, Lin Clan Ancestral Hall, and Guandi Temple. Among these earthen buildings, Kuiju Building, Fuyu Building, Zhencheng Building, and Rusheng Building are listed as National Key Cultural Heritage Sites, and can be said to be representatives of Hongkeng earthen buildings. Kuiju Building was completed in the 14th year of Daoguang reign of the Qing (1834), and is a large square building with clear main and wing configuration. The earthen building was built against the mountain, with imposing momentum; the interior is also高低错落, with primary and secondary well-ordered. Notably, the designer of Kuiju Building was Hanlin academician Wu Yifu, who was a sworn brother of the building owner Lin Kuiyang. Fuyu Building is also a late Qing work, designed by Zhang Xingbing, prefect of Tingzhou, a friend of the three building owners Lin Zhongshan, Lin Renshan, and Lin Deshan. The three also donated large sums to found the local "Rixin School," also a design work by Zhang Xingbing. This building is square, similar in form to Kuiju Building, with two horizontal buildings on the main building's central axis, lower in front and higher in back, with clear primary and secondary. There are three main gates in front of the building, with small gates separating the main building and horizontal buildings; externally they appear as one connected body, internally divided into three major units. Zhencheng Building is a round earthen building, known as the Prince of Earthen Buildings. projects.name: 南溪土楼群
projects.address: 漳平市永定县湖坑镇南江村、南中村、新南村和下南溪村
projects.address_en: Nanjiang, Nanzhong, Xinnan, and Xiananxi Villages, Hukeng Town, Yongding County, Zhangping
highlights: 土楼类型
土楼结构形式
永定县湖坑镇丘陵山区中除了洪坑土楼群之外沿着南溪的实佳南江南中新南和下南溪等村落也保留有土楼
被称为南溪土楼群
衍香楼和振福楼是必须说到的
圆形外观的衍香楼在新南村南溪与奥杳溪交汇于此
土楼背依青山楼后溪畔还藏有一后花园是旧时读书练武的地方
该主姓苏于清道光二十二年1842年建楼
主楼高4层直径40米土木结构内部通廊联络
外墙自下而上逐层递减一、二层不开窗底层墙厚1.5米四层厚0.7米
每层34间首层设厨房餐厅二层设粮仓三、四层为卧室
二层以上每层的廊檐下设木构小储藏室
祖堂位于楼中心位置单层砖木结构方形平面
主楼与祖堂之间以天井相隔以廊道小门贯通地板均以三合土铺面
全楼设一个大门4道楼梯
楼外不远处还保留两座古桥与土楼相映成趣
振福楼也是圆楼在西片村由烟业富翁的苏振太于民国二年1913年兴建
与洪坑的振成楼一样或可称为姊妹楼
振福楼是我国近代西方建筑艺术大规模渗入之后的作品
和二层不开窗底层为厨房餐厅二层为粮仓三、四层为卧室
内环二层砖木结构连着作议事厅宴客厅戏台之用的西洋式中心大厅
其中二楼走廊栏杆更是铸铁所成
此楼由洪坑林氏21世林鸿超兄弟等人于民国元年1912年建造
因此可以看到很多中西合璧的特点
楼的设计人是福裕楼楼主林仁山之子林逊之他曾经做过中央议员
振成楼内对联几乎全是林逊之的大作
林家人才鼎盛逊之胞弟林亮之留学日本早稻田大学获法学博士学位
回国后先后担任闽侯惠安宁化县县长
如升楼与福裕楼隔洪川溪相望是迄今所计最小的圆土楼
此楼为林家在清光绪年间1875至1908年所建单环土木结构高三层
直径23米16间内部通廊联络底层为厨房餐厅二层设粮仓三层为卧室
全楼只设一门楼内天井中有一口水井
projects.content_zh: 永定县湖坑镇的丘陵山区中，除了有洪坑土楼群之外，沿着南溪的实佳、南江、南中、新南和下南溪等村落，也保留有土楼，被称为南溪土楼群。衍香楼和振福楼是必须说到的。圆形外观的衍香楼在新南村，南溪与奥杳溪交汇于此。土楼背依青山，楼后溪畔还藏有一后花园，是旧时读书、练武的地方。该主姓苏，于清道光二十二年（1842年）建楼。主楼高4层，直径40米，土木结构，内部通廊联络；外墙自下而上逐层递减，一、二层不开窗，底层墙厚1.5米，四层厚0.7米；每层34间，首层设厨房、餐厅；二层设粮仓，三、四层为卧室。二层以上每层的廊檐下设木构小储藏室。祖堂位于楼中心位置，单层砖木结构，方形平面；主楼与祖堂之间以天井相隔，以廊道小门贯通，地板均以三合土铺面。全楼设一个大门、4道楼梯。楼外不远处还保留两座古桥，与土楼相映成趣。振福楼也是圆楼，在西片村，由烟业富翁的苏振太于民国二年（1913年）兴建。与洪坑的振成楼一样，或可称为姊妹楼，振福楼是我国近代西方建筑艺术大规模渗入之后的作品。和二层不开窗，底层为厨房、餐厅，二层为粮仓，三、四层为卧室；内环二层，砖木结构，连着作议事厅、宴客厅、戏台之用的西洋式中心大厅，其中二楼走廊栏杆更是铸铁所成。此楼由洪坑林氏21世林鸿超兄弟等人于民国元年（1912年）建造，因此可以看到很多中西合璧的特点。而楼的设计人是福裕楼楼主林仁山之子林逊之，他曾经做过中央议员，振成楼内对联几乎全是林逊之的大作。林家人才鼎盛，逊之胞弟林亮之留学日本早稻田大学，获法学博士学位，回国后先后担任闽侯、惠安、宁化县县长。如升楼与福裕楼隔洪川溪相望，是迄今所计最小的圆土楼。此楼为林家在清光绪年间（1875—1908年）所建，单环，土木结构，高三层；直径23米，16间，内部通廊联络。底层为厨房、餐厅；二层设粮仓；三层为卧室。全楼只设一门，楼内天井中有一口水井。
projects.content_en: In the hilly mountainous area of Hukeng Town, Yongding County, besides the Hongkeng Earthen Building Cluster, along the Nanxi River in villages such as Shijia, Nanjiang, Nanzhong, Xinnan, and Xiananxi, earthen buildings are also preserved, known as the Nanxi Earthen Building Cluster. Yanxiang Building and Zhenfu Building must be mentioned. The round-appearance Yanxiang Building is in Xinnan Village, where the Nanxi and Aoyao streams meet. The earthen building leans against green mountains, and behind the building by the stream there is also a hidden rear garden, a place for reading and martial arts practice in old times. The owner's surname is Su, and the building was built in the 22nd year of Daoguang reign of the Qing (1842). The main building is 4 stories high, 40 meters in diameter, of earth-wood structure, with interior corridor connections; the exterior wall tapers from bottom to top, with no windows on the first and second stories, bottom wall thickness 1.5 meters, fourth story wall thickness 0.7 meters; 34 rooms per story, with kitchens and dining rooms on the first story; granaries on the second story; bedrooms on the third and fourth stories. Above the second story, under the corridor eaves of each story, small wooden storage rooms are set. The ancestral hall is located at the center of the building, single-story brick-wood structure, square plan; between the main building and ancestral hall separated by courtyards, connected by corridor small doors, floors all paved with sanhetu (triple-mixed earth). The whole building has one main gate and 4 staircases. Not far outside the building, two ancient bridges are also preserved, forming a charming contrast with the earthen building. Zhenfu Building is also a round building, in Xipian Village, built by tobacco wealthy man Su Zhentai in the second year of the Republic (1913). Like Zhencheng Building in Hongkeng, it could be called a sister building; Zhenfu Building is a work after the large-scale infiltration of modern Western architectural art into China. With no windows on the second story, the first story has kitchens and dining rooms, the second story granaries, and the third and fourth stories bedrooms; the inner ring is two stories, brick-wood structure, connected to a Western-style central hall used as a meeting hall, banquet hall, and stage, among which the second-floor corridor railings are even made of cast iron. This building was built by Hongkeng Lin clan 21st generation Lin Hongchao brothers and others in the first year of the Republic (1912), so many Chinese-Western combined features can be seen. The building's designer was Lin Xunzhi, son of Fuyu Building owner Lin Renshan, who once served as a central parliament member; almost all the couplets inside Zhencheng Building are Lin Xunzhi's works. The Lin family was full of talent; Lin Xunzhi's younger brother Lin Liangzhi studied at Waseda University in Japan, earned a doctorate in law, and after returning to China served successively as county magistrate of Minhou, Hui'an, and Ninghua. Rusheng Building faces Fuyu Building across the Hongchuan Stream, and is the smallest round earthen building counted to date. This building was built by the Lin family during the Guangxu reign of the Qing (1875–1908), single ring, earth-wood structure, three stories high; 23 meters in diameter, 16 rooms, interior corridor connections. The first story has kitchens and dining rooms; the second story has granaries; the third story has bedrooms. The whole building has only one gate, and there is a well in the courtyard inside the building.

塔后还有登云馆大厅和天井
主塔七层高达40余米
塔基石砌下层土墙厚1米余
底层为主殿供奉妈祖当心有四根大圆木柱支撑塔体一周围房
二、三层周围有走廊
四、五层由四方体转为八方体
六、七层中间塔心柱辐辏为架板木为墙
最上层施是葫芦形瓷缸顶
天后宫的壁画雕塑石刻彩绘等装饰也非常丰富
保留诸多可以深入研究的装饰工艺细节
西陂建筑结构及其艺术成就是国内的天后宫中所罕见的
造型从山水风光花卉鸟兽以至神话传说人物典故无不栩栩如生堪称一绝
戏台屏风上彩画的仕女图古朴风流
与戏台规制均为难得的研究戏曲史的重要实物资料
projects.content_zh: 或许是离开了海边的台风，天后宫就可以向天空的方向伸展了。西陂天后宫，被当地人唤作"文塔"，塔旁就是静静流淌的永定河，一高耸一蜿蜒，相映成趣。此宫始建于明嘉靖二十一年（1542年），清康熙元年（1662年）落成，此后也屡经修缮，好在原始建筑做法和特征尤存。西陂天后宫的主体建筑是天后宫塔，疑为当时利用已成建筑为之或更换了使用功能；塔前有大门、倒座戏台和大厅堂；塔后还有登云馆大厅和天井。主塔七层，高达40余米；塔基石砌，下层土墙厚1米余；底层为主殿，供奉妈祖，当心有四根大圆木柱，支撑塔体，一周围房；二、三层周围有走廊；四、五层由四方体转为八方体；六、七层中间塔心柱，辐辏为架，板木为墙；最上层施是葫芦形瓷缸顶。此外，天后宫的壁画、雕塑、石刻、彩绘等装饰也非常丰富，保留诸多可以深入研究的装饰工艺细节。西陂建筑结构及其艺术成就，是国内的天后宫中所罕见的。它的造型，从山水风光、花卉鸟兽以至神话传说、人物典故，无不栩栩如生，堪称一绝。同时，戏台屏风上彩画的仕女图，古朴风流，与戏台规制均为难得的研究戏曲史的重要实物资料。
projects.content_en: Perhaps having left the coastal typhoons, Tianhou Palace can extend toward the sky. Xibei Tianhou Palace is called "Wen Pagoda" (Literature Pagoda) by locals; beside the pagoda is the quietly flowing Yongding River, one towering and one winding, forming a charming contrast. This palace was first built in the 21st year of Jiajing reign of the Ming (1542), completed in the first year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1662), and has since been repeatedly repaired; fortunately, the original architectural methods and features still survive. The main building of Xibei Tianhou Palace is the Tianhou Palace Pagoda, suspected to have been built using an existing structure at the time or to have had its function changed; in front of the pagoda are a main gate, an opposite-stage theater, and a large hall; behind the pagoda there is also the Dengyun Hall large hall and courtyard. The main pagoda has seven stories, over 40 meters high; the pagoda base is stone-built, with the lower earthen wall over 1 meter thick; the bottom story is the main hall, enshrining Mazu, with four large round timber columns at the center supporting the pagoda body, surrounded by rooms; the second and third stories have corridors around; the fourth and fifth stories transform from square to octagonal; the sixth and seventh stories have a central pagoda core column, with radiating frames and plank-wood walls; the topmost story is crowned with a gourd-shaped porcelain jar top. In addition, the decorations of Tianhou Palace such as murals, sculptures, stone carvings, and painted decorations are also very rich, preserving many decorative craft details worthy of in-depth study. The architectural structure and artistic achievements of Xibei are rare among Tianhou Palaces in China. Its modeling, from landscapes, flowers, birds, and beasts to myths, legends, and historical anecdotes, is all vivid and lifelike, truly exceptional. At the same time, the painted maidens on the theater stage screen, simple and elegant, together with the theater stage regulations, are rare important physical materials for studying the history of Chinese opera.

projects.name: 岩太土楼群
projects.address: 漳平市永定县陈东乡岩太村
projects.address_en: Yantai Village, Chendong Township, Yongding County, Zhangping
highlights: 环境
早期土楼痕迹
在永定海拔750米以上的山已经非常高了
那里的山丘林木梯田多了一个伴侣云雾
在此耕作的农人生计虽艰被唤一声仙人也算是对清僻生活的最大慰藉
陈东乡岩太村的环境就是这样的
这里林氏村民们居住的房屋则是26座造型各异的土楼
这些土楼大大小小有方有圆
其中还有永定县直径最大的一座土圆楼福盛楼直径达到81.6米
虽然稍逊南靖书洋顺裕楼86米的规模也真难以想象里边到底生活着多少人
事实上福盛楼是文革时建设的至今不过四十多年的光景
不禁感叹偏远之地才能躲过汹涌的现代化浪潮
当地人们的头脑和社会生活还能在这种新的欲望和旧的风气对撞之间坚持多久呢
土楼生活其实依旧年轻
福盛楼的四层布置和传统土楼没有差别一层是厨房和餐厅二层是仓库三层四层是卧室
只不过由于生活的需要楼内加建改造较多
新楼之中已少了近旁老楼中常有的生活情趣和味道
游客在这里最大的要务一是寻访当地人常说的早期土楼的痕迹或许真可以追溯到宋朝
二是张开双臂拥抱这里的风景让这里的空气深入每一个毛孔
农人的要务呢请您自己也用平静的心体味一下家乡的好处吧
projects.content_zh: 在永定，海拔750米以上的山已经非常高了。那里的山丘林木、梯田多了一个伴侣——云雾。在此耕作的农人生计虽艰，被唤一声"仙人"，也算是对清僻生活的最大慰藉了吧。陈东乡岩太村的环境就是这样的，而这里林氏村民们居住的房屋则是26座造型各异的土楼。这些土楼大大小小，有方有圆，其中还有永定县直径最大的一座土圆楼——福盛楼，直径达到81.6米，虽然稍逊南靖书洋顺裕楼86米的规模，也真难以想象里边到底生活着多少人。事实上福盛楼是"文革"时建设的，至今不过四十多年的光景。不禁感叹，偏远之地才能躲过汹涌的现代化浪潮，而当地人们的头脑和社会生活还能在这种新的欲望和旧的风气对撞之间坚持多久呢？土楼生活其实依旧年轻，福盛楼的四层布置和传统土楼没有差别：一层是厨房和餐厅，二层是仓库，三层四层是卧室。只不过由于生活的需要，楼内加建改造较多，"新"楼之中已少了近旁"老"楼中常有的生活情趣和味道。游客在这里最大的要务，一是寻访当地人常说的早期土楼的痕迹，或许真可以追溯到宋朝；二是张开双臂拥抱这里的风景，让这里的空气深入每一个毛孔。农人的要务呢？请您自己也用平静的心体味一下家乡的好处吧……
projects.content_en: In Yongding, mountains above 750 meters elevation are already very high. There, the hills, forests, and terraced fields have an extra companion — clouds and mist. Although farmers working here have a hard livelihood, being called "immortals" is perhaps the greatest comfort for their secluded life. The environment of Yantai Village in Chendong Township is just like this, and the houses where the Lin clan villagers live here are 26 earthen buildings of various shapes. These earthen buildings, large and small, square and round, include the largest-diameter round earthen building in Yongding County — Fusheng Building, with a diameter of 81.6 meters; although slightly inferior to the 86-meter scale of Shunyu Building in Shuyang, Nanjing, it is truly hard to imagine how many people live inside. In fact, Fusheng Building was built during the Cultural Revolution, only about forty years ago. One cannot help but sigh that only remote places can escape the surging wave of modernization, and how long can the local people's minds and social life persist between the collision of new desires and old customs? Life in earthen buildings is actually still young; the four-story layout of Fusheng Building is no different from traditional earthen buildings: the first story has kitchens and dining rooms, the second story warehouses, and the third and fourth stories bedrooms. It's just that due to the needs of life, there are many additions and renovations inside the building, and the "new" building has lost the life charm and flavor often found in the nearby "old" buildings. The most important tasks for tourists here are: first, to search for traces of early earthen buildings that locals often mention, perhaps truly traceable to the Song Dynasty; second, to open their arms and embrace the scenery here, letting the air penetrate every pore. And the farmers' tasks? Please yourself use a calm heart to appreciate the benefits of your hometown...

projects.name: 中川胡氏家庙
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 龙岩市永定县下洋镇中川村
projects.address_en: Zhongchuan Village, Xiayang Town, Yongding County, Longyan
highlights: 祠堂环境
石雕功名柱
用过万金油但不一定知道来自永定下洋镇中川村的胡文虎
当得了富甲一方的豪绅但不一定能够在中川胡氏家庙前立一根旗杆
中川胡氏家庙又名安定堂
是明万历十二年1584年客家胡姓夫妇移民来此百年之后族人兴建的
家庙坐西朝东前有一方池塘后为一片密林
宗祠围墙前面和两侧是宽广的草坪族人举行大型祭祀活动时便会聚集在这里
家庙前草坪上则密密地树立着15支石旗杆2支因地震倒塌21支木旗杆
那是胡家历代功名显赫者所立的功名柱
石杆之上蟠龙生动字体清晰雕刻精美大方
家庙大门开在不高的前围墙上面向北
转折进入后面向前厅仅一进院落歇山顶抬梁穿斗混合式结构
庙内壁画众多木雕精美
所有牌位列列两厢
正堂之上悬挂安定堂匾额
宗祠之后还有白塔相伴是胡文虎的女儿捐建近代修建的
projects.content_zh: 用过万金油，但不一定知道来自永定下洋镇中川村的胡文虎；当得了富甲一方的豪绅，但不一定能够在中川胡氏家庙前立一根旗杆。中川胡氏家庙又名安定堂，是明万历十二年（1584年）客家胡姓夫妇移民来此百年之后族人兴建的。家庙坐西朝东，前有一方池塘，后为一片密林。宗祠围墙前面和两侧是宽广的草坪，族人举行大型祭祀活动时便会聚集在这里。家庙前草坪上则密密地树立着15支石旗杆（2支因地震倒塌）、21支木旗杆，那是胡家历代功名显赫者所立的功名柱。石杆之上蟠龙生动，字体清晰，雕刻精美大方。家庙大门开在不高的前围墙上，面向北；转折进入后面向前厅，仅一进院落，歇山顶，抬梁穿斗混合式结构。庙内壁画众多，木雕精美；所有牌位列列两厢；正堂之上悬挂"安定堂"匾额。此外，宗祠之后还有白塔相伴，是胡文虎的女儿捐建，近代修建的。
projects.content_en: You may have used Tiger Balm, but you may not know it comes from Hu Wenhu of Zhongchuan Village, Xiayang Town, Yongding; you may become a wealthy local magnate, but you may not be able to erect a flagpole in front of the Hu Family Temple in Zhongchuan. The Hu Family Temple in Zhongchuan, also known as Anding Hall, was built by clan members a hundred years after a Hakka Hu couple immigrated here in the 12th year of Wanli reign of the Ming (1584). The family temple faces east from the west, with a square pond in front and a dense forest behind. In front of and on both sides of the ancestral hall's enclosure wall are broad lawns, where clan members gather when holding large sacrificial activities. On the lawn in front of the family temple, 15 stone flagpoles (2 collapsed due to earthquakes) and 21 wooden flagpoles are densely erected — these are the merit pillars (gongming zhu) erected by prominent Hu clan members through the generations. On the stone poles, coiling dragons are vivid, characters clear, and carvings exquisite and generous. The main gate of the family temple opens on the low front enclosure wall, facing north; turning in leads to the front hall, with only one courtyard, hip-and-gable roof, and a mixed post-and-lintel and column-and-tie structure. Inside the temple there are many murals and exquisite wood carvings; all ancestral tablets are lined up on both sides; above the main hall hangs the "Anding Hall" plaque. In addition, behind the ancestral hall there is also a white pagoda, donated and built by Hu Wenhu's daughter in modern times.

projects.name: 古田会议旧址
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 龙岩市上杭县古田镇赖坊村
projects.address_en: Laifang Village, Gutian Town, Shanghang County, Longyan
highlights: 凭吊
听说过古田会议吧那是中国共产党成长发展历史上的关键时刻
从建筑的角度瞻仰一下古田会议旧址是能给人以不一样的体会
会议的旧址原是廖氏宗祠建于清道光年间1848年
民国六年1917年修葺后改为小学校舍
祠堂背负青山面对大片荷塘
院落规模不是很大但比较注重细节清幽而气度不凡
祠堂的正厅装饰考究梁架上的雕饰比较精致
全部涂以红色应该是后来出于保护所为
与本地常见的素颜的原木风格不同已经不是我们经常见到的大厝中厚重的风格
祠堂旁边的一口井名曰龙井
门外面对莲花池
古田的发音在中国的某些地方话中类似于福田
这些名称联想起来颇有意趣也许在预示着什么
当年开会的桌椅还原物保存
很多党员代表和红军将领曾经在这里济济一堂
毛泽东也曾经在这里发表演说
与我们脑海中的伟人形象不同他们那时多是虎虎有生气的中青年人
村头有小型廊桥一座常见的古桥要素一应俱全名为红军桥
荷花池畔贩卖仙草饮品的大姐捡拾饮料瓶的老人和小孙女在廊桥中休息
刹那间云起了回眼望红军桥已在远处
projects.content_zh: 听说过古田会议吧，那是中国共产党成长发展历史上的关键时刻；从建筑的角度瞻仰一下古田会议旧址是能给人以不一样的体会。会议的旧址原是廖氏宗祠，建于清道光年间（1848年），民国六年（1917年）修葺后改为小学校舍。祠堂背负青山，面对大片荷塘，院落规模不是很大，但比较注重细节，清幽而气度不凡；祠堂的正厅装饰考究，梁架上的雕饰比较精致，而全部涂以红色应该是后来出于保护所为，与本地常见的素颜的原木风格不同，已经不是我们经常见到的大厝中厚重的风格。祠堂旁边的一口井名曰"龙井"，门外面对莲花池，而"古田"的发音在中国的某些地方话中类似于"福田"，这些名称联想起来颇有意趣，也许在预示着什么。当年开会的桌椅还原物保存，很多党员代表和红军将领曾经在这里济济一堂，而毛泽东也曾经在这里发表演说。与我们脑海中的伟人形象不同，他们那时多是虎虎有生气的中青年人。村头有小型廊桥一座，常见的古桥要素一应俱全，名为"红军桥"。荷花池畔贩卖"仙草"饮品的大姐、捡拾饮料瓶的老人和小孙女在廊桥中休息。刹那间云起了，回眼望红军桥已在远处。
projects.content_en: You've heard of the Gutian Conference, right? It was a key moment in the growth and development history of the Communist Party of China; paying respects to the Gutian Conference site from an architectural perspective can give one a different kind of experience. The conference site was originally the Liao Clan Ancestral Hall, built during the Daoguang reign of the Qing (1848), and after renovation in the sixth year of the Republic (1917), it was converted into a primary school building. The ancestral hall leans against green mountains and faces a large lotus pond; the courtyard scale is not very large, but it pays attention to details, being quiet and elegant with extraordinary bearing; the main hall of the ancestral hall is exquisitely decorated, with relatively refined carvings on the beam frames, and the all-over red paint should have been applied later for protection — different from the common plain natural wood style locally, it is no longer the heavy style often seen in large mansions. A well next to the ancestral hall is called "Dragon Well"; outside the gate faces a lotus pond, and the pronunciation of "Gutian" in some Chinese dialects is similar to "Futian" (Blessed Field); these names associated together are quite interesting, perhaps foreshadowing something. The tables and chairs used at the conference that year are preserved as original objects; many party representatives and Red Army generals once gathered here, and Mao Zedong also delivered speeches here. Different from the great man image in our minds, they were mostly vigorous young and middle-aged people at that time. At the village entrance there is a small covered bridge, with all common ancient bridge elements complete, named "Red Army Bridge." The elder sister selling "xiancao" (grass jelly) drinks by the lotus pond, the old man picking up beverage bottles, and the little granddaughter rest in the covered bridge. In an instant clouds rose, and looking back, the Red Army Bridge was already in the distance.

projects.name: 李氏大宗祠
projects.name_en: Grand Ancestral Temple Complex for Li's Clan
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 龙岩市上杭县稔田镇官田村
projects.address_en: Guantian Village, Rentian Town, Shanghang County, Longyan
highlights: 围龙屋形式
木、石作结构与装饰
上杭稔田的山中古来人口和生计或许常常难以共荣
八闽六姓始祖李邱游陈刘黄发祥于此地而外侨谋生者众
天公不美或是动荡年代里人心因而不定因而近代这里成为了红色的土地
和游氏宗祠程门立雪堂刘氏宗祠黄氏宗祠等一样
稔田的李氏大宗祠是八闽六姓宗祠中影响广大的
此祠堂也称惇叙堂建成于道光十九年1839年
本为李氏后裔集资合建建好后便按捐款数额分配房屋
现在房门上仍标有某公之房间的文字
清宣统三年1911年集资1000银元由上杭庐丰安乡李永久主持维修
祠堂坐落在一片稻田中远远望去四面都有山峦
东边紧靠309省道相传为蜘蛛结网之风水宝地
建筑群坐北朝南砖木结构成回字形前方后圆前低后高
沿南北中轴线前后三重院落两侧有客厅侧天井和横屋
祠堂前有一方形池塘门前有宽广石墁大坪
坪中央有用五色鹅卵石铺砌成阴阳八卦图
大门为牌坊式石门楼斗拱仿木因石材材性并不刻意追求木作细节
左右各另有二旁门
前院左右连廊连接中堂中堂悬山屋顶满施龙凤花卉彩画
内置十扇七抹内屏门上部隔心板镌刻明代天顺年间上杭儒学教谕季远撰写的行书李火德公传
内院惇叙堂面阔三间抬梁减柱梁架遍施雕刻彩绘丁头拱雕刻生动
后壁设神龛火灰飞腾颇令人担忧这一院木构
再北为后院及弧形围屋两间一栋各设木楼梯供李氏后裔祭祖时住宿
projects.content_zh: 上杭稔田的山中，古来人口和生计或许常常难以共荣。八闽六姓始祖——李、邱、游、陈、刘、黄——发祥于此地，而外侨谋生者众；天公不美或是动荡年代里，人心因而不定，因而近代这里成为了红色的土地。和游氏宗祠程门立雪堂、刘氏宗祠、黄氏宗祠等一样，稔田的李氏大宗祠是八闽六姓宗祠中影响广大的。此祠堂也称"惇叙堂"，建成于道光十九年（1839年），本为李氏后裔集资合建，建好后便按捐款数额分配房屋，现在房门上仍标有某公之房间的文字。清宣统三年（1911年），集资1000银元，由上杭庐丰安乡李永久主持维修。祠堂坐落在一片稻田中，远远望去，四面都有山峦，东边紧靠309省道，相传为"蜘蛛结网"之风水宝地。建筑群坐北朝南，砖木结构，成"回"字形，前方后圆，前低后高，沿南北中轴线前后三重院落，两侧有客厅、侧天井和横屋。祠堂前有一方形池塘，门前有宽广石墁大坪，坪中央有用五色鹅卵石铺砌成阴阳八卦图。大门为牌坊式石门楼，斗拱仿木，因石材材性，并不刻意追求木作细节，左右各另有二旁门。前院左右连廊，连接中堂，中堂悬山屋顶，满施龙凤花卉彩画，内置十扇七抹内屏门，上部隔心板镌刻明代天顺年间上杭儒学教谕季远撰写的行书《李火德公传》。内院惇叙堂面阔三间，抬梁减柱，梁架遍施雕刻、彩绘，丁头拱雕刻生动，后壁设神龛，火灰飞腾，颇令人担忧这一院木构。再北为后院及弧形围屋，两间一栋，各设木楼梯，供李氏后裔祭祖时住宿。
projects.content_en: In the mountains of Rentian, Shanghang, since ancient times population and livelihood perhaps often could not prosper together. The six surname ancestors of Bamin (Fujian) — Li, Qiu, You, Chen, Liu, Huang — originated here, and many emigrated abroad to make a living; when heaven was unkind or in turbulent times, people's hearts were thus unsettled, and therefore in modern times this became a red land. Like the You Clan Ancestral Hall Chengmen Lixue Hall, Liu Clan Ancestral Hall, Huang Clan Ancestral Hall, etc., the Li Grand Ancestral Hall in Rentian is the most influential among the six surname ancestral halls of Bamin. This ancestral hall is also called "Dunxu Hall," completed in the 19th year of Daoguang reign (1839), originally built with funds raised collectively by Li clan descendants, and after completion houses were allocated according to donation amounts; today the room doors still bear inscriptions of a certain gentleman's room. In the third year of Xuantong reign of the Qing (1911), 1,000 silver dollars were raised, and Li Yongjiu of Lufeng'an Township, Shanghang, presided over the repairs. The ancestral hall sits in a stretch of rice fields; looking from afar, there are mountains on all sides, and to the east it abuts Provincial Highway 309,相传 to be a fengshui treasure land of "spider weaving web." The building complex faces south, of brick-wood structure, forming a "回" (Hui) shape, square in front and round behind, low in front and high behind, with three courtyards front to back along the north-south central axis, and living rooms, side courtyards, and horizontal houses on both sides. In front of the ancestral hall there is a square pond, and in front of the gate there is a broad stone-paved large flat area, with a yin-yang eight-trigram pattern paved with five-colored cobblestones in the center. The main gate is a paifang-style stone gate tower, with dougong imitating wood; due to the material properties of stone, it does not deliberately pursue woodwork details, and there are two side gates on each side. The front courtyard has connecting corridors on left and right, connecting to the middle hall; the middle hall has a gable roof (xuanshan ding), fully decorated with dragon-phoenix flower paintings, with ten seven-panel inner screen doors inside, and the upper partition panels are engraved with the running-script "Biography of Li Huode Gong" written by Ji Yuan, Confucian instructor of Shanghang during the Tianshun reign of the Ming. The inner courtyard Dunxu Hall is three bays wide, with post-and-lintel reduced columns, beam frames fully decorated with carvings and paintings, and vividly carved dingtou brackets (dingtou gong); the rear wall has a shrine, with incense ash flying, quite worrying for this courtyard of wooden structures. Further north is the rear courtyard and arc-shaped enclosed houses, two rooms per building, each with wooden stairs, for Li clan descendants to stay in during ancestor worship.

projects.name: 文昌阁
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 龙岩市上杭县蛟洋村
projects.address_en: Jiaoyang Village, Shanghang County, Longyan
highlights: 阁之塔式结构
登临
龙岩地区保存完好的文昌阁有好几处上杭县蛟洋村境内就矗立着这样一座
蛟洋说是村子不过一点也不偏僻比较繁华
文昌阁就在道旁外观雄伟而不失灵动
与西陂天后宫有异曲同工之妙
上杭文昌阁建于清代乾隆十九年1754年
外观六层一层至三层为方形上为八角形
顶冠红色葫芦檐角饰凤尾反翘
内为三层底层作厅堂二层为方形神殿四周设有回廊
顶层八面开窗成阁厅堂殿阁组成一体风格独特
木构通高32米
此处的文昌阁有一与众不同之处这里曾经是中共闽西一大的会址
参观需要在门口登记然后有管理人员打开一扇小门
有长长的狭窄楼梯可以通往二层这里就是当时的主会场了
会场的摆设简约质朴使人感觉与当年战斗的历史那么近
试着坐在椅子上体会一下当初的感觉
仿佛导师就在讲台上是位穿着深蓝色的朴素的中山装梳着略长的中分头发的中年人
那目光那谈吐使人们对中国的未来充满信心
文昌阁内部的装潢其实是非常经典的用料厚重到处弥漫着杉木的清香
和几十公里外连城县境内的文昌阁一样这里也有妈祖庙
妈祖庙旁边是一条河河上有一座古桥桥身是新做的
桥的旁边是宽敞的古道突出的石板上面打有拴船的圆孔
这里原先应是一处码头水路交汇货物集散
文昌阁的巨大身躯掩映在绿树之间古老中国的建筑曾经作为传播着西方先进思想的场所
天下大同慈悲为怀人与人之间谦让自律看淡物质享受共同追求精神修为的思想境界
似乎不是西方人的发明而是早就作为理想根植于中国人的心中了
projects.content_zh: 龙岩地区保存完好的文昌阁有好几处，上杭县蛟洋村境内就矗立着这样一座。蛟洋说是村子，不过一点也不偏僻，比较繁华，文昌阁就在道旁，外观雄伟而不失灵动，与西陂天后宫有异曲同工之妙。上杭文昌阁建于清代乾隆十九年（1754年），外观六层，一层至三层为方形，上为八角形，顶冠红色葫芦，檐角饰凤尾反翘。内为三层，底层作厅堂，二层为方形神殿，四周设有回廊，顶层八面开窗成阁，厅、堂、殿、阁组成一体，风格独特。木构，通高32米。此处的文昌阁有一与众不同之处——这里曾经是中共闽西一大的会址。参观需要在门口登记，然后有管理人员打开一扇小门，有长长的狭窄楼梯可以通往二层，这里就是当时的主会场了。会场的摆设简约质朴，使人感觉与当年战斗的历史那么近。试着坐在椅子上体会一下当初的感觉，仿佛导师就在讲台上，是位穿着深蓝色的朴素的中山装，梳着略长的中分头发的中年人，那目光、那谈吐，使人们对中国的未来充满信心。文昌阁内部的装潢其实是非常经典的，用料厚重，到处弥漫着杉木的清香。和几十公里外连城县境内的文昌阁一样，这里也有妈祖庙，妈祖庙旁边是一条河，河上有一座古桥，桥身是新做的。桥的旁边是宽敞的古道，突出的石板上面打有拴船的圆孔。这里原先应是一处码头，水路交汇，货物集散。文昌阁的巨大身躯掩映在绿树之间，古老中国的建筑，曾经作为传播着西方先进思想的场所。不过那种天下大同、慈悲为怀、人与人之间谦让自律、看淡物质享受共同追求精神修为的思想境界，似乎不是西方人的发明，而是早就作为理想根植于中国人的心中了。
projects.content_en: There are several well-preserved Wenchang Pavilions in the Longyan area, and one stands in Jiaoyang Village, Shanghang County. Jiaoyang is called a village, but it is not remote at all, being quite prosperous; Wenchang Pavilion is right by the road, with a majestic yet lively appearance, sharing the same wonderful effect as Xibei Tianhou Palace. Shanghang Wenchang Pavilion was built in the 19th year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1754), with six stories externally; the first to third stories are square, above which is octagonal, crowned with a red gourd, and the eave corners are decorated with phoenix-tail upturned tips. Internally it has three stories: the bottom story serves as a hall, the second story is a square divine hall with corridors around, and the top story has windows on eight sides forming a pavilion; hall, chamber, palace, and pavilion form an integrated whole with a unique style. Timber structure, total height 32 meters. This Wenchang Pavilion has one distinctive feature — it was once the venue of the First Congress of the Communist Party of China in Western Fujian. Visiting requires registration at the entrance, then a manager opens a small door, and a long narrow staircase leads to the second story, which was the main meeting venue at that time. The meeting place furnishings are simple and unadorned, making one feel so close to the fighting history of those years. Try sitting on a chair to experience the feeling of that time, as if the mentor were right on the podium — a middle-aged man wearing a plain dark blue Zhongshan suit, with slightly long center-parted hair, whose gaze and speech filled people with confidence in China's future. The interior decoration of Wenchang Pavilion is actually very classic, with heavy materials, and the fragrance of Chinese fir pervades everywhere. Like the Wenchang Pavilion in Liancheng County dozens of kilometers away, there is also a Mazu Temple here; next to the Mazu Temple is a river, with an ancient bridge over it, the bridge body being newly made. Beside the bridge is a spacious ancient road, with protruding stone slabs having round holes for tying boats. This place should originally have been a dock, where waterways converged and goods were collected and distributed. The massive body of Wenchang Pavilion is hidden among green trees — an ancient Chinese building that once served as a venue for spreading advanced Western ideas. However, that ideological realm of universal harmony, compassion, mutual humility and self-discipline among people, looking down on material enjoyment and jointly pursuing spiritual cultivation, does not seem to be a Western invention, but was already rooted as an ideal in the hearts of Chinese people long ago.

projects.name: 文庙
projects.address: 龙岩市上杭县城解放路东段
projects.address_en: East Section of Jiefang Road, Shanghang County Town, Longyan
highlights: 木结构
乾隆上杭县志载上杭文庙始建于宋嘉定十六年1223年后毁
于明嘉靖二十七年1548年在原地重建
从现存实物来看保存有大量闽西常见的清代建筑元素
尚须深入研究方能洞悉其历史沿革
从门前的下马碑开始就算进入了文庙的领地
这里遵循了文庙一般规制
棂星门是中轴线上的第一座建筑造型简洁古朴而石雕密布是典型的地方风格
进而是泮池拱桥其上素石为栏
泮桥之内便是戟门了单檐悬山屋顶面阔五间朴素谦逊
左右名宦祠乡贤祠
入得戟门面对大成殿前殿建东西两庑
大成殿重檐歇山屋顶面阔五间上层檐显三间
檐下斗拱密闭下层施丁头拱上层施单翘三昂九踩斗拱逐层出斜拱颇具装饰效果
殿内结构简明彩绘和雕刻点缀得当整体风格素雅庄重
大殿之后有明伦堂崇圣殿
中心院落之外还有尊经阁教谕署紫阳书院周公书院入圣第一门及四斋五祠等多座附属建筑
徜徉庙中并无游人只在侧门之内有一群长者在排练演奏
拉的曲子都是客家老曲
你我退食之后可有如此心境
projects.content_zh: 乾隆《上杭县志》载，上杭文庙始建于宋嘉定十六年（1223年），后毁，于明嘉靖二十七年（1548年）在原地重建。从现存实物来看，保存有大量闽西常见的清代建筑元素，尚须深入研究方能洞悉其历史沿革。从门前的"下马碑"开始，就算进入了文庙的领地。这里遵循了文庙一般规制：棂星门是中轴线上的第一座建筑，造型简洁古朴而石雕密布，是典型的地方风格；进而是泮池，拱桥其上，素石为栏；泮桥之内，便是戟门了，单檐悬山屋顶，面阔五间，朴素谦逊；左右名宦祠、乡贤祠；入得戟门，面对大成殿，殿前建东、西两庑；大成殿重檐歇山屋顶，面阔五间，上层檐显三间，檐下斗拱密闭，下层施丁头拱，上层施单翘三昂九踩斗拱，逐层出斜拱，颇具装饰效果；殿内结构简明，彩绘和雕刻点缀得当，整体风格素雅庄重；大殿之后，有明伦堂、崇圣殿；中心院落之外还有尊经阁、教谕署、紫阳书院、周公书院、入圣第一门及四斋五祠等多座附属建筑。徜徉庙中，并无游人，只在侧门之内，有一群长者在排练演奏，拉的曲子都是客家老曲。你我退食之后，可有如此心境？
projects.content_en: According to the Qianlong-era "Shanghang County Gazetteer," Shanghang Confucian Temple was first built in the 16th year of Jiading reign of the Song (1223), later destroyed, and rebuilt on the original site in the 27th year of Jiajing reign of the Ming (1548). From the existing physical remains, a large number of Qing Dynasty architectural elements common in western Fujian are preserved, and in-depth research is still needed to fully understand its historical evolution. Starting from the "Dismount Stele" in front of the gate, one has entered the territory of the Confucian Temple. Here the general regulations of Confucian temples are followed: the Lingxing Gate is the first building on the central axis, with a simple and ancient shape and dense stone carvings, a typical local style; next is the Pan Pond, with an arch bridge over it and plain stone railings; inside the Pan Bridge is the Halberd Gate (Ji Men), with a single-eave gable roof, five bays wide, simple and humble; on the left and right are the Official Fame Shrine and Local Worthies Shrine; entering the Halberd Gate, one faces the Dacheng Hall, with east and west side galleries in front of the hall; the Dacheng Hall has a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, five bays wide, with the upper eave showing three bays, dense dougong under the eaves, dingtou brackets on the lower level, and single-qiao three-ang nine-step dougong on the upper level, with diagonal brackets emerging layer by layer, quite decorative; the interior structure is concise, with paintings and carvings appropriately embellished, and the overall style is elegant and solemn; behind the main hall are the Minglun Hall and Chongsheng Hall; beyond the central courtyard there are also many附属 buildings such as the Zunjing Pavilion, Instructor's Office, Ziyang Academy, Zhougong Academy, First Gate to Sainthood, and four studios and five shrines. Wandering in the temple, there are no tourists; only inside the side gate, a group of elders are rehearsing and playing, all the tunes they play being old Hakka melodies. After you and I finish our meals, can we have such a state of mind?

projects.name: 均庆寺
projects.address: 龙岩市武平县岩前镇灵岩村
projects.address_en: Lingyan Village, Yanqian Town, Wuping County, Longyan
highlights: 大殿和木亭的木结构
石洞
登临
嘉泰三年1203年十月周必大写过一篇定光庵记
说的是莅汀官员创修定光庵的经过算是比较早的关于定光佛的记载
定光佛俗姓郑名自严十七岁出家
主要在赣闽两地游学和修行得道后主要在武平县南安岩和汀州城弘法
攘凶产祥庇佑汀州无水旱疾疫百姓敬信官员呵护
闽西发源一直到台湾甚至广布东南亚定光佛信仰成为联系一方乡亲的纽带
岩前镇在205国道边上
岩前的声名不是依靠国道而盛却是源于镇中心一座名叫狮岩的小石山
狮岩本无奇奇缘自佑之
综合周必大定光庵记和临汀志的记载
定光佛生于五代闽国龙启二年934年
卒于北宋真宗大中祥符八年1015年武平南安旧岩即岩前的均庆寺
于是这里成为著名的定光佛的根本道场
寺院建于北宋乾德二年964年
元代刘将孙在汀州为官时作汀州路南安岩均庆禅寺修造记
大德癸卯1303年有旨诵经环一郡六邑惟南岩均庆禅寺定光古佛道场有新藏
于是府公莅焉贝叶新翻列函严整宝轮炫耀栋宇高深龙蛇通灵护持显赫
但那时古迹在今天已经难觅踪影了
今天的寺院又叫均庆院南宋绍定三年1230年也曾得名定光院
是一座重檐三滴水的大殿结构简明仅上层檐施七踩如意斗拱
大殿左右的钟鼓楼都是新建的
古殿中并没有供奉什么定光佛像它后面的巨大石山才是真正的主角
从均庆院旁边的小路上山是石山的洞口
芜杂的神仙菩萨金刚像之外中间的是一座木亭亭内三尊定光古佛像
木亭形式颇古朴怎乃无法登临琢磨更无法取样分析只能等待今后的机缘了
projects.content_zh: 嘉泰三年（1203年）十月周必大写过一篇《定光庵记》，说的是莅汀官员创修定光庵的经过，算是比较早的关于定光佛的记载。定光佛俗姓郑，名自严，十七岁出家，主要在赣闽两地游学和修行，得道后主要在武平县南安岩和汀州城弘法，"攘凶产祥"，庇佑汀州无水旱疾疫，百姓敬信，官员呵护。闽西发源，一直到台湾，甚至广布东南亚，定光佛信仰成为联系一方乡亲的纽带。岩前镇在205国道边上。岩前的声名不是依靠国道而盛，却是源于镇中心一座名叫"狮岩"的小石山。狮岩本无奇，奇缘自佑之。综合周必大《定光庵记》和《临汀志》的记载，定光佛生于五代闽国龙启二年（934年），卒于北宋真宗大中祥符八年（1015年）武平南安旧岩，即岩前的均庆寺。于是这里成为著名的定光佛的根本道场。寺院建于北宋乾德二年（964年）。元代刘将孙在汀州为官时作《汀州路南安岩均庆禅寺修造记》："大德癸卯（1303年），有旨诵经。环一郡六邑，惟南岩均庆禅寺定光古佛道场有新藏。于是府公莅焉。贝叶新翻，列函严整，宝轮炫耀，栋宇高深。龙蛇通灵，护持显赫……"，但那时古迹在今天已经难觅踪影了。今天的寺院又叫"均庆院"，南宋绍定三年（1230年）也曾得名"定光院"，是一座重檐三滴水的大殿，结构简明，仅上层檐施七踩如意斗拱。大殿左右的钟鼓楼都是新建的。不过，古殿中并没有供奉什么定光佛像，它后面的巨大石山才是真正的主角。从均庆院旁边的小路上山，是石山的洞口，芜杂的神仙、菩萨、金刚像之外，中间的是一座木亭，亭内三尊定光古佛像。木亭形式颇古朴，怎乃无法登临琢磨，更无法取样分析，只能等待今后的机缘了。
projects.content_en: In the tenth month of the third year of Jiatai reign (1203), Zhou Bida wrote an "Account of Dingguang Nunnery," describing the process of officials stationed in Tingzhou founding and repairing Dingguang Nunnery, which is considered a relatively early record about Dingguang Buddha. Dingguang Buddha's secular surname was Zheng, given name Ziyan; he became a monk at age seventeen, mainly studying and practicing in Jiangxi and Fujian, and after attaining enlightenment mainly propagated the Dharma at Nan'an Rock in Wuping County and in Tingzhou city, "dispelling misfortune and producing auspiciousness," protecting Tingzhou from floods, droughts, and plagues, revered by the people and protected by officials. Originating in western Fujian, extending to Taiwan, and even spreading widely in Southeast Asia, the Dingguang Buddha faith became a bond connecting local folks. Yanqian Town is beside National Highway 205. Yanqian's fame did not prosper依靠 the highway, but originated from a small stone mountain in the town center called "Lion Rock" (Shi Yan). Lion Rock itself is nothing extraordinary, but a strange destiny protects it. Combining the records in Zhou Bida's "Account of Dingguang Nunnery" and "Lin Ting Zhi," Dingguang Buddha was born in the second year of Longqi reign of the Min Kingdom in the Five Dynasties (934), and died in the eighth year of Dazhong Xiangfu reign of Emperor Zhenzong of the Northern Song (1015) at the old Nan'an Rock in Wuping, i.e., Junqing Temple in Yanqian. Thus this place became the famous fundamental道场 of Dingguang Buddha. The temple was built in the second year of Qiande reign of the Northern Song (964). In the Yuan Dynasty, Liu Jiangsun, while serving as an official in Tingzhou, wrote "Account of the Repair of Junqing Chan Temple at Nan'an Rock, Tingzhou Route": "In the Gui-mao year of Dade reign (1303), there was an imperial decree to recite sutras. Around one prefecture and six counties, only the Nan'an Rock Junqing Chan Temple, the道场 of the ancient Dingguang Buddha, had a new scripture repository. Then the prefect arrived. Newly translated palm-leaf scriptures, neatly arranged in cases, precious wheels shining, buildings tall and deep. Dragons and snakes communicate with spirits, protection and support are illustrious..." but those ancient sites are hard to find traces of today. Today's temple is also called "Junqing Courtyard," and in the third year of Shaoding reign of the Southern Song (1230) it was also named "Dingguang Courtyard"; it is a main hall with double eaves and three water-drops, with a concise structure, only the upper eave having seven-step ruyi dougong. The bell and drum towers on both sides of the main hall are all newly built. However, the ancient hall does not enshrine any Dingguang Buddha statue; the huge stone mountain behind it is the real protagonist. Going up the mountain from the small path beside Junqing Courtyard, one reaches the cave entrance of the stone mountain; besides miscellaneous statues of immortals, bodhisattvas, and vajra warriors, in the center is a wooden pavilion, with three ancient Dingguang Buddha statues inside. The wooden pavilion is quite ancient in form, but unfortunately one cannot climb up to examine it closely, nor can one take samples for analysis — one can only wait for future opportunities.

projects.content_zh: 梁野山叫作"梁野仙山"，自有它的道理。山里的风景其实在闽西北并不少见，但是这里有水，有纵横奔流的瀑布，天籁之声，动静之景，多了一种感官的享受。山中峰岩奇异，更有沟壑洞穴，季节合适的话，花草自来亲人。有微风，还有泉水，洗去寻访古建筑路途中的一切疲惫。白云禅寺所在的坑头村，还在野猪凹和杉树窝的里边，从名字就可以想见它的深邃。这样的地方成为定光佛的道场，也说明定光崇拜的深入民心。白云寺原建于景区内的仙人洞口，后毁，今天的寺院始建于宋代，清康熙六十一年（1722年）重建，坐落在山中的一块平地，前面静卧着一汪清水。寺院是面朝西北的，外观看来整体都是用石块砌筑的，建筑内部，墙体、梁、柱也均石构。规模不大，只有一进院子。大门连着前殿，内有天井，然后就是大殿，两侧横屋。前殿面阔三间。大殿也是面阔三间，进深较大，殿内立了八根元代大石柱，是罕见的元代仿木石构遗存。白云禅寺附近，还有一座清康熙十四年（1675年）建的普通舍利塔，塔中安放有临济宗祖师的舍利。
projects.content_en: Liangye Mountain is called "Liangye Immortal Mountain," and it has its own reasons. The scenery in the mountains is actually not rare in northwestern Fujian, but here there is water, with crisscrossing rushing waterfalls, the sounds of nature, and scenes of both movement and stillness, adding a kind of sensory enjoyment. The peaks and rocks in the mountains are strange, and there are even gullies and caves; when the season is right, flowers and plants naturally come close to people. There are gentle breezes and also spring water, washing away all fatigue on the journey to visit ancient buildings. Kengtou Village, where White Cloud Zen Temple is located, is still inside Yezhu'ao (Wild Boar Hollow) and Shanshuwo (Fir Tree Nest), and from the names one can imagine its depth. Such a place becoming the道场 of Dingguang Buddha also说明 how deeply rooted the Dingguang worship is in people's hearts. White Cloud Temple was originally built at the Immortal Cave entrance in the scenic area, later destroyed; today's temple was first built in the Song Dynasty and rebuilt in the 61st year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1722), sitting on a flat ground in the mountains, with a pool of clear water quietly lying in front. The temple faces northwest; externally it appears to be entirely built of stone blocks, and inside the building, the walls, beams, and columns are also all stone structures. It is not large in scale, with only one courtyard. The main gate connects to the front hall, with a courtyard inside, then the main hall, with horizontal houses on both sides. The front hall is three bays wide. The main hall is also three bays wide, with a relatively large depth; inside the hall stand eight large stone columns from the Yuan Dynasty, a rare surviving example of Yuan Dynasty stone structure imitating wood. Near White Cloud Zen Temple, there is also an ordinary stupa (reliquary tower) built in the 14th year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1675), in which the relics of the Linji sect patriarch are enshrined.
