projects.content_zh: 唐初开始，长汀便成为从中州辗转迁徙而来的客家先民躲避战乱和灾荒的落脚点。开基创业的同时，对故乡的怀念和对祖先的眷恋便以宗祠的形式兴建了起来。这一建就是千百年，这一建就是一条条的宗祠街，一片片的宗祠群。长汀客家宗祠群在长汀的汀州镇，有连成片的新新巷家祠群，还有分散在城里的林氏家庙、赖氏家庙、邱公祠、刘氏家庙等。新新巷家祠群在南大街历史街区，横跨新新巷及中心巷，总占地面积近3000余平方米，包括曾宅、郑氏家庙、罗氏家庙、傅氏家庙、赖氏宗祠等五座家祠家庙，均为清代所建。建筑采用砖木混合结构，平面与府第无异，一般是由前坪、门楼、门厅、天井、正厅、横屋、后花台、后排房等建筑组成。在分散的几座家祠中，刘氏家庙在城内东门街劳动巷七号，北靠卧龙山，面对宝珠南屏山，地理位置绝佳。祠堂称为"王衙"，是因为初祀三国时蜀汉昭烈帝刘备次子鲁王刘永公及入闽始祖刘祥公。始建于北宋淳化三年（992年），后经过历代修缮鼎新。祠堂为各地客家刘姓集资建造，称"刘氏总祠"。主要建筑包括门楼、边门、照壁，院内上中下三大厅，还有后楼、化胎祠、福德祠、朱子阁、桃园结义亭，以及左右横屋。家庙正堂，单檐歇山顶式，面阔三间，抬梁式结构，屋顶琉璃瓦面。
projects.content_en: From the early Tang Dynasty, Changting became a foothold for Hakka ancestors who migrated from the Central Plains to avoid wars and famines. While establishing their foundations, the nostalgia for their hometown and attachment to their ancestors was expressed through the construction of ancestral halls. This construction lasted for thousands of years, creating street after street of ancestral halls and cluster after cluster of ancestral hall complexes. The Changting Hakka Ancestral Temple Complexes are in Tingzhou Town, Changting, with the contiguous Xinxin Lane ancestral hall cluster, as well as scattered Lin Clan Family Temple, Lai Clan Family Temple, Qiu Gong Shrine, Liu Clan Family Temple, etc. in the city. The Xinxin Lane ancestral hall cluster is in the South Street historical district, spanning Xinxin Lane and Central Lane, with a total area of nearly 3,000 square meters, including five family temples and ancestral halls: Zeng Residence, Zheng Clan Family Temple, Luo Clan Family Temple, Fu Clan Family Temple, and Lai Clan Ancestral Hall, all built in the Qing Dynasty. The buildings use a brick-wood mixed structure, with plans no different from mansions, generally consisting of front flat area, gate tower, entrance hall, courtyard, main hall, horizontal houses, rear flower terrace, and rear row of rooms. Among the scattered family temples, the Liu Clan Family Temple is at No. 7 Laodong Lane, Dongmen Street in the city, backed by Wolong Mountain and facing Baozhu Nanping Mountain, with an excellent geographical location. The ancestral hall is called "Wang Ya" (Royal Mansion) because it originally enshrined Liu Yong, the second son of Liu Bei (Emperor Zhaolie of Shu Han in the Three Kingdoms period), and Liu Xiang, the first ancestor of the Liu clan who entered Fujian. It was first built in the third year of Chunhua reign of the Northern Song (992), and later repaired and renovated through successive dynasties. The ancestral hall was built with funds raised by Hakka Liu clan members from various places, called the "Liu Clan General Ancestral Hall." The main buildings include the gate tower, side gate, and screen wall; inside the courtyard are three large halls upper, middle, and lower; there are also the rear building, Huatai Shrine, Fude Shrine, Zhuzi Pavilion, Taoyuan Jieyi Pavilion, and left and right horizontal houses. The main hall of the family temple has a single-eave hip-and-gable roof, three bays wide, post-and-lintel structure, with glazed tile roof.

projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位

projects.content_zh: "围城"伴随着中国人好几千年，但今天能与围城相伴生活的却已经不多了。近年来努力将古城申报世界文化遗产的意义也便在于此吧。汀州城墙历史悠久。最早是唐大历四年（769年），汀州刺史陈剑将州治从东坊口大丘头迁移到现在的位置。宋治平三年（1066年），郡守刘均扩大规模，城墙周长增加到了"五里二百五十四步"，基宽3丈，高1.8丈，城壕深1.5丈。明洪武四年（1371年）重修，包以砖石。明弘治十一年（1499年），增建门楼。崇祯九年（1635年）筑门且将城墙增高加厚。清顺治以后，还有几次重修。至1924年，城墙大部分被拆毁，余者十之二三。鼎盛时期，汀州古城墙总长达到5公里，一周设有12个城门。算上近来修复的，现在保存完好的城墙近3000米，将朝天门、五通门、惠吉门、宝珠门联结在一起。汀州城墙的特点在山水。所谓"枕山临溪为城"，山中有城，城中有水。城墙从卧龙山顶金沙寺延伸下来，城墙垛口点点相连，恰似一串佛珠，被人们称为"佛挂珠"。城墙塑造生活，城门、城楼塑造形象。长汀城墙现存城楼有朝天门城、三元阁（明崇祯以前称广储门）、五通门、惠吉门、宝珠门，这里的城墙垛口等都是新近恢复的，城门楼都是明清时期的建筑。其中朝天门楼在位于东大街，清代重建，城台和城门都是砖筑，城楼楼阁式双层砖木结构，面阔三间，进深二间，重檐歇山顶。三元阁城楼在和平路，花岗石砌基，青砖城台，城楼二层，青砖墙身，原为"四檐三层"，现存建筑上层大木结构五间，进深四间，下层则面阔三大间，檐下丁头拱挑檐，柱下保留早期八角覆盆式石柱础。宝珠门楼下南大街穿过，是明朝汀州的正南门，双重城门，中间有天窗，城门两廊设养马槽，门楼两层，砖石为墙，内木结构为骨架，重檐歇山顶。
projects.content_en: "Encircling cities" have accompanied Chinese people for thousands of years, but today not many still live alongside encircling city walls. The significance of recent efforts to apply for the ancient city to become a World Cultural Heritage lies precisely in this. The Tingzhou City Wall has a long history. The earliest was in the fourth year of Dali reign of the Tang (769), when Chen Jian, prefect of Tingzhou, moved the prefectural seat from Dongfangkou Daqiutou to its current location. In the third year of Zhiping reign of the Song (1066), Prefect Liu Jun expanded the scale, increasing the city wall circumference to "five li and two hundred fifty-four paces," with a base width of 3 zhang, height of 1.8 zhang, and moat depth of 1.5 zhang. In the fourth year of Hongwu reign of the Ming (1371), it was repaired and wrapped with brick and stone. In the 11th year of Hongzhi reign of the Ming (1499), gate towers were added. In the ninth year of Chongzhen reign (1635), gates were built and the city wall was raised and thickened. After the Shunzhi reign of the Qing, there were several more repairs. By 1924, most of the city wall had been demolished, with only two or three tenths remaining. At its peak, the total length of the Tingzhou ancient city wall reached 5 kilometers, with 12 city gates around the circumference. Including recently restored sections, the well-preserved city wall now is nearly 3,000 meters, connecting Chaotian Gate, Wutong Gate, Huiji Gate, and Baozhu Gate. The characteristic of the Tingzhou City Wall lies in its landscape. The so-called "city leaning on mountains and facing streams" means there is a city within the mountains and water within the city. The city wall extends down from Jinsha Temple at the top of Wolong Mountain, with the crenellations connected point by point, just like a string of Buddhist beads, called by people "Buddha Hanging Beads." The city wall shapes life, while the gates and gate towers shape the image. The existing gate towers of the Changting city wall include Chaotian Gate Tower, Sanyuan Pavilion (called Guangchu Gate before Chongzhen reign of the Ming), Wutong Gate, Huiji Gate, and Baozhu Gate; the crenellations here are all recently restored, and the gate towers are all Ming-Qing period buildings. Among them, Chaotian Gate Tower is on East Street, rebuilt in the Qing, with both the gate platform and gate built of brick; the gate tower is a pavilion-style double-story brick-wood structure, three bays wide, two bays deep, with double-eave hip-and-gable roof. Sanyuan Pavilion Gate Tower is on Heping Road, with granite base and blue-brick gate platform; the gate tower is two stories with blue-brick walls, originally "four eaves and three stories"; the existing building's upper story has five bays of major timber structure, four bays deep, while the lower story is three major bays wide, with dingtou brackets under the eaves supporting the eaves, and early octagonal inverted-bowl stone column bases preserved under the columns. Baozhu Gate Tower, with South Street passing through underneath, was the main south gate of Tingzhou in the Ming Dynasty, with double gates and a skylight in between; horse troughs are set in both corridors of the gate; the gate tower is two stories, with brick-stone walls and internal timber structure as the skeleton, with double-eave hip-and-gable roof.

projects.content_zh: 有汀州城，一定就要供奉好城隍。祭祀城隍神的例规形成于南北朝，唐宋渐盛，宋代已列为国家祀典。这样算来，汀州城隍庙或许也可追溯到1200多年前的唐大历年间。但是从建筑的特征来看，现存庙宇应当是清代的作品，建筑开间所反映出的基址规模和特征则古意颇浓。汀州城隍庙尺度不小但是规模不大，只两进院子，由石牌楼、前殿、正殿、后殿、东宫及两厢等建筑组成。前院空旷，或者历史上还有其他建筑。据说，这是福建省现存规模最大的城隍庙，颇令人感到诧异。如此多的城、堡，如此繁忙的战争和商旅，竟没有制度更严谨些的城隍庙吗？此现象或许说明城隍信仰在当地不是特别兴旺，也许早已被繁多的宗教、礼制祭祀冲淡了。满目文庙、宗祠、妈祖庙、定光寺的地方，留给城隍这样宽敞的一席之地便足资敬重了。石牌楼是福建地方一贯的高水准——造型端庄，雕刻细腻，线脚合理，整体上繁简得当。大院东西两廊60米长，内有复原的十殿阎君壁画。主殿三间，明间尤为宽阔，采用移柱结构，悬单檐歇山顶，而明间之上更施一歇山顶小楼，造型独特。大殿柱头科斗拱装饰丰富，楼檐下如意斗拱弥补。大殿的石雕龙柱、石刻对联依旧。值得一提的是大殿内"九命荷荣封衮冕辉煌位伯子男之上，全汀昭世守金汤巩固神显山川社稷之间"的对联在浩劫年代得以被有心人用泥巴封住，今天真迹才得以复见天日。
projects.content_en: Where there is a Tingzhou city, there must certainly be a well-enshrined City God. The ritual of sacrificing to the City God deity formed during the Northern and Southern Dynasties, gradually flourished in the Tang and Song, and was listed as a state sacrifice in the Song Dynasty. Counting this way, the Tingzhou City God Temple may perhaps be traced back to the Dali reign of the Tang over 1,200 years ago. However, judging from the architectural features, the existing temple should be a Qing Dynasty work, while the scale and characteristics of the foundation site reflected by the building bays are quite rich in ancient meaning. The Tingzhou City God Temple is not small in dimensions but not large in scale, with only two courtyards, consisting of a stone paifang, front hall, main hall, rear hall, east palace, and two side wings. The front courtyard is open and empty, perhaps there were other buildings historically. It is said that this is the largest existing City God Temple in Fujian Province, which is quite surprising. With so many cities and forts, such busy wars and commerce, was there not a City God Temple with more rigorous institutions? This phenomenon perhaps说明 that the City God faith was not particularly prosperous locally, perhaps早已 diluted by the numerous religious and ritual sacrifices. In a place filled with Confucian temples, ancestral halls, Mazu temples, and Dingguang temples, leaving such a spacious place for the City God is sufficient to show respect. The stone paifang maintains Fujian's consistently high standard — dignified modeling, delicate carvings, reasonable moldings, and overall appropriate balance of complexity and simplicity. The east and west corridors of the large courtyard are 60 meters long, with restored murals of the Ten Halls of Yama inside. The main hall has three bays, with the central bay particularly wide, using a column-shifting structure, with a single-eave hip-and-gable roof; above the central bay there is an additional small hip-and-gable roof building, with a unique shape. The column-head dougong of the main hall are richly decorated, with ruyi dougong under the tower eaves making up for it. The stone-carved dragon columns and stone-carved couplets of the main hall remain as before. It is worth mentioning that the couplet inside the main hall — "Nine ranks bear glorious enfeoffment, ceremonial robes and crowns resplendent, ranked above earls, viscounts, and barons; all Tingzhou manifests hereditary defense, golden walls and solid moats, the deity manifests between mountains, rivers, and the state" — was sealed with mud by a caring person during the calamitous years, and today the true work has finally seen the light of day again.

projects.content_zh: 距离城隍庙不远，还有汀州文庙，是汀属八县推崇儒教的场所。与福建现存最大的城隍庙规模形成对比的是，这座文庙显然不是福建之最，但是历史上曾经拥有庞大的建筑群，包括现在的长汀县政府大院的大部，县人大办公楼的全部。现存的核心部分尚且包括棂星门、泮池、拱桥、仪门、门庑斋舍、文会堂、题名策，名宦乡贤祠、大成殿、崇贤祠等建筑。汀州文庙建于宋绍兴三年（1333年），其后历代都有维修之举。而最近的一次重振文庙威严的举措是1995年后重建棂星门。棂星门虽然熬过了"文化大革命"，但是没有熬过"文化大革命"带来的愚昧，1980年遭到了拆除，原地居然盖起了四层的文化大楼，俯视文庙"遗骸"。所幸这座"伪文化"大楼短寿。今天棂星门的石料、石雕还显得光洁崭新，想来时间会给予它阅历，敬重会带给它威严吧。进入仪门，便是文庙大成殿。这里无疑是建筑群的高潮。大殿面阔三间，进深三间，抬梁式木构架，重檐歇山顶，檐下如意斗拱交织。整体看来开间宽广，明间更大，跨度7.35米，大额枋砍制月梁形，用材硕大，金柱直径均不小于40厘米。殿身主体前设卷棚式前廊，明间当中独立一门楼，如意斗拱和花板相间排列。室内部分明间正中四面卷棚中出挑三层如意斗拱承托藻井，角垂花柱；次间为三扇井口天花，绘有龙凤、花草。
projects.content_en: Not far from the City God Temple, there is also the Tingzhou Confucian Temple, a place for the eight counties under Tingzhou to venerate Confucianism. In contrast to the scale of Fujian's largest existing City God Temple, this Confucian temple is obviously not the largest in Fujian, but historically it once had a massive building complex, including most of the current Changting County Government compound and the entire County People's Congress office building. The existing core part still includes the Lingxing Gate, Pan Pond, arch bridge, Yi Gate, gate-side rooms and study halls, Wenhui Hall, inscription hall, Official Fame and Local Worthies Shrine, Dacheng Hall, and Chongxian Shrine. The Tingzhou Confucian Temple was built in the third year of Shaoxing reign of the Song (1333), and has been repaired in successive dynasties thereafter. The most recent measure to restore the majesty of the Confucian temple was the rebuilding of the Lingxing Gate after 1995. Although the Lingxing Gate survived the Cultural Revolution, it did not survive the ignorance brought by the Cultural Revolution; it was demolished in 1980, and a four-story cultural building was actually built on the original site, overlooking the "remains" of the Confucian temple. Fortunately, this "pseudo-cultural" building was short-lived. Today the stone materials and carvings of the Lingxing Gate still appear clean and brand new; presumably time will give it experience, and respect will bring it majesty. Entering the Yi Gate, one reaches the Dacheng Hall of the Confucian temple. This is undoubtedly the climax of the building complex. The main hall is three bays wide and three bays deep, with a post-and-lintel timber frame, double-eave hip-and-gable roof, and interwoven ruyi dougong under the eaves. Overall, the bays are wide, with the central bay even larger, spanning 7.35 meters; the large eave lintel is hewn into a moon-beam shape, with massive materials, and the golden columns are all no less than 40 centimeters in diameter. The main body of the hall has a curved-roof front porch in front, with an independent gate tower in the center of the central bay, with ruyi dougong and decorative panels arranged alternately. In the interior, at the center of the central bay, three layers of ruyi dougong project from the four-sided curved ceiling to support the caisson, with hanging columns at the corners; the secondary bays have three panels of coffered ceiling, painted with dragons, phoenixes, flowers, and plants.

projects.content_zh: 位于连城县莒溪镇璧洲村口的文昌阁，始建于清康熙三十一年（1692年）。因相邻天后宫与永隆桥，形成如今璧洲村三位一体景观，虽历经风雨，仍保存完好。连城文昌阁建筑造型别具一格。第一、二层为四方形，以杉木与青砖为主要建筑材料。第二层四周有走马楼相通。第三层至阁顶采用木质悬臂结构成八角形，融宝塔式与宫殿式于一体，塔尖嵌一大葫芦为顶。阁下楼令人炫目的斗拱结构，在客家人聚居之地这种建筑结构很多见，似乎手到擒来。阁门前建莲花池，砖石结构拱桥将池一分为二。阁底大厅神台同设"文昌帝君"与"十友公"牌位供乡民祭奉。偶遇担当文昌阁管理职责的林君，虽值班之际...
projects.content_en: The Wenchang Pavilion located at the entrance of Bizhou Village, Juxi Town, Liancheng County, was first built in the 31st year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1692). Because it is adjacent to Tianhou Palace and Yonglong Bridge, it forms today's trinity landscape of Bizhou Village; despite weathering through storms, it remains well preserved. The architectural shape of Liancheng Wenchang Pavilion is unique. The first and second stories are square, using Chinese fir and blue brick as the main building materials. The second story has a horse-walking gallery (zouma lou) connecting around all four sides. From the third story to the top of the pavilion, a wooden cantilever structure forms an octagonal shape, integrating pagoda style and palace style into one, with a large gourd embedded at the spire as the top. The dazzling dougong structure under the pavilion is very common in Hakka聚居 areas, seemingly effortlessly achieved. A lotus pond is built in front of the pavilion gate, and a brick-stone arch bridge divides the pond into two. In the main hall at the bottom of the pavilion, the altar simultaneously enshrines the tablets of "Wenchang Dijun" (God of Literature) and "Shiyou Gong" for villagers to worship. I happened to meet Mr. Lin, who is responsible for managing Wenchang Pavilion, although it was during his duty shift...

projects.content_zh: 去往培田的路上，午后的阳光如此炽烈，空气透亮，刹那间有些恍惚：怎么仿佛是拉萨城外哲蚌寺的天空？村口的标志建筑是进士坊，这里有一大片荷塘，又不禁想起避暑山庄的烟雨楼。或者你和我一样幸运，可以遇到进士的后人吴老带你走遍全村。吴老虽说是一普通老者，但谈吐文雅，对村中的文化古迹如数家珍，看得出家学渊源，不失大家风范。培田古村，被誉为"福建省民居第一村"，因为这个村民仅1000多人的小村落留下一笔巨大的遗产：30幢大宅、21座祠堂、6处书院、1条千米古街、2座跨街牌坊、4处庵庙道观。这里的人们都自称是客家人，语言和风俗都是客家文化。公祠是全村人祭祀共祖之地。老的戏台至今还在发挥功用，除了祭祀时刻演戏之外，晚上居然在这里放电影。公祠门前的石鼓固然威严，也默许贩卖小商品的大姐在那里休息。无论何种世外桃源，过去的"宗族"是一切道德实现的保障；从建筑角度来说，礼制建筑数量极多，地位极崇。这里没有人敢私搭乱建，否则的话"罚不予祭三年"。还有一处祠堂，曾经是全村最大者，毁于1995年一场大火。其时正是村子决定"开放"的前后。站在...
projects.content_en: On the way to Peitian, the afternoon sun was so blazing and the air so transparent that for a moment I felt a bit trance: how could it seem like the sky outside Drepung Monastery in Lhasa? The landmark building at the village entrance is the Jinshi (Palace Graduate) Archway, and there is a large lotus pond here, which inevitably reminds one of the Yanyu Tower of the Imperial Summer Resort. Or if you are as lucky as me, you may meet Old Wu, a descendant of the palace graduate, who will take you through the whole village. Although Old Wu is an ordinary elderly man, he speaks elegantly and knows the village's cultural relics like the back of his hand, showing his family scholarly heritage without losing the demeanor of a great family. Peitian Ancient Village is known as "the No. 1 residential village in Fujian Province," because this small village of only over 1,000 people has left a huge legacy: 30 large mansions, 21 ancestral halls, 6 academies, 1 kilometer-long ancient street, 2 cross-street archways, and 4 temples and Taoist shrines. The people here all call themselves Hakka, and their language and customs are all Hakka culture. The public ancestral hall is the place where the whole village sacrifices to their common ancestors. The old stage still functions today; besides performing operas during sacrificial times, movies are actually shown here at night. The stone drums in front of the public ancestral hall are certainly majestic, but they also默许 the elder sister selling small goods to rest there. Whatever kind of paradise, in the past the "clan" was the guarantee for the realization of all morality; from an architectural perspective, ritual buildings are extremely numerous and hold a very high status. No one here dares to build unauthorized structures, otherwise they would be "punished by being forbidden from sacrificing for three years." There is another ancestral hall, once the largest in the village, which was destroyed by a fire in 1995. That was just around the time the village decided to "open up." Standing...

projects.content_zh: 初闻万隆桥是在一篇客家人办的文学刊物上，只是简短的文字说明，并无图片，吸引我的一句话是"藏于深闺，难掩其秀"。说去就去了。大山深处狭窄的村际公路上，路虽然很窄，但周围很少有车。经过一个叫"罗圣"的村庄，无意间发现一座小型廊桥，名叫"大安"。桥外有古老的水车还在运转。桥虽不大但募捐善款的人士名单却历历在目，几笔勾勒出古老山村的淳朴民风。车行愈深，越发感到这里山区的与众不同。濑源乡是红军的发祥地，当年最早在这里成立苏维埃政权。战斗的岁月过去了，现在这里是一片和平的气息。深山中盛产竹子，到处可见竹制品晾晒在路边。在乡人的指引下沿着村头大树的小道下去，一座精美的廊桥出现在眼前，这就是万隆桥。万隆桥也是小型廊桥，不过它的特点在于精巧别致，尤其顶部的六角形的阁楼做得神采飞扬，其工艺的精湛令人惊叹。万隆桥完全隐藏在青山秀水之中，有淙淙小溪从桥边流过，溪水清澈，水底的石头五彩斑斓，竟不知在此山野之中何来如此精美的廊桥，谁人将它建成又抛掷在此。桥内是穿斗式木架构，地面用木板，比较陈旧，风雨板半开，廊屋内光线好，休息用的长条木板是后做的。廊屋内原有神龛，神龛上部高悬"万隆桥"匾额。廊屋内部的木工活非常精美，从外面的阁楼延伸到廊屋内部的神龛斗拱，应该是出于一人之手。站在桥内看着外面的翠竹，听着潺潺的流水，感觉十分凉爽。耳边不断的蝉声鸟鸣，梁架上竟有小松鼠爬过，这一切让人陡然忘却远道而来一路驾车的疲惫。这样的风景如果没有万隆桥与其相伴，或者也就寻常了。突然领略到一句话，即最好的东西就在眼前，最美的时光就是当下。
projects.content_en: I first heard of Wanlong Bridge in a literary magazine run by Hakka people, with only a brief text description and no pictures; the sentence that attracted me was "hidden in the deep boudoir, yet its beauty cannot be concealed." I went as soon as I said so. On the narrow inter-village road deep in the mountains, although the road was very narrow, there were few cars around. Passing through a village called "Luosheng," I accidentally discovered a small covered bridge named "Da'an." Outside the bridge, an ancient waterwheel was still turning. Although the bridge is not large, the list of people who donated funds is clearly visible, a few strokes outlining the simple and honest folk customs of the ancient mountain village. The deeper the car went, the more I felt the uniqueness of this mountain area. Laiyuan Township is the birthplace of the Red Army, where the Soviet regime was first established in those years. The years of battle have passed, and now there is an atmosphere of peace here. Bamboo abounds in the deep mountains, and bamboo products can be seen drying by the roadside everywhere. Under the guidance of the villagers, going down the path by the big tree at the village head, an exquisite covered bridge appeared before my eyes — this is Wanlong Bridge. Wanlong Bridge is also a small covered bridge, but its characteristic lies in its exquisite and unique design; especially the hexagonal pavilion at the top is made with verve, and its craftsmanship is astonishingly exquisite. Wanlong Bridge is completely hidden among green mountains and clear waters, with a gurgling stream flowing by the bridge; the stream water is clear, and the stones at the bottom are colorful — one wonders how such an exquisite covered bridge came to be in these mountains, who built it and left it here. Inside the bridge is a chuan-dou (column-and-tie) timber frame, with wooden plank flooring, relatively old, with wind-and-rain boards half open; the corridor house has good light, and the long wooden boards for resting were made later. There was originally a shrine inside the corridor house, with the "Wanlong Bridge" plaque hanging high above the shrine. The woodwork inside the corridor house is very exquisite; the shrine dougong extending from the outer pavilion to the interior of the corridor house should have been made by the same person. Standing inside the bridge looking at the green bamboo outside and listening to the gurgling water, one feels very cool. With the constant sound of cicadas and birds, a small squirrel even crawled across the beam frame — all this makes one suddenly forget the fatigue of driving all the way from afar. Such scenery, without Wanlong Bridge to accompany it, would perhaps be ordinary. I suddenly grasped a saying: the best things are right before your eyes, and the most beautiful time is the present.

projects.name: 永隆桥
projects.address: 龙岩市连城县莒溪镇璧洲村

highlights: 桥体结构
桥与庙的关系
到永隆桥已经是夕阳时分
惊艳地发现眼前的一联三组建筑宏伟的廊桥永隆桥精美的天后宫再后面是高大的文昌阁
建筑不是凝固的音乐吗从这一角度看去桥身呼应身边的天后宫和文昌阁与远处的青山相对
建筑与自然景色可谓相得益彰
你能够体会到营造二字的内涵了吗
永隆桥建于明洪武二十年1360年桥长100米宽6米高7.5米
桥墩为三墩四孔等跨度花岗岩砌成鳌头状
这似乎已成为当地古桥的通用做法
桥墩上用枕木纵横铺排成倒三角形状与另一大型廊桥云龙桥类似
廊屋内部穿斗式木架构中间设有神龛鹅卵石铺地保养精细
风雨板半开廊屋内采光好
桥头下来紧邻天后宫
据说这里的璧洲村大多是林姓是由莆田地区迁移过来笃信妈祖所以修建天后宫来祭拜
天后宫正在维修中夕阳西下门前的石狮子显得几分落寂
值得注意的是石狮子的形状与我们通常所见不同还带有宋元时期或明代早期的古朴特征
夕阳下的永隆桥显得雍容安闲默默矗立在那里看着还在稻田里辛勤忙碌的人们
得益于横木直排这种构造永隆桥能够经历更多年的风雨
从初建至今没有经历大规模重修
这也是以跨度见长而相对脆弱的木拱廊桥所不能的
希望永隆桥保佑四方其代表的人文精神也像它的名字一样
projects.content_zh: 到永隆桥已经是夕阳时分。惊艳地发现眼前的一联三组建筑：宏伟的廊桥永隆桥，精美的天后宫，再后面是高大的文昌阁。建筑不是凝固的音乐吗？从这一角度看去，桥身呼应身边的天后宫和文昌阁，与远处的青山相对，建筑与自然景色可谓相得益彰。你能够体会到"营造"二字的内涵了吗？永隆桥建于明洪武二十年（1360年），桥长100米，宽6米，高7.5米。桥墩为三墩四孔等跨度，花岗岩砌成鳌头状，这似乎已成为当地古桥的通用做法。桥墩上用枕木纵横铺排成倒三角形状，与另一大型廊桥云龙桥类似。廊屋内部穿斗式木架构，中间设有神龛，鹅卵石铺地，保养精细。风雨板半开，廊屋内采光好。桥头下来紧邻天后宫。据说这里的璧洲村大多是林姓，是由莆田地区迁移过来，笃信妈祖，所以修建天后宫来祭拜。天后宫正在维修中，夕阳西下，门前的石狮子显得几分落寂。值得注意的是石狮子的形状与我们通常所见不同，还带有宋元时期或明代早期的古朴特征。夕阳下的永隆桥显得雍容安闲，默默矗立在那里，看着还在稻田里辛勤忙碌的人们。得益于横木直排这种构造，永隆桥能够经历更多年的风雨。从初建至今没有经历大规模重修，这也是以跨度见长而相对脆弱的木拱廊桥所不能的。希望永隆桥保佑四方，其代表的人文精神也像它的名字一样。
projects.content_en: It was already sunset when I arrived at Yonglong Bridge. I was amazed to discover a trio of buildings before me: the magnificent covered bridge Yonglong Bridge, the exquisite Tianhou Palace, and behind it the tall Wenchang Pavilion. Isn't architecture frozen music? From this angle, the bridge body echoes the Tianhou Palace and Wenchang Pavilion beside it, facing the green mountains in the distance — architecture and natural scenery truly complement each other. Can you now understand the connotation of the two characters "yingzao" (construction/craft)? Yonglong Bridge was built in the 20th year of Hongwu reign of the Ming (1360), with a length of 100 meters, width of 6 meters, and height of 7.5 meters. The bridge piers are three piers with four equal-span openings, built of granite in the shape of a mythical turtle head (aotou), which seems to have become the common practice for local ancient bridges. On the piers, sleepers are laid horizontally and vertically in an inverted triangular shape, similar to another large covered bridge, Yunlong Bridge. Inside the corridor house is a chuan-dou (column-and-tie) timber frame, with a shrine in the middle, cobblestone flooring, and精细 maintenance. The wind-and-rain boards are half open, and the corridor house has good lighting. Coming down from the bridgehead, one is immediately next to Tianhou Palace. It is said that most people in Bizhou Village here are surnamed Lin, having migrated from the Putian area, and devoutly believe in Mazu, so they built Tianhou Palace to worship her. Tianhou Palace is currently under repair; as the sun sets in the west, the stone lions in front of the gate appear somewhat desolate. It is worth noting that the shape of the stone lions differs from what we usually see, still bearing the simple and ancient characteristics of the Song-Yuan period or early Ming Dynasty. Yonglong Bridge in the sunset appears graceful and leisurely, standing silently there, watching people still busily working in the rice fields. Thanks to this construction of horizontal timbers laid straight, Yonglong Bridge has been able to withstand many more years of wind and rain. From its initial construction to today, it has not undergone large-scale rebuilding — something that the relatively fragile timber-arch covered bridges, known for their spans, cannot do. May Yonglong Bridge bless all directions, and may the humanistic spirit it represents be like its name.

projects.name: 玉龙桥
projects.address: 龙岩市连城县四堡乡马屋村

highlights: 桥梁结构
屋顶做法
玉沙桥有着属于自己的一片安静的领地
在一片新楼林立的村庄外古树和桥下的河水构成一片别有洞天的小环境
与周围参差不齐的建筑相隔绝虽几步之遥仿佛走入另一个世界
玉沙桥始建于清康熙二十三年1684年民国十年重修
桥的外观与江坊村的会龙桥有些相似也是并排三重庑殿顶
只不过装饰更加古朴自然
玉沙桥的跨度不大总长30米宽5米桥面距水面4米距桥顶5米
中间一桥墩形状做成船型或称鳌头状以减少大水对桥体的冲击
桥屋整体穿斗式木架构风雨板半开既能遮风挡雨采光又好
廊屋内设有神龛梁架上未见太多题刻
玉沙桥内部地面以鹅卵石铺就保养得相当精心甚至到了毫发未损的地步
中间神龛前面用小石子铺成图案仔细看去是一可爱的小羊大概寓意吉祥丰收
桥身是用粗大的枕木交错铺叠而成
桥梁的精神实质也是其最吸引人之处在于一个公字
因其所作之初衷乃是济世利民为公众提供交通便利
廊桥更加以遮风挡雨因此简约也罢豪华也罢都令人欢喜而起敬
是豪宅大厝建造之余想起建桥还是建起了桥梁积蓄了功德才大发其家
玉沙桥边的村落四堡乡马屋村原是当地雕版印刷基地也是纸张和书籍的集散地
现该村群被定为国家级保护单位但看上去已是荒草丛生当年的繁华热闹已经丝毫不见了
询问当地人雕版印刷和古建筑群他们大多漠然并无太多自豪之意
提到古建筑的保护在人们口中也不过是不许拆而已
未来的主人翁全指望您了
projects.content_zh: 玉沙桥有着属于自己的一片安静的领地。在一片新楼林立的村庄外，古树和桥下的河水构成一片别有洞天的小环境，与周围参差不齐的建筑相隔绝，虽几步之遥仿佛走入另一个世界。玉沙桥始建于清康熙二十三年（1684年），民国十年重修。桥的外观与江坊村的会龙桥有些相似，也是并排三重庑殿顶，只不过装饰更加古朴自然。玉沙桥的跨度不大，总长30米，宽5米，桥面距水面4米，距桥顶5米，中间一桥墩，形状做成船型或称鳌头状，以减少大水对桥体的冲击。桥屋整体穿斗式木架构，风雨板半开，既能遮风挡雨，采光又好。廊屋内设有神龛，梁架上未见太多题刻。玉沙桥内部地面以鹅卵石铺就，保养得相当精心，甚至到了毫发未损的地步。中间神龛前面用小石子铺成图案，仔细看去是一可爱的小羊，大概寓意吉祥丰收。桥身是用粗大的枕木交错铺叠而成。桥梁的精神实质也是其最吸引人之处在于一个"公"字，因其所作之初衷乃是济世利民，为公众提供交通便利，廊桥更加以遮风挡雨，因此简约也罢，豪华也罢，都令人欢喜而起敬。是豪宅大厝建造之余，想起建桥？还是建起了桥梁积蓄了功德，才大发其家？玉沙桥边的村落四堡乡马屋村，原是当地雕版印刷基地，也是纸张和书籍的集散地。现该村群被定为国家级保护单位，但看上去已是荒草丛生，当年的繁华热闹已经丝毫不见了。询问当地人雕版印刷和古建筑群，他们大多漠然，并无太多自豪之意，提到古建筑的保护，在人们口中也不过是"不许拆"而已。未来的主人翁，全指望您了。
projects.content_en: Yusha Bridge has its own quiet territory. Outside a village lined with new buildings, ancient trees and the river under the bridge form a small environment of its own, isolated from the surrounding uneven buildings; though only a few steps away, it feels like entering another world. Yusha Bridge was first built in the 23rd year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1684) and rebuilt in the tenth year of the Republic. Its appearance is somewhat similar to Huilong Bridge in Jiangfang Village, also with three parallel hip roofs (wudian ding), except that the decoration is more simple and natural. Yusha Bridge's span is not large, with a total length of 30 meters, width of 5 meters, bridge deck 4 meters above the water, and 5 meters below the bridge top; there is one bridge pier in the middle, shaped like a boat or a mythical turtle head (aotou) to reduce the impact of floodwater on the bridge body. The bridge house overall has a chuan-dou (column-and-tie) timber frame, with wind-and-rain boards half open, both sheltering from wind and rain and providing good lighting. There is a shrine inside the corridor house, and not many inscriptions are seen on the beam frames. The interior floor of Yusha Bridge is paved with cobblestones, maintained quite meticulously, even to the point of being undamaged. In front of the middle shrine, small stones are laid into a pattern; looking carefully, it is a cute little sheep, probably symbolizing auspiciousness and harvest. The bridge body is made of large sleepers laid and stacked alternately. The spiritual essence of the bridge, and also its most attractive feature, lies in the character "gong" (public/common good), because its original purpose was to benefit the people and provide public transportation convenience; the covered bridge additionally shelters from wind and rain, so whether simple or luxurious, it is delightful and worthy of respect. Was it after building grand mansions that one thought of building a bridge? Or was it by building bridges and accumulating merit that one became wealthy? The village beside Yusha Bridge, Mawu Village in Sibao Township, was originally a local woodblock printing base and also a distribution center for paper and books. Now this village group has been designated as a national-level protection unit, but it looks overgrown with weeds, and the prosperity and liveliness of those years have completely disappeared. Asking locals about woodblock printing and the ancient building complex, they are mostly indifferent, without much sense of pride; when mentioning the protection of ancient buildings, in people's mouths it is merely "not allowed to demolish." The future masters, it all depends on you.

巨大的桥墩和枕木就像放着鲜花的花瓶雄浑中透出几分雅致
一个桥墩上方的桥身顶部做出庑殿顶形状的桥亭看上去舒展典雅
又一亮点是位于桥正中的这个六角的塔状阁楼号曰魁星楼
属于设计上的点睛之作整个桥看上去越发灵动
魁星楼从内部是可以上去的开始没有注意后来有几个女学生来玩
其中一个显然是在尽地主之谊告诉我们几个人这个小秘密果然别有洞天
云龙桥的周边不算冷清很多人来这里休闲聊天大人小孩其乐融融
牛儿也来桥头吃草一点都不怕人的样子
午后的阳光透过云层照在云龙桥上
云龙桥也许并不知道自己的美只是用巨大的身躯庇护着桥内休闲的老人谈天的少男少女发呆的游人嬉闹的孩子自以为是的牛等一切众生

projects.content_zh: 下罗村前一条河和几株古树，远远就可以看到云龙桥雄伟的桥体。云龙桥始建于明崇祯七年（1634年），清乾隆三十七年（1772年）重修。云龙桥颇可得一"龙"字，桥长81米，6墩7孔；桥廊内部穿斗式木架构，做工比较讲究，共31间128柱，恐怕只有屏南县境内的万安桥可与其比肩。该桥首先是桥头做工精湛，飞檐斗拱极具本地特色，牌匾上书"云龙桥"三个大字，仿佛是龙头，桥的另一端直抵山岩；再有就是桥墩有力，几个巨大的桥墩做成鳌头形状并立水中，上覆纵横铺排的枕木成倒三角形将桥身托起，巨大的桥墩和枕木就像放着鲜花的花瓶，雄浑中透出几分雅致；一个桥墩上方的桥身顶部做出庑殿顶形状的桥亭，看上去舒展典雅；又一亮点是位于桥正中的这个六角的塔状阁楼，号曰魁星楼，属于设计上的点睛之作，整个桥看上去越发灵动。魁星楼从内部是可以上去的，开始没有注意，后来有几个女学生来玩，其中一个显然是在尽地主之谊，告诉我们几个人这个小秘密。果然别有洞天。云龙桥的周边不算冷清，很多人来这里休闲聊天，大人小孩其乐融融，牛儿也来桥头吃草，一点都不怕人的样子。午后的阳光透过云层照在云龙桥上，云龙桥也许并不知道自己的美，只是用巨大的身躯庇护着桥内休闲的老人、谈天的少男少女、发呆的游人、嬉闹的孩子、自以为是的牛等一切众生。孩子们啊，多想书成之后送给你们，你们是珍爱家乡的种子。
projects.content_en: In front of Xialuo Village, a river and a few ancient trees — from afar one can see the majestic bridge body of Yunlong Bridge. Yunlong Bridge was first built in the seventh year of Chongzhen reign of the Ming (1634) and rebuilt in the 37th year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1772). Yunlong Bridge well deserves the character "long" (dragon): it is 81 meters long, with 6 piers and 7 openings; inside the bridge corridor is a chuan-dou (column-and-tie) timber frame, with relatively exquisite workmanship, totaling 31 bays and 128 columns — I'm afraid only Wan'an Bridge in Pingnan County can compare with it. First of all, the bridgehead is exquisitely crafted, with flying eaves and dougong strongly characteristic of the local style; the plaque bears the three large characters "Yunlong Bridge," as if it were the dragon's head, while the other end of the bridge reaches directly to the mountain rock. Furthermore, the piers are powerful: several huge piers made in the shape of mythical turtle heads (aotou) stand in the water, covered with sleepers laid horizontally and vertically in an inverted triangle to lift the bridge body; the huge piers and sleepers are like vases holding flowers, with a touch of elegance amid their grandeur. Above one pier, the top of the bridge body forms a bridge pavilion in the shape of a hip roof (wudian ding), looking舒展 and elegant. Another highlight is this hexagonal tower-like pavilion located at the center of the bridge, called Kuixing Tower (Star of Literature Tower), a finishing touch in the design that makes the whole bridge look ever more lively. Kuixing Tower can be accessed from inside; I didn't notice it at first, but later several female students came to play, and one of them, clearly acting as a host, told us this little secret. Indeed, there is a hidden world. The surroundings of Yunlong Bridge are not desolate; many people come here to relax and chat, adults and children enjoying themselves together, and cows also come to graze at the bridgehead, not at all afraid of people. The afternoon sun shines through the clouds onto Yunlong Bridge; perhaps Yunlong Bridge does not know its own beauty, but simply uses its huge body to shelter all living beings inside the bridge — relaxing elderly people, chatting young men and women, daydreaming tourists, playful children, self-important cows, and all creatures. Children, how I wish to give this book to you after it is completed — you are the seeds that cherish your hometown.

projects.name: 芷溪宗祠
projects.level: 国家级历史文化名村，省级文物保护单位

highlights: 祠堂群
祠堂格局
木结构与特色装饰
拜访土楼的人如果再深入一些就能够在50公里之外看到与土楼大相径庭的芷溪村古建筑
这里主要居住着黄杨邱华四姓客家人黄杨两姓居多
芷溪的老屋前面是灰砖的屋顶是灰瓦的结构是素木或朱漆的门楼是高耸的
而最为难得的是这里多祠居合一
明清以来先后建了74座古宗祠139幢古民居
代表性的有澄川公祠集鳣堂黄氏家庙翠畴公祠杨氏家庙杨辉公祠等
探访客家人慎终追远敬祖睦宗的传统这里是不能错过的地方
只看一眼澄川公祠的门楼就会觉得此行不虚
澄川公祠建于清同治年间也叫孔硕堂
门屋楼五间门楼三间镶嵌在中间
石雕斗拱仿照如意斗拱穿插雕刻花鸟山水等装饰题材
门楼当心安澄川公祠匾额两次间分别额书流芳衍庆
集鳣堂是集中讲学的意思也叫渔溪公祠建于康熙末年
堂的规模很大从前坪大门下厅天井中厅天井上天井后厅到左右横屋
加上花园假山池塘大小房间逾百当地人叫九厅十八井
这里边内外两个门楼是特色突出的
外门楼造型最隆重石构平面两翼前伸作八字状飞檐翘角简洁大气
内门楼则细砖所成朴素大方
厅堂之内则是一番朴素庄重的景象
此外在建于清光绪十八年1892年的翠畴公祠康熙三十年落成的黄氏家庙等院落之中
还能体会到多种建筑形式对于同一建筑主题的不同表现
projects.content_zh: 拜访土楼的人如果再深入一些，就能够在50公里之外看到与土楼大相径庭的芷溪村古建筑。这里主要居住着黄、杨、邱、华四姓客家人，黄、杨两姓居多。芷溪的老屋前面是灰砖的，屋顶是灰瓦的，结构是素木或朱漆的，门楼是高耸的。而最为难得的是，这里多"祠居合一"。明清以来，先后建了74座古宗祠、139幢古民居，代表性的有澄川公祠、集鳣堂、黄氏家庙、翠畴公祠、杨氏家庙、杨辉公祠等。探访客家人"慎终追远、敬祖睦宗"的传统，这里是不能错过的地方。只看一眼澄川公祠的门楼，就会觉得此行不虚。澄川公祠建于清同治年间，也叫孔硕堂，门屋楼五间，门楼三间"镶嵌"在中间，石雕斗拱仿照如意斗拱，穿插雕刻花鸟、山水等装饰题材。门楼当心安"澄川公祠"匾额，两次间分别额书"流芳"、"衍庆"。集鳣堂是集中讲学的意思，也叫"渔溪公祠"，建于康熙末年。堂的规模很大，从前坪、大门、下厅、天井、中厅、天井、上厅、天井、后厅，到左右横屋，加上花园、假山、池塘，大小房间逾百，当地人叫"九厅十八井"。这里边内外两个门楼是特色突出的，外门楼造型最隆重，石构，平面两翼前伸，作八字状，飞檐翘角，简洁大气。内门楼则细砖所成，朴素大方。厅堂之内，则是一番朴素庄重的景象。此外，在建于清光绪十八年（1892年）的翠畴公祠、康熙三十年落成的黄氏家庙等院落之中还能体会到多种建筑形式对于同一建筑主题的不同表现。
projects.content_en: Those who visit earthen buildings (tulou), if they go a bit deeper, can see the ancient buildings of Zhixi Village, which are quite different from tulou, 50 kilometers away. This place is mainly inhabited by Hakka people of four surnames — Huang, Yang, Qiu, and Hua — with the Huang and Yang surnames being the majority. The old houses in Zhixi have gray brick fronts, gray tile roofs, plain or red-lacquered timber structures, and towering gate towers. Most rare is that here many are "shrine-residence combined" (ci ju he yi). Since the Ming and Qing dynasties, 74 ancient ancestral halls and 139 ancient residences have been built successively; representative ones include Chengchuan Gong Shrine, Jizhan Hall, Huang Clan Family Temple, Cuichou Gong Shrine, Yang Clan Family Temple, Yanghui Gong Shrine, etc. To explore the Hakka tradition of "carefully attending to the funeral rites of parents and following them when gone with due sacrifices; revering ancestors and harmonizing with the clan," this is a place not to be missed. Just one glance at the gate tower of Chengchuan Gong Shrine will make you feel the trip was worthwhile. Chengchuan Gong Shrine was built during the Tongzhi reign of the Qing, also called Kongshuo Hall; the gate house has five bays, with the three-bay gate tower "inlaid" in the middle; the stone-carved dougong imitate ruyi dougong, interspersed with carved decorative themes such as flowers, birds, and landscapes. At the center of the gate tower is the "Chengchuan Gong Shrine" plaque, and the two side bays bear the inscriptions "Liufang" (Eternal Fame) and "Yanqing" (Extended Blessing) respectively. Jizhan Hall means a place for concentrated teaching, also called "Yuxi Gong Shrine," built in the late Kangxi reign. The hall is very large in scale: from the front flat area, main gate, lower hall, courtyard, middle hall, courtyard, upper hall, courtyard, rear hall, to the left and right horizontal houses, plus gardens, rockeries, and ponds — there are over a hundred rooms of various sizes, locally called "nine halls and eighteen courtyards." The two inner and outer gate towers here are particularly distinctive: the outer gate tower has the most grand造型, of stone construction, with both wings of the plan extending forward in a figure-eight shape, with flying eaves and upturned corners, simple and大气. The inner gate tower is made of fine bricks, simple and generous. Inside the halls, there is a scene of simplicity and solemnity. In addition, in courtyards such as Cuichou Gong Shrine built in the 18th year of Guangxu reign of the Qing (1892) and Huang Clan Family Temple completed in the 30th year of Kangxi reign, one can also experience the different expressions of multiple architectural forms for the same architectural theme.

projects.name: 崇福寺·应庚塔
projects.address: 泉州市鲤城区开元街道崇福寺路

projects.type_en: Religious Architecture · Stone Structure · Timber Structure
highlights: 石结构和石刻手法
木结构
崇福寺清静整齐鹤立于周围不甚整齐的街巷
崇福寺的名声在民众的心中起于妙月大师传授的南少林武功
在文人的眼里是声波洛阳桥的崇福晚钟
在古建筑人的课本上则要数始建于宋代的应庚塔
寺院的肇始也可以追溯到北宋原为女尼修行的千佛庵
元祐六年改名为崇福寺
后废明代崇祯年间重建清康熙年间扩建
现存建筑多系光绪年间遗构
走过兜率天宫大雄宝殿圆通宝殿等建筑时也可以留意一下颇具地方手法的石雕作品
各个建筑中保留使用的一些斗拱和屋架构件

反而疏朗简约仿佛缺少些构造或是没有完成一般

塔身七层八角形平面收分微妙不显塔刹为宝相轮
塔身各面浮雕门窗及栏杆平坐处隐刻出壶门

projects.content_zh: 崇福寺清静整齐，鹤立于周围不甚整齐的街巷。崇福寺的名声，在民众的心中起于妙月大师传授的南少林武功，在文人的眼里是声波洛阳桥的"崇福晚钟"，在古建筑人的课本上则要数始建于宋代的应庚塔。寺院的肇始也可以追溯到北宋，原为女尼修行的千佛庵，元祐六年改名为崇福寺。后废，明代崇祯年间重建，清康熙年间扩建，现存建筑多系光绪年间遗构。不过走过兜率天宫、大雄宝殿、圆通宝殿等建筑时也可以留意一下颇具地方手法的石雕作品，还有就是各个建筑中保留使用的一些斗拱和屋架构件。尤其是斗拱，有的尺度相当大，做法也不似晚期那般完整而琐碎，反而疏朗简约，仿佛缺少些构造或是没有完成一般，很是怀疑它们是历代修缮得以幸存下来的老家伙。最最紧要的，还是寺东的应庚塔。塔身七层，八角形平面，收分微妙不显，塔刹为宝相轮；塔身各面浮雕门窗及栏杆，平坐处隐刻出壶门；檐下做叠涩以代铺作层，转角...
projects.content_en: Chongfu Temple is quiet and orderly, standing out like a crane among the somewhat unkempt surrounding streets and alleys. The fame of Chongfu Temple, in the hearts of the people, began with the Southern Shaolin martial arts taught by Master Miaoyue; in the eyes of literati, it is the "Chongfu Evening Bell" whose sound waves reach Luoyang Bridge; in the textbooks of ancient architecture scholars, it must be the Yinggeng Pagoda first built in the Song Dynasty. The temple's origins can also be traced back to the Northern Song, originally called Qianfo Nunnery where female nuns practiced; in the sixth year of Yuanyou reign it was renamed Chongfu Temple. Later abandoned, it was rebuilt during the Chongzhen reign of the Ming and expanded during the Kangxi reign of the Qing; the existing buildings are mostly remains from the Guangxu reign. However, when passing through buildings such as Tusita Heaven Palace, Mahavira Hall, and Yuantong Hall, one can also pay attention to the stone carvings with quite local techniques, as well as some dougong and roof frame components preserved and used in various buildings. Especially the dougong, some are quite large in scale, and their construction is not as complete and fussy as in the late period, but rather sparse and simple, as if lacking some structure or unfinished — one strongly suspects they are old fellows that survived through successive repairs. Most importantly, it is the Yinggeng Pagoda east of the temple. The pagoda body has seven stories, with an octagonal plan, subtle and unnoticeable tapering, and the pagoda finial is a treasure wheel (baoxianglun); each face of the pagoda body has relief carvings of doors, windows, and railings, with hidden carving of pot doors (humen) at the flat seating; under the eaves, corbelling (diese) is done to replace the bracket set layer, at the corners...

projects.name: 东禅寺
projects.address: 泉州市东门仁风街东禅村凤山
projects.address_en: Fengshan, Dongchan Village, Renfeng Street, East Gate, Quanzhou
highlights: 凭吊与考证
关于南少林的争论赞同者最多者有三莆田少林寺泉州少林寺和福清少林寺
泉州的一座被学者和大众指认为东门外的镇国东禅寺
其实东禅寺史籍未见有关于少林寺的记载
仅是在清咸丰六年1856年住持幻空写下了少林古迹的匾额
道光晋江县志卷六九载镇国东禅寺在仁风门外东湖畔明宣德十年重修后废僧人修其旧址十分之一
另据清人蔡永兼西山杂志记载乾隆二十八年1763年秋诏焚少林寺
原来的东禅寺规模之大远非今天的面貌可比
寺院屡有兴废的身世和南少林寺的历史也仿佛大致相符合了
如今的东禅寺是泉州文物部门按照旧址遗留下来的唐代构件于1992年重新修建的
至1997年大雄宝殿五观堂及僧舍基本完成
中国佛教协会会长赵朴初为其题东禅少林寺匾额
2002年进而修复了大雄宝殿正前方的天王殿
寺内还有部分保存完整的唐代柱础墙体以及至今仍能打出清水的古井
寺的周围还散有古代的大石槽练武的石板凳金刚池刈狗池等现已被建为东湖新村了
据说2002年复建天王殿时从地下挖掘出石制寺庙构件40多件
其中塔座1个塔盖1个与应庚塔相似的塔刹7个石帽4个柱础4块石柱6根等
保存完整的直径达1米的榫石就有20块反映出当时的宏大规模
还从现场发掘出大量的瓦片和瓦盖
专家推测这些构件极有可能是唐宋时期泉州少林寺的建筑构件
projects.content_zh: 关于南少林的争论，赞同者最多者有三——莆田少林寺、泉州少林寺和福清少林寺。泉州的一座，被学者和大众指认为东门外的镇国东禅寺。其实东禅寺史籍未见有关于少林寺的记载，仅是在清咸丰六年（1856年）住持幻空写下了"少林古迹"的匾额。道光《晋江县志·卷六九》载："镇国东禅寺在仁风门外东湖畔……明宣德十年重修，后废。僧人修其旧址十分之一。"另据清人蔡永兼《西山杂志》记载："乾隆二十八年（1763年）秋，诏焚少林寺。"原来的东禅寺规模之大远非今天的面貌可比。寺院屡有兴废的身世和南少林寺的历史也仿佛大致相符合了。如今的东禅寺是泉州文物部门按照旧址遗留下来的唐代构件于1992年重新修建的。至1997年，大雄宝殿、五观堂及僧舍基本完成，中国佛教协会会长赵朴初为其题"东禅少林寺"匾额；2002年进而修复了大雄宝殿正前方的天王殿。寺内还有部分保存完整的唐代柱础、墙体，以及至今仍能打出清水的古井。寺的周围，还散有古代的大石槽、练武的石板凳、金刚池、刈狗池等，现已被建为东湖新村了。据说2002年复建天王殿时，从地下挖掘出石制寺庙构件40多件，其中塔座1个、塔盖1个，与应庚塔相似的塔刹7个、石帽4个、柱础4块、石柱6根等，保存完整的直径达1米的榫石就有20块，反映出当时的宏大规模。还从现场发掘出大量的瓦片和瓦盖。专家推测，这些构件极有可能是唐宋时期泉州少林寺的建筑构件。
projects.content_en: Regarding the debate over Southern Shaolin, there are three most endorsed candidates — Putian Shaolin Temple, Quanzhou Shaolin Temple, and Fuqing Shaolin Temple. The one in Quanzhou is identified by scholars and the public as Zhenguo Dongchan Temple outside the East Gate. In fact, historical records of Dongchan Temple contain no mention of Shaolin Temple; only in the sixth year of Xianfeng reign of the Qing (1856) did the abbot Huankong write the plaque "Shaolin Ancient Site." The Daoguang-era "Jinjiang County Gazetteer · Volume 69" records: "Zhenguo Dongchan Temple is by East Lake outside Renfeng Gate... rebuilt in the tenth year of Xuande reign of the Ming, later abandoned. Monks restored one-tenth of its original site." According to another record by Qing person Cai Yongjian in "Xishan Zazhi": "In the autumn of the 28th year of Qianlong reign (1763), an imperial edict ordered the burning of Shaolin Temple." The original scale of Dongchan Temple was far from comparable to today's appearance. The temple's history of repeated rises and falls also seems to roughly match the history of Southern Shaolin Temple. Today's Dongchan Temple was rebuilt in 1992 by the Quanzhou cultural relics department according to Tang Dynasty components left at the original site. By 1997, the Mahavira Hall, Five Contemplations Hall, and monk quarters were basically completed; Zhao Puchu, president of the Buddhist Association of China, inscribed the plaque "Dongchan Shaolin Temple" for it; in 2002, the Hall of Heavenly Kings directly in front of the Mahavira Hall was further restored. Inside the temple there are also some well-preserved Tang Dynasty column bases, walls, and an ancient well that can still produce clear water to this day. Around the temple, there are also scattered ancient large stone troughs, stone benches for martial arts practice, Vajra Pool, Gougou Pool, etc., which have now been built into Donghu New Village. It is said that when rebuilding the Hall of Heavenly Kings in 2002, over 40 stone temple components were excavated from underground, including 1 pagoda base, 1 pagoda cover, 7 pagoda finials similar to Yinggeng Pagoda, 4 stone caps, 4 column bases, 6 stone columns, etc.; there are 20 well-preserved tenon stones with a diameter of up to 1 meter, reflecting the massive scale at that time. A large number of tiles and tile covers were also excavated from the site. Experts speculate that these components are very likely architectural components of Quanzhou Shaolin Temple from the Tang-Song period.

projects.name: 府文庙
projects.name_en: Temple of Confucius in Quanzhou Prefecture
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 泉州市鲤城区中山中路泮宫内
projects.address_en: Within Pan Palace, Middle Zhongshan Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou
highlights: 格局
木结构
砖石做法
在泉州市区繁华的商业区中心地段文庙得以保存了下来
中国商业的破坏力没有政治强大但它的侵蚀力却是难以抗拒的
临中山街入得泮宫门是一宽大露埕左右为礼门义路
远远地看见泉州孔子学会的牌子
庙内还设有文物陈列馆泉州历史名人纪念馆泉州古代教育展览馆
联想起当地同窗请客时的好尚很希望文庙能够真正成为引以为豪的所在
而不是只摆些乏人问津的陈列
其实泉州府文庙是大有内涵的
庙始建于唐开元末年
北宋太平兴国初年移建孔庙于此太平兴国七年982年建为州学后又迁他处
大观三年1109年迁回南宋绍兴七年1137年重建
经过宋元明清历代修缮规模依旧宏大规模制完整
是东南地区最大的文庙建筑群
府文庙前有大成门三开间两侧左有金声门右有玉振门
门内有泮池上架元代泮桥两旁古榕垂荫
主体建筑是大成殿殿东西两侧有东庑和西庑
大殿为典型的重檐庑殿式结构面阔七间进深五间
以48根白色石柱承托木结构屋架
其中正面的八根檐柱浮雕盘龙风格古朴
立柱之上斗拱层叠双杪双下昂七铺作
中间三间只施两朵补间铺作其余更仅用一朵
屋脊短小更衬托出四坡面的舒缓
殿前砌露台台明嵌有仰莲复莲扶桑山茶牡丹芙蓉等辉绿岩石浮雕
此外府文庙内还有明伦堂庄际昌状元祠蔡清祠李文节祠等建筑
projects.content_zh: 在泉州市区繁华的商业区中心地段，文庙得以保存了下来。中国商业的破坏力没有政治强大，但它的侵蚀力却是难以抗拒的。临中山街入得泮宫门是一宽大露埕，左右为礼门、义路。远远地看见"泉州孔子学会"的牌子，庙内还设有"文物陈列馆"、"泉州历史名人纪念馆"、"泉州古代教育展览馆"。联想起当地同窗请客时的好尚，很希望文庙能够真正成为引以为豪的所在，而不是只摆些乏人问津的陈列。其实泉州府文庙是大有内涵的。庙始建于唐开元末年，北宋太平兴国初年移建孔庙于此，太平兴国七年（982年）建为州学，后又迁他处，大观三年（1109年）迁回，南宋绍兴七年（1137年）重建，经过宋、元、明、清历代修缮，规模依旧宏大，规制完整，是东南地区最大的文庙建筑群。府文庙前有大成门三开间，两侧左有金声门，右有玉振门，门内有泮池上架元代泮桥，两旁古榕垂荫，主体建筑是大成殿，殿东西两侧有东庑和西庑。大殿为典型的重檐庑殿式结构，面阔七间进深五间，以48根白色石柱承托木结构屋架，其中正面的八根檐柱浮雕盘龙，风格古朴。立柱之上斗拱层叠，双杪双下昂七铺作，中间三间只施两朵补间铺作，其余更仅用一朵。屋脊短小，更衬托出四坡面的舒缓。殿前砌露台，台明嵌有仰莲、复莲、扶桑、山茶、牡丹、芙蓉等辉绿岩石浮雕。此外，府文庙内还有明伦堂、庄际昌状元祠、蔡清祠、李文节祠等建筑。
projects.content_en: In the central area of the bustling commercial district of Quanzhou city, the Confucian Temple has been preserved. The destructive power of Chinese commerce is not as great as that of politics, but its erosive force is hard to resist. Entering the Pan Palace gate from Zhongshan Street, there is a wide open courtyard, with the Gate of Ritual (Li Men) and Gate of Righteousness (Yi Lu) on the left and right. From afar one sees the sign of the "Quanzhou Confucius Society"; inside the temple there are also a "Cultural Relics Exhibition Hall," "Quanzhou Historical Celebrities Memorial Hall," and "Quanzhou Ancient Education Exhibition Hall." Recalling the preferences of local classmates when treating guests, one hopes the Confucian Temple can truly become a place to be proud of, rather than just displaying some neglected exhibits. In fact, Quanzhou Prefecture Confucian Temple has great内涵. The temple was first built in the late Kaiyuan reign of the Tang; in the early Taiping Xingguo reign of the Northern Song, the Confucian Temple was moved here, and in the seventh year of Taiping Xingguo (982) it was established as a prefectural school, later moved elsewhere, returned in the third year of Daguan reign (1109), rebuilt in the seventh year of Shaoxing reign of the Southern Song (1137), and经过 repairs through the Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties; its scale remains grand and its regulations complete, making it the largest Confucian temple complex in the southeast region. In front of the prefecture Confucian Temple is the Dacheng Gate with three bays; on both sides, to the left is the Jinsheng Gate and to the right the Yuzhen Gate; inside the gate there is a Pan Pond with a Yuan Dynasty Pan Bridge over it, with ancient banyan trees casting shade on both sides; the main building is the Dacheng Hall, with east and west side galleries on both sides of the hall. The main hall is a typical double-eave hip roof (wudian) structure, seven bays wide and five bays deep, with 48 white stone columns supporting the timber roof frame; among them, the eight front eave columns have relief-carved coiling dragons, with an ancient style. Above the columns, dougong are layered, with double-tiao double-xia'ang seven-step bracket sets; the middle three bays only have two intermediate bracket sets, and the rest use only one. The roof ridge is short, further emphasizing the gentle slope of the four roof surfaces. In front of the hall is a terrace, with the terrace edge embedded with relief carvings of upward lotus, downward lotus, hibiscus, camellia, peony, and cotton rose in diabase (huilü rock). In addition, within the prefecture Confucian Temple there are also the Minglun Hall, Zhuang Jichang Zhuangyuan Shrine, Cai Qing Shrine, Li Wenjie Shrine, and other buildings.

projects.name: 花桥慈济宫
projects.address: 泉州市鲤城区中山南路北段西侧
projects.address_en: West side of the northern section of South Zhongshan Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou
highlights: 寺院格局
木结构
距离泉州府文庙不远就是花桥慈济宫了
慈济宫用琉璃瓦屋面在周围有些洋风的建筑群中非常容易辨认
此宫又名真人庙还被当地人称为花桥坛
自古以来此地就是花市旁边的八卦沟上架有石桥
这里最最出名的要数施药局就是免费赠送药品救灾治病的场所
慈济宫祭祀的当然首推保生大帝吴夲
他在泉州悬壶于花桥亭的事迹在民间也广为传颂
据载清光绪四年1878年泉州绅士及商民于花桥宫内倡设泉郡施药局
博采药源广施民众以弘扬吴真人业医济世扶危济困之精神
光绪六年1880年改称泉州府施药局
光绪二十三年1897年泉州鼠疫猖獗花桥宫施棺舍药恤孤扶贫善举无算
百余年来此传统得到了发扬延续
花桥慈济宫历史悠久主体部分规模不大仅一进院
大门上方的真人所居石匾是明代泉州书法家张瑞图所书
室内的屋架还可以看出精细的木工手艺
功能强大之所原始痕迹便不易找寻
这是一个非常普遍的现象
祭祀文化兴旺发达的闽粤地区的众多各类祠堂庙宇或鲜艳夺目或古色古香
表象之下到底掩盖了多少历史痕迹骨子里面到底还有多少原始构件
这是我们所深切关心的
除去这些庙宇的法力和能力千百年来多少代人留下来的调色板和构造兴替
它们在活着人的心中还可以勾起一些酸楚或是惆怅
以及进而引起的全力保护它们的愿望这是我们希望能够得到共鸣的
projects.content_zh: 距离泉州府文庙不远，就是花桥慈济宫了。慈济宫用琉璃瓦屋面，在周围有些洋风的建筑群中非常容易辨认。此宫又名真人庙，还被当地人称为"花桥坛"。自古以来，此地就是花市，旁边的八卦沟上架有石桥。这里最最出名的要数"施药局"，就是免费赠送药品、救灾治病的场所。慈济宫祭祀的当然首推保生大帝吴夲，他在泉州悬壶于花桥亭的事迹在民间也广为传颂。据载，清光绪四年（1878年），泉州绅士及商民于花桥宫内倡设泉郡施药局，博采药源，广施民众，以弘扬吴真人业医济世、扶危济困之精神。光绪六年（1880年）改称泉州府施药局。光绪二十三年（1897年），泉州鼠疫猖獗，花桥宫施棺舍药，恤孤扶贫，善举无算。百余年来，此传统得到了发扬延续。花桥慈济宫历史悠久，主体部分规模不大仅一进院。大门上方的"真人所居"石匾，是明代泉州书法家张瑞图所书。室内的屋架还可以看出精细的木工手艺。功能强大之所原始痕迹便不易找寻。这是一个非常普遍的现象。祭祀文化兴旺发达的闽粤地区的众多各类祠堂庙宇，或鲜艳夺目，或古色古香，表象之下到底掩盖了多少历史痕迹，骨子里面到底还有多少原始构件，这是我们所深切关心的。除去这些庙宇的"法力"和"能力"，千百年来多少代人留下来的调色板和构造兴替，它们在活着人的心中还可以勾起一些酸楚或是惆怅，以及进而引起的全力保护它们的愿望，这是我们希望能够得到共鸣的。
projects.content_en: Not far from Quanzhou Prefecture Confucian Temple is Ciji Temple in Huaqiao. Ciji Temple uses glazed tile roofing, making it very easy to identify among the surrounding somewhat Western-style building complex. This temple is also called Zhenren Temple (True Man Temple), and is also called "Huaqiao Altar" by locals. Since ancient times, this place has been a flower market, with a stone bridge over the Bagua Ditch beside it. What it is most famous for is the "Medicine Distribution Bureau," a place that gives away medicine for free and provides disaster relief and medical treatment. Of course, the primary deity worshipped at Ciji Temple is Baosheng Dadi (Great Emperor of Life Protection) Wu Ben, whose deeds of practicing medicine at Huaqiao Pavilion in Quanzhou are also widely told among the people. According to records, in the fourth year of Guangxu reign of the Qing (1878), Quanzhou gentry and merchants initiated the establishment of the Quanzhou Prefecture Medicine Distribution Bureau within Ciji Temple, broadly sourcing medicines and distributing them widely to the people, to promote the spirit of Wu Zhenren's medical practice to benefit the world and help the distressed and poor. In the sixth year of Guangxu reign (1880), it was renamed Quanzhou Prefecture Medicine Distribution Bureau. In the 23rd year of Guangxu reign (1897), when the plague was rampant in Quanzhou, Huaqiao Temple distributed coffins and medicine, cared for orphans and helped the poor, with countless good deeds. For over a hundred years, this tradition has been carried forward and continued. Ciji Temple in Huaqiao has a long history, with the main part not large in scale, only one courtyard. The stone plaque "Where the True Man Resides" above the main gate was written by Zhang Ruitu, a Ming Dynasty Quanzhou calligrapher. The roof frame inside still shows fine woodworking craftsmanship. In places with powerful functions, original traces are not easy to find. This is a very common phenomenon. Among the numerous various ancestral halls and temples in the Fujian-Guangdong region where sacrificial culture flourishes, whether brightly colored or antique, how many historical traces are concealed beneath the surface, and how many original components remain in the bones — this is what we deeply care about. Beyond the "magic power" and "ability" of these temples, the palettes and construction changes left by countless generations over thousands of years can still evoke some bitterness or melancholy in the hearts of living people, and thereby arouse the desire to fully protect them — this is what we hope can resonate.

projects.name: 旧馆驿街巷
projects.name_en: Lane of Old Inns and Way-station
projects.address: 泉州市鲤中街道馆驿巷
projects.address_en: Guanyi Lane, Lizhong Subdistrict, Quanzhou
highlights: 古宅格局
历史痕迹
旧馆驿街巷位于泉州的历史街区内
旧肃清门外是古时驿站旧址因而得名
南宋的时候宝庆初年1225至1227年巷西侧就是泉州行衙所在地
元代的时候驿站就是庞大帝国的神经系统当时的清源驿就驻扎在这条街巷中
明天启年间1621至1627年迁出城外
资料显示巷中历史积淀丰富应当是史迹众多的
算来这里曾经有过水陆寺天室池南外宗正司元代驿站明代染织房
明嘉靖间御史汪旦和户部侍郎庄国桢府第
还有清道光间翰林龚维琳胞弟举人龚维琨刑部主事王海文
清嘉庆间进士杨滨海故居清末状元吴鲁的读书处汪氏宗祠等
不过今天已经无法按图索骥了
现在这段巷子长约200米南北走向尺度宜人
路东多大树巷内多砖构平房偶尔可见年代较早的装修
旧馆驿20号似较老宅邸可惜大门紧闭不向我等开放
巷南端有董杨大宗祠始建于明天顺五年后毁1999年重建
巷内多见房屋外墙砖石混砌为福建地区特有之出砖入石做法
石块表面比砖面略内陷故名之
是不是一定要像福州三坊七巷那般打造一番呢
projects.content_zh: 旧馆驿街巷位于泉州的历史街区内。旧肃清门外，是古时驿站旧址，因而得名。南宋的时候（宝庆初年，1225—1227年）巷西侧就是泉州行衙所在地。元代的时候，驿站就是庞大帝国的神经系统，当时的清源驿就驻扎在这条街巷中。明天启年间（1621—1627年）迁出城外。资料显示，巷中历史积淀丰富，应当是史迹众多的。算来这里曾经有过水陆寺、天室池、南外宗正司、元代驿站、明代染织房、明嘉靖间御史汪旦和户部侍郎庄国桢府第，还有清道光间翰林龚维琳胞弟举人龚维琨、刑部主事王海文、清嘉庆间进士杨滨海故居、清末状元吴鲁的读书处、汪氏宗祠等。不过今天已经无法按图索骥了。现在这段巷子长约200米，南北走向，尺度宜人。路东多大树。巷内多砖构平房，偶尔可见年代较早的装修。旧馆驿20号似较老宅邸，可惜大门紧闭，不向我等开放。巷南端有董杨大宗祠，始建于明天顺五年，后毁，1999年重建。巷内多见房屋外墙砖石混砌，为福建地区特有之"出砖入石"做法。石块表面比砖面略内陷，故名之。是不是一定要像福州三坊七巷那般打造一番呢？
projects.content_en: The Old Inn and Way-station Lane is located within the historical district of Quanzhou. Outside the old Suqing Gate, it was the site of an ancient way-station, hence the name. During the Southern Song (early Baoqing reign, 1225–1227), the west side of the lane was the location of the Quanzhou Administrative Office. During the Yuan Dynasty, way-stations were the nervous system of the vast empire, and the Qingyuan Way-station at that time was stationed in this lane. During the Tianqi reign of the Ming (1621–1627), it was moved outside the city. Data shows that the lane has a rich historical accumulation and should have numerous historical sites. Counting up, there were once the Shuilu Temple, Tianshi Pond, Southern Outer Clan Administration Office, Yuan Dynasty way-station, Ming Dynasty dyeing and weaving workshop, the residences of Censor Wang Dan and Vice Minister of Revenue Zhuang Guozhen during the Jiajing reign of the Ming, as well as the former residence of Gong Weikun (a juren and younger brother of Hanlin Gong Weilin during the Daoguang reign of the Qing), Wang Haiwen (Director of the Ministry of Justice), Yang Binhai (a jinshi during the Jiaqing reign of the Qing), the study place of Wu Lu (the last Zhuangyuan of the Qing), the Wang Clan Ancestral Hall, etc. However, today it is no longer possible to locate them by the map. Now this section of lane is about 200 meters long, running north-south, with pleasant scale. On the east side of the road there are many large trees. Inside the lane there are mostly brick bungalows, with occasionally earlier-period decorations visible. No. 20 Old Inn Lane seems to be an older mansion, but unfortunately its gate is tightly closed, not open to us. At the south end of the lane is the Dong-Yang Grand Ancestral Hall, first built in the fifth year of Tianshun reign of the Ming, later destroyed, and rebuilt in 1999. Inside the lane, house exterior walls are commonly seen with mixed brick and stone masonry, a practice unique to the Fujian region called "chu zhuan ru shi" (bricks protruding, stones inset). The surface of the stones is slightly recessed compared to the brick surface, hence the name. Must it really be developed like the Three Lanes and Seven Alleys in Fuzhou?

projects.name: 开元寺·双塔
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 泉州市鲤城区西街
projects.address_en: West Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou
projects.type: 宗教建筑·石结构·木结构
projects.type_en: Religious Architecture · Stone Structure · Timber Structure
highlights: 石塔结构和仿木做法
晚期木结构
巨大的石塔能够安定躁动的众生吗
建筑系的学生们啊你们需要先有信仰再信仰建筑
开元寺是闽中名刹
寺院始建于唐垂拱二年686年那时叫作莲花寺
开元二十六年738年改成了这个名字
拿史料记载和散布的众多小型古塔对照看今天寺院的规模和唐宋时期的差别不很大
中轴线上从影壁到带着倒座抱厦的天王殿再到大殿甘露戒坛和藏经阁
两翼有东西塔的镇佑寺院的进深要小于宽度
如同一切古老的寺院开元寺也是经历代重修今存木构均为明清时期建筑
其中以大雄宝殿年代相对较早斗拱雄浑有力
得见东西塔真面目以前先看到一对宝箧印经式的小石塔
有绍兴乙丑七月1145年题刻为南宋的作品
四面浮雕佛传故事风格朴拙可爱
更加有趣的是塔檐上刻着当今皇帝皇帝万岁日光菩萨月光菩萨等字样
日光月光菩萨是东方药师佛的胁侍两塔暗示着当年的净土信仰
两位主角相距不近东塔名镇国塔西塔名仁寿塔规制全同仅浮雕图案存在差异
东塔建于南宋嘉熙二年至淳祐十年间1238至1250年
西塔建于南宋绍定元年至嘉熙元年间1228至1237年
同为八角五层楼阁式仿木结构
大塔的须弥座尺度很小但不失力量
塔身各层细腻地刻出了门窗栏杆立柱阑额雀替斗拱檐口
对斗拱细节的刻画尤其精到表现出转角附角补间铺作
栌斗交互斗散斗刷头形象逼真甚至还有我们今天难以解释的构件
推测那该是替木型小拱头
五层塔身罗列起来气势是难以形容的宏大
也难以想象信仰如何有那么大的力量让古人倾毕生所有倾毕生所学来营造一件作品
那是为了来生的净土还是工作的时候头脑就是一片净土
projects.content_zh: 巨大的石塔能够安定躁动的众生吗？建筑系的学生们啊，你们需要先有信仰，再信仰建筑。开元寺是闽中名刹。寺院始建于唐垂拱二年（686年），那时叫作莲花寺，开元二十六年（738年）改成了这个名字。拿史料记载和散布的众多小型古塔对照看，今天寺院的规模和唐宋时期的差别不很大。中轴线上从影壁到带着倒座抱厦的天王殿，再到大殿、甘露戒坛和藏经阁，两翼有东西塔的镇佑，寺院的进深要小于宽度。如同一切古老的寺院，开元寺也是经历代重修，今存木构均为明清时期建筑，其中以大雄宝殿年代相对较早，斗拱雄浑有力。得见东西塔真面目以前，先看到一对宝箧印经式的小石塔，有"绍兴乙丑七月"（1145年）题刻，为南宋的作品。四面浮雕佛传故事，风格朴拙可爱。更加有趣的是塔檐上刻着"当今皇帝"、"皇帝万岁"、"日光菩萨"、"月光菩萨"等字样。要知道，日光、月光菩萨是东方药师佛的胁侍，两塔暗示着当年的净土信仰。两位主角相距不近。东塔名镇国塔，西塔名仁寿塔，规制全同，仅浮雕图案存在差异。东塔建于南宋嘉熙二年至淳祐十年间（1238—1250年），西塔建于南宋绍定元年至嘉熙元年间（1228—1237年），同为八角五层楼阁式仿木结构。大塔的须弥座尺度很小，但不失力量。塔身各层细腻地刻出了门窗、栏杆、立柱、阑额、雀替、斗拱、檐口，对斗拱细节的刻画尤其精到，表现出转角、附角、补间铺作，栌斗、交互斗、散斗、刷头形象逼真，甚至还有我们今天难以解释的构件，推测那该是"替木型小拱头"。五层塔身罗列起来，气势是难以形容的宏大，也难以想象信仰如何有那么大的力量，让古人倾毕生所有，倾毕生所学来营造一件作品。那是为了来生的净土？还是工作的时候，头脑就是一片净土？
projects.content_en: Can the massive stone pagodas calm restless beings? Students of architecture, you need to have faith first, then faith in architecture. Kaiyuan Temple is a famous temple in central Fujian. The temple was first built in the second year of Chuigong reign of the Tang (686), then called Lianhua Temple (Lotus Temple), and changed to its current name in the 26th year of Kaiyuan reign (738). Comparing historical records with the many small ancient pagodas scattered around, the scale of today's temple is not very different from that of the Tang-Song period. On the central axis, from the screen wall to the Hall of Heavenly Kings with an opposite portico, then to the main hall, the Ganlu Precepts Altar, and the Scripture Library, with the east and west pagodas guarding both wings, the depth of the temple is less than its width. Like all ancient temples, Kaiyuan Temple has been repaired through successive dynasties; the existing timber structures are all Ming-Qing period buildings, among which the Mahavira Hall is relatively early in date, with powerful and vigorous dougong. Before seeing the true faces of the east and west pagodas, one first sees a pair of small stone pagodas in the baqie yinjing (sutra-reliquary) style, with inscriptions "the seventh month of the Yichou year of Shaoxing" (1145), works of the Southern Song. The four sides have relief carvings of Buddha's life stories, in a simple and endearing style. Even more interesting is that the pagoda eaves are carved with characters such as "Current Emperor," "Long Live the Emperor," "Sunlight Bodhisattva," and "Moonlight Bodhisattva." You should know that the Sunlight and Moonlight Bodhisattvas are the attendant bodhisattvas of the Eastern Medicine Buddha (Bhaishajyaguru), and the two pagodas hint at the Pure Land faith of those years. The two protagonists are not close together. The east pagoda is named Zhenguo Pagoda (Township-Guarding Pagoda), and the west pagoda is named Renshou Pagoda (Benevolent-Longevity Pagoda); they have identical regulations, differing only in their relief patterns. The east pagoda was built between the second year of Jiaxi reign and the tenth year of Chunyou reign of the Southern Song (1238–1250), and the west pagoda between the first year of Shaoding reign and the first year of Jiaxi reign (1228–1237), both being octagonal five-story pavilion-style structures imitating timber. The xumizuo (Sumeru pedestal) of the large pagodas is small in scale but not lacking in strength. Each story of the pagoda body delicately carves out doors, windows, railings, columns, architraves, sparrow brackets (queti), dougong, and eaves; the depiction of dougong details is especially exquisite, showing corner sets, attached-corner sets, and intermediate sets, with vivid images of cap blocks (ludou),交互 blocks (jiaohu dou), loose blocks (sandou), and brush heads (shuatou), and even components that are difficult for us to explain today —推测 they should be "timber-substitute small bracket heads." The five stories of pagoda bodies arranged together create an indescribably grand momentum, and it is hard to imagine how faith could have such great power, making ancient people devote all their life's possessions and all their life's learning to creating one work. Was it for the Pure Land of the next life? Or was it that when working, their minds were already a Pure Land?

projects.content_zh: 宽阔的洛阳江入海的水面上，架设着一眼望不到头的洛阳桥。"洛阳桥是福建桥梁的状元"——茅以升。洛阳桥初建时长1200米，宽6.67米，武士造像分立两旁。桥中亭附近历代碑刻林立，有"万古安澜"等宋代石刻；桥北有昭惠庙、真身庵遗址；桥南有蔡襄祠，蔡襄著名的《万安桥记》碑立于祠内。史料记载，当时桥名是"万安桥"，主持人是北宋泉州太守蔡襄。没有一劳永逸的美事，造桥花了七年（1053—1059年），历代修建则贯穿千载。简单历数一下，宋绍兴八年（1138年），飓风坏桥，郡守赵思诚修复；明宣德间（1426—1435年）桥址下沉，潮至，桥没，知府冯桢命郡人增高三尺；万历三十二年（1424年），地震，桥塌，基址沉降，知府姜志礼修复；清雍正八年（1730年）秋，桥崩，知县工之琦修复；民国二十年（公元1932年）蔡廷锴军长改建为钢筋混凝土公路桥，桥面增高2米；抗日战争时期受到严重破坏，近代复修缮之。造桥的关键技术有两个——"筏形基础"和"种蛎固基"。所谓"筏形基础"，就是先在江底建成一条矮石堤，然后在堤上建桥墩。这样一来石堤将所有桥墩的基础连为一体，石堤底面积大，因此减小了建造单个桥墩基底对河底的压强，也便因而提高了地基土的承载力，并更有效地增强基础的整体性，调整不均匀沉降。所谓"种蛎固基"，即在基石上养殖牡蛎，使之胶结成牢固的中流砥柱。宋方勺《泊宅篇》中便有"即多去蛎房散置石基，益胶固焉"。尽管专家之间存在争论，但史料中的说法无疑是世界上把生物学应用于桥梁工程中的先例。端详着现在那些缀满白色蛎房痕迹的桥墩石，历史的沧桑感已荡然胸中，是不是卓越发明确实那么重要吗？
projects.content_en: On the broad surface where the Luoyang River empties into the sea, Luoyang Bridge stretches as far as the eye can see. "Luoyang Bridge is the champion of Fujian bridges" — Mao Yisheng. When first built, Luoyang Bridge was 1,200 meters long and 6.67 meters wide, with warrior statues standing on both sides. Near the bridge pavilion, steles from successive dynasties stand in rows, including Song Dynasty stone carvings such as "Eternal Peace Over the Waves"; north of the bridge are the sites of Zhaohui Temple and Zhenzhen Nunnery; south of the bridge is the Cai Xiang Shrine, where Cai Xiang's famous "Record of Wan'an Bridge" stele stands. Historical records show that the bridge was then named "Wan'an Bridge" (Peace Bridge), and the person in charge was Cai Xiang, prefect of Quanzhou in the Northern Song. There is no such thing as a once-and-for-all achievement; building the bridge took seven years (1053–1059), and repairs through successive dynasties span a thousand years. To briefly recount: in the eighth year of Shaoxing reign of the Song (1138), a hurricane damaged the bridge, and Prefect Zhao Sicheng repaired it; during the Xuande reign of the Ming (1426–1435), the bridge foundation sank, and at high tide the bridge was submerged; Prefect Feng Zhen ordered locals to raise it by three chi; in the 32nd year of Wanli reign (1424), an earthquake caused the bridge to collapse and the foundation to sink, and Prefect Jiang Zhili repaired it; in the autumn of the eighth year of Yongzheng reign of the Qing (1730), the bridge collapsed, and Magistrate Gong Zhiqi repaired it; in the 20th year of the Republic (1932), Army Commander Cai Tingkai converted it into a reinforced concrete highway bridge, raising the deck by 2 meters; it was severely damaged during the War of Resistance against Japan, and was repaired again in modern times. There are two key technologies in building the bridge — "raft foundation" and "oyster-cultivation foundation consolidation." The so-called "raft foundation" means first building a low stone embankment at the river bottom, then building bridge piers on the embankment. In this way, the stone embankment connects the foundations of all piers into one; with a large base area, it reduces the pressure on the river bottom from each individual pier foundation, thereby increasing the bearing capacity of the foundation soil, and more effectively enhancing the integrity of the foundation and adjusting uneven settlement. The so-called "oyster-cultivation foundation consolidation" means cultivating oysters on the foundation stones, causing them to cement into a firm midstream pillar. In Song Dynasty author Fang Shao's "Bozhai Pian," there is already mention of "cultivating oysters to consolidate the foundation." Although there is debate among experts, the statement in historical records is undoubtedly the world's first precedent of applying biology to bridge engineering. Looking at the pier stones now covered with traces of white oyster shells, the vicissitudes of history fill the chest — is an outstanding invention really that important?

晚期木结构
和晚近的欢天喜地的庙宇比起来泉州清净寺作为古老的清真寺是饱含宗教气氛的
肤浅地观察寺院外表便一下自让人想到阿尔多罗西甚至还有路易康
不过那是北宋大中祥符二年1009年的大师作品

楼顶作宣礼台入口处接连着两个半个的穹顶无尽的异域风情

墙上门洞作火焰券并有多处阿拉伯文铭文

从门口往北入得内院正对着的北墙嵌有明永乐五年1407年的敕谕碑
院子西头则是明善堂
此堂始建于明隆庆元年1567年现存建筑为清代重建风格中西合璧
油饰彩绘较新近年当有重修
projects.content_zh: 和晚近的欢天喜地的庙宇比起来，泉州清净寺，作为古老的清真寺，是饱含宗教气氛的。肤浅地观察寺院外表，便一下自让人想到阿尔多·罗西，甚至还有路易·康。不过那是北宋大中祥符二年（1009年）的大师作品，虽然风格的模仿对象是叙利亚大马士革清真寺，但比例尺度的把握不是抄袭得来的，使用的材料也是福建土产的石材。寺内现存最重要的建筑包括门楼、古礼拜堂奉天坛遗址，以及今天使用的礼拜堂明善堂。门楼是古寺庙的标志，高耸，南向，以辉绿岩和白花岗岩砌筑。楼顶作宣礼台。入口处接连着两个半个的穹顶，无尽的异域风情。门东为祝圣亭，内有重修碑记二通，一通为万历"重修清净寺碑记"，一通为正德"重立清净寺碑"。门西就是奉天坛，现仅存石墙、石柱及础。墙上门洞作火焰券，并有多处阿拉伯文铭文。柱、础均圆柱形。柱网三横四纵、高低不一，柱上尚存卯口。柱础有阳刻花纹雕饰。坛堂西端设立龛室，为礼拜的方向。再西的配院中还有古伊斯兰教石刻和古穆斯林石墓盖等陈设。从门口往北入得内院，正对着的北墙嵌有明永乐五年（1407年）的敕谕碑，院子西头则是明善堂。此堂始建于明隆庆元年（1567年），现存建筑为清代重建，风格中西合璧。油饰彩绘较新，近年当有重修。
projects.content_en: Compared with the joyous temples of later periods, Quanzhou Qingjing Temple, as an ancient mosque, is full of religious atmosphere. A superficial observation of the temple's exterior immediately brings to mind Aldo Rossi, and even Louis Kahn. However, it was a masterwork from the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu reign of the Northern Song (1009); although the style was modeled after the Great Mosque of Damascus in Syria, the grasp of proportion and scale was not obtained by copying, and the materials used are also locally produced stone from Fujian. The most important existing buildings in the temple include the gate tower, the site of the ancient prayer hall Fengtian Altar, and the prayer hall Mingshan Hall used today. The gate tower is the标志 of the ancient temple, tall and imposing, facing south, built of diabase (huilü rock) and white granite. The top of the building serves as a minaret platform. At the entrance, two half-domes connect, with endless exotic charm. East of the gate is the Zhusheng Pavilion, containing two repair stele records: one is the Wanli-era "Record of Repairing Qingjing Temple," and the other is the Zhengde-era "Re-erected Stele of Qingjing Temple." West of the gate is the Fengtian Altar, now only retaining stone walls, stone columns, and column bases. The door openings on the walls are in the form of flame arches, with multiple Arabic inscriptions. The columns and bases are all cylindrical. The column grid is three by four, of varying heights, with mortise openings still remaining on the columns. The column bases have relief-carved floral patterns. At the west end of the altar hall is a niche room, the direction of prayer. Further west in the auxiliary courtyard there are also ancient Islamic stone carvings and ancient Muslim stone tomb covers and other furnishings. Entering the inner courtyard northward from the gate, the north wall directly opposite is embedded with an imperial edict stele from the fifth year of Yongle reign of the Ming (1407), and at the west end of the courtyard is Mingshan Hall. This hall was first built in the first year of Longqing reign of the Ming (1567); the existing building is a Qing Dynasty reconstruction, with a combined Chinese-Western style. The oil paint and colored decorations are relatively new, suggesting repairs in recent years.

projects.name_en: Laozi Statue and Stone Chamber at Qingyuan Mountain

projects.address: 泉州市清源山风景名胜区内

highlights: 元代石雕造像工艺
石柱
建筑遗迹
泉州之所以叫作泉州是因为清源山上泉眼众多
在古代东方第一大港有这样的好去处自然人文荟萃古迹深厚
经过自古以来儒道释三家竞相经营清源山上还有伊斯兰教摩尼教印度教的活动踪迹
发展成为多种宗教兼容并蓄的文化名山
景区内宗教寺庙宫观文人书院石室以及石雕石构石刻等文物为主的人文景观几乎遍布清源山的每个角落
现存完好的宋元时期道教佛教大型石雕共7处历代摩崖石刻近500处
元代以来花岗岩仿木结构佛像石室3处以及近代高僧弘一法师舍利塔和广钦法师塔院
其中老君岩的装饰纹样以及弥陀岩和瑞像岩的仿木石室最具特点
老君岩造像是独一无二的艺术瑰宝造像成于宋代
清乾隆泉州府志说石像天成好事者略施雕琢字里行间充满了道教的传奇味道
石像高5.63米厚6.85米宽8.01米占地面积55平方米
是我国现存最大雕技最绝年代最久的道教石雕造像
与福州瑞岩弥勒佛像的情况类似老君岩原有一座高大的道观围护
可惜后来道观被焚只有老君岩的装饰细节留下来给我们讲述一些带有早期标签性质的做法特征了
顺着山路寻访过了千手岩和弘一法师舍利塔就是弥陀岩了
这里的仿木石构石室建于元顺帝至正二十四年1364年
石室重檐攒尖顶上施窣堵坡式顶刹下层丰满上层尺度很小似不甚协调
室身浮雕木结构构件中开门洞
檐下雕刻斗拱五铺作偷心造四朵补间铺作
转角铺作栌斗尺度显著大于补间角部施由昂
石室内的阿弥陀佛立像就天然崖壁雕凿而成
去瑞像岩则要走向东的山路需要途径碧霄岩继续东行
瑞像岩石室建于北宋元祐二年1086年依天柱峰山石雕刻释迦迦佛像
明成化十九年1483年建仿木构石室
石室形制与弥陀岩类似只是两层中上层呈一方形小屋
室身雕刻斗拱做法表现出与弥陀岩的继承关系
projects.content_zh: 泉州之所以叫作泉州，是因为清源山上泉眼众多。在古代"东方第一大港"有这样的好去处，自然人文荟萃、古迹深厚。经过自古以来儒、道、释三家竞相经营，清源山上还有伊斯兰教、摩尼教、印度教的活动踪迹，发展成为多种宗教兼容并蓄的文化名山。景区内宗教寺庙宫观、文人书院石室以及石雕石构石刻等文物为主的人文景观几乎遍布清源山的每个角落。现存完好的宋、元时期道教、佛教大型石雕共7处，历代摩崖石刻近500处。元代以来花岗岩仿木结构佛像石室3处，以及近代高僧弘一法师舍利塔和广钦法师塔院。其中老君岩的装饰纹样，以及弥陀岩和瑞像岩的仿木石室最具特点。老君岩造像是独一无二的艺术瑰宝。造像成于宋代。清乾隆《泉州府志》说："石像天成，好事者略施雕琢。"字里行间充满了道教的传奇味道。石像高5.63米，厚6.85米，宽8.01米，占地面积55平方米，是我国现存最大，雕技最绝，年代最久的道教石雕造像。与福州瑞岩弥勒佛像的情况类似，老君岩原有一座高大的道观围护，可惜后来道观被焚，只有老君岩的装饰细节留下来给我们讲述一些带有早期标签性质的做法特征了。顺着山路寻访，过了千手岩和弘一法师舍利塔就是弥陀岩了。这里的仿木石构石室，建于元顺帝至正二十四年（1364年）。石室重檐攒尖顶，上施窣堵坡式顶刹，下层丰满，上层尺度很小似不甚协调。室身浮雕木结构构件，中开门洞。檐下雕刻斗拱，五铺作，偷心造，四朵补间铺作，转角铺作栌斗尺度显著大于补间，角部施由昂。石室内的阿弥陀佛立像就天然崖壁雕凿而成。去瑞像岩则要走向东的山路，需要途径碧霄岩继续东行。瑞像岩石室建于北宋元祐二年（1086年），依天柱峰山石雕刻释迦迦佛像。明成化十九年（1483年）建仿木构石室。石室形制与弥陀岩类似，只是两层中上层呈一方形小屋。室身雕刻、斗拱做法表现出与弥陀岩的继承关系。
projects.content_en: Quanzhou is called Quanzhou (Spring Prefecture) because there are numerous springs on Qingyuan Mountain. In ancient times, as the "No. 1 Port of the East," having such a fine place naturally meant a gathering of humanities and profound historical sites. Through the successive operations of Confucianism, Daoism, and Buddhism since ancient times, Qingyuan Mountain also has traces of Islamic, Manichaean, and Hindu activities, developing into a famous cultural mountain where multiple religions coexist. Within the scenic area, humanistic landscapes dominated by cultural relics such as religious temples and palaces, literati academies and stone chambers, as well as stone carvings, stone structures, and stone inscriptions, almost cover every corner of Qingyuan Mountain. There are 7 well-preserved large-scale Daoist and Buddhist stone carvings from the Song and Yuan periods, and nearly 500 cliffside inscriptions from successive dynasties. Since the Yuan Dynasty, there are 3 granite timber-imitating stone chambers for Buddha statues, as well as the stupa of modern eminent monk Master Hongyi and the pagoda courtyard of Master Guangqin. Among them, the decorative patterns of Laojun Rock, and the timber-imitating stone chambers of Mituo Rock and Ruixiang Rock are the most distinctive. The Laojun Rock statue is a unique artistic treasure. The statue was created in the Song Dynasty. The Qianlong-era "Quanzhou Prefecture Gazetteer" says: "The stone statue was naturally formed, and an enthusiast applied slight carving." Between the lines is full of the legendary flavor of Daoism. The stone statue is 5.63 meters high, 6.85 meters thick, 8.01 meters wide, covering 55 square meters; it is the largest, most exquisitely carved, and oldest Daoist stone carving existing in China. Similar to the situation of the Mile (Maitreya) Buddha statue at Ruiyan in Fuzhou, Laojun Rock originally had a tall Daoist temple surrounding it; unfortunately the temple was later burned down, and only the decorative details of Laojun Rock remain to tell us about some construction features with early-period labels. Following the mountain path to visit, after passing Qianshou Rock and the stupa of Master Hongyi, one reaches Mituo Rock. The timber-imitating stone chamber here was built in the 24th year of Zhizheng reign of Emperor Shun of the Yuan (1364). The stone chamber has a double-eave pyramidal roof, topped with a stupa-style finial; the lower story is full, while the upper story is very small in scale, seeming somewhat不协调. The chamber body has relief-carved timber structure components, with a door opening in the center. Under the eaves, dougong are carved, five-step bracket sets, in the touxin (stealth) style, with four intermediate bracket sets; the cap block of the corner bracket set is significantly larger than that of the intermediate sets, with you'ang (corner ang) applied at the corners. The standing statue of Amitabha Buddha inside the stone chamber was carved from the natural cliff face. To go to Ruixiang Rock, one must take the eastward mountain path, passing through Bixiao Rock and continuing east. The Ruixiang Rock stone chamber was built in the second year of Yuanyou reign of the Northern Song (1086), with a statue of Shakyamuni Buddha carved from the stone of Tianzhu Peak. In the 19th year of Chenghua reign of the Ming (1483), a timber-imitating stone chamber was built. The form of the stone chamber is similar to that of Mituo Rock, except that among the two stories, the upper one is a square small room. The chamber body carvings and dougong construction show an继承 relationship with Mituo Rock.

projects.content_zh: 泉州古城的南门叫作"德济门"，今天只剩下了城门和城垣的遗址。这里曾经出土过伊斯兰教、印度教、犹太教、佛教、基督教等宗教石刻，那是怎样的昨日的繁华！与德济门错开遥相呼应的是泉州天后宫的大门，飞檐和灯笼，跳跃而热烈，是今天的高楼大厦中的点缀。处在"蕃舶客航聚集之地"，泉州天后宫建于南宋庆元二年（公元1196年），无论规格还是规模都是不输于人的。其后元代（1278年）下诏"制封泉州神女护国明著灵惠协正善庆显济天妃"，明代郑和下西洋时也奏令福建镇守官重新其庙，永乐十三年（1415年）改宫号为"天妃宫"。清康熙十九年（1680年）施琅征海，得敕封"护国庇民妙灵昭应宏仁普济天后"，后易宫名为"天后宫"。如今的天后宫山门不是原来的，而是搬迁来支援的晋江县学的棂星门，好在都是泉州帮的作品。门座面阔三间带左右旁门，青石龙柱，两侧石雕麒麟，螭虎窗，屋顶单檐歇山，屋脊三段划分，反翘贴瓷八龙二鳄，角脊成凤尾伸展而卷曲，线条柔和优美，整体结构华丽壮观。戏台连接...
projects.content_en: The south gate of ancient Quanzhou city was called "Deji Gate," and today only the ruins of the gate and city wall remain. Religious stone carvings of Islam, Hinduism, Judaism, Buddhism, Christianity, and others have been excavated here — what a prosperity of yesterday! Offset from and echoing Deji Gate from afar is the main gate of Quanzhou Tianhou Palace, with flying eaves and lanterns, lively and warm, an ornament among today's high-rise buildings. Located in a "place where foreign ships and passenger vessels gathered," Quanzhou Tianhou Palace was built in the second year of Qingyuan reign of the Southern Song (1196 AD), and in both specifications and scale it is second to none. Later, in the Yuan Dynasty (1278), an imperial edict was issued to "confer upon the Quanzhou goddess the title of Tianfei (Heavenly Consort) who protects the nation, manifests brightness, shows spiritual power, assists righteousness, celebrates goodness, and brings salvation"; during Zheng He's voyages to the Western Seas in the Ming Dynasty, he also petitioned to order the Fujian garrison commander to rebuild the temple, and in the 13th year of Yongle reign (1415) the palace name was changed to "Tianfei Palace." In the 19th year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1680), Shi Lang's maritime campaign received the imperial conferral of "Tianhou (Empress of Heaven) who protects the nation and people, manifests wondrous spiritual power, and universally saves through great benevolence," and the palace name was later changed to "Tianhou Palace." Today's gate of Tianhou Palace is not the original, but the Lingxing Gate moved here from the Jinjiang County School to support it; fortunately, both are works of the Quanzhou school. The gate base is three bays wide with side gates on left and right, with blue stone dragon columns, stone-carved qilin on both sides, and chihu (hornless dragon) windows; the roof has a single-eave hip-and-gable style, with the roof ridge divided into three sections, with upturned porcelain-inlaid eight dragons and two crocodiles; the corner ridges extend and curl like phoenix tails, with soft and elegant lines, and the overall structure is gorgeous and spectacular. highlights: 近现代民居格局
工艺做法
虽然建造年代并不古远但是杨家人大可拍着胸脯说我们的房子是清光绪二十年1894年动工光绪三十年1906年完工的
亭店社区是泉州著名的侨乡几千居民中杨姓为主其次是林陈等姓氏
早期社区人员远播菲律宾印度尼西亚美国越南等地清代民国华侨回乡建有古建筑几十座

花厅后为卧房并配有天井各自成一独立的小庭院

布局相当严谨显得小巧玲珑而又气派宏伟
