而其充分利用地形的设计特点又赋予它奇峻独特的气势
projects.content_zh: 背依青山的青山宫面对着青山湾。本是享用不尽的风景，只是隐隐地担心林立的石雕石材企业不知道今后要向哪条路上走。惠安青山宫始建于北宋太平兴国六年（981年），堪称千年古庙。《惠安县志》载："青山寨隘在县南，伪闽将军张悃立寨于此，以御海寇。既殁，乡人庙祀之，后倾圮，故地犹存，明洪武二十一年重造之。"这样便形成了"青山王"信仰，又叫"惠安境主"或"灵安王"，而且随着明清之际惠安人远渡谋生而在台湾、东南亚一带广泛传播，还对当地的宗教建筑和雕刻、泥塑、彩绘技艺产生了深远的影响。这里的青山祖宫由灵安尊王庙、文昌阁、英烈祠几个建筑群组成。主庙是灵安王庙，坐北朝南，呈台阶状层层抬高，由山门、两廊、天井、前殿、拱亭和后殿沿中轴线布置。山门与庙前石埕存在显著高差，五开间，中门三间与边门组合屋顶，屋面八兽，泥塑彩绘双龙戏珠，飞檐翘脊，轮廓丰富。山门之内，回廊围合天井，左右道教题材壁画彩塑。前殿继续抬高，面阔五间，而尺度紧凑。保存有"同治五年西湖铺后蔡黄□□敬修"题记。前后殿之间有拱亭，实为天井加盖屋顶所成。后殿面阔五间、进深四间，供奉灵安尊王及文武判官。建筑因山就势，后殿地面高度相当于山门的屋脊。文昌阁在灵安尊王庙东，并排而建，坐北朝南，由放生池、石埕、大门、前厅、天井、明台和正殿组成。前厅面阔三间，经左右回廊过天井、明台直达正殿。天井中有800年树龄的古槐树。正殿面阔、进深各三间。单体建筑抬梁穿斗式混合木架构，硬山式屋顶。正殿内供奉文昌帝君及惠安首任知县崔知节塑像。后殿保留墨书"咸丰五年乙卯起盖……"等语。英烈祠，在灵安尊王庙西南，坐西北向东南，面阔三间，进深一间，抬梁式木结构，硬山式屋顶。中祀张悃部将英烈侯，右祀土地神，左祀司马爷公、骏马及天兵神将。青山宫各组成部分共有的飞檐翘脊、雕梁画栋、红砖白墙，沿中轴线布置的特点，可以当地术语"皇宫起"冠之；而其充分利用地形的设计特点又赋予它奇峻独特的气势。
projects.content_en: Qingshan Temple, backed by Qingshan Mountain, faces Qingshan Bay. It is originally scenery to be enjoyed endlessly, only one faintly worries that the林立 stone carving and stone material enterprises do not know which road to take in the future. Hui'an Qingshan Temple was first built in the sixth year of Taiping Xingguo reign of the Northern Song (981), and can be called a thousand-year-old ancient temple. The "Hui'an County Gazetteer" records: "Qingshan Stockade Pass is south of the county; General Zhang Kun of the pseudo-Min established a stockade here to defend against sea pirates. After his death, villagers worshipped him in a temple; later it collapsed, but the original site still remains, and it was rebuilt in the 21st year of Hongwu reign of the Ming." Thus formed the "Qingshan King" faith, also called "Hui'an Jingzhu" (Territorial Lord of Hui'an) or "Ling'an King," which, as Hui'an people traveled far to make a living during the Ming-Qing transition, spread widely in Taiwan and Southeast Asia, and also had a profound influence on local religious architecture and carving, clay sculpture, and painting techniques. The Qingshan Ancestral Temple here consists of several building groups: the Temple of Ling'an Zunwang, Wenchang Pavilion, and Yinglie Shrine. The main temple is the Ling'an King Temple, facing south, in a stepped form rising layer by layer, with the mountain gate, two corridors, courtyard, front hall, arched pavilion, and rear hall arranged along the central axis. There is a significant height difference between the mountain gate and the stone courtyard in front of the temple; it is five bays wide, with the central three bays and side gates combining roofs, with eight beasts on the roof, clay sculpture and painted twin dragons playing with a pearl, flying eaves and upturned ridges, with rich contours. Inside the mountain gate, corridors enclose the courtyard, with Daoist-themed murals and painted sculptures on left and right. The front hall continues to rise, five bays wide, but compact in scale. It preserves the inscription "Repaired by Cai Huang of Xihu Pu in the fifth year of Tongzhi." Between the front and rear halls is an arched pavilion, actually formed by covering the courtyard with a roof. The rear hall is five bays wide and four bays deep, enshrining Ling'an Zunwang and civil and military judges. The building adapts to the mountain terrain, with the floor height of the rear hall equivalent to the roof ridge of the mountain gate. Wenchang Pavilion is east of the Temple of Ling'an Zunwang, built side by side, facing south, composed of a release pond, stone courtyard, main gate, front hall, courtyard, bright platform, and main hall. The front hall is three bays wide, passing through left and right corridors across the courtyard and bright platform to reach the main hall directly. In the courtyard is an ancient scholar tree 800 years old. The main hall is three bays wide and three bays deep. The individual building uses a mixed tailiang-chuandou timber frame, with a gable roof. Inside the main hall are enshrined statues of Wenchang Dijun and Cui Zhijie, the first county magistrate of Hui'an. The rear hall preserves ink inscriptions such as "Built in the Yimao year of the fifth year of Xianfeng..." Yinglie Shrine is southwest of the Temple of Ling'an Zunwang, facing southeast from the northwest, three bays wide and one bay deep, with a tailiang timber structure and gable roof. In the center is worshipped Yinglie Hou, a general under Zhang Kun; on the right is the Earth God; on the left are Sima Ye Gong, a fine horse, and heavenly soldiers and divine generals. The common features of all components of Qingshan Temple — flying eaves and upturned ridges, carved beams and painted rafters, red bricks and white walls, arranged along the central axis — can be crowned with the local term "huanggong qi" (palace-style start); and its design feature of fully utilizing the terrain endows it with a precipitous and unique momentum.

projects.name: 施琅墓
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 惠安县黄塘镇虎窟村
projects.address_en: Huku Village, Huangtang Town, Hui'an County
highlights: 石亭构造
石雕纹饰
凭吊
施琅墓是施琅与其妻王氏黄氏合葬墓
墓地坐东北朝西南因山就势划分成七层平台
最上面的第七层墓碑中刻皇清光禄大夫太子少傅靖海将军襄壮施公赐茔
两侧刻一品夫人王氏一品夫人黄氏
墓室为石结构两翼逐层外扩共三穴
左右两旁为两对石雕文武翁仲
第六层依次成对排列石马石虎石羊造型古朴
第五层分别为钦赐祭葬碑坊
第四层为清康熙皇帝第一二三次皇清谕祭碑亭
第三层是皇清敕建碑亭
第二层为一对石柱高约8米高
最前面的是山河砺带牌坊
施琅身上真正能够看到人性的丰富甚至是复杂
年少时有识度膂力绝人而且于兵法无不兼精遂智勇为万人敌
而后先是随郑成功反清复明又投靠清廷打击妄图台湾独立的郑成功后人诠释了何为识时务者
亲人几十口被郑经杀害但是踏上台湾后却能够善待郑氏后人不再杀戮
起伏往复之间令人大大在意的则还是他维系了台海的统一
projects.content_zh: 施琅墓是施琅与其妻王氏、黄氏合葬墓。墓地坐东北朝西南，因山就势划分成七层平台。最上面的第七层墓碑中刻"皇清光禄大夫太子少傅靖海将军襄壮施公赐茔"，两侧刻"一品夫人王氏"、"一品夫人黄氏"，墓室为石结构，两翼逐层外扩，共三穴，左右两旁为两对石雕文武翁仲；第六层依次成对排列石马、石虎、石羊，造型古朴；第五层分别为"钦赐祭葬"碑坊；第四层为清康熙皇帝第一、二、三次"皇清谕祭"碑亭；第三层是"皇清敕建"碑亭；第二层为一对石柱，高约8米高；最前面的是"山河砺带"牌坊。施琅身上真正能够看到人性的丰富，甚至是复杂。年少时"有识度，膂力绝人"，而且"于兵法无不兼精，遂智勇为万人敌"；而后先是随郑成功反清复明，又投靠清廷打击妄图台湾独立的郑成功后人，诠释了何为"识时务者"；亲人几十口被郑经杀害，但是踏上台湾后却能够善待郑氏后人，不再杀戮。起伏往复之间，令人大大在意的则还是他维系了台海的统一。
projects.content_en: Shi Lang's Tomb is the joint burial tomb of Shi Lang and his wives Wang and Huang. The cemetery faces southwest from the northeast, divided into seven platforms adapting to the mountain terrain. On the topmost seventh layer, the tombstone is inscribed in the center with "Imperial Qing Guanglu Daifu, Taizi Shaofu, Jinghai General, Xiangzhuang Shi Gong's Bestowed Tomb," with "First-Rank Madam Wang" and "First-Rank Madam Huang" inscribed on both sides; the tomb chamber is of stone structure, with both wings expanding outward layer by layer, totaling three caves; on both left and right sides are two pairs of stone-carved civil and military officials (wengzhong); the sixth layer has pairs of stone horses, stone tigers, and stone goats arranged in sequence, with simple and ancient造型; the fifth layer respectively has the "Imperially Bestowed Sacrifice and Burial" memorial archways; the fourth layer has the first, second, and third "Imperial Qing Sacrificial Edict" stele pavilions of the Kangxi Emperor of the Qing; the third layer is the "Imperial Qing Edict Construction" stele pavilion; the second layer is a pair of stone columns, about 8 meters high; at the very front is the "Mountains and Rivers as Belts" memorial archway. On Shi Lang one can truly see the richness, even complexity, of human nature. In his youth he "had discernment and extraordinary physical strength," and "was proficient in all aspects of military art, thus his wisdom and courage made him a match for ten thousand men"; later he first followed Zheng Chenggong to oppose the Qing and restore the Ming, then defected to the Qing court to strike at the descendants of Zheng Chenggong who sought Taiwan independence, interpreting what it means to be "a person who understands the times"; dozens of his family members were killed by Zheng Jing, but after setting foot on Taiwan he was able to treat the Zheng descendants well and no longer kill them. Amid the ups and downs, what one cares most about is that he maintained the unification of Taiwan and the mainland.

projects.name: 湖头贤良祠
projects.name_en: Temple of Eminent Statesmen in Hutou
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 安溪县湖头镇安溪第三中学内
projects.address_en: Within Anxi No. 3 Middle School, Hutou Town, Anxi County
highlights: 格局
木结构与特色装饰
安溪先生李光地是康熙皇帝极其倚重的大臣也是充满争议的历史人物
今天安溪李光地的祠堂原本是他读书的地方叫作榕村书屋
是他命长子李钟伦于清康熙二十四年1685年建造的
人称襟带蓝水背负阆峰山川灵秀人文所钟
安溪先生死后十五年的雍正十一年1733年得以入祀北京贤良祠榕村书屋随之改名为贤良祠
这座祠堂坐西向东中心为三进四合院式
中心部分的东南两面都是荷花池西北两面则为花园草地与假山
中心院东南角复建了原有歇山重檐的碑亭亭中立雍正帝谕祭文碑追恤先生风概节操
碑后连接着临水轩凭栏而望洗心荷池
核心院落第一进已废今为门厅
第二进大厅即为祠堂主体陈列李光地的遗物遗稿
大厅内外环墙嵌大理石镌刻康熙御书太极图说巡子牙河建坝诗恭临唐太宗劝农诏朱文家训等
第三进是二层的藏书楼延甲楼原珍藏图书与木刻印版今已毁弃殆尽
当地村民李姓居多想必不少是安溪先生后人
至于衣锦还乡者也当不少
今天所见的格局完整的贤良祠便是1995年由旅居海外的李氏宗亲李陆大先生捐资修葺的结果
面貌上恢复旧观内容上复兴之举无奈之失也令人叹息
2001年祠堂辟为李光地纪念馆
projects.content_zh: "安溪先生"李光地是康熙皇帝极其倚重的大臣，也是充满争议的历史人物。今天安溪李光地的祠堂，原本是他读书的地方，叫作"榕村书屋"，是他命长子李钟伦于清康熙二十四年（1685年）建造的，人称"襟带蓝水，背负阆峰，山川灵秀，人文所钟"。安溪先生死后十五年的雍正十一年（1733年），得以入祀北京贤良祠，榕村书屋随之改名为贤良祠。这座祠堂坐西向东，中心为三进四合院式。中心部分的东南两面都是荷花池，西北两面则为花园草地与假山。中心院东南角复建了原有歇山重檐的碑亭，亭中立雍正帝《谕祭文》碑，追恤先生风概节操，碑后连接着临水轩，凭栏而望，洗心荷池。核心院落第一进已废，今为门厅；第二进大厅即为祠堂主体，陈列李光地的遗物、遗稿，大厅内外环墙嵌大理石，镌刻康熙御书"太极图说"、"巡子牙河建坝诗"、"恭临唐太宗劝农诏"、"朱文家训"等；第三进是二层的藏书楼"延甲楼"，原珍藏图书与木刻印版，今已毁弃殆尽。当地村民李姓居多，想必不少是"安溪先生"后人。至于衣锦还乡者，也当不少。今天所见的格局完整的贤良祠便是1995年由旅居海外的李氏宗亲李陆大先生捐资修葺的结果。面貌上恢复旧观，内容上复兴之举，无奈之失也令人叹息。2001年，祠堂辟为李光地纪念馆。
projects.content_en: "Mr. Anxi" Li Guangdi was a minister highly relied upon by the Kangxi Emperor, and also a controversial historical figure. Today's ancestral temple of Li Guangdi in Anxi was originally the place where he studied, called "Rongcun Study," built by his eldest son Li Zhonglun in the 24th year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1685) on his orders, known as "girded by blue waters, backed by Langfeng Peak, where mountains and rivers are spiritually beautiful and humanities are cherished." Fifteen years after Mr. Anxi's death, in the 11th year of Yongzheng reign (1733), he was enshrined in the Xianliang Temple in Beijing, and Rongcun Study was subsequently renamed Xianliang Temple. This temple faces east, with a three-courtyard quadrangle at its center. The southeast two sides of the central part are all lotus ponds, while the northwest two sides are garden lawns and rockeries. In the southeast corner of the central courtyard, the original hip-and-gable double-eave stele pavilion was rebuilt, with the Yongzheng Emperor's "Edict of Sacrifice" stele inside, posthumously honoring Mr. Li's character and integrity; behind the stele is connected the Waterside Pavilion, where leaning on the railing one can view the heart-cleansing lotus pond. The first courtyard of the core complex has been abandoned, now serving as an entrance hall; the second courtyard's main hall is the main body of the temple, displaying Li Guangdi's relics and manuscripts; the inner and outer walls of the main hall are inlaid with marble, engraved with Kangxi's imperial calligraphy such as "Taiji Diagram Explanation," "Poem on Building Dams during the Tour of Ziya River," "Respectfully Copying Emperor Taizong of Tang's Edict Encouraging Agriculture," and "Zhu Family Instructions"; the third courtyard is the two-story library building "Yanjia Tower," which originally treasured books and woodblock printing plates, now completely destroyed. Most local villagers have the surname Li, presumably many are descendants of "Mr. Anxi." As for those who returned to their hometown in glory, there should also be many. The complete-pattern Xianliang Temple seen today is the result of renovation funded by Mr. Li Luda, an overseas Li clan member residing abroad, in 1995. In appearance it has restored the old look, and in content it is a revival effort, but the helpless losses are also lamentable. In 2001, the temple was converted into the Li Guangdi Memorial Hall.

projects.name: 李光地故居
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 福建省泉州市安溪县湖头镇
projects.address_en: Hutou Town, Anxi County, Quanzhou, Fujian Province
highlights: 民居格局
木结构
砖石构造
李光地的一生仿佛是一条路线一端是朝廷一端连着家乡
他在故乡的身影留在旧衙新衙两座宅第以及旧居住地问房大厝一座和侄辈所建之盘屿厝之中
旧衙又名昌和堂建于康熙前期
建筑群坐北向南前后四落左右护厝各十八间
沿中轴线依次为大埕门厅官厅大厅后厅
门厅面阔五间悬昌和堂匾
其内之官厅面阔三间而进深五柱九檩明间抬梁减中柱后期筑墙分隔成实三间
大厅又名教忠堂面阔五间进深更大七柱十二檩留足功能空间
太师壁神龛内壁悬挂李光地画像案供李光地及夫人林氏顺勤神主额匾为康熙五十二年所赐夹辅高风
后厅则面阔五间
各落屋顶均为歇山顶三段燕脊
建筑檐下多用丁头拱入柱用材壮硕但此外并不注重雕饰油饰彩画年久色褪但更显出整体风格的朴素庄重
新衙又名昌佑堂建于清康熙三十七年1698年
建筑群坐北向南四周围墙宽庭大埕前后四落东西侧由内而外各有护厝巷道
东巷北端建有接官亭或称报房是新衙的主要出入口
门前置所谓的戒贪兽
沿中轴线依次为大埕门厅官厅大厅后厅
门厅面阔五间进深三柱五檩悬昌佑堂匾明间设屏门次间作内廊尽间为门房
二进官厅面阔五间进深五柱九檩明间抬梁减柱中三间连作厅堂现为李光地祖裔世系展示室
核心为大厅面阔五间进深七柱十三檩额上悬挂雍正十一年赐匾昌时柱石
再入则为后厅面阔五间进深五柱九檩
各落屋顶均为歇山顶三段燕脊
建筑做法与旧衙差异不大雕刻使用也非常简约只施点睛之笔近来经重新油饰更恢复了一些彩画装饰面貌的确符合新衙的称谓
问房大厝是二伯李日燝于明代末年所建造
此厝规模很大前后五进院落落沿中轴线依次为门厅官厅大厅后厅倒朗合院后花园东西侧各有两列护厝
其中大厅主座进深七柱十五檩面阔五间前檐单跳钉头拱挑檐明间前后均有隔断中设神龛
整体建筑面貌更加朴素斗拱木雕隔扇装饰精到恰当色泽已难寻历史痕迹保存庄重气质
问房大厝之西北侧为盘屿厝是李日燝孙辈于康熙中后期所建
难得的是问房大厝盘屿厝仍住着李日燝一系后裔
该厝坐北朝南由门楼门埕左右两列主座护厝组成门楼设于门埕东端
两列主座均前后四落沿中轴线依次为门厅官厅大厅后厅
主座之间以中巷相隔于第三进大厅位置设门相通并设跨巷石额字曰盘屿
projects.content_zh: 李光地的一生仿佛是一条路线，一端是朝廷，一端连着家乡。他在故乡的身影留在旧衙、新衙两座宅第，以及旧居住地问房大厝一座和侄辈所建之盘屿厝之中。旧衙又名昌和堂，建于康熙前期。建筑群坐北向南，前后四落，左右护厝各十八间。沿中轴线依次为大埕、门厅、官厅、大厅、后厅。门厅面阔五间，悬"昌和堂"匾；其内之官厅面阔三间，而进深五柱九檩，明间抬梁减中柱，后期筑墙分隔成实三间；大厅，又名教忠堂，面阔五间，进深更大，七柱十二檩，留足功能空间，太师壁神龛内壁悬挂李光地画像，案供李光地及夫人林氏顺勤神主，额匾为康熙五十二年所赐"夹辅高风"；后厅则面阔五间。各落屋顶均为歇山顶，三段燕脊。建筑檐下多用丁头拱入柱，用材壮硕，但此外并不注重雕饰，油饰彩画年久色褪，但更显出整体风格的朴素庄重。新衙又名昌佑堂，建于清康熙三十七年（1698年）。建筑群坐北向南，四周围墙，宽庭大埕，前后四落，东西侧由内而外各有护厝、巷道。东巷北端建有接官亭或称报房，是新衙的主要出入口；门前置所谓的"戒贪兽"。沿中轴线依次为大埕、门厅、官厅、大厅、后厅。门厅面阔五间，进深三柱五檩，悬"昌佑堂"匾，明间设屏门，次间作内廊，尽间为门房；二进官厅，面阔五间，进深五柱九檩，明间抬梁减柱，中三间连作厅堂，现为李光地祖裔世系展示室；核心为大厅，面阔五间，进深七柱十三檩，额上悬挂雍正十一年赐匾"昌时柱石"；再入则为后厅，面阔五间，进深五柱九檩。各落屋顶均为歇山顶，三段燕脊。建筑做法与旧衙差异不大，雕刻使用也非常简约，只施点睛之笔，近来经重新油饰，更恢复了一些彩画装饰，面貌的确符合"新衙"的称谓。问房大厝是二伯李日燝于明代末年所建造。此厝规模很大，前后五进院落落，沿中轴线依次为门厅、官厅、大厅、后厅、倒朗合院、后花园，东西侧各有两列护厝。其中大厅主座进深七柱十五檩、面阔五间，前檐单跳钉头拱挑檐，明间前后均有隔断，中设神龛。整体建筑面貌更加朴素，斗拱、木雕、隔扇装饰精到恰当。色泽已难寻历史痕迹，保存庄重气质。问房大厝之西北侧为盘屿厝，是李日燝孙辈于康熙中后期所建。难得的是问房大厝、盘屿厝仍住着李日燝一系后裔。该厝坐北朝南，由门楼、门埕、左右两列主座、护厝组成。门楼设于门埕东端。两列主座均前后四落，沿中轴线依次为门厅、官厅、大厅、后厅；主座之间以中巷相隔，于第三进大厅位置设门相通并设跨巷石额字曰"盘屿"。
projects.content_en: Li Guangdi's life seems like a route, with one end at the court and the other connected to his hometown. His presence in his hometown remains in two residences, the Old Yamen and the New Yamen, as well as the former residence Wenfang Dacuo and the Panyu Cuo built by his nephews. The Old Yamen, also named Changhe Hall, was built in the early Kangxi period. The building complex faces south, with four lops (sections) front to back, and eighteen side-wing rooms (hucuo) on each of the left and right sides. Along the central axis are依次 the large courtyard, entrance hall, official hall, main hall, and rear hall. The entrance hall is five bays wide, hanging the plaque "Changhe Hall"; the official hall inside is three bays wide, with a depth of five columns and nine purlins, with the central bay using a beam-lifting frame reducing the central column, later divided into three actual bays by walls; the main hall, also named Jiaozhong Hall, is five bays wide, with a greater depth of seven columns and twelve purlins, leaving ample functional space; on the inner wall of the taishi wall shrine hangs a portrait of Li Guangdi, with the altar enshrining the spirit tablets of Li Guangdi and his wife Lady Lin Shunqin, and the plaque "Jiafu Gaofeng" (High Wind of Assisting and Supporting) bestowed in the 52nd year of Kangxi; the rear hall is five bays wide. All lop roofs are hip-and-gable style, with three-section swallow-tail ridges. Under the eaves, dingtou brackets (corbel brackets) are commonly used entering columns, with robust materials, but otherwise little attention is paid to carving; the oil paint and colored paintings have faded over time, but this further shows the simple and solemn overall style. The New Yamen, also named Changyou Hall, was built in the 37th year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1698). The building complex faces south, surrounded by walls, with wide courtyards, four lops front to back, and side wings and alleys from inside to outside on the east and west sides. At the north end of the east alley is built the Jieguan Pavilion (Official Reception Pavilion), also called the newspaper room, which is the main entrance of the New Yamen; in front of the door is placed the so-called "Jietan Beast" (Warning Against Greed Beast). Along the central axis are依次 the large courtyard, entrance hall, official hall, main hall, and rear hall. The entrance hall is five bays wide, with a depth of three columns and five purlins, hanging the plaque "Changyou Hall," with a screen door in the central bay, inner corridors in the secondary bays, and gatekeeper rooms in the end bays; the second-entry official hall is five bays wide, with a depth of five columns and nine purlins, with the central bay using a beam-lifting frame reducing columns, and the middle three bays connected as a hall, now serving as the Li Guangdi Ancestral Lineage Exhibition Room; the core is the main hall, five bays wide, with a depth of seven columns and thirteen purlins, with the plaque "Changshi Zhushi" (Pillar Stone of the Prosperous Era) bestowed in the 11th year of Yongzheng hanging above; further in is the rear hall, five bays wide, with a depth of five columns and nine purlins. All lop roofs are hip-and-gable style, with three-section swallow-tail ridges. The construction method is not very different from the Old Yamen, and the use of carvings is also very简约, only applying finishing touches; after recent repainting, some colored painting decorations have been restored, and the appearance indeed matches the name "New Yamen." Wenfang Dacuo was built by his second uncle Li Rizong in the late Ming Dynasty. This residence is very large, with five front-to-back courtyards, along the central axis依次 being the entrance hall, official hall, main hall, rear hall, Daolang courtyard, and back garden, with two rows of side wings on each of the east and west sides. Among them, the main hall's main seat has a depth of seven columns and fifteen purlins, five bays wide, with the front eave using a single-tiao nail-head bracket to support the eaves, with partitions in both front and rear of the central bay, and a shrine in the middle. The overall building appearance is even simpler, with dougong, wood carvings, and lattice door decorations refined and appropriate. The color has long lost its historical traces, preserving a solemn temperament. Northwest of Wenfang Dacuo is Panyu Cuo, built by Li Rizong's grandchildren in the mid-to-late Kangxi period. What is rare is that Wenfang Dacuo and Panyu Cuo still house descendants of the Li Rizong line. This residence faces south, composed of a gate tower, gate courtyard, two rows of main seats on left and right, and side wings. The gate tower is located at the east end of the gate courtyard. Both rows of main seats have four front-to-back lops, along the central axis依次 being the entrance hall, official hall, main hall, and rear hall; the main seats are separated by a central alley, with a connecting door at the third-entry main hall position and a cross-alley stone plaque inscribed "Panyu."

projects.address: 安溪县蓬莱镇鹤前村蓬莱山

highlights: 寺院格局

现在叫作蓬莱山的张岩山如同福建很多有山的地方一样绿色葱郁山岩苍劲
但真正让蓬莱的清水岩具有灵气的与其说是现在的寺院不如说是寺院里的一通碑岩图
这是一张宋代的规划图碑用散点透视的手段记录了清水岩周边的建筑面貌
是罕见的集历史科学艺术为一体的文化瑰宝
根据学者们的研究成果北宋元丰六年1083年清水祖师普足禅师1037至1101年到蓬莱住张岩石宫后旁侧构庵数间
至元祐八年1093年改建清水岩九十九间规模岩宇逐趋完善遂有岩图碑传世
南宋寺毁后代多有复兴的努力而以乾隆二十六年1761年的全面重修为最盛
至于清水岩寺笔者实在不好过于美誉

而是全然是因为口味的缘故建筑体型比较僵化材料构造和施工质量相对粗糙

这里尚存宋代文物古迹29处元代1处明代8处清代5处
还有一点很重要清水岩寺是全球各地华人的崇拜清水祖师的祖殿
目前世界各地有清水祖师分炉分庙超过千座其中台湾地区便居其半充分说明清水岩的重要地位
projects.content_zh: 把"彭内"改成"蓬莱"，此地必要有"蓬莱仙境"的意境。现在叫作蓬莱山的张岩山，如同福建很多有山的地方一样，绿色葱郁，山岩苍劲。但真正让蓬莱的清水岩具有灵气的，与其说是现在的寺院，不如说是寺院里的一通碑——《岩图》。这是一张宋代的"规划图碑"，用散点透视的手段记录了清水岩周边的建筑面貌，是罕见的集历史、科学、艺术为一体的文化瑰宝。根据学者们的研究成果，北宋元丰六年（1083年），清水祖师普足禅师（1037—1101年）到蓬莱，住张岩石宫，后旁侧构庵数间；至元祐八年（1093年），改建清水岩，九十九间规模岩宇逐趋完善，遂有《岩图》碑传世。南宋寺毁，后代多有复兴的努力，而以乾隆二十六年（1761年）的全面重修为最盛。至于清水岩寺，笔者实在不好过于美誉。原因并非是今天的建筑为清乾隆所谓依照宋代《岩图》碑所记载的建筑规模、尺寸、度数重建，近来又经修复、扩建，而是全然是因为口味的缘故——建筑体型比较僵化，材料构造和施工质量相对粗糙……今天清水岩寺的殿宇坐东南朝西北，以三层楼阁为主题，依山就势，对称布置。主体建筑是清水祖殿，又名蓬莱祖殿，殿外有清水法门、觉亭、三忠庙、护界宫、洋中亭等楼阁亭榭，与岩殿联缀，所憾"坐姿"过于端庄，红砖绿树之间，石材堆砌之间总觉得欠缺高手的指点。好在流连在寺中，寻访古迹是一大乐事。这里尚存宋代文物古迹29处、元代1处、明代8处、清代5处。还有一点很重要，清水岩寺是全球各地华人的崇拜清水祖师的祖殿。目前世界各地有清水祖师分炉分庙超过千座，其中台湾地区便居其半，充分说明清水岩的重要地位。
projects.content_en: Changing "Pengnei" to "Penglai" (Penglai Fairyland), this place must have the mood of a "Penglai fairyland." Zhangyan Mountain, now called Penglai Mountain, like many mountainous places in Fujian, is lush with greenery and has vigorous rock formations. But what truly gives Qingshuiyan at Penglai its spiritual aura is not so much the present temple as a stele inside the temple — the "Rock Map" (Yantu). This is a Song Dynasty "planning map stele," recording the architectural appearance around Qingshuiyan through scattered-point perspective, a rare cultural treasure integrating history, science, and art. According to scholars' research results, in the sixth year of Yuanfeng reign of the Northern Song (1083), the Qingshui Ancestor Master Puzu Chan Master (1037–1101) came to Penglai, lived in the Zhangyan Stone Palace, and later built several huts beside it; by the eighth year of Yuanyou reign (1093), Qingshuiyan was rebuilt, with the scale of ninety-nine rock halls gradually perfected, and thus the "Rock Map" stele was passed down. The temple was destroyed in the Southern Song, and later generations made many efforts to revive it, with the comprehensive reconstruction in the 26th year of Qianlong reign (1761) being the most flourishing. As for Qingshuiyan Temple, the author really cannot praise it too highly. The reason is not that today's buildings were rebuilt in the Qianlong reign of the Qing supposedly according to the scale, dimensions, and degrees recorded in the Song Dynasty "Rock Map" stele, and have recently undergone repairs and expansion, but entirely because of taste — the architectural form is relatively rigid, and the material construction and construction quality are relatively rough... Today's halls of Qingshuiyan Temple face northwest from the southeast, with three-story pavilions as the theme, adapting to the mountain terrain and symmetrically arranged. The main building is the Qingshui Ancestral Hall, also called Penglai Ancestral Hall; outside the hall are pavilions and towers such as the Qingshui Gate, Jue Pavilion, Three Loyalty Temple, Guardian Palace, and Yangzhong Pavilion, connected with the rock hall; regrettably the "posture" is too dignified, and between red bricks and green trees, between stone masonry, one always feels a lack of expert guidance. Fortunately, lingering in the temple and searching for ancient relics is a great pleasure. Here still remain 29 Song Dynasty cultural relics, 1 Yuan Dynasty, 8 Ming Dynasty, and 5 Qing Dynasty. Another very important point: Qingshuiyan Temple is the ancestral hall for Chinese people around the world who worship the Qingshui Ancestor Master. Currently there are over a thousand branch temples and shrines of the Qingshui Ancestor Master around the world, with the Taiwan region accounting for half of them, fully illustrating the important position of Qingshuiyan.

projects.content_zh: 安溪文庙，俗称孔庙，"居县城东南，背依凤山，前滨龙津，名冠八闽"，即便是在经济快速发展的福建的今天，安溪文庙的环境也算是周边县市中最好的。安溪文庙最早的年代可以追溯到北宋咸平四年（1001年）。绍兴十二年（1142年），迁今址；咸淳元年（1265年）重修大成殿及两庑廊；元至正十四年（1354年）毁于兵燹；明洪武十年（1381年）重建；嘉靖三十九年（1560年）再毁于倭寇；万历三十九年（1611年）修大成殿东西庑；清初又战乱复毁；康熙二十五年（1686年），康熙重臣李光地参与了本县重建；乾隆二十年和咸丰十一年又加以维修，清光绪二十四年重修。一路下来三十多次的维修、重建、增建，其中又以李光地的参与最为令人瞩目。文庙坐北朝南，遥望笔架山，前有泮池，复有照墙和棂星门围合成的前埕，左右"起凤"、"腾蛟"石牌楼，周围朴素庄严的石栅。面对照壁的棂星门则主体三间，两翼门房各一间，额上斗拱斜拱交织，类似北方如意斗拱做法。中轴线上下一进则为戟门，与两翼通檐，脊分三段，斗拱壮硕，不施斜拱，做法与棂星门迥异，内外各施二根蟠龙立柱。再内即主要建筑大成殿，重檐歇山，四根龙柱，殿前丹墀，殿内藻井，气势颇为磅礴。大成殿后尚有崇圣殿，崇圣殿东侧还有训导廨、教谕廨，廨前为明伦堂，形成一个庞大建筑群。
projects.content_en: Anxi Confucian Temple, commonly called the Confucius Temple, "located southeast of the county seat, backed by Fengshan Mountain, fronting Longjin River, renowned throughout the Eight Min (Fujian)" — even in today's rapidly developing Fujian, the environment of Anxi Confucian Temple can be considered the best among surrounding counties and cities. The earliest date of Anxi Confucian Temple can be traced back to the fourth year of Xianping reign of the Northern Song (1001). In the 12th year of Shaoxing reign (1142), it was moved to the present site; in the first year of Xianchun reign (1265), the Dacheng Hall and both side galleries were repaired; in the 14th year of Zhizheng reign of the Yuan (1354), it was destroyed by war; in the 10th year of Hongwu reign of the Ming (1381), it was rebuilt; in the 39th year of Jiajing reign (1560), it was again destroyed by Japanese pirates; in the 39th year of Wanli reign (1611), the east and west side galleries of the Dacheng Hall were repaired; in the early Qing it was again destroyed by war; in the 25th year of Kangxi reign (1686), Li Guangdi, an important minister of Kangxi, participated in the county's reconstruction; in the 20th year of Qianlong and the 11th year of Xianfeng it was further repaired, and in the 24th year of Guangxu reign of the Qing it was rebuilt. All in all, over thirty repairs, reconstructions, and expansions, among which Li Guangdi's participation is the most eye-catching. The Confucian Temple faces south, looking toward Bijia Mountain (Pen Rack Mountain), with a Pan Pond in front, and a front courtyard enclosed by a screen wall and Lingxing Gate; on the left and right are the "Qifeng" (Rising Phoenix) and "Tengjiao" (Soaring Dragon) stone memorial archways, surrounded by simple and solemn stone fences. The Lingxing Gate facing the screen wall has a main body of three bays, with one gate room on each wing, with dougong and diagonal brackets interwoven above the lintel, similar to the northern ruyi dougong practice. The next entry along the central axis is the Halberd Gate, with connected eaves on both wings, the ridge divided into three sections, with robust dougong without diagonal brackets, a practice quite different from the Lingxing Gate, with two dragon-coiled columns applied both inside and outside. Further in is the main building Dacheng Hall, with double-eave hip-and-gable roof, four dragon columns, a red stone platform (danqi) in front, and a caisson ceiling inside, with quite a majestic momentum. Behind the Dacheng Hall there is also the Chongsheng Hall; east of the Chongsheng Hall there are also the Xun Dao (Instruction) Office and the Jiao Yu (Teaching) Office, with the Minglun Hall in front of the offices, forming a huge building complex.

projects.name: 东关桥
projects.address: 永春县东关镇东美村湖洋溪
projects.address_en: Huyang Stream, Dongmei Village, Dongguan Town, Yongchun County
highlights: 木桥结构
睡木沉基
凭吊
东关桥又叫通仙桥早在南宋绍兴十五年公元1145年便有此桥了
明弘治十三年1500年在桥上建造20间木廊屋用以抵御雨水浸蚀桥板和便利行人歇脚
明正德三年1508年在桥上砌砖为路列椅两旁并在桥头用地产黏土青瓦搭盖雨遮
清同治七年1868年重修
桥的主体结构则应是南宋以来无多变化的
桥有二台四墩五孔
每个桥墩都用石条逐层丁顺搭配砌筑造如船形两头俱尖以分水势
墩下以大松木作卧桩承载整座桥梁古称睡木沉基
在冬天枯水期水位降低能透过清澈的溪水看见桥墩下面压着的松木
墩上用巨石叠涩出挑三层支架木结构卧梁
每个桥孔22根长16米至18米的特大杉木铺设上下两层每根梁直径30厘米至40厘米
再上则以砖石砌墙用木料做廊屋梁架桥板护栏凡26间
这样全长85米宽5米闽南绝无仅有的长廊屋梁式木桥便舒展在那里了
projects.content_zh: 东关桥又叫"通仙桥"，早在南宋绍兴十五年（公元1145年）便有此桥了；明弘治十三年（1500年），在桥上建造20间木廊屋，用以抵御雨水浸蚀桥板和便利行人歇脚；明正德三年（1508年），在桥上"砌砖为路，列椅两旁"，并在桥头用地产黏土青瓦搭盖雨遮；清同治七年（1868年）重修。桥的主体结构则应是南宋以来无多变化的。桥有二台、四墩、五孔。每个桥墩都用石条逐层丁顺搭配砌筑，造如船形，两头俱尖，以分水势；墩下以大松木作卧桩，承载整座桥梁，古称"睡木沉基"，在冬天枯水期水位降低，能透过清澈的溪水看见桥墩下面压着的松木；墩上用巨石叠涩出挑三层，支架木结构卧梁——每个桥孔22根长16米至18米的特大杉木铺设上下两层，每根梁直径30厘米至40厘米；再上则以砖石砌墙，用木料做廊屋梁架、桥板、护栏，凡26间。这样，全长85米、宽5米，闽南绝无仅有的长廊屋梁式木桥便舒展在那里了。
projects.content_en: Dongguan Bridge is also called "Tongxian Bridge" (Bridge to the Immortals); as early as the 15th year of Shaoxing reign of the Southern Song (1145 AD), this bridge already existed; in the 13th year of Hongzhi reign of the Ming (1500), 20 timber corridor houses were built on the bridge to resist rain erosion of the bridge deck and facilitate pedestrians resting their feet; in the third year of Zhengde reign of the Ming (1508), bricks were laid as a road on the bridge with chairs lined on both sides, and rain shelters were built at the bridgehead using local clay and blue tiles; it was repaired in the seventh year of Tongzhi reign of the Qing (1868). The main structure of the bridge should have remained largely unchanged since the Southern Song. The bridge has two abutments, four piers, and five openings. Each pier is built with stone strips laid alternately in ding (perpendicular) and shun (parallel) patterns layer by layer, shaped like a boat, pointed at both ends, to divide the water flow; under the piers, large pine logs are used as horizontal piles to bear the entire bridge, anciently called "sleeping timber sunken foundation"; in winter when the water level drops during the dry season, one can see the pine logs pressed under the piers through the clear stream water; on the piers, huge stones are corbelled out in three layers to support the timber structure horizontal beams — each bridge opening has 22 extra-large fir logs 16 to 18 meters long laid in two upper and lower layers, each beam 30 to 40 centimeters in diameter; further up, bricks and stones are used to build walls, and timber is used for the corridor house beam frames, bridge deck, and guardrails, totaling 26 bays. Thus, with a total length of 85 meters and width of 5 meters, the unique long corridor roof-beam timber bridge in southern Fujian stretches out there.

projects.name: 文庙
projects.address: 永春县桃城镇桃城路40号
projects.address_en: No. 40 Taocheng Road, Taocheng Town, Yongchun County
highlights: 格局
木结构
砖石做法
永春文庙始建于宋庆历年间1041至1048年最初建在东渡东岳桥西
历经宋元明七次迁址到明嘉靖四十四年1556年以后才在县城中部现址固定下来
现在的永春文庙是清代乾隆五十年1785年的建筑
整座建筑群坐南朝北呈中轴线对称结构
原来在东西两侧还有明伦堂和奉祀先贤的祠堂试院
试院可容纳2000名考生考试可见当时规模之宏大
现已辟为永春县博物馆
永春文庙坐北朝南前照壁用花岗岩和红砖砌成对面是花岗岩结构的棂星门及二腋门
入门则为半圆形的泮池其上架一座两墩三孔的拱桥
过桥为大成门即核心院落之大门
大成殿是文庙的核心建筑前有月台重檐歇山屋顶面阔五间进深五间
斗拱飞檐雕梁画栋正面廊檐有四根蟠龙石柱
大成殿悬挂有清朝康熙皇帝御书万世师表匾额
大殿之后还有明伦堂基本保持原貌
而其仰高楼启圣祠则为原址复建而成用作展厅
projects.content_zh: 永春文庙始建于宋庆历年间（1041—1048年），最初建在东渡（东岳）桥西，历经宋、元、明七次迁址，到明嘉靖四十四年（1556年）以后，才在县城中部现址固定下来。现在的永春文庙是清代乾隆五十年（1785年）的建筑，整座建筑群坐南朝北，呈中轴线对称结构。原来在东西两侧还有明伦堂和奉祀先贤的祠堂、试院。试院可容纳2000名考生考试。可见当时规模之宏大。现已辟为永春县博物馆。永春文庙坐北朝南，前照壁用花岗岩和红砖砌成，对面是花岗岩结构的棂星门及二腋门。入门则为半圆形的泮池，其上架一座两墩三孔的拱桥；过桥为大成门，即核心院落之大门。大成殿是文庙的核心建筑，前有月台，重檐歇山屋顶，面阔五间，进深五间，斗拱飞檐，雕梁画栋，正面廊檐有四根蟠龙石柱，大成殿悬挂有清朝康熙皇帝御书"万世师表"匾额。大殿之后还有明伦堂，基本保持原貌；而其"仰高楼"、"启圣祠"则为原址复建而成，用作展厅。
projects.content_en: Yongchun Confucian Temple was first built during the Qingli reign of the Song (1041–1048), originally built west of the Dongdu (Dongyue) Bridge, and经历 seven relocations during the Song, Yuan, and Ming dynasties; after the 44th year of Jiajing reign of the Ming (1556), it was finally fixed at the present site in the central part of the county town. The present Yongchun Confucian Temple is a building from the 50th year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1785), with the entire building complex facing south, in a symmetrical structure along the central axis. Originally on the east and west sides there were also the Minglun Hall, shrines enshrining former sages, and an examination hall. The examination hall could accommodate 2,000 candidates taking exams, showing the grand scale at that time. It has now been converted into the Yongchun County Museum. Yongchun Confucian Temple faces south, with the front screen wall built of granite and red bricks, and opposite is the granite-structured Lingxing Gate and two side gates. Entering the gate is a semicircular Pan Pond, over which spans a two-pier three-opening arch bridge; crossing the bridge is the Dacheng Gate, the gate of the core courtyard. The Dacheng Hall is the core building of the Confucian Temple, with a moon platform in front, a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, five bays wide and five bays deep, with dougong and flying eaves, carved beams and painted rafters, and four dragon-coiled stone columns on the front corridor eaves; the Dacheng Hall hangs the plaque "Teacher of Ten Thousand Generations" in the imperial calligraphy of the Kangxi Emperor of the Qing. Behind the main hall there is also the Minglun Hall, basically maintaining its original appearance; while its "Yanggao Tower" and "Qisheng Shrine" were rebuilt on the original site and used as exhibition halls.

projects.name: 新坂堂
projects.address: 永春县桃城镇洋上村
projects.address_en: Yangshang Village, Taocheng Town, Yongchun County
highlights: 民居格局
乡愁
爱读余光中的乡愁却没有去余光中的故乡
所以没有搞清楚那里到底叫作鼎新堂还是新坂堂只知道网络上地址信息是相同的
网络上的信息也与其他闽南民居没有什么差别
清代始建由门庭正门正厅东西护厝组成
有厅堂房间40间穿斗式木构架单檐歇山顶
正立面以红砖装饰门斗以花岗岩辉绿岩镶嵌屋面铺以灰瓦
正脊堆塑有动物人物卷草花卉图案等
木梁枋雀替窗户饰有镏金浮雕
还有红砖黑瓦雕梁翘脊
能够成为重要的文物保护单位有赖于余先生的盛名吧或许诗人本无意乡人自重之
余先生曾经在2003年9月2011年10月和2013年12月三次回乡
不知诗人是否如我一样反复玩味门前花岗岩石板上的那副对联世事无乖天地阔心田有种子孙耕
人立于天地之间最难得的是世代人格的传承一代人的名利又能福荫多久呢
未来是子孙的唯有精神财富才是千秋享用不尽的
projects.content_zh: 爱读余光中的《乡愁》，却没有去余光中的故乡，所以没有搞清楚那里到底叫作"鼎新堂"还是"新坂堂"，只知道网络上地址信息是相同的。网络上的信息也与其他闽南民居没有什么差别："清代始建，由门庭、正门、正厅、东西护厝组成。有厅堂、房间40间，穿斗式木构架，单檐歇山顶。正立面以红砖装饰，门斗以花岗岩、辉绿岩镶嵌，屋面铺以灰瓦，正脊堆塑有动物、人物、卷草、花卉图案等。木梁枋、雀替、窗户饰有镏金浮雕"。还有"红砖、黑瓦、雕梁、翘脊"。能够成为重要的文物保护单位，有赖于余先生的盛名吧。或许诗人本无意，乡人自重之。余先生曾经在2003年9月、2011年10月和2013年12月三次回乡，不知诗人是否如我一样反复玩味门前花岗岩石板上的那副对联："世事无乖天地阔，心田有种子孙耕（图7-7-3-03）。"人立于天地之间最难得的是世代人格的传承，一代人的名利，又能福荫多久呢？未来是子孙的，唯有精神财富才是千秋享用不尽的。
projects.content_en: I love reading Yu Guangzhong's "Nostalgia," but have not been to Yu Guangzhong's hometown, so I have not figured out whether it is called "Dingxin Hall" or "Xinban Hall" there, only knowing that the address information online is the same. The information online is also no different from other southern Fujian vernacular dwellings: "First built in the Qing Dynasty, composed of a gate courtyard, main gate, main hall, and east and west side wings. There are 40 halls and rooms, with a chuandou (column-and-tie) timber frame and a single-eave hip-and-gable roof. The front facade is decorated with red bricks, the gate斗 is inlaid with granite and diabase, the roof is covered with gray tiles, and the main ridge has piled sculptures of animals, figures, scrolling grass, and flower patterns. Timber beams, sparrow brackets (queti), and windows are decorated with gilded relief carvings." There is also "red bricks, black tiles, carved beams, and upturned ridges." Being able to become an important cultural heritage protection unit relies on Mr. Yu's fame, I suppose. Perhaps the poet had no such intention, but the townspeople value it themselves. Mr. Yu returned to his hometown three times, in September 2003, October 2011, and December 2013; I wonder if the poet, like me, repeatedly savored the couplet on the granite stone slab in front of the door: "Worldly affairs have no contradictions, heaven and earth are broad; the heart field has seeds, descendants cultivate them." What is rarest for a person standing between heaven and earth is the inheritance of generation-after-generation character; how long can the fame and wealth of one generation bless descendants? The future belongs to descendants; only spiritual wealth can be enjoyed endlessly for a thousand autumns.

projects.name: 巽来庄
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 永春县五里街仰贤村
projects.address_en: Yangxian Village, Wulijie Town, Yongchun County
highlights: 土楼形式
木结构
夯土工艺
用万国梯航万国衣冠之类的词语形容古代的泉州那是丝毫不过分的
或许正是这种开放的传统土楼堡垒一样的民居在泉州一带并不多见
永春巽来庄这座方形土楼是清朝盐官林悠凤于乾隆丁酉年1777年所建
又名山美土楼永春土楼其实更似闽西北土堡
盐官钱多亦为后迁入户更或整天担心着盗匪
而土楼之内则是闽南典型的居民建筑基本上可以说就是一座土楼外皮之内的闽南大厝
先说围墙土楼围墙内是二层防御设施木结构回廊联络通高9.5米
墙体本身下层2.5米厚用花岗岩和卵石砌筑
上层用夯土墙掺有石竹枝桠呈灰黄色厚0.8米
墙上窗下有射孔墙上东西南三面开楼门
南门为正嵌巽来庄匾东门挹翠西门迎春
再说内厝由南向北依次为上带镂窗的红砖六雀墙石墁天井大厅和后院
两边有东西厢房另外还有古井和马厩厕池等古老设施
正厅悬山顶木结构用抬梁穿斗混合构架
正厅廊柱略成梭形颇有古意柱础则辉绿岩精心雕刻而成
柱枋饰有精美的人物故事和花鸟走兽雕刻
庄内供奉神农
projects.content_zh: 用"万国梯航"、"万国衣冠"之类的词语形容古代的泉州，那是丝毫不过分的；或许正是这种开放的传统，土楼堡垒一样的民居在泉州一带并不多见。永春巽来庄这座方形土楼是清朝盐官林悠凤于乾隆丁酉年（1777年）所建，又名山美土楼、永春土楼，其实更似闽西北土堡。盐官钱多，亦为后迁入户，更或整天担心着盗匪。而土楼之内，则是闽南典型的居民建筑，基本上可以说就是一座土楼外皮之内的闽南大厝。先说围墙。土楼围墙内是二层防御设施，木结构，回廊联络，通高9.5米。墙体本身下层2.5米厚，用花岗岩和卵石砌筑；上层用夯土墙，掺有石竹枝桠，呈灰黄色，厚0.8米。墙上窗，下有射孔。墙上东、西、南三面开楼门。南门为正，嵌"巽来庄"匾（图7-7-4-02），东门"挹翠"，西门"迎春"。再说内厝。由南向北依次为上带镂窗的红砖"六雀墙"、石墁天井、大厅和后院；两边有东西厢房，另外还有古井和马厩、厕池等古老设施（图7-7-4-04）。正厅悬山顶，木结构用抬梁穿斗混合构架。正厅廊柱略成梭形，颇有古意，柱础则辉绿岩精心雕刻而成，柱枋饰有精美的人物故事和花鸟走兽雕刻。庄内供奉神农。
projects.content_en: Using terms like "ten thousand countries' ladders and ships" and "ten thousand countries' clothes and hats" to describe ancient Quanzhou is not at all excessive; perhaps it is precisely this open tradition that fortress-like tulou dwellings are rare in the Quanzhou area. This square tulou, Xunlai House in Yongchun, was built in the Dingyou year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1777) by Lin Youfeng, a salt official of the Qing, also known as Shanmei Tulou and Yongchun Tulou; in fact it is more like a tulou (fortified dwelling) of northwestern Fujian. Salt officials had much money, were also later immigrants, and perhaps worried about bandits all day long. Inside the tulou, however, are typical southern Fujian residential buildings; basically it can be said to be a southern Fujian large mansion within a tulou outer skin. First, the surrounding wall. Inside the tulou's surrounding wall are two-story defensive facilities, timber structure, with corridors connecting, with a total height of 9.5 meters. The wall itself is 2.5 meters thick in the lower layer, built with granite and cobblestones; the upper layer uses rammed earth walls, mixed with stone and bamboo branches, grayish-yellow in color, 0.8 meters thick. There are windows on the wall and arrow slits below. Building gates are opened on the east, west, and south sides of the wall. The south gate is the main one, inlaid with the plaque "Xunlai House" (Figure 7-7-4-02), the east gate is "Yicui" (Gathering Green), and the west gate is "Yingchun" (Welcoming Spring). Next, the inner dwelling. From south to north are依次 the red brick "Six Sparrow Wall" with carved windows above, a stone-paved courtyard, the main hall, and the backyard; on both sides are east and west wing rooms, and there are also ancient facilities such as an old well, stable, and cesspool (Figure 7-7-4-04). The main hall has an overhanging gable roof (xuanshan), with a timber structure using a mixed tailiang (beam-lifting) and chuandou (column-and-tie) frame. The main hall's corridor columns are slightly spindle-shaped, quite ancient in feel, while the column bases are carefully carved from diabase, and the columns and beams are decorated with exquisite carvings of figure stories, flowers, birds, and beasts. The house enshrines Shennong (the Divine Farmer).

projects.name: 山后连氏祠堂
projects.name_en: Lian's Ancestral Hall on the Foot of Mountain
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 德化县国宝乡格头村
projects.address_en: Getou Village, Guobao Township, Dehua County
highlights: 格局
木结构与特色装饰
虽然不知道连战先生是否在此一宗但这位国民党荣誉主席的题词当使山后连氏祠堂更播声名
虽然猜想着德化起伏的山地中一定留有一些特殊的传统建筑但是看到连氏祠堂的时候还是不免惊诧一番
掩映在茂密竹影当中的居然不是常见的大厝甚至不是泉州地区少见的土楼
而是一座根本没有料到会出现在福建的吊脚楼
但回想起一路而来的蜿蜒山路想起要防潮防洪防野兽吊脚楼的存在倒变得顺理成章的了
只是猜不透古时工匠们辛苦奔波的路径
连氏这一片故居被称为山后祖即祖屋之意
由连氏五世祖山公海公辂公三兄弟建于明正德初年1505年
坐南朝北由主楼赞楼阳庭品字池等组成
主楼为歇山式二层木瓦结构楼堂底楼架空零星放着捣米台大水桶等一些杂物
沿梯上楼二层为四房一厅加护厝的五开间结构
堂中厅上安放着连氏祖先牌位采用穿斗式梁架悬山顶屋顶铺瓦
还要赞美当地的景色颠簸自有颠簸的回报
山峦兀立绿水蜿蜒竹木丰茂已经是最普通的形容了但也已经是城市人最奢望的体验
不用附会什么仙人照镜燕巢形胜之类的辞藻那只会把我们从体会自然仙境的感受拉回到人间
projects.content_zh: 虽然不知道连战先生是否在此一宗，但这位国民党荣誉主席的题词当使山后连氏祠堂更播声名。虽然猜想着德化起伏的山地中一定留有一些特殊的传统建筑，但是看到连氏祠堂的时候还是不免惊诧一番。掩映在茂密竹影当中的，居然不是常见的大厝，甚至不是泉州地区少见的土楼，而是一座根本没有料到会出现在福建的吊脚楼。但回想起一路而来的蜿蜒山路，想起要防潮、防洪、防野兽，吊脚楼的存在倒变得顺理成章的了，只是猜不透古时工匠们辛苦奔波的路径。连氏这一片故居被称为"山后祖"，即祖屋之意，由连氏五世祖山公、海公、辂公三兄弟建于明正德初年（1505年）。坐南朝北，由主楼、赞楼、阳庭、品字池等组成。主楼为歇山式二层木瓦结构楼堂，底楼架空，零星放着捣米台、大水桶等一些杂物；沿梯上楼，二层为四房一厅加护厝的五开间结构，堂中厅上安放着连氏祖先牌位，采用穿斗式梁架，悬山顶，屋顶铺瓦。还要赞美当地的景色。颠簸自有颠簸的回报。山峦兀立，绿水蜿蜒，竹木丰茂，已经是最普通的形容了，但也已经是城市人最奢望的体验。不用附会什么"仙人照镜"、"燕巢形胜"之类的辞藻，那只会把我们从体会自然仙境的感受拉回到人间。
projects.content_en: Although I do not know whether Mr. Lien Chan belongs to this clan, the inscription by this Honorary Chairman of the Kuomintang should make the Shanhou Lian Clan Ancestral Hall even more famous. Although I guessed that the undulating mountainous terrain of Dehua must retain some special traditional buildings, I was still quite surprised when I saw the Lian Clan Ancestral Hall. Hidden among dense bamboo shadows, it is actually not the common large mansion (dacuo), nor even the rare tulou in the Quanzhou region, but a stilt house (diaojiaolou) that I never expected to appear in Fujian. But recalling the winding mountain road along the way, and thinking about the need for moisture protection, flood prevention, and wild animal defense, the existence of the stilt house becomes quite logical; I just cannot figure out the paths that ancient craftsmen traveled with such hardship. This former residence of the Lian clan is called "Shanhou Zu," meaning ancestral house, built by three brothers — the fifth-generation ancestors of the Lian clan, Lord Shan, Lord Hai, and Lord Lu — in the early Zhengde reign of the Ming (1505). Facing south, it is composed of the main building, auxiliary building, sunny courtyard, and character-pin (品) shaped pond. The main building is a two-story timber-tile structure hall in the hip-and-gable style, with the ground floor elevated on stilts, sparsely placed with some杂物 such as rice-pounding platforms and large water buckets; climbing the stairs to the second floor, it is a five-bay structure of four rooms and one hall plus side wings; in the central hall of the hall are placed the ancestral tablets of the Lian clan, using a chuandou (column-and-tie) beam frame, with an overhanging gable roof (xuanshan), and the roof is covered with tiles. One must also praise the local scenery. Bumps have their own rewards. Standing mountains, winding green waters, lush bamboo and trees — these are already the most ordinary descriptions, but they are also the most coveted experience for city dwellers. There is no need to attach fancy terms like "Immortal Looking in the Mirror" or "Swallow Nest Scenic Beauty," which would only pull us back from the experience of a natural fairyland to the human world.

projects.name: 黄素石楼
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 泉港区前黄镇涂楼村
projects.address_en: Tulou Village, Qianhuang Town, Quangang District
highlights: 石楼形式
结构工艺
装饰做法
在泉州泉港区涂楼村的一群古厝的中间坐东朝西地屹立着一幢石楼
楼的下两层由花岗岩条石砌筑磨石对缝平整均匀只见缝线不见灰浆
第三层由石灰抹壁而成
造型奇特之处还有四角石砌哨楼凸出于墙壁上留射孔下以半混石条交错出挑
这座黄素石楼俗称土楼又名定楼建于清乾隆六年1741年
是当地人黄素黄堂官父子历时三十多年建成的
土楼高9.4米长宽各20.8米墙壁厚度0.73米至1.4米
楼内构屋36间沿墙环屋72间
楼下仅在西面设一拱形石门门头匾额题式好攸宁四字落乾隆六年岁次字样
外门板包铁皮以防备盗贼火攻
其内再设两重内门中门为铁闸门框上方还设有水槽
从楼内水井可随时汲水灭火防御严密
石楼之内有开井周围厢房回廊年久失修复文革破坏今徒四壁唯可辨认环楼72廊房
从楼上远眺可见泉港海湾片片航帆周边良田万顷
颇疑乾隆初年建设如此坚固的堡垒的初衷也想考察黄氏一族的真正来历
旅行间在意想不到的地方看到意想不到的建筑不正是绝大的收获吗
projects.content_zh: 在泉州泉港区涂楼村的一群古厝的中间，坐东朝西地屹立着一幢石楼。楼的下两层由花岗岩条石砌筑，磨"石"对缝，平整均匀，只见缝线，不见灰浆。第三层由石灰抹壁而成。造型奇特之处还有四角石砌哨楼，凸出于墙壁，上留射孔，下以半混石条交错出挑。这座"黄素石楼"俗称"土楼"，又名"定楼"，建于清乾隆六年（1741年），是当地人黄素、黄堂官父子历时三十多年建成的。土楼高9.4米，长、宽各20.8米，墙壁厚度0.73米至1.4米。楼内构屋36间，沿墙环屋72间。楼下仅在西面设一拱形石门，门头匾额题"式好攸宁"四字，落"乾隆六年岁次"字样。外门板包铁皮，以防备盗贼火攻，其内再设两重内门，中门为铁闸，门框上方还设有水槽，从楼内水井可随时汲水灭火，防御严密。石楼之内有开井，周围厢房回廊，年久失修，复"文革"破坏，今徒四壁，唯可辨认环楼72廊房。从楼上远眺，可见泉港海湾片片航帆，周边良田万顷。颇疑乾隆初年建设如此坚固的堡垒的初衷，也想考察黄氏一族的真正来历。旅行间在意想不到的地方看到意想不到的建筑，不正是绝大的收获吗？
projects.content_en: In the middle of a group of ancient mansions in Tulou Village, Qianhuang Town, Quangang District, Quanzhou, a stone building stands facing west from the east. The lower two stories of the building are built with granite strip stones, ground and fitted against each other, flat and even, with only seams visible and no mortar. The third story is finished with lime plaster. Another peculiar feature of its shape is the four corner stone sentry towers, protruding from the walls, with arrow slits above and semi-circular stone strips交错 corbelling below. This "Huangsu Stone Building," commonly called "Tulou" (Earthen Building) and also known as "Dinglou" (Firm Building), was built in the sixth year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1741), completed over more than thirty years by local people Huang Su and his son Huang Tangguan. The tulou is 9.4 meters high, 20.8 meters long and wide, with wall thickness from 0.73 to 1.4 meters. Inside the building there are 36 rooms, with 72 rooms ringing along the walls. On the ground floor, only an arched stone gate is set on the west side; the plaque above the gate is inscribed with the four characters "Shi Hao You Ning" (Goodness and Peace), with the inscription "In the sixth year of Qianlong" below. The outer door panel is wrapped in iron sheet to guard against thieves and fire attacks; inside it are two more inner doors, with the middle door being an iron gate, and a water trough is also set above the door frame, allowing water to be drawn from the well inside the building at any time to extinguish fires, with严密 defenses. Inside the stone building there is an open well, with surrounding wing rooms and corridors; due to long-term disrepair and further damage during the "Cultural Revolution," today only four walls remain, with only the 72 corridor rooms around the building identifiable. Looking into the distance from upstairs, one can see sails dotting Quangang Bay and vast fertile fields around. One quite suspects the original intention of building such a strong fortress in the early Qianlong reign, and also wishes to investigate the true origins of the Huang clan. Seeing unexpected buildings in unexpected places during travel — isn't that exactly a great harvest?

projects.name: 沙格灵慈宫
projects.address: 泉州市泉港区南埔镇沙格村
projects.address_en: Shage Village, Nanpu Town, Quangang District, Quanzhou
highlights: 寺院格局
木结构
沙格只是湄洲湾南岸泉港的一座小渔村
这里的热闹在于龙舟赛泉港各乡镇都会来
而当地人心灵的安慰在于妈祖出渔或航海必得有她的保佑
沙格灵慈宫始建于元至正年间1341至1368年奉祀海神妈祖
至明末清初因协助郑成功抗清复明沙格村遭清兵洗劫妈祖庙也遭受严重破坏
直至清嘉庆十四年公元1809年圣母庙始得大加修缮终于形成了延续至今的格局正式冠名灵慈宫
后来还经历了光绪年间的大修
宫坐北朝南并不十分宏大只一进院落由山门拜亭两厢和大殿组成
山门重檐歇山顶面阔5间进深2间龙柱石牲屋脊泥塑等均为闽南典型的地方工艺
拜亭由蟠龙石柱支架作重檐歇山顶正中为八角藻井
大殿重檐歇山顶面阔五间进深三间抬梁式木构斗拱精巧
但并不似常见的北方清代斗拱般琐碎
神龛上悬清乾隆四十七年1782惠安知县所书海天元后匾
灵慈宫屋顶的翘脊和冲角表面采用瓷碗碎块拼装成各种图案为闽南常用的剪碗做法
projects.content_zh: 沙格只是湄洲湾南岸泉港的一座小渔村。这里的热闹在于龙舟赛，泉港各乡镇都会来。而当地人心灵的安慰在于妈祖，出渔或航海，必得有她的保佑。沙格灵慈宫始建于元至正年间（1341—1368年），奉祀海神妈祖。至明末清初，因协助郑成功抗清复明，沙格村遭清兵洗劫，妈祖庙也遭受严重破坏。直至清嘉庆十四年（公元1809年）圣母庙始得大加修缮，终于形成了延续至今的格局，正式冠名"灵慈宫"。后来还经历了光绪年间的大修。宫坐北朝南，并不十分宏大，只一进院落，由山门、拜亭、两厢和大殿组成。山门，重檐歇山顶，面阔5间，进深2间，龙柱、石牲、屋脊泥塑等均为闽南典型的地方工艺。拜亭由蟠龙石柱支架作重檐歇山顶，正中为八角藻井。大殿重檐歇山顶，面阔五间，进深三间，抬梁式木构，斗拱精巧，但并不似常见的北方清代斗拱般琐碎，神龛上悬清乾隆四十七年（1782）惠安知县所书"海天元后"匾。灵慈宫屋顶的翘脊和冲角，表面采用瓷碗碎块拼装成各种图案，为闽南常用的"剪碗做法"。
projects.content_en: Shage is just a small fishing village in Quangang on the south bank of Meizhou Bay. Its liveliness lies in dragon boat races, with all towns and townships in Quangang coming to participate. And the spiritual comfort of the locals lies in Mazu; when going fishing or sailing, they must have her blessing. Shage Lingci Temple was first built during the Zhizheng reign of the Yuan (1341–1368), enshrining the sea goddess Mazu. By the late Ming and early Qing, due to assisting Zheng Chenggong in resisting the Qing and restoring the Ming, Shage Village was looted by Qing troops, and the Mazu Temple also suffered severe damage. It was not until the 14th year of Jiaqing reign of the Qing (1809 AD) that the Holy Mother Temple received major repairs, finally forming the pattern that continues to this day, and was officially named "Lingci Temple" (Temple of Numinous Compassion). It later also underwent a major repair during the Guangxu reign. The temple faces south, not very large, with only one courtyard, composed of the mountain gate, worship pavilion, two side wings, and the main hall. The mountain gate has a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, five bays wide and two bays deep, with dragon columns, stone sacrificial animals, and roof ridge clay sculptures all being typical local crafts of southern Fujian. The worship pavilion is supported by dragon-coiled stone columns with a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, with an octagonal caisson ceiling in the center. The main hall has a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, five bays wide and three bays deep, with a tailiang (beam-lifting) timber structure and exquisite dougong, but not as fussy as the common northern Qing dougong; above the shrine hangs the plaque "Haitian Yuanhou" (Primordial Empress of Sea and Sky) written by the Hui'an County Magistrate in the 47th year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1782). The upturned ridges and projecting corners of Lingci Temple's roof use broken porcelain bowl pieces assembled into various patterns on the surface, a commonly used "jianwan" (cut-bowl) technique in southern Fujian.

projects.name: 胡里口炮台
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 厦门市厦门岛东南海岬
projects.address_en: Southeast headland of Xiamen Island, Xiamen
highlights: 石结构
面向大海船行如织
胡里口炮台台建于清光绪十七年至二十二年1891至1896年
占地1.1万多平方米主要功能区域包括炮台弹药库兵营和阅练场
最为核心的所在当然东西两大炮台
那是两座花岗岩砌筑的大型掩体
东炮台更是保留了当初装备的280毫米巨大口径的克虏伯大炮
这是一种固定的暴露式线膛后装式的海岸炮炮身可以调整瞄准方向
是导弹发明之前濒海战场上的重拳
东西炮台附近设置了小型弹药库营房和阅练场也在附近而大弹药库则设置在更北的位置
军事建筑的流线设计很是值得推敲的
今天的公园在1841年的夏天曾经是侵略军的屠戮场
后来炮台建设完成试射的震动甚至毁坏了远处的民房
到了1937年大炮真正派上了用场击沉了日舰打退了日本侵略军的舰队
天南锁匙一词已经没有了军事意义但是永远也不能从我们记忆的字典中抹去
projects.content_zh: 面向大海，船行如织。胡里口炮台台建于清光绪十七年至二十二年（1891—1896年），占地1.1万多平方米，主要功能区域包括炮台、弹药库、兵营和阅练场。最为核心的所在当然东西两大炮台。那是两座花岗岩砌筑的大型掩体，东炮台更是保留了当初装备的280毫米巨大口径的克虏伯大炮。这是一种固定的、暴露式、线膛后装式的海岸炮，炮身可以调整瞄准方向，是导弹发明之前濒海战场上的重拳。东西炮台附近设置了小型弹药库，营房和阅练场也在附近，而大弹药库则设置在更北的位置。军事建筑的流线设计很是值得推敲的。今天的公园在1841年的夏天曾经是侵略军的屠戮场，后来炮台建设完成，试射的震动甚至毁坏了远处的民房。到了1937年，大炮真正派上了用场，击沉了日舰，打退了日本侵略军的舰队。"天南锁匙"一词已经没有了军事意义，但是永远也不能从我们记忆的字典中抹去。
projects.content_en: Facing the sea, with ships passing like woven cloth. Hulikou Battery was built from the 17th to the 22nd year of Guangxu reign of the Qing (1891–1896), covering over 11,000 square meters, with main functional areas including the battery, ammunition depot, barracks, and parade ground. The most core locations are of course the two major east and west batteries. Those are two large shelters built of granite; the east battery even retains the originally equipped Krupp cannon with a huge 280mm caliber. This is a fixed, exposed, rifled breech-loading coastal gun, with the barrel adjustable for aiming direction, a heavy punch on coastal battlefields before the invention of missiles. Small ammunition depots were set near the east and west batteries, with barracks and parade grounds also nearby, while the large ammunition depot was set further north. The流线 design of military architecture is well worth deliberating. Today's park was once a slaughter field of invading troops in the summer of 1841; later, after the battery was completed, the vibration of test firing even damaged distant houses. By 1937, the cannons truly came into use, sinking Japanese warships and repelling the fleet of Japanese invading troops. The term "Key to the South of Heaven" no longer has military significance, but it can never be erased from the dictionary of our memory.

projects.name: 南普陀寺
projects.address: 厦门市厦门岛五老峰下
projects.address_en: At the foot of Wulao Peak, Xiamen Island, Xiamen
highlights: 寺院格局
木结构
凭吊
南普陀寺依山面海而建背靠着五老峰面向着南边的厦门大学
有点西方大学里教堂的味道唯一的缺憾是游人如织配合着中国大学的生意经
寺院规模宏大气势不凡
重要的建筑排列在中轴线上依次是天王殿大雄宝殿大悲殿藏经阁
其中天王殿位于寺院中轴线的最前端
前殿正中供奉笑容可掬的弥勒佛两侧立有怒目环视的四大天王
殿后有韦陀菩萨覆掌按杵而立是个典型的以殿代门的形制
大雄宝殿大悲殿建筑体量不小金妆得相当宏丽
藏经阁则以珍藏佛教文物为盛有经典佛像宋代铜钟古书等
其中明万历年间血书妙法莲华经和何朝宗名作白瓷观音等最为名贵
寺宇周围保留众多题刻著名的有明万历陈第沈有容题名石刻和清乾隆御制碑
寺后崖壁佛字石刻高一丈四尺宽一丈
寺后五峰屏立号五老凌霄是厦门八大景之一
南普陀寺始建于唐末五代初称泗洲院是闽南佛教圣地之一
现存为清康熙二十三年1684年靖海侯施琅收复台湾后驻镇厦门时捐资修复寺院旧观
又增建大悲阁奉观音菩萨更名为南普陀寺
此后数百年来经历多次重修扩建至民国初年已构成殿堂齐全的禅寺格局成为近代闽南最具规模的名刹
projects.content_zh: 南普陀寺依山面海而建，背靠着五老峰，面向着南边的厦门大学，有点西方大学里教堂的味道，唯一的缺憾是游人如织，配合着中国大学的生意经。寺院规模宏大，气势不凡。重要的建筑排列在中轴线上，依次是天王殿、大雄宝殿、大悲殿、藏经阁。其中，天王殿位于寺院中轴线的最前端。前殿正中供奉笑容可掬的弥勒佛，两侧立有怒目环视的四大天王，殿后有韦陀菩萨覆掌按杵而立，是个典型的以殿代门的形制。大雄宝殿、大悲殿建筑体量不小，金妆得相当宏丽。藏经阁则以珍藏佛教文物为盛，有经典、佛像、宋代铜钟、古书等，其中明万历年间血书《妙法莲华经》和何朝宗名作白瓷观音等最为名贵。寺宇周围保留众多题刻，著名的有明万历陈第、沈有容题名石刻和清乾隆御制碑寺后崖壁"佛"字石刻，高一丈四尺，宽一丈。寺后五峰屏立，号"五老凌霄"，是厦门八大景之一。南普陀寺始建于唐末五代，初称泗洲院，是闽南佛教圣地之一。现存为清康熙二十三年（1684年），靖海侯施琅收复台湾后驻镇厦门时捐资修复寺院旧观，又增建大悲阁奉观音菩萨，更名为南普陀寺。此后数百年来，经历多次重修扩建，至民国初年已构成殿堂齐全的禅寺格局，成为近代闽南最具规模的名刹。
projects.content_en: South Putuo Temple is built against the mountain and facing the sea, with its back against Wulao Peak (Five Elders Peak) and facing Xiamen University to the south, somewhat like a church in a Western university; the only regret is the crowds of tourists, matching the business ethos of Chinese universities. The temple is grand in scale and extraordinary in momentum. Important buildings are arranged along the central axis,依次 being the Hall of Heavenly Kings, Mahavira Hall, Great Compassion Hall, and Scripture Library. Among them, the Hall of Heavenly Kings is located at the foremost end of the temple's central axis. In the center of the front hall is enshrined the smiling Maitreya Buddha, with the Four Heavenly Kings with glaring eyes standing on both sides; behind the hall, Skanda Bodhisattva stands with palms covering and staff pressed, a typical form of using a hall as a gate. The Mahavira Hall and Great Compassion Hall are not small in building volume, quite magnificently gilded. The Scripture Library is rich in treasured Buddhist cultural relics, including scriptures, Buddha statues, Song Dynasty bronze bells, ancient books, etc.; among them, the blood-written "Lotus Sutra of the Wonderful Dharma" from the Wanli reign of the Ming and the famous white porcelain Guanyin by He Chaozong are the most precious. Around the temple buildings, many inscriptions are preserved; famous ones include the title inscriptions by Chen Di and Shen Yourong from the Wanli reign of the Ming and the imperial stele of the Qianlong reign of the Qing; on the cliff wall behind the temple is the stone carving of the character "Fo" (Buddha), one zhang four chi high and one zhang wide. Behind the temple, five peaks stand like a screen, called "Wulao Lingxiao" (Five Elders Reaching the Clouds), one of the Eight Great Scenes of Xiamen. South Putuo Temple was first built in the late Tang and Five Dynasties period, initially called Sizhou Courtyard, one of the Buddhist holy lands in southern Fujian. The existing buildings date from the 23rd year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1684), when Marquis Jinghai Shi Lang, after recovering Taiwan and stationed in Xiamen, donated funds to restore the temple's old appearance, and additionally built the Great Compassion Pavilion to enshrine Guanyin Bodhisattva, renaming it South Putuo Temple. Over the following hundreds of years, through multiple repairs and expansions, by the early Republican period it had formed a complete Zen temple layout with all halls, becoming the most规模 famous temple in modern southern Fujian.

projects.name: 青礁慈济祖宫
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 厦门市海沧区青礁村
projects.address_en: Qingjiao Village, Haicang District, Xiamen
highlights: 寺院格局
木结构
青礁慈济祖宫是供奉念保生大帝吴夲而兴建的
这位保生大帝原本是宋代闽南地区的神医后谥为医灵真人成为神祇
海澄县志中录载了南宋嘉定二年1209年的慈济宫碑作者是杨志
今正殿内尚存碑刻两通南宋嘉定碑和咸丰甲寅年重修慈济祖宫碑记
在南宋绍兴二十一年颜师鲁奏请立庙淳熙十二年彻旧而新之
即此宫经历了南宋淳熙十二年比较彻底的大修
到了清咸丰光绪年间又有重修之举现存建筑主要为晚清遗构
今天的青礁慈济宫入口处立起了新修的五开间石牌坊与慈济宫建筑群不在同一轴线上
2001年新修了文昌武帝二配院随后博物馆展览馆又次第起楼一派热闹的景象
慈济宫独立成院院落尺度紧凑
正殿五间重檐歇山顶
前廊柱透雕龙纹及花卉纹一层明间及次间外檐装木板门其余装石雕门窗
饰以高浮雕及透雕花纹内容为人物故事及花卉
其中东西次间中央漏窗透雕戏曲人物画面尤为生动有趣
二层皆装木隔扇雕花彩绘
正殿内柱皆用石柱明间廊下等处饰盘龙透雕梁架亦多浮雕髹金四架梁绘人物故事彩画
殿内油饰均近年重修彩画疑年代稍早或为清末重修所遗
慈济宫屋面装饰极繁复垂脊端头饰完整戏台人物为最具特色处
正脊作燕尾脊两端复为龙形
翼角起翘处亦为装饰重点饰以各色花卉甚琳琅
后殿山墙上有田字形花漏窗里外双层甚具装饰意味推测为透气之用
projects.content_zh: 青礁慈济祖宫是供奉念保生大帝吴夲而兴建的。这位保生大帝原本是宋代闽南地区的神医，后谥为医灵真人，成为神祇。《海澄县志》中录载了南宋嘉定二年（1209年）的《慈济宫碑》，作者是杨志。今正殿内尚存碑刻两通，南宋嘉定碑和咸丰甲寅年《重修慈济祖宫碑记》。在南宋绍兴二十一年，颜师鲁奏请立庙，淳熙十二年"彻旧而新之"，即此宫经历了南宋淳熙十二年比较彻底的大修，到了清咸丰、光绪年间又有重修之举，现存建筑主要为晚清遗构。今天的青礁慈济宫入口处立起了新修的五开间石牌坊，与慈济宫建筑群不在同一轴线上。2001年新修了文昌、武帝二配院，随后博物馆、展览馆又次第起楼，一派热闹的景象。慈济宫独立成院，院落尺度紧凑。正殿五间，重檐歇山顶。前廊柱透雕龙纹及花卉纹，一层明间及次间外檐装木板门，其余装石雕门窗，饰以高浮雕及透雕花纹，内容为人物故事及花卉。其中，东西次间中央漏窗透雕戏曲人物，画面尤为生动有趣。二层皆装木隔扇，雕花彩绘。正殿内柱皆用石柱，明间廊下等处饰盘龙透雕，梁架亦多浮雕髹金，四架梁绘人物故事彩画。殿内油饰均近年重修，彩画疑年代稍早，或为清末重修所遗。慈济宫屋面装饰极繁复，垂脊端头饰完整戏台人物，为最具特色处。正脊作燕尾脊，两端复为龙形。翼角起翘处亦为装饰重点，饰以各色花卉，甚琳琅。后殿山墙上有田字形花漏窗，里外双层，甚具装饰意味，推测为透气之用。
projects.content_en: Qingjiao Jizu Temple was built to enshrine Baosheng Dadi (Great Emperor of Life Protection) Wu Ben. This Baosheng Dadi was originally a divine doctor in the Minnan (southern Fujian) region during the Song Dynasty, later posthumously titled Yiling Zhenren (True Man of Medical Spirit), becoming a deity. The "Haicheng County Gazetteer" records the "Stele of Ciji Temple" from the second year of Jiading reign of the Southern Song (1209), authored by Yang Zhi. Today, two stele inscriptions still remain in the main hall: the Southern Song Jiading stele and the "Record of Repairing Ciji Ancestral Temple" from the Jiayin year of Xianfeng. In the 21st year of Shaoxing reign of the Southern Song, Yan Shilu petitioned to establish the temple; in the 12th year of Chunxi reign, it was "completely renewed," meaning this temple underwent a relatively thorough major repair in the 12th year of Chunxi reign of the Southern Song; by the Xianfeng and Guangxu reigns of the Qing, there were further repairs, and the existing buildings are mainly remains from the late Qing. Today, at the entrance of Qingjiao Ciji Temple, a newly repaired five-bay stone memorial archway has been erected, not on the same axis as the Ciji Temple building complex. In 2001, the two auxiliary halls of Wenchang (Literary Prosperity) and Wudi (Martial Emperor) were newly built; subsequently, museums and exhibition halls were built one after another, a scene of bustling activity. Ciji Temple forms an independent courtyard, with a compact courtyard scale. The main hall is five bays, with a double-eave hip-and-gable roof. The front corridor columns have openwork carvings of dragon patterns and flower patterns; on the first floor, the outer eaves of the central and secondary bays are fitted with wooden board doors, while the rest are fitted with stone-carved doors and windows, decorated with high-relief and openwork patterns, with content of figure stories and flowers. Among them, the central lattice windows of the east and west secondary bays have openwork carvings of opera figures, with particularly vivid and interesting scenes. The second floor is all fitted with wooden lattice doors, with carved flowers and colored paintings. The inner columns of the main hall are all stone columns; places such as under the central bay corridor are decorated with dragon openwork carvings, the beam frames are also mostly relief-carved and gilded, and the four-frame beams are painted with figure story colored paintings. The oil paint inside the hall was all repaired in recent years; the colored paintings are suspected to be slightly earlier in date, perhaps remnants from the late Qing repair. The roof decoration of Ciji Temple is extremely complex, with the ends of the vertical ridges decorated with complete opera stage figures, the most distinctive feature. The main ridge is a swallow-tail ridge, with both ends again in dragon form. The upturned wing corners are also decorative focuses, decorated with various flowers, quite resplendent. On the gable wall of the rear hall, there are tian-shaped (field-character) flower lattice windows, double-layered inside and outside, quite decorative, presumably for ventilation purposes.

projects.name: 集美寨遗址
projects.address: 厦门集美区集美学村
projects.address_en: Jimei School Village, Jimei District, Xiamen
highlights: 石构造
厦门市集美学村浔江海边有临海的游泳池一番优雅舒适的景色
在游泳池的北侧是一片整齐的石台阶
从石台阶中间的石径拾级而上到了顶端是集美中学校舍延平楼
楼前的大榕树下就是我们这一节的主角集美寨遗址
集美寨遗址只剩下了石寨门
集美寨的原名叫作浔尾寨是大陆通往厦门岛及同安之汛口要津自古以来也是海防军事重地
清康熙十八年1679年五月郑成功看到这里海礁密布易守难攻
如在此加强防卫设施则可与隔水相望的厦门岛北部禾山的高崎寨互为犄角扼控浔江海上通道
于是命部将刘国轩建造集美寨屯防驻守以加强厦门岛防务
全寨以花岗岩垒砌成为郑氏集团军事防御的前哨阵地
因郑成功受封延平王故此寨称延平故垒
到了1919年至1922年间爱国华侨领袖陈嘉庚选择了集美寨遗址作为集美小学校舍成为今天学村的前身
当时陈先生为纪念民族英雄郑成功将建成的三层校舍取名为延平楼
20世纪50年代后陈先生继续扩建集美学校美化校园举措包括了将寨门前的山坡坟地和滩涂改成石砌台阶和游泳池并且整修遗址
今天我们能看到经过整修的花岗岩条石叠砌的寨门和两侧残墙
寨门高3.08米宽1.68米厚0.65米
古今功用不同但不妨一同构成学子们锻炼和憩息的好去处
projects.content_zh: 厦门市集美学村浔江海边，有临海的游泳池，一番优雅舒适的景色。在游泳池的北侧，是一片整齐的石台阶。从石台阶中间的石径拾级而上，到了顶端，是集美中学校舍延平楼。楼前的大榕树下，就是我们这一节的主角集美寨遗址。集美寨遗址只剩下了石寨门。集美寨的原名叫作浔尾寨，是大陆通往厦门岛及同安之汛口要津，自古以来也是海防军事重地。清康熙十八年（1679年）五月，郑成功看到这里海礁密布、易守难攻，如在此加强防卫设施则可与隔水相望的厦门岛北部禾山的高崎寨互为犄角，扼控浔江海上通道，于是命部将刘国轩建造集美寨，屯防驻守，以加强厦门岛防务。全寨以花岗岩垒砌，成为郑氏集团军事防御的前哨阵地。因郑成功受封延平王，故此寨称"延平故垒"。到了1919年至1922年间，爱国华侨领袖陈嘉庚选择了集美寨遗址作为集美小学校舍，成为今天学村的前身。当时陈先生为纪念民族英雄郑成功，将建成的三层校舍取名为"延平楼"。20世纪50年代后，陈先生继续扩建集美学校、美化校园，举措包括了将寨门前的山坡坟地和滩涂改成石砌台阶和游泳池，并且整修遗址。今天我们能看到经过整修的花岗岩条石叠砌的寨门和两侧残墙。寨门高3.08米，宽1.68米，厚0.65米。古今功用不同，但不妨一同构成学子们锻炼和憩息的好去处。
projects.content_en: By the Xunjiang seaside in Jimei School Village, Xiamen, there is a seaside swimming pool, a scene of elegance and comfort. North of the swimming pool is a neat flight of stone steps. Climbing up the stone path in the middle of the stone steps, at the top is Yanping Building, the school building of Jimei Middle School. Under the large banyan tree in front of the building is the protagonist of this section, the Site of Jimei Stockade. Only the stone stockade gate remains at the Site of Jimei Stockade. Jimei Stockade was originally called Xunwei Stockade, a strategic ferry crossing from the mainland to Xiamen Island and Tong'an, and has also been an important coastal defense military site since ancient times. In the fifth month of the 18th year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1679), Zheng Chenggong saw that the sea reefs here were dense and the place was easy to defend but hard to attack; if defense facilities were strengthened here, it could form a pincer with Gaoqi Stockade at Heshan in northern Xiamen Island across the water, controlling the maritime channel of Xunjiang; so he ordered his general Liu Guoxuan to build Jimei Stockade, stationing troops for defense to strengthen the defense of Xiamen Island. The entire stockade was built with granite, becoming the forward defensive position of the Zheng clan group's military defense. Because Zheng Chenggong was enfeoffed as the Prince of Yanping, this stockade was called "Yanping Old Rampart." From 1919 to 1922, the patriotic overseas Chinese leader Tan Kah Kee chose the Site of Jimei Stockade as the Jimei Primary School building, becoming the predecessor of today's school village. At that time, to commemorate the national hero Zheng Chenggong, Mr. Tan named the completed three-story school building "Yanping Building." After the 1950s, Mr. Tan continued to expand Jimei School and beautify the campus, measures including converting the hillside graveyards and mudflats in front of the stockade gate into stone steps and a swimming pool, and renovating the site. Today we can see the renovated stockade gate built of granite strip stones and the remnant walls on both sides. The stockade gate is 3.08 meters high, 1.68 meters wide, and 0.65 meters thick. The functions differ between ancient and modern times, but they may well together form a good place for students to exercise and rest.

projects.name: 苎溪桥
projects.address: 厦门市集美区后溪镇第二农场坂头桥西侧500米处
projects.address_en: 500 meters west of Bantou Bridge, Second Farm, Houxi Town, Jimei District, Xiamen
highlights: 古石桥遗迹
跨度与结构形式
未见其貌先见文字
福建通志同安县志等史料中都有这样的记载苎溪桥在仁德里去城西三十五里
溪源出自白桐岑谷中经蛇蟒所翻蛰故其水多黑涉者患瘴病
宋大观中邑人徐诚始石为桥后圮乾道中其孙应昌及道士法昌重修
可见造桥之功不仅在于便通行更在于利众生
苎溪发源于白桐岭全长20公里与许溪汇合后称后溪向东南注入杏林湾
而今建设了坂头水库溪水已经不如往昔深
朴素的苎溪桥长73米桥面宽2.6米
每个桥墩长5.2米顶宽2.5米朝上流方向作船头形
墩上铺架平直石板共九段每段五条石板
每条石板长5米左右宽0.5米厚0.35米
苎溪桥是厦门集美区现存最古老的石建桥梁
projects.content_zh: 未见其貌，先见文字。《福建通志》、《同安县志》等史料中都有这样的记载："苎溪桥在仁德里，去城西三十五里……溪源出自白桐岑，谷中经蛇蟒所翻蛰，故其水多黑，涉者患瘴病。宋大观中邑人徐诚始石为桥，后圮，乾道中其孙应昌及道士法昌重修。"可见造桥之功不仅在于便通行，更在于利众生。苎溪发源于白桐岭，全长20公里，与许溪汇合后称后溪，向东南注入杏林湾。而今建设了坂头水库，溪水已经不如往昔深。朴素的苎溪桥，长73米，桥面宽2.6米，每个桥墩长5.2米，顶宽2.5米，朝上流方向作船头形，墩上铺架平直石板共九段，每段五条石板，每条石板长5米左右，宽0.5米，厚0.35米。苎溪桥是厦门集美区现存最古老的石建桥梁。
projects.content_en: Before seeing its appearance, one first sees the text. Historical materials such as the "Fujian General Gazetteer" and "Tong'an County Gazetteer" all have such records: "Zhuxi Bridge is in Rende Village, thirty-five li west of the city... the stream source comes from Baitong Ridge, in the valley where snakes and pythons coil and hibernate, so its water is mostly black, and those who wade suffer from miasma. During the Daguan reign of the Song, local resident Xu Cheng first built a stone bridge, which later collapsed; during the Qiandao reign, his grandson Yingchang and the Taoist priest Fachang repaired it." It can be seen that the merit of bridge-building lies not only in facilitating passage, but even more in benefiting all living beings. Zhuxi Stream originates from Baitong Ridge, with a total length of 20 kilometers; after converging with Xu Stream, it is called Hou Stream, flowing southeast into Xinglin Bay. Today, with the construction of Bantou Reservoir, the stream water is no longer as deep as in the past. The simple Zhuxi Bridge is 73 meters long, with a deck 2.6 meters wide; each pier is 5.2 meters long and 2.5 meters wide at the top, shaped like a boat bow facing upstream; on the piers, flat stone slabs are laid in a total of nine sections, with five stone slabs per section, each stone slab about 5 meters long, 0.5 meters wide, and 0.35 meters thick. Zhuxi Bridge is the oldest existing stone bridge in Jimei District, Xiamen.

projects.name: 芦山堂
projects.address: 厦门市同安区大同街道
projects.address_en: Datong Subdistrict, Tong'an District, Xiamen
highlights: 凭吊
为了凭吊苏颂特意寻访芦山堂满腔地担心连当地人也忘记了苏颂的功绩
苏颂和王安石是同科的进士比王大一岁
他担任过9年的馆阁校勘
这9年里苏颂每日默记2000字归来写出作为自己的藏书功力因此在进士的基础上愈发精进
终于在1087年至1092年间他成功地完成了世界科技史上的一件壮举设计并制作完成了水运仪象台
对于搞建筑的人来说苏颂的重要性在于他的理论还有他的营造团队
制作水运仪象台时他和他的技术骨干韩公廉先做的是小样后做台体大样从台到木阁都少不了与建筑的干系
这或许是中国古建筑和中国古代科技最紧密的一次合作合作的伟大成果丝毫不比四大发明逊色
追溯芦山堂的历史始建年代是五代开运元年944年
祠堂本为当地望族苏氏府第后裔苏颂无疑是佼佼者之一
到了元武宗至大四年芦山堂被毁明嘉靖二十二年重建1644年再次焚毁于抗击清兵战争
民国辛亥年重建翌年成奠定了今天这个样子
1987年重修2007年再次修缮
史料说明芦山堂原来是二进双护厝结构嘉靖重修时增修第三进
建筑雕梁画栋装饰至为繁复
考察团队一致同意因其建筑年代较晚工艺不精作为古建筑的价值不及人文历史价值之高
projects.content_zh: 为了凭吊苏颂，特意寻访芦山堂，满腔地担心连当地人也忘记了苏颂的功绩。苏颂和王安石是同科的进士，比王大一岁。他担任过9年的"馆阁校勘"。这9年里，苏颂每日默记2000字，归来写出作为自己的藏书，功力因此在进士的基础上愈发精进。终于，在1087年至1092年间，他成功地完成了世界科技史上的一件壮举：设计并制作完成了水运仪象台。对于搞建筑的人来说，苏颂的重要性在于他的理论，还有他的"营造团队"。制作"水运仪象台"时，他和他的技术骨干韩公廉先做的是"小样"，后做台体"大样"，从台到木阁都少不了与建筑的干系。这或许是中国古建筑和中国古代科技最紧密的一次合作，合作的伟大成果丝毫不比四大发明逊色。追溯芦山堂的历史，始建年代是五代开运元年（944年），祠堂本为当地望族苏氏府第，后裔苏颂无疑是佼佼者之一。到了元武宗至大四年，芦山堂被毁，明嘉靖二十二年重建，1644年再次焚毁于抗击清兵战争。民国辛亥年重建，翌年成，奠定了今天这个样子。1987年重修，2007年再次修缮。史料说明芦山堂原来是二进双护厝结构，嘉靖重修时增修第三进。建筑雕梁画栋，装饰至为繁复。考察团队一致同意，因其建筑年代较晚，工艺不精，作为古建筑的价值不及人文历史价值之高。
projects.content_en: To pay homage to Su Song, I specifically sought out Lushan Mansion, full of worry that even the locals might have forgotten Su Song's achievements. Su Song and Wang Anshi were jinshi (presented scholars) of the same examination cohort, with Su one year older than Wang. He served for 9 years as "Editor of the Imperial Library." During these 9 years, Su Song silently memorized 2,000 characters every day, and upon returning wrote them out as his own collection of books, his skill thus becoming increasingly refined on the basis of his jinshi achievement. Finally, between 1087 and 1092, he successfully accomplished a great feat in the history of world science and technology: designing and completing the Water-Driven Astronomical Clock Tower (Shuiyun Yixiang Tai). For those engaged in architecture, Su Song's importance lies in his theories and also in his "construction team." When making the "Water-Driven Astronomical Clock Tower," he and his technical骨干 Han Gonglian first made a "small model," then made the platform "large model," from the platform to the wooden pavilion all inseparable from architecture. This is perhaps the closest collaboration between ancient Chinese architecture and ancient Chinese science and technology, and the great成果 of the collaboration is in no way inferior to the Four Great Inventions. Tracing the history of Lushan Mansion, its founding date is the first year of Kaiyun reign of the Five Dynasties (944); the ancestral hall was originally the mansion of the local prominent Su clan, and descendant Su Song was undoubtedly one of the outstanding figures. By the fourth year of Zhida reign of Emperor Wuzong of the Yuan, Lushan Mansion was destroyed; it was rebuilt in the 22nd year of Jiajing reign of the Ming, and again burned down in 1644 during the war against Qing troops. It was rebuilt in the Xinhai year of the Republic, completed the following year, establishing its present appearance. It was repaired in 1987 and again renovated in 2007. Historical materials indicate that Lushan Mansion was originally a two-courtyard double-wing structure, with a third courtyard added during the Jiajing repair. The building has carved beams and painted rafters, with extremely complex decoration. The investigation team unanimously agreed that due to its relatively late construction date and unrefined craftsmanship, its value as an ancient building is not as high as its humanistic and historical value.

projects.content_en: Tong'an Confucian Temple has a long history, first built in the Tang Dynasty, built at Denglong Fang during the Five Dynasties period, and relocated to its present site in the tenth year of Shaoxing reign of the Southern Song. In the 23rd year of Shaoxing reign (1153), when Zhu Xi served as the registrar of Tong'an, he built the Classics and History Pavilion, Teaching and Thought Hall, and the four study halls of Zhidao (Following the Way), Jude (Abiding in Virtue), Yiren (Relying on Benevolence), and Youqi (Wandering in the Arts). It was destroyed in the 13th year of Zhizheng reign of the Yuan (1353). It was restored in the ninth year of Zhengtong reign of the Ming (1444). In the fifth year of Tianshun reign of the Ming, an additional group of courtyards was added beside the main courtyard, with the construction of the "Xianxian Yucai" (Promoting Sages and Nurturing Talent) memorial archway, forming a route from the Pan Pond to the archway, then turning into the main gate of the Confucian Temple. In the 32nd year of Qianlong reign of the Qing, the Dacheng Hall and Halberd Gate were again rebuilt. The main hall of the Confucian Temple is the most important ancient building here, conventionally called the Dacheng Hall (Hall of Great Achievement). The hall body is five bays wide, with a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, a moon platform in front, and no front corridor. The outer eaves have no colored paintings; only components such as sparrow brackets (queti), dou (block), and pendant column capitals are decorated with relief colored paintings, while the rest are all plain-colored painted. The main hall's beam frame is quite regular, without tedious decoration; the inner columns are stone below and wood above, with the wooden columns spliced from several sections — it is unknown whether this is due to repeated repairs or出于 some consideration. The inner eave decoration does not use a unified decorative language for all components, but is clearly divided into several layers. The main beam is the decorative focus, entirely covered with gilded colored paintings. The purlins and rafters are painted with dark wood grain. The dou blocks are black below and red above. projects.content_zh: 如同福州仓山龙瑞寺留不住镇寺之宝千佛陶塔，西安桥也没有与婆罗门教塔白头偕老的福气，只是给古塔留下个"西安桥塔"的别名而已。现今的婆罗门教塔，已经在梵天禅寺内的别院里了，那是1957年出于保护古塔目的而做的搬迁。梵天禅寺虽大多新作，而气氛肃穆，环境上佳，配得上古塔的尊严。回顾婆罗门教塔的历史，则是创建于宋元祐年间（1086—1093年），守着西安桥。塔是完全的石结构，实心，分为塔刹、塔身和塔座三部分，塔身进而由檐部、身部和基座构成。造型比例秀美，装饰简朴，四面皆有浮雕，塔身部最为丰富，题材不详，似为佛教故事，塔身基座四面布置佛像，塔座四角雕刻力士负载。
projects.content_en: Just as Longrui Temple in Cangshan, Fuzhou could not keep its town-temple treasure, the Thousand-Buddha Ceramic Pagoda, Xi'an Bridge also did not have the fortune to grow old together with the Brahmanic Pagoda, only leaving the ancient pagoda the alias "Xi'an Bridge Pagoda." Today's Brahmanic Pagoda is already in a side courtyard within Fantian Chan Temple; that was a relocation made in 1957 for the purpose of protecting the ancient pagoda. Although Fantian Chan Temple is mostly newly built, its atmosphere is solemn and its environment excellent, worthy of the dignity of the ancient pagoda. Reviewing the history of the Brahmanic Pagoda, it was founded during the Yuanyou reign of the Song (1086–1093), guarding Xi'an Bridge. The pagoda is entirely of stone structure, solid, divided into three parts: the spire, the body, and the base; the body is further composed of the eave part, the body part, and the pedestal. Its shape and proportions are graceful, its decoration simple, with relief carvings on all four sides; the body part is the richest, with unknown themes, seemingly Buddhist stories; Buddha statues are arranged on all four sides of the body's pedestal, and the four corners of the pagoda base are carved with strongmen bearing loads.

projects.content_zh: "绩光铜柱"坊实际上也是施琅的纪念碑。施琅（1627—1696年），字尊侯，号琢公，是晋江衙口人。他本是郑成功部将，后辅佐清廷平定闽台。这座牌坊立于将军死后的清康熙五十六年（1717年），由当时的福建水师提督施世骠等所立。牌坊就在从漳州到泉州的古驿道上，坐北朝南，为四柱三间三楼式石牌坊，通高9米多，明间宽3.6米，次间宽1.23米。正面明间坊额题"绩光铜柱"，背面坊额题"思永岘碑"。额下板镌刻："解赐御衣龙袍，褒锡诗章，太子太保内大臣靖海将军靖海侯，世袭罔替，兼管提督福建全省水师事务，统辖澎、台水陆官兵，加三级，前镇守同安总兵官，赠太子少傅，谥襄壮施琅"。牌坊上浮雕不多但非常精美，尤以二龙戏珠造型为细腻传神。这里的"绩光铜柱"、"思永岘碑"都是典故。铜柱指的是东汉伏波将军马援，带兵平定交趾，立铜柱以表功；岘碑则说的是西晋羊祜为官时体恤民瘼，深得民心，辞世后百姓便在他经常登游的岘山立碑纪念的故事。
projects.content_en: The "Jiguang Tongzhu" (Merits Shining Like Bronze Pillars) Archway is actually also a memorial to Shi Lang. Shi Lang (1627–1696), courtesy name Zunhou, art name Zhuogong, was from Yakou, Jinjiang. He was originally a general under Zheng Chenggong, later assisting the Qing court in pacifying Fujian and Taiwan. This archway was erected in the 56th year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1717), after the general's death, by Shi Shibiao, then the Naval Commander of Fujian, and others. The archway stands on the ancient post road from Zhangzhou to Quanzhou, facing south from the north, and is a four-column three-bay three-story stone archway, with a total height of over 9 meters, the central bay 3.6 meters wide, and the side bays 1.23 meters wide. The front central bay archway plaque is inscribed "Jiguang Tongzhu," and the back archway plaque is inscribed "Siyong Xianbei" (Ever-Remembering Xian Stele). The board below the plaque is engraved: "Bestowed with imperial robes and dragon robes, praised with poems, Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, Inner Minister, General of the Pacifying Sea, Marquis of the Pacifying Sea, hereditary without substitution, concurrently managing the affairs of the Naval Commander of all Fujian Province, commanding the land and naval officers and soldiers of Penghu and Taiwan, promoted three ranks, formerly Commander-in-Chief guarding Tong'an, posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, posthumous name Xiangzhuang Shi Lang." There are not many relief carvings on the archway but they are very exquisite, especially the two dragons playing with a pearl造型, which is delicate and vivid. Both "Jiguang Tongzhu" and "Siyong Xianbei" here are allusions. "Bronze pillars" refers to General Fubo Ma Yuan of the Eastern Han, who led troops to pacify Jiaozhi and erected bronze pillars to mark his merit; "Xian Stele" tells the story of Yang Hu of the Western Jin, who when in office sympathized with the people's sufferings and won their hearts; after his death, the people erected a stele in his memory on Xian Mountain, which he often climbed and toured.

一千二百多年过去漳州古城池的位置和格局仍依稀可辨

往昔城池碧水悠悠舟楫如梭满载货物的船只自东西闸口而入可直通市中心渔头庙今南昌路
在今天拥挤的城区依然可以找到保留至今的东西桥亭还有亭前郁郁葱葱的大榕树
相比之下还是东桥亭古朴些西桥亭则随了暴发者的口味让人想起螃蟹熟的
东桥亭始建于唐元和十一年816年桥成之日恰逢漳州人周匡物进士及第故又名及第桥
宋代在桥上建亭历代重修现存三进桥亭雕刻精美古风盎然
尤其是屋架和斗拱做工细腻造型得体是并不常见的佳作
projects.content_zh: 漳州城历史悠久，唐代的漳州城以现中山公园为中心，筑方形城堡、挖东西城池，称为"子城"。一千二百多年过去，漳州古城池的位置和格局仍依稀可辨。从南昌路，到澎湖路、九龙江北堤、钟法路所形成的矩形地带就是唐代漳州古城的遗址。往昔城池碧水悠悠，舟楫如梭，满载货物的船只自东、西闸口而入，可直通市中心渔头庙（今南昌路）。在今天拥挤的城区，依然可以找到保留至今的东西桥亭，还有亭前郁郁葱葱的大榕树。相比之下，还是东桥亭古朴些，西桥亭则随了暴发者的口味，让人想起螃蟹，熟的。东桥亭始建于唐元和十一年（816年），桥成之日，恰逢漳州人周匡物进士及第，故又名"及第桥"。宋代在桥上建亭，历代重修，现存三进桥亭，雕刻精美，古风盎然。尤其是屋架和斗拱，做工细腻，造型得体，是并不常见的佳作。
projects.content_en: Zhangzhou City has a long history; the Tang Dynasty Zhangzhou City centered on the present Zhongshan Park, with a square castle built and east and west moats dug, called the "Zicheng" (Sub-city). Over 1,200 years have passed, and the location and layout of the ancient Zhangzhou city wall are still faintly discernible. The rectangular zone formed by Nanchang Road, Penghu Road, the north embankment of the Jiulong River, and Zhongfa Road is the site of the ancient Tang Dynasty Zhangzhou City. In the past, the city's waters were blue and gentle, with boats passing like shuttles; ships fully loaded with goods entered through the east and west sluice gates and could go directly to Yutou Temple (today's Nanchang Road) in the city center. In today's crowded urban area, one can still find the preserved Dongqiaoting and Xiqiaoting (East and West Bridge Pavilions), as well as the lush banyan trees in front of the pavilions. In comparison, Dongqiaoting is more rustic, while Xiqiaoting has followed the tastes of the nouveau riche, reminding one of a cooked crab. Dongqiaoting was first built in the 11th year of Yuanhe reign of the Tang (816); on the day the bridge was completed, it coincided with Zhangzhou native Zhou Kuangwu passing the jinshi examination, so it is also called "Jidi Bridge" (Passing the Examination Bridge). In the Song Dynasty, pavilions were built on the bridge, repaired through successive dynasties; the existing three-courtyard bridge pavilions are exquisitely carved, full of ancient charm. Especially the roof frames and dougong, with delicate workmanship and appropriate shapes, are uncommon masterpieces.
