highlights: 格局
木结构
彩画遗存
漳州文庙位于漳州老城区的修文西路上是漳州城内最大的古建筑群也是漳州市文物管理委员会的办公室所在地
幸运的拜访者还有可能得到专业老师的指教
文庙始建于宋庆历四年1044年按宋制孔庙与官学并建一处
政和二年1112年移于州左绍兴九年1139年复原址历代经多次重修
据记载朱熹郑成功黄道周都曾到此祭祀孔子
其中朱熹在任漳州知事时曾每旬之二日必领官属下州学视诸生讲小学为正其义
文庙前的道路左右分别建有德配天地道冠古今两座牌坊原为木构牌坊现存的石牌坊是民国时期蒋鼎文出资重修的
文庙整体坐北向南占地15000平方米现存建筑面积2600平方米
中轴线上依次设有作为现大门的仪门戟门两庑丹墀祭台和大成殿
殿西侧建有敬一亭原有建筑明伦堂棂星门等已毁
戟门面阔九间进深两间木构梁枋石制圆柱穿斗式的屋架看起来简洁古朴
东西两庑均面阔八间进深两间其中一间形成室外连廊
大成殿面阔五间进深六间为重檐歇山顶上层檐只留当心三间
殿前有祭台丹墀其内供有孔子像一尊
大成殿前檐出廊的六根廊柱为浮雕蟠龙石柱而檐柱和金柱则为圆形石柱
正檐檐柱间置隔扇门而后檐墙则在明间设门东西次梢间各开方窗
室内的木构造继承了早期插柱造的做法
同时大成殿的斗拱也都保留了早期斗拱上昂造等很多的特征
大成殿大量额枋木雕构件脊桁天花上均有彩绘遗留局部保留有十分鲜艳的色彩
1999年由中国文物研究所指导进行维修我的老师郭黛姮先生也参加了指导
当时采用了抽梁换柱填心包心等方法对木结构进行了维修并对彩画进行了加固
环视殿内可以想象过去的文庙遍布彩画和原汁原味的金碧辉煌的场景
projects.content_zh: 漳州文庙位于漳州老城区的修文西路上，是漳州城内最大的古建筑群，也是漳州市文物管理委员会的办公室所在地。幸运的拜访者还有可能得到专业老师的指教。文庙始建于宋庆历四年（1044年），按宋制，孔庙与官学并建一处。政和二年（1112年）移于州左，绍兴九年（1139年）复原址，历代经多次重修。据记载，朱熹、郑成功、黄道周都曾到此祭祀孔子。其中，朱熹在任漳州知事时，曾"每旬之二日必领官属下州学，视诸生，讲小学，为正其义"。文庙前的道路左右分别建有"德配天地"、"道冠古今"两座牌坊，原为木构牌坊，现存的石牌坊是民国时期蒋鼎文出资重修的。文庙整体坐北向南，占地15000平方米，现存建筑面积2600平方米。中轴线上依次设有作为现大门的仪门、戟门、两庑、丹墀、祭台和大成殿。殿西侧建有敬一亭。原有建筑明伦堂、棂星门等已毁。戟门面阔九间，进深两间。木构梁枋，石制圆柱。穿斗式的屋架看起来简洁古朴。东西两庑均面阔八间，进深两间，其中一间形成室外连廊。大成殿面阔五间，进深六间，为重檐歇山顶，上层檐只留当心三间。殿前有祭台、丹墀，其内供有孔子像一尊。大成殿前檐出廊的六根廊柱为浮雕蟠龙石柱，而檐柱和金柱则为圆形石柱。正檐檐柱间置隔扇门，而后檐墙则在明间设门，东西次、梢间各开方窗。室内的木构造继承了早期"插柱造"的做法。同时，大成殿的斗拱也都保留了早期斗拱上昂造等很多的特征。大成殿大量额枋、木雕构件、脊桁、天花上均有彩绘遗留，局部保留有十分鲜艳的色彩。1999年由中国文物研究所指导进行维修，我的老师郭黛姮先生也参加了指导。当时采用了"抽梁换柱"、"填心"、"包心"等方法对木结构进行了维修，并对彩画进行了加固。环视殿内，可以想象过去的文庙遍布彩画和原汁原味的金碧辉煌的场景。
projects.content_en: Zhangzhou Confucian Temple is located on Xiuwen West Road in the old urban area of Zhangzhou; it is the largest ancient building complex in Zhangzhou City and also the office location of the Zhangzhou Cultural Relics Management Committee. Lucky visitors may also receive guidance from professional teachers. The Confucian Temple was first built in the fourth year of Qingli reign of the Song (1044); according to Song system, the Confucian Temple and official school were built together. In the second year of Zhenghe reign (1112), it was moved to the left of the prefecture; in the ninth year of Shaoxing reign (1139), it was restored to its original site, and has undergone multiple repairs through successive dynasties. According to records, Zhu Xi, Zheng Chenggong, and Huang Daozhou all came here to sacrifice to Confucius. Among them, when Zhu Xi served as the magistrate of Zhangzhou, he "on the second day of every ten-day period must lead officials to the prefectural school, observe the students, lecture on elementary learning, and rectify their righteousness." On the left and right of the road in front of the Confucian Temple, two memorial archways "De Pei Tian Di" (Virtue Matching Heaven and Earth) and "Dao Guan Gu Jin" (Way Capping Past and Present) were respectively built, originally wooden archways; the existing stone archways were rebuilt with funds from Jiang Dingwen during the Republican period. The Confucian Temple as a whole faces south from the north, covering 15,000 square meters, with an existing building area of 2,600 square meters. Along the central axis are依次 the Yi Gate (serving as the current main gate), Halberd Gate, two side wings, Dan Chi (red courtyard), sacrificial platform, and Dacheng Hall. On the west side of the hall, a Jingyi Pavilion is built. Original buildings such as the Minglun Hall and Lingxing Gate have been destroyed. The Halberd Gate is nine bays wide and two bays deep, with timber beams and stone cylindrical columns; the chuandou (column-and-tie) roof frame looks simple and ancient. Both the east and west side wings are eight bays wide and two bays deep, with one bay forming an outdoor corridor. The Dacheng Hall is five bays wide and six bays deep, with a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, with the upper eave retaining only the central three bays. In front of the hall are a sacrificial platform and Dan Chi, inside which a statue of Confucius is enshrined. The six corridor columns of the front eave of the Dacheng Hall are relief-carved dragon-coiled stone columns, while the eave columns and golden columns are circular stone columns. Between the front eave columns are lattice doors, while the rear eave wall has a door in the central bay, with square windows in the east and west secondary and end bays. The interior timber structure inherits the early "inserted column" (chazhu zao) method. At the same time, the dougong of the Dacheng Hall also retain many features of early dougong such as the upward-ang construction. A large number of额枋, timber-carved components, ridge purlins, and ceilings in the Dacheng Hall all have remaining colored paintings, with some parts retaining very vivid colors. In 1999, repairs were carried out under the guidance of the Chinese Institute of Cultural Relics, and my teacher Ms. Guo Daiheng also participated in the guidance. At that time, methods such as "extracting beams and replacing columns," "filling the core," and "wrapping the core" were used to repair the timber structure, and the colored paintings were reinforced. Looking around the hall, one can imagine the past Confucian Temple covered with colored paintings and the original resplendent scene.

projects.name: 林氏宗祠
projects.name_en: Ancestral Temple Complex for Lin's Clan
projects.address: 漳州市芗城区修文西路
projects.address_en: Xiuwen West Road, Xiangcheng District, Zhangzhou
highlights: 木结构
斗拱做法
漳州林氏宗祠又称比干庙是漳州七县林姓氏族合建的
供奉林氏始祖比干作为漳邑林氏祭祖之所和历年本宗族赴考往来生员的接待站
原来的宗祠规模不小而今前后进已废仅存正殿了
只是这远远一瞥已经让我们感到此殿非同寻常绝对不虚此行
大殿面南红瓦重檐歇山顶殿身三间
下层原构似为副阶周匝但经过复杂的历史改造可见旧有结构痕迹
前后下层单独做卷棚顶用垂脊戗脊是檐下另加抱厦的样子
铺作部分明间用补间四朵次间用二朵偷心造施华拱一跳下昂二根昂形耍头
伸出构件雕刻装饰花板皆精良独特
可惜宗祠确切建筑年代已无考也没有机缘入得殿内只从间接资料得知室内有上昂的做法
关于形制年代有的只是一些专家给出的模糊说法始建于宋代因清末曾修葺故亦带有清式建筑的痕迹
projects.content_zh: 漳州林氏宗祠，又称比干庙，是漳州七县林姓氏族合建的，供奉林氏始祖比干，作为漳邑林氏祭祖之所和历年本宗族赴考往来生员的接待站。原来的宗祠规模不小，而今前后进已废，仅存正殿了。只是这远远一瞥，已经让我们感到此殿非同寻常，绝对不虚此行。大殿面南，红瓦，重檐歇山顶，殿身三间，下层原构似为副阶周匝，但经过复杂的历史改造，可见旧有结构痕迹，前后下层单独做卷棚顶，用垂脊戗脊，是檐下另加抱厦的样子。铺作部分，明间用补间四朵，次间用二朵，偷心造，施华拱一跳、下昂二根，昂形耍头，伸出构件雕刻、装饰花板皆精良独特。可惜宗祠确切建筑年代已无考，也没有机缘入得殿内，只从间接资料得知室内有上昂的做法。关于形制年代，有的只是一些专家给出的模糊说法"始建于宋代，因清末曾修葺，故亦带有清式建筑的痕迹"。
projects.content_en: The Zhangzhou Lin Clan Ancestral Temple, also known as Bigan Temple, was jointly built by the Lin clan from seven counties of Zhangzhou, enshrining the Lin clan ancestor Bigan, serving as a place for the Lin clan of Zhangzhou to worship ancestors and as a reception station for clan members going to and from examinations over the years. The original ancestral temple was not small in scale, but today the front and rear courtyards have been destroyed, with only the main hall remaining. Just this distant glance has already made us feel that this hall is extraordinary, absolutely worth the trip. The main hall faces south, with red tiles and a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, with the hall body three bays wide; the original structure of the lower layer seems to have been a surrounding secondary eave (fujie zhouza), but through complex historical modifications, traces of the old structure can be seen; the front and rear lower layers separately have curved-roof ceilings (juanpeng ding), with vertical ridges and diagonal ridges, looking like an additional抱厦 (baosha) under the eaves. In the bracket set part, the central bay uses four intermediate bracket sets, the secondary bays use two, in the "stealing-heart" (touxin zao) construction, with one hua-gong jump and two lower ang, with ang-shaped shuatou (cantilever head); the protruding component carvings and decorative patterned boards are all exquisite and unique. Unfortunately, the exact construction date of the ancestral temple is no longer verifiable, and there was no opportunity to enter the hall; only from indirect materials do we know that the interior has the upward-ang construction method. Regarding the date of the form, there are only vague statements given by some experts: "First built in the Song Dynasty, because it was repaired in the late Qing, it also bears traces of Qing-style architecture."

projects.name: 可园
projects.address: 漳州芗城区新桥街道文川
projects.address_en: Wenchuan, Xinqiao Subdistrict, Xiangcheng District, Zhangzhou
highlights: 凭吊
可园不可以再这样下去了
这座位于漳州老街区文川里的闽南名园是清代闽中十大才子之一郑开禧的私家花园
美名可园取自苏东坡的话凡物皆有可观苟有可观皆有可乐
文学作品当中老人口碑当中园中原先亭榭台楼阁池塘小桥假山园圃尽有令人目不暇接还演绎了一批厦大学子的爱国故事
而今经过动荡岁月对财富和权力的洗牌经过冲动岁月对文化和遗产的洗牌可园终于在物质和精神两个世界内被均贫富了
宅第部分主厝大厅保存得相对较为完好建造主厝墙脚的石条雕花也很精巧显示出中西合璧的风格
主厝之后才是园林部分庭院内植物生长得郁郁葱葱
最多可以说虽现状较为破败仍不掩其曲径幽幽典雅宁静之美
倔强的月亮门似乎努力在对抗着新时代的粗糙掇石的婀娜也全然没有在瓦砾中放弃浪漫的希望
一汪碧水无言地反射着周围的一切毫不在意众生的审美
当然园内留下了吟香阁思哺堂等建筑我们唯有为它们祈祷
可园已经不可以再这样下去了
projects.content_zh: 可园不可以再这样下去了。这座位于漳州老街区文川里的闽南名园，是清代闽中十大才子之一郑开禧的私家花园。美名"可园"取自苏东坡的话："凡物皆有可观，苟有可观，皆有可乐。"文学作品当中，老人口碑当中，园中原先亭、榭、台、楼、阁、池塘、小桥、假山、园圃尽有，令人目不暇接，还演绎了一批厦大学子的爱国故事。而今，经过动荡岁月对财富和权力的洗牌，经过冲动岁月对文化和遗产的洗牌，可园终于在物质和精神两个世界内被均贫富了。宅第部分，主厝大厅保存得相对较为完好，建造主厝墙脚的石条雕花也很精巧，显示出中西合璧的风格。主厝之后才是园林部分。庭院内植物生长得郁郁葱葱。最多可以说，虽现状较为破败，仍不掩其曲径幽幽、典雅宁静之美。倔强的月亮门似乎努力在对抗着新时代的粗糙，掇石的婀娜也全然没有在瓦砾中放弃浪漫的希望，一汪碧水无言地反射着周围的一切，毫不在意众生的审美。当然，园内留下了"吟香阁"、"思哺堂"等建筑，我们唯有为它们祈祷。可园已经不可以再这样下去了。
projects.content_en: Keyuan can no longer go on like this. This famous Minnan garden located in Wenchuan Lane of the old Zhangzhou district was the private garden of Zheng Kaixi, one of the ten great talents of central Fujian in the Qing Dynasty. The beautiful name "Keyuan" (Garden of Worth) is taken from Su Dongpo's words: "All things have something worth observing; if there is something worth observing, there is something worth enjoying." In literary works and in the oral traditions of the elderly, the garden originally had pavilions, open halls, terraces, towers, attics, ponds, small bridges, rockeries, and vegetable gardens all present, dazzling the eye, and also staged patriotic stories of a group of Xiamen University students. Today, after the turbulent years reshuffled wealth and power, and after the impulsive years reshuffled culture and heritage, Keyuan has finally been "equalized in wealth" in both the material and spiritual worlds. In the residential part, the main mansion hall is relatively well preserved, and the carved stone strips at the base of the main mansion walls are also very exquisite, showing a style combining Chinese and Western elements. Behind the main mansion is the garden part. Plants in the courtyard grow lushly. At most one can say that although the current condition is rather dilapidated, it still does not conceal its beauty of winding paths and elegant tranquility. The stubborn moon gate seems to be striving against the crudeness of the new era, and the graceful rockeries have absolutely not given up romantic hope amid the rubble; a pool of blue water silently reflects everything around, indifferent to the aesthetics of all living beings. Of course, the garden has retained buildings such as the "Yinxiang Pavilion" (Chanting Fragrance Pavilion) and "Sibu Hall" (Thinking of Nourishment Hall), and we can only pray for them. Keyuan can no longer go on like this.

projects.name: 路边威惠庙
projects.address: 漳州市芗城区天宝镇路边村
projects.address_en: Lubian Village, Tianbao Town, Xiangcheng District, Zhangzhou
highlights: 寺院格局
木结构
凭吊
唐史无人修列传漳江有庙祀将军说的就是陈元光
他的祖籍是河南光州固始县少年随父归德将军陈政奉诏南征入闽安定边陲
后袭父职拓地开屯
武则天垂拱二年686年首任漳州刺史后创办府学兴农惠工终使漳州成为闽南重镇
所以陈元光成了开漳将士后裔所尊奉的开漳圣王所建庙宇就被称为威惠庙同祀观音和韩氏先祖等
威惠庙的祖庙就是芗城路边村巨大古树下的这一座
庙中樟木雕观音坐像是元延祐六年1319年的出水石莲花上有元泰定三年1326年的题记
因此路边威惠庙的始建年代可以上溯到元延祐六年
经过历代改造修缮现存的建筑为清代重修的作品
这里的威惠庙的规模不像它的名声那样大只有一进院落前后两座殿宇
两殿也很小巧面阔三间屋脊也划分三段起翘高挑龙塑飞腾垂脊端更塑天宫楼阁
室内木结构则是出乎意料的古朴不仅雕刻装饰细致精美多处还保留有历代油饰彩画壁画的痕迹可供研究者开展各种分析检测工作
projects.content_zh: "唐史无人修列传，漳江有庙祀将军"说的就是陈元光。他的祖籍是河南光州固始县，少年随父"归德将军"陈政奉诏南征入闽，安定边陲。后袭父职，拓地开屯。武则天垂拱二年（686年），首任漳州刺史，后创办府学，兴农惠工，终使漳州成为闽南重镇。所以陈元光成了开漳将士后裔所尊奉的"开漳圣王"，所建庙宇就被称为威惠庙，同祀观音和韩氏先祖等。威惠庙的祖庙就是芗城路边村巨大古树下的这一座。庙中樟木雕观音坐像是元延祐六年（1319年）的，出水石莲花上有元泰定三年（1326年）的题记，因此，路边威惠庙的始建年代可以上溯到元延祐六年。经过历代改造修缮，现存的建筑为清代重修的作品。这里的威惠庙的规模不像它的名声那样大，只有一进院落，前后两座殿宇。两殿也很小巧，面阔三间，屋脊也划分三段，起翘高挑，龙塑飞腾，垂脊端更塑天宫楼阁。室内木结构则是出乎意料的古朴，不仅雕刻装饰细致精美，多处还保留有历代油饰彩画、壁画的痕迹，可供研究者开展各种分析检测工作。
projects.content_en: "The Tang history has no one to write biographies, but the Zhang River has temples to sacrifice to the general" — this refers to Chen Yuanguang. His ancestral home was Gushi County, Guangzhou, Henan; as a youth he followed his father Chen Zheng, "General of Returning Virtue," who was ordered to march south into Fujian and stabilize the frontier. Later he inherited his father's position, expanding territory and opening military colonies. In the second year of Chuigong reign of Wu Zetian (686), he became the first prefect of Zhangzhou, later founded the prefectural school, promoted agriculture and benefited craftsmen, finally making Zhangzhou an important town in southern Fujian. Therefore, Chen Yuanguang became the "Sacred King of Opening Zhangzhou" revered by the descendants of the soldiers who opened Zhangzhou, and the temples built were called Weihui Temples (Temples of Power and Grace), also enshrining Guanyin and Han clan ancestors. The ancestral temple of Weihui Temple is this one under the huge ancient tree in Lubian Village, Xiangcheng. The camphor-wood carved seated Guanyin statue in the temple is from the sixth year of Yanyou reign of the Yuan (1319), and the water-emerged stone lotus has an inscription from the third year of Taiding reign of the Yuan (1326); therefore, the founding date of Lubian Weihui Temple can be traced back to the sixth year of Yanyou reign of the Yuan. Through modifications and repairs in successive dynasties, the existing buildings are works repaired in the Qing Dynasty. The scale of the Weihui Temple here is not as large as its reputation, with only one courtyard and two halls front and back. Both halls are also very small and exquisite, three bays wide; the roof ridge is also divided into three sections, with high upturned ends and soaring dragon sculptures, and the ends of the vertical ridges are further sculpted with heavenly palace pavilions. The interior timber structure is unexpectedly ancient, not only with exquisite carving and decoration, but also retaining traces of oil paint, colored paintings, and murals from successive dynasties in many places, available for researchers to carry out various analytical and testing work.

projects.name: 南山寺
projects.address: 漳州市芗城区西桥街道丹霞山麓
projects.address_en: At the foot of Danxia Mountain, Xiqiao Subdistrict, Xiangcheng District, Zhangzhou
highlights: 寺院格局
晚期木结构
南山寺位于漳州市区九龙江南侧的丹霞山麓
从江滨公园一侧的人行桥跨过九龙江再向东步行一段时间就可以看到一座写有南山禅寺的牌楼
从这里走一段林荫大道途经一座城隍庙到达路的尽端就可以看到南山寺了
南山寺初建于唐开元二十四年736年为唐玄宗李隆基任太子时的太傅陈邕所建私宅
相传由于府邸建造形式类似宫廷严重逾制被告到了朝廷
皇上听闻后派钦差查案为了避罪陈邕的女儿主动要求削发为尼按照隋唐以来的惯例献宅田以为寺院将私宅改为寺庙
南山寺初名延福禅寺宋乾德年间刺史陈文颢重修为名报劬院后改曰崇福
明朝改为南山寺彼时香火兴旺是禅宗临济喝云派的发源地
南山寺历代多有重修仅方志上记载就有元至正明嘉靖隆庆年间几次重修现存建筑为清末重修
南山寺坐南朝北中轴线上自北而南依次为山门天王殿放生池大雄宝殿法堂
法堂左右两侧设有祖师堂太傅殿

西侧匾额上书般若东侧为解脱
走进山门可以看到天王殿的正面当中挂有虞愚所书天王殿三字
殿中供奉弥勒佛佛龛上有匾额皆大欢喜四周供有四大金刚弥勒佛背后则是护法韦陀
再行有两个巨大的放生池放生池之后则是大雄宝殿

檐内则有弘一法师手书妙相庄严匾
殿中佛坛上供奉三宝佛并塑阿难迦叶两尊者于两旁
在三尊大佛的背后则供奉观世音菩萨文殊菩萨和普贤菩萨
大雄宝殿东侧的净业堂旧称石佛阁其中石佛系初唐时期由一块天然石笋雕琢而成
净业堂内有一口铜钟为元延祐年间重铸
石佛阁内的石柱上有大量刻字为过去文人所题对联
