highlights: 堡墙设计
土楼设计
园林设计
赵家堡是诒安堡的姊妹城赵家堡是姐姐姊妹之间只有十分钟的车程
不过赵家堡的身世要显赫得多是曾经改姓避祸的南宋皇族
硕高筑堡记中说得清楚余祖宋闽冲郡王决意卜庐入山楼建于万历庚子1600年之冬堡建于甲辰1604年之夏
这个皇室后裔聚居之所的创始人就是此文的作者隆庆五年进士赵范
城堡因山就势方圆随形辟四门门上建城楼北门筑瓮城为正门
石砌城墙坚实厚厚达2.5米高3米至4米墙上垛口高约1.5米沿墙建马面6座并有墩台藏兵洞之设
城内东侧更有内城内有赵范所谓之楼是一座3层的方土楼完璧楼意思是不用隐姓埋名终归赵家
还有一座三合院平时并不住人
土楼的台基用以花岗岩条石纵横砌筑墙体以三合土夯筑高20米周长88米首层有房10间二层9间三层通廊楼底有地道通往城外
至于赵范所谓堡的部分则由公共性的广场关帝庙石坊戏台以及先后建造的大型和小型住宅院落和园林组成
宅院俗称官厅规模井然
园林中更有书院桥亭塔山石水面绿植互为映衬山林野趣文人气息并重
projects.content_zh: 赵家堡是诒安堡的姊妹城，赵家堡是姐姐，姊妹之间只有十分钟的车程。不过赵家堡的身世要显赫得多，是曾经改姓避祸的南宋皇族。《硕高筑堡记》中说得清楚，"余祖宋闽冲郡王……决意卜庐入山……楼建于万历庚子（1600年）之冬，堡建于甲辰（1604年）之夏……"，这个皇室后裔聚居之所的创始人就是此文的作者，隆庆五年进士，赵范。城堡因山就势，方圆随形，辟四门，门上建城楼，北门筑瓮城为正门。石砌城墙，坚实厚重，厚达2.5米，高3米至4米，墙上垛口高约1.5米。沿墙建马面6座，并有墩台、藏兵洞之设。城内东侧更有内城，内有赵范所谓之"楼"，是一座3层的方土楼"完璧楼"，意思是不用隐姓埋名，终归赵家。还有一座三合院，平时并不住人。土楼的台基用以花岗岩条石纵横砌筑，墙体以三合土夯筑，高20米，周长88米。首层有房10间，二层9间，三层通廊。楼底有地道通往城外。至于赵范所谓"堡"的部分，则由公共性的广场、关帝庙、石坊、戏台，以及先后建造的大型和小型住宅院落和园林组成。宅院俗称"官厅"，规模井然。园林中更有书院，桥、亭、塔、山石、水面、绿植互为映衬，山林野趣、文人气息并重。
projects.content_en: Zhaojiabao is the sister city of Yi'an Fort, with Zhaojiabao being the elder sister, only a ten-minute drive between the sisters. However, Zhaojiabao's origins are far more illustrious — it was the Southern Song imperial family who once changed their surname to avoid disaster. The "Record of Building the Fort at Shuogao" clearly states: "My ancestor, the Prince of Minchong of the Song... resolved to choose a dwelling in the mountains... the building was built in the winter of Wanli Gengzi (1600), and the fort in the summer of Jiachen (1604)..." The founder of this place where imperial descendants gathered was the author of this text, Zhao Fan, a jinshi of the fifth year of Longqing reign. The castle follows the mountain terrain, with square and round shapes adapting to the form, opening four gates, with gate towers built above the gates, and a barbican built at the north gate as the main gate. The stone-built city wall is solid and thick, reaching 2.5 meters thick, 3 to 4 meters high, with crenellations about 1.5 meters high on the wall. Six horse-face towers were built along the wall, with the establishment of mounds and soldier-hiding caves. On the east side inside the city there is further an inner city, containing what Zhao Fan called the "building," a three-story square tulou "Wanbi Lou" (Jade Returned Building), meaning no need to hide one's surname, ultimately returning to the Zhao family. There is also a three-courtyard compound, usually uninhabited. The foundation of the tulou is built with granite strip stones laid horizontally and vertically, and the walls are rammed with three-in-one soil, 20 meters high, with a circumference of 88 meters. The first floor has 10 rooms, the second floor 9 rooms, and the third floor a corridor. There is an underground passage at the bottom of the building leading outside the city. As for the part Zhao Fan called the "fort," it consists of public squares, Guandi Temple, stone archways, opera stages, as well as large and small residential courtyards and gardens built successively. The residential courtyards are commonly called "Official Hall," with orderly scale. In the garden there is further an academy, with bridges, pavilions, pagodas, rockeries, water surfaces, and green plants setting each other off, with both mountain forest wild charm and literati atmosphere.

projects.name: 大地土楼群
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位，省级文物保护单位
projects.level_en: National Key Cultural Heritage Site, Provincial Cultural Heritage Site
projects.address: 漳州华安县仙都镇大地村
projects.address_en: Dadi Village, Xiandu Town, Hua'an County, Zhangzhou
highlights: 土楼结构
生活方式
到大地村看土楼看的是二宜楼南阳楼东阳楼还有周边的玄天阁嘉应庙慈西庵茶香街等古迹
大地村以蒋刘两大姓为主而这里的三座土楼都是蒋氏所建所居
二宜楼是蒋氏十四世蒋士熊于清乾隆五年1740年所建规模宏大
楼直径73.4米外环楼四层内环一层平分成12个单元居住单元192间
墙厚2.53米高16米外环底层用花岗岩石砌成以上各层生土夯筑
四层更利用墙体内收形成隐蔽通廊环绕楼内设通往楼外的暗道
大楼中心是公共内院开井两口名为阴泉和阳泉
南阳楼在二宜楼东南150米处系二宜楼建造者蒋士熊之孙蒋经帮建于清嘉庆二十二年1817年
以二宜楼为蓝本而木雕石刻用材方面较之二楼更胜一筹
南阳楼朝向西北规模仅其母本之半设4个单元每个单元均为7开间共有房间96间
南阳楼后还有依山而建的后花园
东阳楼比邻南阳楼为一方形土楼系二宜楼创建者蒋士熊之孙太学生蒋宗朽于清嘉庆丁丑年1817年所建
周边景色优美前有池塘旁有小溪流过
东阳楼坐西南朝东北整个建筑前低后高楼体面宽45.81米纵深26米二层通高11米
主楼有住房36间厅4个二楼后厅置列祖牌位
主楼外两侧各建护厝计15间为厨房餐室避免主楼起居受炊烟干扰
projects.content_zh: 到大地村看土楼，看的是二宜楼、南阳楼、东阳楼，还有周边的玄天阁、嘉应庙、慈西庵、茶香街等古迹。大地村以蒋、刘两大姓为主，而这里的三座土楼都是蒋氏所建所居。二宜楼是蒋氏十四世蒋士熊于清乾隆五年（1740年）所建，规模宏大。楼直径73.4米，外环楼四层，内环一层，平分成12个单元，居住单元192间；墙厚2.53米，高16米，外环底层用花岗岩石砌成，以上各层生土夯筑；四层更利用墙体内收形成隐蔽通廊环绕；楼内设通往楼外的暗道；大楼中心是公共内院，开井两口，名为"阴泉"和"阳泉"。南阳楼在二宜楼东南150米处，系二宜楼建造者蒋士熊之孙蒋经帮建于清嘉庆二十二年（1817年），以二宜楼为蓝本，而木雕、石刻用材方面较之二楼更胜一筹。南阳楼朝向西北，规模仅其母本之半，设4个单元，每个单元均为7开间，共有房间96间。南阳楼后还有依山而建的后花园。东阳楼比邻南阳楼，为一方形土楼，系二宜楼创建者蒋士熊之孙太学生蒋宗朽于清嘉庆丁丑年（1817年）所建。周边景色优美，前有池塘，旁有小溪流过。东阳楼坐西南朝东北，整个建筑前低后高；楼体面宽45.81米，纵深26米，二层，通高11米；主楼有住房36间，厅4个，二楼后厅置列祖牌位。主楼外两侧各建护厝计15间，为厨房餐室，避免主楼起居受炊烟干扰。
projects.content_en: Visiting tulou (earthen buildings) in Dadi Village, one sees Eryan Lou (Two-Suitability Building), Nanyang Lou, and Dongyang Lou, as well as surrounding ancient sites such as Xuantian Pavilion, Jiaying Temple, Cixi Nunnery, and Chaxiang Street. Dadi Village is mainly dominated by the two major surnames Jiang and Liu, and the three tulou here were all built and inhabited by the Jiang clan. Eryan Lou was built in the fifth year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1740) by Jiang Shixiong, the 14th generation of the Jiang clan, with a grand scale. The building has a diameter of 73.4 meters, with the outer ring building four stories and the inner ring one story, evenly divided into 12 units, with 192 residential units; the wall is 2.53 meters thick and 16 meters high, with the bottom layer of the outer ring built of granite stone, and the upper layers rammed with raw earth; the fourth story further uses the inward contraction of the wall to form a hidden corridor encircling; an underground passage leading outside the building is set inside; the center of the large building is a public inner courtyard, with two wells opened, named "Yin Spring" and "Yang Spring." Nanyang Lou is 150 meters southeast of Eryan Lou, built in the 22nd year of Jiaqing reign of the Qing (1817) by Jiang Jingbang, grandson of Jiang Shixiong, the builder of Eryan Lou; using Eryan Lou as a blueprint, it surpasses the second building in terms of wood carving, stone carving, and materials. Nanyang Lou faces northwest, with a scale only half of its prototype, with 4 units, each unit 7 bays wide, totaling 96 rooms. Behind Nanyang Lou there is also a back garden built against the mountain. Dongyang Lou is adjacent to Nanyang Lou, a square tulou, built in the Dingchou year of Jiaqing reign of the Qing (1817) by Jiang Zongxiu, a imperial student and grandson of Jiang Shixiong, the founder of Eryan Lou. The surrounding scenery is beautiful, with a pond in front and a small stream flowing by. Dongyang Lou faces northeast from the southwest, with the entire building low in front and high in back; the building face is 45.81 meters wide, 26 meters deep, two stories, with a total height of 11 meters; the main building has 36 residential rooms and 4 halls, with ancestral tablets placed in the rear hall on the second floor. On both sides outside the main building, 15 side wings are built in total, serving as kitchens and dining rooms, avoiding the main building's living areas being disturbed by cooking smoke.

projects.name: 南山宫
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 漳州市华安县良村乡南山腰
projects.address_en: Southern slope of Nanshan, Liangcun Township, Hua'an County, Zhangzhou
highlights: 木结构
彩绘
道观神祗繁多听说过圣祖大仙和都统舍人吗那是精神世界的崇敬
对于笔者一类狭隘的专业至上主义者来说南山宫的建筑和装饰遗迹才是拜访的重点
南山宫始建于南宋德祐元年1275年明弘治十八年1505年重建此后一直到清代屡有修葺之举
专家判断现存建筑是明末清初时期形成的
宫观位于南山东麓的半山腰四周果木丛生几座老屋但与古老的南山宫有关的就只剩下一座孤零零的大殿了
看门人并没有接待参观的任务拜访者需要内线或是运气
建筑重檐歇山屋顶脊饰丰富翘角如飞
主体部分面阔和进深都是三间外围还有副阶周匝明间开门两侧隔扇中间彩绘板门
檐下斗拱密集下昂低垂造型让人想起浦城云峰寺只是更加密集繁复
内部抬梁式构架明间顶部置八角斗拱层层出挑上承螺旋式鸡笼藻井色彩古拙而清晰
虽然经过近年的修缮但宫内彩绘做法木作特点等领域留给研究者的课题还有很多
projects.content_zh: 道观神祗繁多，听说过"圣祖大仙"和"都统舍人"吗？那是精神世界的崇敬。对于笔者一类狭隘的"专业至上主义者"来说，南山宫的建筑和装饰遗迹才是拜访的重点。南山宫始建于南宋德祐元年（1275年），明弘治十八年（1505年）重建。此后一直到清代，屡有修葺之举。专家判断现存建筑是明末清初时期形成的。宫观位于南山东麓的半山腰，四周果木丛生，几座老屋，但与古老的南山宫有关的就只剩下一座孤零零的大殿了。看门人并没有接待参观的任务，拜访者需要"内线"或是运气。建筑重檐歇山屋顶，脊饰丰富，翘角如飞；主体部分面阔和进深都是三间，外围还有副阶周匝；明间开门，两侧隔扇，中间彩绘板门；檐下斗拱密集，下昂低垂，造型让人想起浦城云峰寺，只是更加密集繁复；内部抬梁式构架，明间顶部置八角斗拱层层出挑，上承螺旋式"鸡笼"藻井，色彩古拙而清晰。虽然经过近年的修缮，但宫内彩绘做法、木作特点等领域留给研究者的课题还有很多。
projects.content_en: Taoist temples have numerous deities; have you heard of the "Holy Ancestor Great Immortal" and "Dutong Sheren"? That is reverence in the spiritual world. For narrow-minded "professional supremacists" like the author, the architectural and decorative remains of Nanshan Palace are the focus of the visit. Nanshan Palace was first built in the first year of Deyou reign of the Southern Song (1275), and rebuilt in the 18th year of Hongzhi reign of the Ming (1505). From then until the Qing Dynasty, there were repeated repairs. Experts judge that the existing building was formed in the late Ming and early Qing period. The palace is located on the halfway slope of the eastern foot of Nanshan Mountain, surrounded by fruit trees, with several old houses, but only a solitary main hall remains related to the ancient Nanshan Palace. The gatekeeper has no task of receiving visitors, so visitors need "inside connections" or luck. The building has a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, with rich ridge ornaments and flying upturned corners; the main part is three bays wide and three bays deep, with a surrounding secondary eave on the outside; the central bay has a door, with lattice doors on both sides and painted panel doors in the middle; under the eaves, dougong are dense, with lower ang hanging low, the shape reminiscent of Yunfeng Temple in Pucheng, only denser and more complex; the interior has a tailiang (beam-lifting) frame, with octagonal dougong at the top of the central bay protruding layer by layer, supporting a spiral "chicken coop" caisson ceiling, with colors ancient and clear. Although repaired in recent years, there are still many topics left for researchers in fields such as the colored painting techniques and timber characteristics inside the palace.

projects.name: 上坪三楼
projects.address: 漳州华安县沙建镇岱山村
projects.address_en: Daishan Village, Shajian Town, Hua'an County, Zhangzhou
highlights: 遗迹
内部构造
凭吊
华安县西南山区中有一块平坦之地被称作上坪
这里保存着建成于明代万历年间的万历三楼齐云楼日新楼和昇平楼是闽南人建造的土楼
万历漳州府志说漳州土堡旧时尚少唯巡检司及人烟凑集去处设有土城嘉靖四十年1561年以来寇贼生发民间围筑土围土楼日众沿海地方甚多
或许有人会说这种保存的不完整啊但是这种沧桑的所在这种坦白地暴露着的内部的构造却恰恰是最真切的教科书土楼之间的对视穿过时空震撼着人们的灵魂
齐云楼可以上溯至明洪武四年1371年传为唐代名将郭子仪的后裔迁闽时所建现状楼阁的落成时间则为万历十八年1590年
这是一座双环式椭圆形土楼建立在一个小山包上需拾阶而上
墙体材料混合使用夯土和土坯砖底墙厚1.5米高7.6米
楼坐北朝南东西直径62米南北直径47米内部东西长22.6米南北宽14.2米
楼外环高两层楼内设26个居住单元内环平房各单元的开间数与房间面积并不均匀
门厅中有一部公共楼梯此外再无厅堂之设
山巅之楼取水不易楼内有一眼30米深井以轱辘汲水
昇平楼建成于明代万历二十九年1601年建造者与齐云楼主郭氏同源有研究者认为他们是回族的一支
楼内土房多已坍塌今天仅存四套相对完整的三层居住单元
此楼直径45米外墙全部用取自两公里外的花岗岩条石砌筑墙高10.5米厚1.2米内设藏兵洞
projects.content_zh: 华安县西南山区中有一块平坦之地被称作上坪。这里保存着建成于明代万历年间的"万历三楼"——齐云楼、日新楼和昇平楼，是闽南人建造的土楼。万历《漳州府志》说："漳州土堡，旧时尚少，唯巡检司及人烟凑集去处，设有土城。嘉靖四十年（1561年）以来，寇贼生发，民间围筑土围土楼日众，沿海地方甚多。"或许有人会说，这种保存的不完整啊！但是这种沧桑的所在，这种坦白地暴露着的内部的构造，却恰恰是最真切的教科书。土楼之间的对视，穿过时空，震撼着人们的灵魂。齐云楼可以上溯至明洪武四年（1371年），传为唐代名将郭子仪的后裔迁闽时所建。现状楼阁的落成时间则为万历十八年（1590年）。这是一座双环式椭圆形土楼，建立在一个小山包上，需拾阶而上。墙体材料混合使用夯土和土坯砖，底墙厚1.5米，高7.6米。楼坐北朝南，东西直径62米，南北直径47米，内部东西长22.6米，南北宽14.2米。楼外环高两层，楼内设26个居住单元，内环平房。各单元的开间数与房间面积并不均匀。门厅中有一部公共楼梯，此外再无厅堂之设。山巅之楼取水不易，楼内有一眼30米深井，以轱辘汲水。昇平楼建成于明代万历二十九年（1601年），建造者与齐云楼主郭氏同源，有研究者认为他们是回族的一支。楼内土房多已坍塌，今天仅存四套相对完整的三层居住单元。此楼直径45米，外墙全部用取自两公里外的花岗岩条石砌筑，墙高10.5米，厚1.2米，内设藏兵洞。
projects.content_en: In the southwestern mountainous area of Hua'an County there is a flat land called Shangping. Preserved here are the "Three Wanli Buildings" built during the Wanli reign of the Ming Dynasty — Qiyun Lou (Reaching Clouds Building), Rixin Lou (Daily Renewal Building), and Shengping Lou (Ascending Peace Building), tulou built by people of southern Fujian. The Wanli-era "Zhangzhou Prefecture Gazetteer" says: "Zhangzhou earthen forts were few in old times, only at inspection offices and densely populated places were earthen cities established. Since the 40th year of Jiajing reign (1561), with the outbreak of bandits, the people's surrounding and building of earthen enclosures and earthen buildings increased daily, especially in coastal areas." Perhaps some would say this preservation is incomplete! But such a weathered place, with its frankly exposed internal structure, is precisely the most authentic textbook. The mutual gazing between the tulou, crossing time and space, shakes people's souls. Qiyun Lou can be traced back to the fourth year of Hongwu reign of the Ming (1371),传说 built when descendants of the famous Tang general Guo Ziyi migrated to Fujian. The completion time of the current building is the 18th year of Wanli reign (1590). This is a double-ring oval tulou, built on a small hill, requiring climbing steps. The wall material uses a mixture of rammed earth and adobe bricks, with the bottom wall 1.5 meters thick and 7.6 meters high. The building faces south, with an east-west diameter of 62 meters, a north-south diameter of 47 meters, and an interior 22.6 meters long east-west and 14.2 meters wide north-south. The outer ring of the building is two stories high, with 26 residential units inside, and the inner ring is single-story. The number of bays and room area of each unit are not uniform. There is a public staircase in the entrance hall, and no other hall is set. Water is not easy to obtain for a building on a mountain top; there is a 30-meter-deep well inside the building, with a windlass for drawing water. Shengping Lou was completed in the 29th year of Wanli reign of the Ming (1601); its builder shares the same origin as the Guo clan owner of Qiyun Lou, and some researchers believe they are a branch of the Hui ethnic group. Most of the earthen rooms inside the building have collapsed; today only four relatively complete three-story residential units remain. This building has a diameter of 45 meters, with the outer wall entirely built of granite strip stones taken from two kilometers away, the wall 10.5 meters high and 1.2 meters thick, with soldier-hiding caves inside.

projects.name: 关帝庙
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 漳州东山县西埔镇铜陵岵嵝山下

梭柱
柱础等石作
台湾关帝庙要是追溯在福建的源头的话就一定会到东山关帝庙
顺着时间线索探究的话那就是唐代总章年间开漳的陈政陈元光的到来
到了宋代东山更是设了四铺驻兵武圣关羽自然成为了军士们最重要的崇拜对象
明洪武二十年1387年建铜山城时以防倭寇刻像祀之以护官兵

今天大殿石柱上还保留着大明正德吴子约敬送的题记
我们的造访不巧遇上了东山关帝庙的维修工程
与在永泰凤凰寺大殿的经历不同丝毫没有机会进入工地一窥究竟
虽然精彩的庙门一览无余但是其他部分只好借助其他图文资料简要介绍
庙门一间但气势不凡是邻居宝智寺无法相比的

柱头斗拱出七跳之多五翘重昂各攒斗拱间横拱和素方连缀雕刻和彩画绚丽繁复得无以复加

projects.content_zh: 台湾关帝庙要是追溯在福建的源头的话，就一定会到东山关帝庙。顺着时间线索探究的话，那就是唐代总章年间"开漳"的陈政、陈元光的到来。到了宋代，东山更是设了四铺驻兵，武圣关羽自然成为了军士们最重要的崇拜对象。明洪武二十年（1387年）建铜山城时，以防倭寇，刻像祀之，以护官兵。明正德三年（1508年）扩建，至正德七年（1512年）落成。今天大殿石柱上还保留着"大明正德吴子约敬送"的题记。我们的造访不巧遇上了东山关帝庙的维修工程。与在永泰凤凰寺大殿的经历不同，丝毫没有机会进入工地一窥究竟。虽然精彩的庙门一览无余，但是其他部分只好借助其他图文资料简要介绍。庙门一间，但气势不凡，是邻居宝智寺无法相比的。大门用了六根圆石柱，其中两根定门限，另四根分列左右倾斜支撑，作为戗柱。柱头斗拱出七跳之多，五翘重昂，各攒斗拱间横拱和素方连缀，雕刻和彩画绚丽繁复得无以复加。屋架之上承托歇山屋顶，琉璃瓦面上各种闽南地方特色的瓷雕图案，八仙过海、瑞兽、古代故事等主题变化丰富。庙内大殿木结构部分为明、清两代和近代历次修缮的结果。悬山顶，屋顶剪瓷雕，面阔三间，用抬梁式屋架建筑；蟠龙柱之外，立柱多为石梭柱，下施鼓状柱础；室内陈设众多历史楹联；且有清咸丰皇帝御笔"万世人极"匾和黄道周所撰木匾。庙前有一大广场，台地层叠，池水居中，然品位不高，是当地文化、设计界人士大可改进之处。
projects.content_en: If one traces the origin of Taiwan's Guan Yu temples back to Fujian, one will surely arrive at Dongshan Guan Yu Temple. Following the timeline, it was the arrival of Chen Zheng and Chen Yuanguang, who "opened Zhangzhou" during the Zongzhang reign of the Tang Dynasty. By the Song Dynasty, Dongshan had even established four posts for stationing troops, and the Martial Sage Guan Yu naturally became the most important object of worship for the soldiers. When Tongshan City was built in the 20th year of Hongwu reign of the Ming (1387), to defend against Japanese pirates, an image was carved and enshrined to protect the officers and soldiers. It was expanded in the third year of Zhengde reign (1508) and completed in the seventh year of Zhengde reign (1512). Today, the stone pillars of the main hall still retain the inscription "Respectfully presented by Wu Ziyue of the Great Ming Zhengde reign." Our visit unfortunately coincided with the repair project of Dongshan Guan Yu Temple. Unlike the experience at the main hall of Yongtai Phoenix Temple, there was no opportunity at all to enter the construction site for a glimpse. Although the splendid temple gate was fully visible, the other parts had to be briefly introduced with the help of other graphic materials. The temple gate is one bay, but its momentum is extraordinary, incomparable to the neighboring Baozhi Temple. The gate uses six round stone pillars, two of which define the door threshold, while the other four are arranged on the left and right, leaning to support as raking columns. The column-top dougong protrude as many as seven jumps, with five raised and double ang, with transverse brackets and plain squares connecting between each cluster of dougong, the carvings and colored paintings gorgeously complex beyond measure. Above the roof frame supports the hip-and-gable roof, with various Minnan-style porcelain sculpture patterns on the glazed tile surface, with richly varying themes such as the Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea, auspicious beasts, and ancient stories. The timber structure of the main hall inside the temple is the result of successive repairs in the Ming and Qing dynasties and modern times. It has an overhanging gable roof (xuanshan), with porcelain-cut sculptures on the roof, three bays wide, built with a tailiang (beam-lifting) roof frame; besides the dragon-coiled columns, the columns are mostly stone shuttle-shaped columns, with drum-shaped column bases below; the interior is furnished with numerous historical couplets; and there is also the plaque "Model for Ten Thousand Generations" in the imperial calligraphy of the Xianfeng Emperor of the Qing and a wooden plaque written by Huang Daozhou. In front of the temple there is a large square, with layered platforms and a pool in the center, but the taste is not high, an area that local cultural and design professionals could greatly improve.

projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 漳州长泰县武安镇中山南路
projects.address_en: Zhongshan South Road, Wu'an Town, Changtai County, Zhangzhou
highlights: 石结构
仿木做法
石装饰
雕刻工艺
行驶在长泰宽阔的机动车道上两侧是新近开发的楼宇和气派的行道树丝毫察觉不到就在新楼的背后还藏着一条崎岖的老街

武安石牌坊有三座就在正对着县政府的中山南路上从南到北分别为解元世科坊秋水鱼龙坊和祖孙执法坊
解元世科坊当心二柱左右各二根副柱合为三间通高10米
上屏无存下屏南面题额解元北面题写世科

正反两面当中石匾阴刻祖孙执法两根额上分别刻有明万历二十三年岁次乙未吉旦立和都御史戴时宗监察御史戴火景
说明此坊是1595年为长泰籍进士都察院右佥都御史戴时宗和他的曾孙进士监察御史戴火景所立
此外离牌坊不远的街上还有宋大观四年1110年凿造的义泉井和牌坊一起隐于凋敝巷道而品位自高
projects.content_zh: 行驶在长泰宽阔的机动车道上，两侧是新近开发的楼宇和气派的行道树，丝毫察觉不到就在新楼的背后还藏着一条崎岖的老街，街道的名称听上去像是原来的主路——中山南路。武安石牌坊有三座，就在正对着县政府的中山南路上。从南到北分别为解元世科坊、秋水鱼龙坊和祖孙执法坊。解元世科坊，当心二柱，左右各二根副柱，合为三间，通高10米。上屏无存，下屏南面题额"解元"，北面题写"世科"。屏下额上刻有科第题名事迹及人名，说明此坊建于明嘉靖七年（1528年），为解元薛炳、举人薛春所立的。秋水鱼龙坊，二柱一门，单檐歇山式屋顶。柱上、枋上斗拱有丁头拱、四铺作两种，并有假昂做法。面阔4.34米，通高7米。正面匾书"秋水鱼龙"，背面书"春风桃李"，坊上题铭记载此坊为历科进士举人建于明万历四年（1576年）。祖孙执法坊，四柱三门，明间阔4米，次间阔1.8米，通面阔7.6米，通高8.8米。中楼为单檐歇山式屋顶，柱上、枋上斗拱有丁头拱、四铺作两种。正反两面当中石匾阴刻"祖孙执法"，两根额上分别刻有"明万历二十三年岁次乙未吉旦立"和"都御史戴时宗，监察御史戴火景"，说明此坊是1595年为长泰籍进士、都察院右佥都御史戴时宗和他的曾孙进士监察御史戴火景所立。此外，离牌坊不远的街上还有宋大观四年（1110年）凿造的义泉井，和牌坊一起，隐于凋敝巷道而品位自高。
projects.content_en: Driving on the wide motor vehicle road of Changtai, with newly developed buildings and imposing street trees on both sides, one does not notice at all that behind the new buildings there is still hidden a rugged old street, whose name sounds like the original main road — Zhongshan South Road. There are three Wu'an stone archways, on Zhongshan South Road directly facing the county government. From south to north they are respectively the Jieyuan Shike Archway (First-place Scholar and Generational Scholars), Qiushui Yulong Archway (Autumn Water and Fish-Dragon), and Zusun Zhifa Archway (Grandfather and Grandson Enforcing the Law). The Jieyuan Shike Archway has two central columns, with two auxiliary columns on each side, making three bays, with a total height of 10 meters. The upper screen no longer exists; the lower screen has the inscription "Jieyuan" (First-place Scholar) on the south face and "Shike" (Generational Scholars) on the north face. On the lintel below the screen are engraved the names and deeds of examination graduates, indicating that this archway was built in the seventh year of Jiajing reign of the Ming (1528), erected for Xue Bing, a first-place scholar, and Xue Chun, a provincial graduate. The Qiushui Yulong Archway has two columns and one gate, with a single-eave hip-and-gable roof. The dougong on the columns and lintels are of two types: dingtou-gong (corbel bracket) and sipuzuo (four-set bracket), with a false ang technique. It is 4.34 meters wide and 7 meters high. The front plaque reads "Qiushui Yulong" (Autumn Water and Fish-Dragon), and the back reads "Chunfeng Taoli" (Spring Wind and Peach-Plum Blossoms); the inscription on the archway records that it was built by successive jinshi and juren graduates in the fourth year of Wanli reign of the Ming (1576). The Zusun Zhifa Archway has four columns and three gates, with the central bay 4 meters wide, the side bays 1.8 meters wide, a total width of 7.6 meters, and a total height of 8.8 meters. The central tower has a single-eave hip-and-gable roof, with dougong on the columns and lintels of two types: dingtou-gong and sipuzuo. On both front and back faces, the central stone plaque is intaglio-carved "Zusun Zhifa" (Grandfather and Grandson Enforcing the Law), and the two lintels are respectively engraved with "Erected on an auspicious day in the Yiwei year, the 23rd year of Wanli reign of the Ming" and "Censor Dai Shizong, Supervising Censor Dai Huojing," indicating that this archway was erected in 1595 for Dai Shizong, a Changtai-native jinshi and Right Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate, and his great-grandson Dai Huojing, a jinshi and Supervising Censor. In addition, not far from the archways on the street there is also the Yiquan Well, dug in the fourth year of Daguan reign of the Song (1110), which together with the archways, hidden in dilapidated alleys, has its own elevated taste.

projects.name: 杨氏宗祠
projects.name_en: Ancestral Temple Complex for Yang's Clan
projects.address: 漳州市长泰县武安镇城关村后庵
projects.address_en: Hou'an, Chengguan Village, Wu'an Town, Changtai County, Zhangzhou
highlights: 木结构
木雕
或许是长泰宾馆建造得摩登气派我们根本就没有想到在它后边沿着通衢大道建设北路的一侧还藏着一座慈济宫和一座杨氏宗祠
或许是治病救人的功能保证了慈济宫的香火所以要比宗祠显眼而杨氏宗祠才是一座真正的古迹但围墙掩护大门紧锁
我们能够透过窗户窥视到的门庭便让我们饱了眼福
这里实际是杨海的纪念堂
杨海是唐朝文德元年888年诰封的武胜场大使到了南唐保大十四年955年场升为县定名长泰再后来宋太平兴国五年980年长泰改隶漳州杨海就是开县元勋
由于他关心百姓疾苦民众尊其武胜公
宗祠仅一进院落由门厅天井侧廊正堂组成
屋架之上襻间斗拱采用连珠斗的做法构架加工细腻木雕精美
檐下采用丁头拱支撑悬挑垂花柱柱头花饰玲珑剔透
资料记载里边无法欣赏到的正堂面阔三间进深三间梁架十三檩带前廊规模不小阶石也相当硕大浮雕花卉图案精美
堂内悬挂有历代的匾额和武胜家声远弘农世泽长的对联横批清白传家
projects.content_zh: 或许是长泰宾馆建造得摩登气派，我们根本就没有想到在它后边沿着通衢大道建设北路的一侧还藏着一座慈济宫和一座杨氏宗祠。或许是治病救人的功能保证了慈济宫的香火，所以要比宗祠显眼。而杨氏宗祠才是一座真正的古迹，但围墙掩护，大门紧锁。我们能够透过窗户窥视到的门庭便让我们饱了眼福。这里实际是杨海的纪念堂。杨海是唐朝文德元年（888年）诰封的武胜场大使；到了南唐保大十四年（955年），"场"升为"县"，定名长泰；再后来宋太平兴国五年（980年），长泰改隶漳州。杨海就是开县元勋。由于他关心百姓疾苦，民众尊其"武胜公"。宗祠仅一进院落，由门厅、天井、侧廊、正堂组成。屋架之上，襻间斗拱采用连珠斗的做法，构架加工细腻，木雕精美；檐下采用丁头拱支撑，悬挑垂花柱，柱头花饰玲珑剔透。资料记载，里边无法欣赏到的正堂面阔三间，进深三间，梁架十三檩带前廊，规模不小；阶石也相当硕大，浮雕花卉图案精美。堂内悬挂有历代的匾额和"武胜家声远，弘农世泽长"的对联，横批"清白传家"。
projects.content_en: Perhaps because the Changtai Hotel was built so modern and imposing, we never expected that behind it, along one side of Jianshe North Road, a thoroughfare, there were hidden a Ciji Temple and a Yang Clan Ancestral Temple. Perhaps the function of healing the sick and saving people ensured the incense of Ciji Temple, making it more conspicuous than the ancestral temple. But the Yang Clan Ancestral Temple is a true ancient site, yet protected by a surrounding wall with its main gate tightly locked. The entrance hall we could peek at through the window already feasted our eyes. This is actually the memorial hall of Yang Hai. Yang Hai was the Wusheng Field Ambassador conferred by imperial edict in the first year of Wende reign of the Tang (888); by the 14th year of Baoda reign of the Southern Tang (955), the "field" was promoted to a "county," named Changtai; later, in the fifth year of Taiping Xingguo reign of the Song (980), Changtai was transferred to Zhangzhou. Yang Hai was the founding hero of the county. Because he cared about the people's hardships, the people honored him as "Lord Wusheng." The ancestral temple has only one courtyard, composed of the entrance hall, courtyard, side corridors, and main hall. Above the roof frame, the inter-columnar dougong adopt the "beads-connected dou" technique, with exquisitely processed frames and fine wood carvings; under the eaves, dingtou-gong (corbel brackets) are used for support, with overhanging pendant column capitals, and the column-top floral ornaments are exquisitely carved. According to records, the main hall that cannot be appreciated inside is three bays wide and three bays deep, with a 13-purlin beam frame with a front corridor, of considerable scale; the step stones are also quite large, with exquisite relief flower patterns. Inside the hall hang plaques of successive dynasties and the couplet "The family reputation of Wusheng extends far, the ancestral grace of Hongnong lasts long," with the horizontal inscription "Passing Down Purity and Integrity."

projects.name: 石矾塔
projects.address: 漳州云霄县东厦镇湖丘村漳江入海处
projects.address_en: At the mouth of the Zhangjiang River, Huqiu Village, Dongxia Town, Yunxiao County, Zhangzhou
highlights: 石结构
景观
凭吊
虽然时常会讥讽一下若干景病但看到石矾塔就由不得赞叹云霄八景之石矾砥柱并非虚名了
石矾塔在漳江入海处海中礁石岛上惊涛拍打潮涨漫基
塔始建于清康熙九年1670年嘉庆十九年1814年重建
这是一座本很普通的密檐式筒体结构塔塔七层平面呈八角形通高24.81米花岗岩条石砌成
一层塔壁厚2.19米逐层减薄至顶减至0.9米塔檐每层条石叠涩内有石作螺旋通顶
塔刹为葫芦形塔顶屋面条石浮雕覆莲纹每层均开设拱门数量不一
第二层门额镶嵌斯文永昌和嘉庆时期的落款
寻常之塔立于不寻常之地所成绝不寻常是人心的非同寻常
云霄厅志和清嘉庆二十年1815年新建石矾塔碑记说明礁石岛上原有一天然笋石所谓云霄故郡治扶舆磅礴名山环映独缺东南一面巉岩秀削适当其缺高数丈如笋尖旧名石矾
郑成功与清军争战的年代笋石系船而倒海上顿失镇佑
清康熙九年建一石塔高不盈丈低小不称清嘉庆十九年云霄厅同知薛凝度募金修得今天的石矾塔
默默吟诵日月京华远风涛海国秋作为北京的来客顿感海风的凉意
projects.content_zh: 虽然时常会讥讽一下"若干景病"，但看到石矾塔，就由不得赞叹云霄八景之"石矾砥柱"并非虚名了。石矾塔在漳江入海处海中礁石岛上，惊涛拍打，潮涨漫基。塔始建于清康熙九年（1670年），嘉庆十九年（1814年）重建。这是一座本很普通的密檐式筒体结构塔；塔七层，平面呈八角形，通高24.81米，花岗岩条石砌成；一层塔壁厚2.19米，逐层减薄，至顶减至0.9米；塔檐每层条石叠涩；内有石作螺旋通顶；塔刹为葫芦形，塔顶屋面条石浮雕覆莲纹；每层均开设拱门，数量不一；第二层门额镶嵌"斯文永昌"和嘉庆时期的落款。寻常之塔立于不寻常之地，所成绝不寻常，是人心的非同寻常。《云霄厅志》和清嘉庆二十年（1815年）《新建石矾塔碑记》说明，礁石岛上原有一天然笋石，所谓"云霄故郡治，扶舆磅礴，名山环映，独缺东南一面……巉岩秀削，适当其缺，高数丈如笋尖，旧名石矾"。郑成功与清军争战的年代，笋石系船而倒，海上顿失镇佑。清康熙九年建一石塔"高不盈丈，低小不称"。清嘉庆十九年，云霄厅同知薛凝度募金修得今天的石矾塔。默默吟诵"日月京华远，风涛海国秋"，作为北京的来客，顿感海风的凉意。
projects.content_en: Although one often mocks the "disease of having too many scenic spots," upon seeing Shifan Pagoda, one cannot help but praise that the "Shifan Pillar" among the Eight Scenes of Yunxiao is not an empty name. Shifan Pagoda is on a reef island in the sea at the mouth of the Zhangjiang River, with surging waves beating against it and the tide submerging its base at high tide. The pagoda was first built in the ninth year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1670) and rebuilt in the 19th year of Jiaqing reign (1814). This is an otherwise ordinary multi-eave cylindrical structure pagoda; it has seven stories, with an octagonal plan, a total height of 24.81 meters, built of granite strip stones; the first-story wall is 2.19 meters thick, thinning layer by layer, reducing to 0.9 meters at the top; each story's eave is corbelled with strip stones; inside there is a stone spiral staircase reaching the top; the spire is gourd-shaped, with the roof strip stones at the top carved in relief with overlapping lotus patterns; each story has arched doors, varying in number; the second-story door lintel is inlaid with "Siwen Yongchang" (Culture and Letters Forever Prosperous) and a Jiaqing-period inscription. An ordinary pagoda standing in an extraordinary place becomes anything but ordinary — it is the extraordinariness of human hearts. The "Yunxiao Subprefecture Gazetteer" and the "Record of Newly Building Shifan Pagoda" from the 20th year of Jiaqing reign of the Qing (1815) explain that there was originally a natural stalagmite on the reef island, so-called "Yunxiao, the old prefectural seat, with vast and majestic terrain, surrounded by famous mountains, only lacking the southeast side... the rugged and elegantly sharp rock, exactly filling the gap, several zhang high like a bamboo shoot tip, formerly named Shifan." During the years of war between Zheng Chenggong and the Qing army, the stalagmite was used to tie boats and fell, and the sea suddenly lost its guardian. In the ninth year of Kangxi reign of the Qing, a stone pagoda was built "not even a zhang high, too small and low to be commensurate." In the 19th year of Jiaqing reign of the Qing, Xue Ningdu, the subprefect of Yunxiao, raised funds to build today's Shifan Pagoda. Silently reciting "The sun and moon are far from the capital, the wind and waves of the sea kingdom in autumn," as a visitor from Beijing, one suddenly feels the coolness of the sea breeze.

projects.name: 树滋楼
projects.address: 漳州云霄县和平乡宜谷径村
projects.address_en: Yigujing Village, Heping Township, Yunxiao County, Zhangzhou
highlights: 土石结构
居住单元分配方式
凭吊
树滋楼是圆形土楼
清乾隆五十四年1789年始建高氏族人所居
楼体单环三层直径50米高12.5米墙厚2米
楼外墙下部以花岗岩条石菱形斜置砌筑上部为夯土墙
北面门楼内共28开间每单元自备楼梯上下每层设厅房三层设内通廊
楼内是空旷的内庭还有一眼孤独的水井
本次勘察没有看到树滋楼也不知道它还是不是从前的样子
与华安县上坪三楼遗址状态不同的是树滋楼给人的感觉不是历史劫难过后的沧桑而是破败之中的绝望
留意到圆楼正中颇为讲究的圆形墁石了吧时间飞逝好多事情周而复始树滋楼的命运会是什么样呢
projects.content_zh: 树滋楼是圆形土楼。清乾隆五十四年（1789年）始建，高氏族人所居。楼体单环，三层，直径50米，高12.5米，墙厚2米。楼外墙下部以花岗岩条石菱形斜置砌筑，上部为夯土墙。北面门，楼内共28开间，每单元自备楼梯上下，每层设厅房，三层设内通廊。楼内是空旷的内庭，还有一眼孤独的水井。本次勘察没有看到树滋楼，也不知道它还是不是从前的样子。与华安县上坪三楼遗址状态不同的是，树滋楼给人的感觉不是历史劫难过后的沧桑，而是破败之中的绝望。留意到圆楼正中颇为讲究的圆形墁石了吧，时间飞逝，好多事情周而复始。树滋楼的命运会是什么样呢？
projects.content_en: Shuzi Building is a round tulou (earthen building). It was first built in the 54th year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1789), inhabited by the Gao clan. The building has a single ring, three stories, with a diameter of 50 meters, a height of 12.5 meters, and walls 2 meters thick. The lower part of the outer wall is built with granite strip stones laid diagonally in a diamond pattern, and the upper part is rammed earth wall. There is a gate on the north side; inside the building there are 28 bays in total, with each unit having its own staircase for going up and down, each story having hall rooms, and the third story having an inner corridor. Inside the building is an open inner courtyard, with also a lonely water well. This survey did not see Shuzi Building, nor do we know if it is still what it used to be. Different from the state of the Three Buildings of Shangping in Hua'an County, the feeling Shuzi Building gives is not the vicissitudes after historical disasters, but despair amid dilapidation. Have you noticed the quite exquisite round paved stone in the center of the round building? Time flies, and many things repeat themselves. What will the fate of Shuzi Building be?

projects.name: 威惠庙
projects.address: 漳州云霄县云陵镇享堂村西北路
projects.address_en: Northwest Road, Xiangtang Village, Yunling Town, Yunxiao County, Zhangzhou
highlights: 晚期木结构及装饰特点
前期石做法极其痕迹
云霄老城镇中心保留了人口密集的特点却已经基本失去了原来城镇的面貌
虽然云霄威惠庙邻近还保存紫阳书院宇云山书院燕翼宫等一些古迹新旧建筑之间的协调则基本无从谈起
在威惠庙中可以听到云师附小内的读书声想起在国外博物馆看到的孩子们附小旁边不就是一本最厚重的历史书吗
漳州地区的威惠庙不少这里是祖宗
嘉靖漳浦县志载威惠庙祀唐将军陈元光始建于云霄
另有清嘉庆云霄厅志载威惠庙唐嗣圣间建现庙在镇城西门外明成化间里人吴永绥建弘治辛亥1491年男道初重修崇祯辛未1631年裔孙仰说再修
嘉庆之后清道光十一年1831年重修只可惜同治三年1864年庙宇毁于太平军战火光绪二年1876年复建
庙宇南向是一进小院前面有月台和大埕对着一座照壁
主体部分门厅对大殿回廊围天井布局紧凑
光绪年间所成的木结构反映在门厅和大殿上就是雕镂丰富色彩绚烂金碧辉煌
门厅屋脊三段划分石柱石墙垂花柱和彩绘满满的所用石柱上有道光题刻是战火没有毁掉的构件
门侧内壁嵌清光绪二十八年1902年开漳圣王碑记一方
大殿面阔五间单檐歇山顶木屋架殿内石柱4根为梭形形式颇古朴方柱讹角上有道光刻联也是重复利用的老构件
丁头拱挑檐周边夯土围合殿内尚存明代方形石炉一座有崇祯壬申1632年春王正月金浦刘登枢舍题记也是太平天国动荡岁月没有毁坏之物
projects.content_zh: 云霄老城镇中心保留了人口密集的特点，却已经基本失去了原来城镇的面貌——虽然云霄威惠庙邻近还保存紫阳书院、宇云山书院、燕翼宫等一些古迹，新旧建筑之间的协调则基本无从谈起。在威惠庙中，可以听到云师附小内的读书声。想起在国外博物馆看到的孩子们，附小旁边不就是一本最厚重的历史书吗？漳州地区的威惠庙不少，这里是祖宗。嘉靖《漳浦县志》载："威惠庙，祀唐将军陈元光，始建于云霄。"另有清嘉庆《云霄厅志》载："威惠庙……唐嗣圣间建。现庙在镇城西门外，明成化间里人吴永绥建。弘治辛亥（1491年）男道初重修……崇祯辛未（1631年）裔孙仰说再修。"嘉庆之后，清道光十一年（1831年）重修。只可惜同治三年（1864年），庙宇毁于太平军战火，光绪二年（1876年）复建。庙宇南向，是一进小院，前面有月台和大埕，对着一座照壁。主体部分门厅对大殿，回廊围天井，布局紧凑。光绪年间所成的木结构反映在门厅和大殿上就是雕镂丰富、色彩绚烂、金碧辉煌。门厅屋脊三段划分，石柱、石墙、垂花柱和彩绘满满的，所用石柱上有道光题刻，是战火没有毁掉的构件。门侧内壁嵌清光绪二十八年（1902年）《开漳圣王碑记》一方。大殿面阔五间，单檐歇山顶，木屋架；殿内石柱4根为梭形，形式颇古朴，方柱讹角，上有道光刻联，也是重复利用的老构件；丁头拱挑檐，周边夯土围合；殿内尚存明代方形石炉一座，有"崇祯壬申（1632年）春王正月金浦刘登枢舍"题记，也是太平天国动荡岁月没有毁坏之物。
projects.content_en: The center of the old town of Yunxiao retains the characteristic of dense population, but has basically lost its original town appearance — although near Yunxiao Weihui Temple there are still preserved some ancient sites such as Ziyang Academy, Yuyunshan Academy, and Yanyi Palace, the coordination between old and new buildings is basically out of the question. In Weihui Temple, one can hear the sound of reading from Yunshi Affiliated Primary School. Thinking of the children seen in museums abroad, isn't the affiliated primary school next to it the most profound history book? There are many Weihui Temples in the Zhangzhou area, and this one is the ancestor. The Jiajing-era "Zhangpu County Gazetteer" records: "Weihui Temple, enshrining Tang General Chen Yuanguang, was first built in Yunxiao." Another Qing Jiaqing-era "Yunxiao Subprefecture Gazetteer" records: "Weihui Temple... built during the Sisheng reign of the Tang. The current temple is outside the west gate of the town city, built by local resident Wu Yongsui during the Chenghua reign of the Ming. Rebuilt by his son Daochu in the Xinhai year of Hongzhi (1491)... repaired again by descendant Yangshuo in the Xinwei year of Chongzhen (1631)." After Jiaqing, it was repaired in the 11th year of Daoguang reign of the Qing (1831). Unfortunately, in the third year of Tongzhi reign (1864), the temple was destroyed in the war flames of the Taiping Army, and rebuilt in the second year of Guangxu reign (1876). The temple faces south, is a one-courtyard small compound, with a moon platform and large courtyard in front, facing a screen wall. The main part has the entrance hall facing the main hall, with corridors surrounding the courtyard, in a compact layout. The timber structure completed during the Guangxu period is reflected in the entrance hall and main hall as rich carving, gorgeous colors, and resplendent gold. The entrance hall roof ridge is divided into three sections, with stone columns, stone walls, pendant column capitals, and full colored paintings; the stone columns used have Daoguang inscriptions, components not destroyed by the war flames. The inner wall beside the gate is inlaid with a "Record of the Sage King Who Opened Zhangzhou" stele from the 28th year of Guangxu reign of the Qing (1902). The main hall is five bays wide, with a single-eave hip-and-gable roof and timber roof frame; inside the hall there are 4 shuttle-shaped stone columns, quite ancient in form, with square columns having chamfered corners and Daoguang inscribed couplets, also old components reused; dingtou-gong (corbel brackets) support the eaves, surrounded by rammed earth; inside the hall there remains a square stone furnace from the Ming Dynasty, with the inscription "Donated by Liu Dengshu of Jinpu in the first month of the Renshen year of Chongzhen (1632)," also an object not destroyed in the turbulent years of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.

projects.name: 河坑土楼群
projects.address: 漳州南靖书洋镇曲江圩河坑村
projects.address_en: Hekeng Village, Qujiangxu, Shuyang Town, Nanjing County, Zhangzhou
highlights: 各种土楼形式
居住方式
从明朝到近现代修造的土楼如果选址和布局与北斗星有什么关系其中的偶然是有趣的但我绝对不会拿这个说法来过多咀嚼我就是这么枯燥的人
分布河坑狭长的河谷地带中有名登录在册的河坑土楼有13座平面有方形圆形和五边形三种
它们是朝水楼永盛楼绳庆楼永荣楼南薰楼阳照楼永贵楼裕昌楼东升楼春贵楼晓春楼永庆楼裕兴楼
河坑是张姓族人祖祖辈辈聚居之所世代辛劳建造了这些年代不同形式尺度各异的土楼
在此13座中最值得详细介绍的有始建年代最早的朝水楼楼包厝厝包楼的绳庆楼五边形平面的南薰楼和最晚建造的裕兴楼
朝水楼位于土楼群中部张氏族谱记载河坑肇基始祖张仕良在明代中期从石桥村迁此其子张六益长大后于明嘉靖年间1549至1553年动工兴建朝水楼1923年朝水楼失火而后得到重修
此楼是一座内通廊式的方形土楼整体南向中等规模高三层每层20个房间通高11.3米
土楼建筑最为紧要的的墙体仅在局部采用1米多高的鹅卵石墙基厚1.66米屋顶出檐非常深远保护了夯土墙体是土楼能够留存至今的重要保证
绳庆楼土楼群东端的溪竹坝由张氏十一世祖张仕优建于清雍正年间1723至1735年
楼是方形的由于楼后山高楼前凹下于是设计者在前面又建有25间的二层护厝三面围合土楼并将楼的朝向面西整体布局院楼呼应体型丰富
主体土楼面宽26.1米进深24.5米高3层通高12米基墙厚1米每层24间设4部楼梯1个大门
土楼中心院中有一座一进小院的祖堂主厅面阔三间曰庭槐上悬挂清乾隆二十八年1763年德式乡闾匾祖堂结构简明雕刻简朴大方
绳庆楼之西便是南薰楼了为张氏十七世祖张钟荫于清道光年间1821至1850年所建
南薰楼是内通廊式土楼平面呈五边形并非正五边形实际上更接近一个抹去一角的方形
土楼整体上坐北朝南建楼之初楼门向西正对山峰出于风水上视线上的考虑把楼门改为朝南而厅堂在楼东侧
土楼面宽29米进深30米外墙通高12.6米高3层每层21间设4部楼梯大门一座
裕兴楼是河坑建造最晚的土楼年代是1969年至1971年
在20世纪六七十年代又再次兴起建造土楼的高潮一下子建造了春贵楼晓春楼永庆楼裕兴楼
与传统方式不同的是这些土楼不再分房分支系安排而是由族人集资兴建共同使用历史的原因也不再设有祠堂了
裕兴楼为内通廊式圆形土楼坐西朝东楼外径34米内径18米外墙通高11米基墙厚0.9米楼高3层每层20间设有2个楼梯1个大门楼内天院用卵石铺墁大门用青石密缝摆砌
这一套做法都是传统的延续说明土楼建造遗产的强大生命力
projects.content_zh: 从明朝到近现代修造的土楼，如果选址和布局与北斗星有什么关系，其中的偶然是有趣的，但我绝对不会拿这个说法来过多咀嚼。我就是这么枯燥的人。分布河坑狭长的河谷地带中，有名、登录在册的河坑土楼有13座，平面有方形、圆形和五边形三种。它们是：朝水楼、永盛楼、绳庆楼、永荣楼、南薰楼、阳照楼、永贵楼、裕昌楼、东升楼、春贵楼、晓春楼、永庆楼、裕兴楼。河坑是张姓族人祖祖辈辈聚居之所，世代辛劳，建造了这些年代不同形式尺度各异的土楼。在此13座中最值得详细介绍的有始建年代最早的朝水楼、楼包厝、厝包楼的绳庆楼、五边形平面的南薰楼和最晚建造的裕兴楼。朝水楼位于土楼群中部。《张氏族谱》记载，河坑肇基始祖张仕良在明代中期从石桥村迁此，其子张六益长大后，于明嘉靖年间（1549—1553年）动工兴建朝水楼。1923年朝水楼失火，而后得到重修。此楼是一座内通廊式的方形土楼，整体南向，中等规模，高三层，每层20个房间，通高11.3米。土楼建筑最为紧要的的墙体仅在局部采用1米多高的鹅卵石墙基，厚1.66米。屋顶出檐非常深远，保护了夯土墙体，是土楼能够留存至今的重要保证。绳庆楼土楼群东端的溪竹坝，由张氏十一世祖张仕优建于清雍正年间（1723—1735年）。楼是方形的，由于楼后山高，楼前凹下，于是设计者在前面又建有25间的二层护厝三面围合土楼，并将楼的朝向面西，整体布局院、楼呼应，体型丰富。主体土楼面宽26.1米，进深24.5米；高3层，通高12米；基墙厚1米；每层24间，设4部楼梯，1个大门。土楼中心院中有一座一进小院的祖堂。主厅面阔三间，曰"庭槐"，上悬挂清乾隆二十八年（1763年）"德式乡闾"匾。祖堂结构简明，雕刻简朴大方。绳庆楼之西，便是南薰楼了，为张氏十七世祖张钟荫于清道光年间（1821—1850年）所建。南薰楼是内通廊式土楼，平面呈五边形——并非正五边形，实际上更接近一个抹去一角的方形。土楼整体上坐北朝南。建楼之初，楼门向西正对山峰，出于风水上、视线上的考虑，把楼门改为朝南，而厅堂在楼东侧。土楼面宽29米，进深30米，外墙通高12.6米。高3层，每层21间，设4部楼梯，大门一座。裕兴楼是河坑建造最晚的土楼，年代是1969年至1971年。在20世纪六七十年代又再次兴起建造土楼的高潮，一下子建造了春贵楼、晓春楼、永庆楼、裕兴楼。与传统方式不同的是这些土楼不再分房、分支系安排，而是由族人集资兴建，共同使用，历史的原因也不再设有祠堂了。裕兴楼为内通廊式圆形土楼，坐西朝东；楼外径34米，内径18米，外墙通高11米，基墙厚0.9米；楼高3层，每层20间，设有2个楼梯，1个大门；楼内天院用卵石铺墁，大门用青石密缝摆砌。这一套做法都是传统的延续，说明土楼建造遗产的强大生命力。
projects.content_en: For tulou (earthen buildings) built from the Ming Dynasty to modern times, if there is any relationship between their site selection and layout and the Big Dipper, the coincidence is interesting, but I would absolutely not dwell too much on this claim. I am just such a dry person. Distributed in the narrow river valley of Hekeng, there are 13 registered and named Hekeng tulou, with square, round, and pentagonal plans. They are: Chaoshui Lou, Yongsheng Lou, Shengqing Lou, Yongrong Lou, Nanxun Lou, Yangzhao Lou, Yonggui Lou, Yuchang Lou, Dongsheng Lou, Chungui Lou, Xiaochun Lou, Yongqing Lou, and Yuxing Lou. Hekeng is a place where the Zhang clan has lived for generations, working hard generation after generation, building these tulou of different eras, forms, and scales. Among these 13, the most worthy of detailed introduction are Chaoshui Lou, the earliest built; Shengqing Lou, with building-enclosing-house and house-enclosing-building; Nanxun Lou, with a pentagonal plan; and Yuxing Lou, the latest built. Chaoshui Lou is located in the middle of the tulou cluster. The "Zhang Clan Genealogy" records that Zhang Shiliang, the founding ancestor of Hekeng, moved here from Shiqiao Village in the mid-Ming Dynasty; his son Zhang Liuyi, after growing up, began construction of Chaoshui Lou during the Jiajing reign of the Ming (1549–1553). In 1923, Chaoshui Lou caught fire and was later rebuilt. This building is an inner-corridor square tulou, overall facing south, of medium scale, three stories high, with 20 rooms per story, and a total height of 11.3 meters. The most critical walls of the tulou only locally use a cobblestone foundation over 1 meter high, 1.66 meters thick. The roof eaves extend very far, protecting the rammed earth walls, an important guarantee for the tulou to survive to this day. Shengqing Lou, at Xizhuba at the eastern end of the tulou cluster, was built by Zhang Shiyou, the 11th-generation ancestor of the Zhang clan, during the Yongzheng reign of the Qing (1723–1735). The building is square; because the mountain behind the building is high and the front is depressed, the designer built 25 two-story side wings in front, enclosing the tulou on three sides, and oriented the building to face west, with the overall layout of courtyard and building echoing each other, rich in form. The main tulou is 26.1 meters wide and 24.5 meters deep; 3 stories high, with a total height of 12 meters; foundation wall 1 meter thick; 24 rooms per story, with 4 staircases and 1 main gate. In the central courtyard of the tulou there is an ancestral hall in a small one-courtyard compound. The main hall is three bays wide, called "Tinghuai," with a plaque "Exemplary in the Village" from the 28th year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1763) hanging above. The ancestral hall has a simple structure with simple and generous carvings. West of Shengqing Lou is Nanxun Lou, built by Zhang Zhongyin, the 17th-generation ancestor of the Zhang clan, during the Daoguang reign of the Qing (1821–1850). Nanxun Lou is an inner-corridor tulou with a pentagonal plan — not a regular pentagon, actually closer to a square with one corner erased. The tulou overall faces south. At the beginning of construction, the building gate faced west directly toward a mountain peak; for feng shui and line-of-sight considerations, the gate was changed to face south, with the hall on the east side of the building. The tulou is 29 meters wide and 30 meters deep, with the outer wall 12.6 meters high. It is 3 stories high, with 21 rooms per story, 4 staircases, and one main gate. Yuxing Lou is the latest-built tulou in Hekeng, dating from 1969 to 1971. In the 1960s and 1970s, there was another upsurge in building tulou, with Chungui Lou, Xiaochun Lou, Yongqing Lou, and Yuxing Lou built all at once. Different from traditional methods, these tulou are no longer arranged by separate houses or branch lineages, but are built with funds raised by clan members for shared use, and for historical reasons no ancestral halls are set up anymore. Yuxing Lou is an inner-corridor round tulou, facing east from the west; the building has an outer diameter of 34 meters, an inner diameter of 18 meters, an outer wall total height of 11 meters, and a foundation wall 0.9 meters thick; the building is 3 stories high, with 20 rooms per story, 2 staircases, and 1 main gate; the inner courtyard is paved with cobblestones, and the main gate is built with bluestone in tight joints. This set of practices is all a continuation of tradition, demonstrating the strong vitality of the tulou-building heritage.

projects.name: 龙潭楼
projects.address: 漳州南靖龙山镇田中村
projects.address_en: Tianzhong Village, Longshan Town, Nanjing County, Zhangzhou
highlights: 土楼博物馆
龙潭楼是一座方形土楼本是非常普通的一座方楼却因为两个原因而与众不同
龙潭楼是土楼博物馆所在陈设保管着很多土楼文物为那些不是走马观花的人而设
龙潭楼是书洋吕氏祖厝而台湾桃源吕氏家族廷玉支系与夏珍支系两大房派的祖地都在书洋吕厝所以此楼在台影响颇深
此楼建于清朝康熙癸卯年1663年据说启用之时已是龙年加之楼前有一大深潭楼遂得名龙潭
族谱记载清朝乾隆五年1740年龙潭楼吕氏第11代孙吕廷玉携妻东渡台湾于是此楼亦成两岸吕氏纽带
楼规模中等高4层约略16米夯土墙底部厚达1.73米边长26米每层16开间
四楼四个边角分别悬挑出台作为瞭望之用下三层射孔之外并不对外开窗立面效果坚实封闭
而楼内一至四层均为敞回廊四角设四部公梯楼内还有水井一眼井水甘洌足资战时之用
projects.content_zh: 龙潭楼是一座方形土楼。本是非常普通的一座方楼，却因为两个原因而与众不同：龙潭楼是土楼博物馆所在，陈设保管着很多土楼文物，为那些不是走马观花的人而设。龙潭楼是书洋吕氏祖厝，而台湾桃源吕氏家族廷玉支系与夏珍支系两大房派的祖地都在书洋吕厝，所以此楼在台影响颇深。此楼建于清朝康熙癸卯年（1663年），据说启用之时已是龙年，加之楼前有一大深潭，楼遂得名"龙潭"。族谱记载清朝乾隆五年（1740年）龙潭楼吕氏第11代孙吕廷玉携妻东渡台湾，于是此楼亦成两岸吕氏纽带。楼规模中等，高4层约略16米，夯土墙底部厚达1.73米；边长26米，每层16开间，四楼四个边角分别悬挑出台，作为瞭望之用；下三层射孔之外并不对外开窗，立面效果坚实封闭；而楼内一至四层均为敞回廊，四角设四部公梯；楼内还有水井一眼，井水甘洌，足资战时之用。
projects.content_en: Longtan Lou is a square tulou (earthen building). Originally a very ordinary square building, it is distinctive for two reasons: Longtan Lou houses the Tulou Museum, which displays and preserves many tulou artifacts, designed for those who do not just glance in passing. Longtan Lou is the ancestral home of the Lü clan of Shuyang, and the ancestral lands of the two major branch lineages of the Lü clan in Taoyuan, Taiwan — the Tingyu branch and the Xiazhen branch — are both at Lücuo in Shuyang, so this building has considerable influence in Taiwan. This building was built in the Guimao year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1663); it is said that when it was put into use it was already the Year of the Dragon, and in addition there was a large deep pool in front of the building, so the building was named "Longtan" (Dragon Pool). The genealogy records that in the fifth year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1740), Lü Tingyu, the 11th-generation descendant of the Lü clan of Longtan Lou, crossed east to Taiwan with his wife, so this building also became a bond between the Lü clan on both sides of the strait. The building is of medium scale, 4 stories high, approximately 16 meters, with the rammed earth wall at the bottom reaching 1.73 meters thick; the side length is 26 meters, with 16 bays per story; the four corners of the fourth story each have overhanging platforms for observation purposes; besides arrow slits on the lower three stories, there are no outward-facing windows, giving the facade a solid and closed effect; while inside the building, the first to fourth stories all have open corridors, with four public staircases at the four corners; there is also a water well inside the building, with sweet and clear water, sufficient for wartime use.

projects.name: 梅林天后宫
projects.name_en: Temple of the Queen Heaven in Meilin
projects.address: 漳州南靖梅林镇梅林村梅溪北岸
projects.address_en: North bank of Mei Stream, Meilin Village, Meilin Town, Nanjing County, Zhangzhou
highlights: 古石作遗存
环境
南靖起伏的山峦之间已经没有了梅花林海的身影只留下了梅林的地名
沿着梅溪踏着卵石路朝着茂密的竹海就走进了梅林村
天后宫在梅溪北岸梅林村村口
村里艰辛的生活和有限的资源使得村口的小庙里拥挤地供奉着关老爷保生大帝和妈祖武庙在前殿慈济宫在后院楼下天后娘娘则在后院楼上的最显要的位置
这一组宗教建筑始建于明崇祯年间1628至1644年历代修葺其中有碑刻记载的是清道光光绪年间的重修
整体上建筑朝向西南前殿直接对着道路单层悬山砖木结构两山加小型坡檐一副要装作歇山顶的样子前檐明间一对蟠龙石柱颇为精美亦显古朴有力
后楼二层悬山屋顶砖墙为近来重建木装修尚似旧有之物楼和前殿之间有一小院院门上题名天后宫
projects.content_zh: 南靖起伏的山峦之间已经没有了梅花林海的身影，只留下了梅林的地名。沿着梅溪，踏着卵石路，朝着茂密的竹海，就走进了梅林村。天后宫在梅溪北岸，梅林村村口。村里艰辛的生活和有限的资源，使得村口的小庙里拥挤地供奉着关老爷、保生大帝和妈祖——武庙在前殿，慈济宫在后院楼下，天后娘娘则在后院楼上的最显要的位置。这一组宗教建筑始建于明崇祯年间（1628—1644年），历代修葺，其中有碑刻记载的是清道光、光绪年间的重修。整体上建筑朝向西南，前殿直接对着道路，单层悬山砖木结构，两山加小型坡檐，一副要装作歇山顶的样子，前檐明间一对蟠龙石柱颇为精美，亦显古朴有力。后楼二层，悬山屋顶，砖墙为近来重建，木装修尚似旧有之物。楼和前殿之间有一小院，院门上题名天后宫。
projects.content_en: Among the rolling mountains of Nanjing, there is no longer any trace of the sea of plum blossoms, only the place name Meilin (Plum Forest) remains. Following the Mei Stream, treading on the cobblestone road, toward the dense bamboo sea, one enters Meilin Village. Tianhou Palace is on the north bank of Mei Stream, at the entrance of Meilin Village. The hard life and limited resources in the village have caused the small temple at the village entrance to crowdedly enshrine Lord Guan, the Great Emperor of Life Preservation, and Mazu — the Martial Temple is in the front hall, Ciji Palace is downstairs in the back courtyard, and the Empress of Heaven is in the most prominent position upstairs in the back courtyard. This group of religious buildings was first built during the Chongzhen reign of the Ming (1628–1644), repaired through successive dynasties, with stele inscriptions recording repairs during the Daoguang and Guangxu reigns of the Qing. Overall the building faces southwest, with the front hall directly facing the road, a single-story overhanging-gable brick-timber structure, with small sloping eaves added to both gable ends, putting on an appearance of pretending to be a hip-and-gable roof; a pair of dragon-coiled stone columns in the central bay of the front eave are quite exquisite, also appearing ancient and powerful. The back building is two stories, with an overhanging-gable roof, the brick wall being a recent reconstruction, and the timber fittings still resembling the original. Between the building and the front hall there is a small courtyard, with the gate of the courtyard inscribed with the name Tianhou Palace.

projects.name: 塔下土楼群
projects.address: 漳州南靖书洋镇塔下村
projects.address_en: Taxia Village, Shuyang Town, Nanjing County, Zhangzhou
highlights: 村落文化
土楼形式
塔下是一个普通的村落一条溪水贯穿家家户户喜得临水而居
塔下更是一个客家村落民居建筑有吊脚楼更有客家土楼
土楼沿着溪水铺陈或远观或穿行体会自然不普通了
说到建筑客家土楼值得拜访体会之外围裙楼裕德楼和张氏家庙德远堂最富视觉冲击力两者名字里共用的德字则让人体会古村安然百世之本
今天辟作旅馆的裕德楼基本上是一座圆形土楼而楼体前后两部分形式做法不同
其前半楼高四层墙体除墙基卵石砌筑之外用夯土建造每层10个房间设置1个厅堂和2部公用楼梯于土楼常见做法完全相同
然而后半楼则为之一变夯土墙得到了延续但有所降低相当于前半部分的三层楼高墙顶覆盖木结构墙帽内有廊房一段墙上构造洞的存在也暗示着从前此处也是现状一样的做法
颠倒过来看此楼形象一半似腰带一半似裙摆围裙楼的绰号也算是贴切
德远堂可以说是塔下村的地标明代宣德元年1426年张氏祖先迁居至塔下明朝后期起建德远堂
家庙背靠一座小丘前辟半月池塘池塘外沿呈半圆形树立着24座石旗杆高度逾10米彰表族人功名
projects.content_zh: 塔下是一个普通的村落，一条溪水贯穿，家家户户喜得临水而居。塔下更是一个客家村落，民居建筑有吊脚楼，更有客家土楼。土楼沿着溪水铺陈，或远观或穿行，体会自然不普通了。说到建筑，客家土楼值得拜访体会之外，"围裙楼"裕德楼和张氏家庙德远堂最富视觉冲击力，两者名字里共用的"德"字则让人体会古村安然百世之本。今天辟作旅馆的裕德楼基本上是一座圆形土楼，而楼体前后两部分形式做法不同。其前半楼高四层，墙体除墙基卵石砌筑之外用夯土建造；每层10个房间，设置1个厅堂和2部公用楼梯，于土楼常见做法完全相同。然而，后半楼则为之一变，夯土墙得到了延续，但有所降低，相当于前半部分的三层楼高，墙顶覆盖木结构墙帽，内有廊房一段；墙上构造洞的存在也暗示着从前此处也是现状一样的做法。颠倒过来看，此楼形象一半似腰带，一半似裙摆，"围裙楼"的绰号也算是贴切。德远堂可以说是塔下村的地标。明代宣德元年（1426年）张氏祖先迁居至塔下，明朝后期起建"德远堂"。家庙背靠一座小丘，前辟半月池塘，池塘外沿呈半圆形树立着24座石旗杆，高度逾10米，彰表族人功名。
projects.content_en: Taxia is an ordinary village, with a stream running through it, and every household happily enjoys living by the water. Taxia is even more a Hakka village, with vernacular buildings including stilt houses and even more Hakka tulou (earthen buildings). The tulou are laid out along the stream; whether viewed from afar or walked through, the experience is naturally extraordinary. Speaking of architecture, besides the Hakka tulou worth visiting and experiencing, the "Apron Building" Yude Lou and the Zhang Clan Family Temple Deyuan Tang have the most visual impact; the shared character "De" (virtue) in both names makes one appreciate the foundation of the ancient village's peaceful survival through a hundred generations. Yude Lou, today converted into a hotel, is basically a round tulou, but the front and back parts of the building have different forms and methods. Its front half is four stories high, with walls built of rammed earth except for the cobblestone foundation; each story has 10 rooms, with 1 hall and 2 public staircases, completely the same as common tulou practices. However, the back half changes completely: the rammed earth wall continues but is lowered, equivalent to the three-story height of the front half, with the wall top covered by a timber structure cap, containing a section of corridor; the existence of structural holes in the wall also suggests that this place was previously done the same as the current state. Looking at it upside down, the building's image is half like a belt and half like a skirt hem, so the nickname "Apron Building" is quite apt. Deyuan Tang can be said to be the landmark of Taxia Village. In the first year of Xuande reign of the Ming (1426), the Zhang clan ancestors moved to Taxia, and from the late Ming Dynasty they began building "Deyuan Tang." The family temple backs onto a small hill, with a half-moon pond in front, and along the outer edge of the pond stand 24 stone flagpoles in a semicircle, over 10 meters high, commemorating the clan members' academic and official achievements.

projects.name: 田螺坑土楼群
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 漳州南靖书洋镇上坂村田螺坑村
projects.address_en: Tianluokeng Village, Shangban Village, Shuyang Town, Nanjing County, Zhangzhou
highlights: 村落文化
土楼形式
其实田螺坑土楼群已不必再多做介绍
这里的一座方楼步云楼三座圆楼和昌楼振昌楼瑞云楼以及一座椭圆形楼文昌楼组成了著名的四菜一汤
田螺坑得名于地形像田螺一般环绕着一片低地四周群山高耸土楼群在山势起伏掩映之间确实令人叹为观止
步云楼始建于清嘉庆元年1796年高三层每层26个房间全楼有4部楼梯
圆楼和昌楼跟随步云楼的脚步而建也是三层高每层22个房间设两部楼梯
到了1930年步云楼另侧又建起了振昌楼还是三层高每层26个房接下来是1936年建造的瑞云楼同样是三层每层26个房间
最后建造的是1966年兴工的文昌楼椭圆形平面三层每层有32个房间
在田螺坑的特殊地形中营造土楼群的关键在于如何结合地形调整完形为主要特征的土楼
建造者的具体手法首先是平整台地把地形整理成阶梯而更微妙的做法是调整首层立柱的高度或增或减而在第二层上实现理想的平面
行进在村中高低错落的阶梯之上的时候由衷地体会到当年营造的艰辛
projects.content_zh: 其实田螺坑土楼群已不必再多做介绍。这里的一座方楼——步云楼、三座圆楼——和昌楼、振昌楼、瑞云楼，以及一座椭圆形楼——文昌楼，组成了著名的"四菜一汤"。田螺坑得名于地形，像田螺一般环绕着一片低地，四周群山高耸；土楼群在山势起伏掩映之间，确实令人叹为观止。步云楼始建于清嘉庆元年（1796年），高三层，每层26个房间，全楼有4部楼梯；圆楼和昌楼，跟随步云楼的脚步而建，也是三层高，每层22个房间，设两部楼梯；到了1930年步云楼另侧又建起了振昌楼，还是三层高，每层26个房；接下来是1936年建造的瑞云楼，同样是三层，每层26个房间；最后建造的是1966年兴工的文昌楼，椭圆形平面，三层，每层有32个房间。在田螺坑的特殊地形中营造土楼群的关键在于如何结合地形调整"完形"为主要特征的土楼。建造者的具体手法首先是平整台地，把地形整理成阶梯，而更微妙的做法是调整首层立柱的高度，或增或减，而在第二层上实现理想的平面。行进在村中高低错落的阶梯之上的时候，由衷地体会到当年营造的艰辛。
projects.content_en: In fact, the Tianluokeng tulou cluster needs no further introduction. Here, one square building — Buyun Lou, three round buildings — Hechang Lou, Zhenchang Lou, Ruiyun Lou, and one oval building — Wenchang Lou, form the famous "Four Dishes and One Soup." Tianluokeng (Snail Pit) gets its name from its terrain, surrounding a lowland like a snail, with towering mountains on all sides; the tulou cluster, half-hidden among the undulating mountain slopes, is truly breathtaking. Buyun Lou was first built in the first year of Jiaqing reign of the Qing (1796), three stories high, with 26 rooms per story and 4 staircases in the whole building; the round building Hechang Lou, built following in the footsteps of Buyun Lou, is also three stories high, with 22 rooms per story and 2 staircases; by 1930, Zhenchang Lou was built on the other side of Buyun Lou, still three stories high with 26 rooms per story; next came Ruiyun Lou built in 1936, also three stories with 26 rooms per story; the last built was Wenchang Lou, begun in 1966, with an oval plan, three stories, and 32 rooms per story. The key to building a tulou cluster in the special terrain of Tianluokeng lies in how to adjust the tulou, characterized by "complete form," in conjunction with the terrain. The builders' specific technique was first to level the terraces, organizing the terrain into steps, and a more subtle method was to adjust the height of the first-story columns, increasing or decreasing them, to achieve an ideal plane on the second story. When walking among the high and low scattered steps in the village, one sincerely appreciates the hardships of construction in those years.

projects.name: 云水谣之和贵楼
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 漳州南靖县梅林镇璞山村
projects.address_en: Pushan Village, Meilin Town, Nanjing County, Zhangzhou
highlights: 规模
基础处理
把长教古镇称为云水谣是借着电影的春风招徕婚纱摄影的好主意效果自不必说
镇上茂密的大榕树老商铺深色的木板墙地上新新旧旧浅色的鹅卵石路山脚下溪岸旁田野上大大小小保存完好53座土楼让古镇韵味十足
与其自命老古董倒不如顺应时尚的新口味顺着云水谣的老路介绍两座老土楼
先说南靖最高的和贵楼
和贵楼这座安静祥和的长方形大楼是简次屏于清雍正十年1732年建造的据记载当时的总投资达到一万五千两银子成就了南靖最高的美名
楼前面一条围屋原有一条水渠周围土屋错落反衬楼体高大
楼高五层计21.5米底层夯土墙厚1.34米由下而上逐渐收分至第五层墙厚缩减至0.65米楼仅开大门一座
楼内由每层有28个共计140个居住单元组成四方各设一公共楼梯以便交通天井中心建三间一堂式学堂
此楼一大建筑成就是其地基处理
故旧介绍当初建楼选址于沼泽地上于是打了几千根松木桩以为基础
这个做法与意大利威尼斯的基础处理一样海水固然帮助固化松脂和贵楼下的木桩也已经辅佐土楼屹立300年了
projects.content_zh: 把长教古镇称为"云水谣"是借着电影的春风招徕婚纱摄影的好主意，效果自不必说。镇上茂密的大榕树，老商铺深色的木板墙，地上新新旧旧浅色的鹅卵石路，山脚下、溪岸旁、田野上大大小小保存完好53座土楼，让古镇韵味十足。与其自命老古董，倒不如顺应时尚的新口味，顺着云水谣的老路介绍两座老土楼。先说南靖最高的和贵楼。和贵楼，这座安静祥和的长方形大楼，是简次屏于清雍正十年（1732年）建造的，据记载当时的总投资达到一万五千两银子，成就了南靖最高的美名。楼前面一条围屋，原有一条水渠，周围土屋错落，反衬楼体高大。楼高五层，计21.5米，底层夯土墙厚1.34米，由下而上逐渐收分，至第五层墙厚缩减至0.65米。楼仅开大门一座。楼内由每层有28个、共计140个居住单元组成，四方各设一公共楼梯以便交通。天井中心建"三间一堂式"学堂。此楼一大建筑成就是其地基处理。故旧介绍，当初建楼选址于沼泽地上，于是打了几千根松木桩以为基础。这个做法与意大利威尼斯的基础处理一样，海水固然帮助固化松脂。和贵楼下的木桩也已经辅佐土楼屹立300年了。
projects.content_en: Calling the ancient town of Changjiao "Yunshuiyao" (Ballad of Clouds and Water) is a good idea to attract wedding photography by riding the wave of a film, and the effect goes without saying. The dense large banyan trees in the town, the dark wooden plank walls of old shops, the new and old light-colored cobblestone roads on the ground, and the 53 well-preserved tulou of all sizes at the foot of the mountains, by the stream banks, and in the fields give the ancient town ample charm. Rather than claiming to be an old antique, it is better to conform to fashionable new tastes and introduce two old tulou along the old road of Yunshuiyao. First, the tallest tulou in Nanjing, Hegui Lou. Hegui Lou, this quiet and peaceful rectangular building, was built by Jian Ciping in the 10th year of Yongzheng reign of the Qing (1732); according to records, the total investment at that time reached 15,000 taels of silver, achieving the reputation of being the tallest in Nanjing. In front of the building there is a row of surrounding houses, originally with a water channel, with scattered earthen houses around, setting off the tall building. The building is five stories high, totaling 21.5 meters, with the bottom rammed earth wall 1.34 meters thick, gradually tapering from bottom to top, reducing to 0.65 meters thick at the fifth story. The building has only one main gate. Inside the building there are 28 residential units per story, totaling 140 units, with a public staircase on each of the four sides for transportation. In the center of the courtyard there is a "three-bay-one-hall" style school. A major architectural achievement of this building is its foundation treatment. According to old accounts, when the building site was originally chosen on marshland, thousands of pine piles were driven as the foundation. This method is the same as the foundation treatment in Venice, Italy; seawater certainly helps solidify the pine resin. The piles under Hegui Lou have also assisted the tulou in standing for 300 years.

projects.name: 云水谣之怀远楼
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 漳州南靖县梅林镇坎下村东部
projects.address_en: Eastern part of Kania Village, Meilin Town, Nanjing County, Zhangzhou
highlights: 造型
装饰工艺
经过长教的古道是长汀府今龙岩市通往漳州府今漳州市的必经之路古道连接着几座大型土楼驱车不远便可到达
怀远楼从形式到工艺都是绝对值得好好体会的
怀远楼也是当地简氏所建时间已经到了清光绪三十一年至宣统元年1904至1909年建楼的经费则是华侨汇资而来
这是一座双环形平面的土楼高四层计14.5米楼基用鹅卵石和三合土垒筑高3米余以上夯土
楼内外环一周每层34间共136间居住单元
楼之内环实为一进院落分上下堂两翼弧形围合这个核心院落称为诗礼庭
大门两侧围墙上镶嵌着四方琉璃花砖是那个年代简氏族人从南洋带回来的
而上堂则是祖堂斯是室是长辈议政小辈课业的场所强调读书的氛围屋架斗拱上的木刻也多以书卷为主题是难得一见的精美工艺
projects.content_zh: 经过长教的古道是长汀府（今龙岩市）通往漳州府（今漳州市）的必经之路。古道连接着几座大型土楼，驱车不远便可到达。怀远楼从形式到工艺，都是绝对值得好好体会的。怀远楼也是当地简氏所建，时间已经到了清光绪三十一年至宣统元年（1904—1909年），建楼的经费则是华侨汇资而来。这是一座双环形平面的土楼，高四层，计14.5米；楼基用鹅卵石和三合土垒筑，高3米余，以上夯土；楼内外环一周每层34间，共136间居住单元；楼之内环实为一进院落，分上下堂，两翼弧形围合；这个核心院落称为"诗礼庭"；大门两侧、围墙上镶嵌着四方琉璃花砖，是那个年代简氏族人从南洋带回来的；而上堂则是祖堂"斯是室"，是长辈议政、小辈课业的场所，强调读书的氛围，屋架斗拱上的木刻也多以书卷为主题，是难得一见的精美工艺。
projects.content_en: The ancient road through Changjiao was the necessary route from Changting Prefecture (today's Longyan City) to Zhangzhou Prefecture (today's Zhangzhou City). The ancient road connects several large tulou, reachable by a short drive. Huaiyuan Lou, from form to craftsmanship, is absolutely worth experiencing carefully. Huaiyuan Lou was also built by the local Jian clan, with the time reaching from the 31st year of Guangxu reign to the first year of Xuantong reign of the Qing (1904–1909), and the funds for building the楼 came from remittances by overseas Chinese. This is a double-ring plan tulou, four stories high, totaling 14.5 meters; the building foundation is built of cobblestones and three-in-one soil, over 3 meters high, with rammed earth above; the inner and outer rings of the building each have 34 rooms per story, totaling 136 residential units; the inner ring of the building is actually a one-courtyard compound, divided into upper and lower halls, with two wings arc-shaped enclosing; this core courtyard is called "Shili Ting" (Poetry and Propriety Courtyard); on both sides of the main gate and on the surrounding walls, four square glazed floral bricks are inlaid, brought back from Nanyang (Southeast Asia) by the Jian clan members in that era; and the upper hall is the ancestral hall "Sishi Shi" (This Is the Room), a place for elders to discuss politics and juniors to study, emphasizing the atmosphere of reading, and the wood carvings on the roof frame dougong are mostly themed on scrolls, a rarely seen exquisite craftsmanship.

projects.name: 裕昌楼
projects.address: 漳州南靖书洋镇下版寮村上节社
projects.address_en: Shangjieshe, Xiabanliao Village, Shuyang Town, Nanjing County, Zhangzhou
highlights: 土楼结构和病害
布局和供水设计
在田螺坑和塔下村之间下版寮村的土楼也有12座溪水汀步树影石路是宜人的所在
当地人生意经念得更好保护意识也相当不错土楼旅馆餐饮小卖部都颇方便随处可见的文革标语也大有沧海桑田的味道
不过这里最为繁忙的还要数那座东倒西歪的裕昌楼
裕昌楼是南靖县现存最古老的土楼建造年代大致是在元末明初约1368年
当时的建造者是刘罗张唐范五姓族人于是土楼的平面布置就要考虑到房间的分配要把整座楼分为间数不等的五个部分各设一部楼梯各层通廊连接
楼高也是五层计18.2米底层墙厚1.8米外环每层有54个房间
最为有趣的是底层设厨房后半楼家家厨房有一口水井为土楼建筑所仅见楼内天井中心建有单层祖堂
故旧言称这座土楼建成后不久楼内回廊木柱便开始倾斜最大倾斜度为15度但经受几百年风雨和地震的考验至今有惊无险
不过土楼承重本不很大而且作为怀疑论者如果没有检测裕昌楼内木结构的年代没有进行整体力学分析之前本人对于种种传言是不予评论的
projects.content_zh: 在田螺坑和塔下村之间，下版寮村的土楼也有12座。溪水汀步树影石路，是宜人的所在。当地人生意经念得更好，保护意识也相当不错，土楼旅馆、餐饮、小卖部都颇方便，随处可见的"文革"标语也大有沧海桑田的味道。不过这里最为繁忙的，还要数那座"东倒西歪"的裕昌楼。裕昌楼是南靖县现存最古老的土楼，建造年代大致是在元末明初（约1368年）。当时的建造者是刘、罗、张、唐、范五姓族人。于是，土楼的平面布置就要考虑到房间的分配，要把整座楼分为间数不等的五个部分，各设一部楼梯，各层通廊连接；楼高也是五层，计18.2米，底层墙厚1.8米；外环每层有54个房间；最为有趣的是底层设厨房，后半楼家家厨房有一口水井，为土楼建筑所仅见；楼内天井中心建有单层祖堂。故旧言称，这座土楼建成后不久，楼内回廊木柱便开始倾斜，最大倾斜度为15度。但经受几百年风雨和地震的考验，至今有惊无险。不过，土楼承重本不很大；而且作为怀疑论者，如果没有检测裕昌楼内木结构的年代，没有进行整体力学分析之前，本人对于种种传言是不予评论的。
projects.content_en: Between Tianluokeng and Taxia Village, there are also 12 tulou in Xiabanliao Village. The stream stepping stones, tree shadows, and stone roads make it a pleasant place. The locals are better at business, and their awareness of protection is also quite good; tulou hotels, restaurants, and small shops are quite convenient, and the ubiquitous "Cultural Revolution" slogans also have a strong flavor of the passage of time. However, the busiest place here must be the "tilting" Yuchang Lou. Yuchang Lou is the oldest surviving tulou in Nanjing County, built roughly in the late Yuan and early Ming Dynasty (around 1368). The builders at that time were members of five surnames: Liu, Luo, Zhang, Tang, and Fan. Therefore, the plan layout of the tulou had to consider the allocation of rooms, dividing the entire building into five parts with unequal numbers of rooms, each with a staircase, connected by corridors on each floor; the building is also five stories high, totaling 18.2 meters, with the bottom wall 1.8 meters thick; the outer ring has 54 rooms per story; the most interesting is that the bottom floor has kitchens, and every household in the rear half of the building has a water well in its kitchen, unique among tulou architecture; in the center of the inner courtyard there is a single-story ancestral hall. According to old accounts, shortly after this tulou was completed, the wooden columns of the inner corridors began to tilt, with a maximum tilt of 15 degrees. But after经受 hundreds of years of wind, rain, and earthquakes, it has survived to this day without disaster. However, the load-bearing of the tulou is not very large to begin with; and as a skeptic, without testing the age of the timber structure inside Yuchang Lou and without conducting an overall mechanical analysis, I do not comment on various rumors.

projects.name: 城隍庙
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 漳州平和县九峰镇东门内
projects.address_en: Inside East Gate, Jiufeng Town, Pinghe County, Zhangzhou
highlights: 木结构
壁画
院落布局
作为闽粤间的交通要道九峰是古平和县治所在是闽南潮汕客家交融之地保留着明清时期的县衙遗址明城墙残迹古窑址寺院宗祠民居土楼牌坊等历史建筑尤以城隍庙著称
平和县与大名鼎鼎的王阳明关系至密
明正德十一年1516年王阳明以左佥都御史巡抚南赣次年五月王阳明奏请设置新县平和奏准以府级规格建置县城隍庙并于正德十三年1518年下半年动工修建
县志和碑刻记载清代对城隍庙进行多次修缮康熙三十六年1697年知县巫元东重修建制皆因旧而后范公廷谋陈公淳宗相继修葺嘉庆七年1802年知县张毓龄黄士棠相继重修道光七年1827年知县滕子玉重修咸丰十年1860年平和县儒学教谕洪亮功等又行修茸
平和城隍庙得以比较完整地保留了下来格局与康熙平和县志记载基本吻合前有大门仪门仪门内接戏台拜亭县志未提及大殿后殿建制皆因旧即延续了正德时的格局
城隍庙大门面阔三间屋面是近期复原所成台基立柱门框梁架等保持古物门内庭院深深遥对仪门
仪门单檐悬山顶面阔三间中柱设三门石门额门框立柱上有题记仪门内接戏台四柱卷棚歇山顶仪门之内左右厢房各三间墙壁上有墨线淡彩的壁画行乞图百艺图等
拜亭单檐歇山顶面阔三间左右次间内分祀十二房科立像像后壁画平和八景图为明嘉靖年县庠生九峰东门人朱龙翔所绘拜亭后檐与大殿前檐对窟排水
大殿重檐歇山顶面阔五间独特的是大殿下檐用四架梁而上层用七架梁显得下层饱满而上层较小加之拜殿的遮挡令人难以在院中欣赏到重檐的风采这样的做法或许是历次重修留下的设计遗憾
大殿祀东岳大帝殿中心有嘉靖年的拜石明间前廊及内檐立四根龙柱是清嘉庆的遗物大殿之后天井两侧廊内分别绘有二十四孝与十八层地狱壁画弥足珍贵
后殿单檐歇山顶面阔五间供奉城隍神和内宫夫人明间前廊立柱上有嘉庆题记神龛上方悬有清道光十年1830年灵佑九和匾
作为王阳明所立黄道周称道的古庙平和城隍庙的重要性尤其突出以至于1928年的时候这里一度作为县政府的办公地点有趣的是新中国成立后城隍庙被平和茶厂占用我们也可微笑着颔首了解茶文化在当地人心目中的地位了来来学一学养生怡神的凭吊吧
projects.content_zh: 作为闽粤间的交通要道，九峰是古平和县治所在，是闽南、潮汕、客家交融之地，保留着明清时期的县衙遗址、明城墙残迹、古窑址、寺院、宗祠、民居、土楼、牌坊等历史建筑，尤以城隍庙著称。平和县与大名鼎鼎的王阳明关系至密。明正德十一年（1516年），王阳明以左佥都御史巡抚南赣；次年五月，王阳明奏请设置新县"平和"，奏准以府级规格建置县城隍庙，并于正德十三年（1518年）下半年动工修建。县志和碑刻记载，清代对城隍庙进行多次修缮，康熙三十六年（1697年），"知县巫元东重修，建制皆因旧"，而后，"范公廷谋、陈公淳宗相继修葺"；嘉庆七年（1802年），"知县张毓龄、黄士棠相继重修；道光七年（1827年），知县滕子玉重修；咸丰十年（1860年），平和县儒学教谕洪亮功等又行修茸。平和城隍庙得以比较完整地保留了下来，格局与康熙《平和县志》记载基本吻合：前有大门、仪门，仪门内接戏台、拜亭（县志未提及）、大殿、后殿，"建制皆因旧"，即延续了正德时的格局。城隍庙大门面阔三间，屋面是近期复原所成；台基、立柱、门框、梁架等保持古物。门内庭院深深，遥对仪门。仪门单檐悬山顶，面阔三间，中柱设三门；石门额、门框、立柱上有题记。仪门内接戏台，四柱，卷棚歇山顶。仪门之内左右厢房各三间，墙壁上有墨线淡彩的壁画"行乞图"、"百艺图"等。拜亭单檐歇山顶，面阔三间；左右次间内分祀十二房科立像，像后壁画"平和八景"图，为明嘉靖年县庠生、九峰东门人朱龙翔所绘；拜亭后檐与大殿前檐"对窟"排水。大殿重檐歇山顶，面阔五间。独特的是大殿下檐用四架梁，而上层用七架梁，显得下层饱满而上层较小，加之拜殿的遮挡，令人难以在院中欣赏到重檐的风采。这样的做法或许是历次重修留下的设计遗憾。大殿祀东岳大帝，殿中心有嘉靖年的拜石；明间前廊及内檐立四根龙柱，是清嘉庆的遗物。大殿之后天井，两侧廊内分别绘有"二十四孝"与"十八层地狱"壁画，弥足珍贵。后殿单檐歇山顶，面阔五间，供奉城隍神和内宫夫人；明间前廊立柱上有嘉庆题记，神龛上方悬有清道光十年（1830年）"灵佑九和"匾。作为王阳明所立、黄道周称道的古庙，平和城隍庙的重要性尤其突出，以至于1928年的时候这里一度作为县政府的办公地点。有趣的是新中国成立后城隍庙被平和茶厂占用，我们也可微笑着颔首，了解茶文化在当地人心目中的地位了。来，来，学一学养生怡神的凭吊吧。
projects.content_en: As a transportation hub between Fujian and Guangdong, Jiufeng was the seat of ancient Pinghe County, a place where Minnan, Chaoshan, and Hakka cultures intermingled, preserving historical buildings from the Ming and Qing periods such as county government ruins, remnants of Ming city walls, ancient kiln sites, temples, ancestral halls, residences, tulou, and archways, especially renowned for its City God Temple. Pinghe County has an extremely close relationship with the famous Wang Yangming. In the 11th year of Zhengde reign of the Ming (1516), Wang Yangming served as Grand Coordinator of Southern Jiangxi with the title of Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; in May of the following year, Wang Yangming memorialized to establish a new county "Pinghe," which was approved to build a county City God Temple at prefectural-level specifications, and construction began in the second half of the 13th year of Zhengde reign (1518). County gazetteers and stele inscriptions record that the City God Temple was repaired multiple times in the Qing Dynasty: in the 36th year of Kangxi reign (1697), "County Magistrate Wu Yuandong rebuilt it, with the system all following the old"; later, "Fan Tingmou and Chen Chunzong successively repaired it"; in the seventh year of Jiaqing reign (1802), "County Magistrates Zhang Yuling and Huang Shitang successively rebuilt it; in the seventh year of Daoguang reign (1827), County Magistrate Teng Ziyu rebuilt it; in the 10th year of Xianfeng reign (1860), Hong Lianggong, the Confucian instructor of Pinghe County, and others again repaired it." Pinghe City God Temple has been preserved relatively completely, with its layout basically matching the records in the Kangxi-era "Pinghe County Gazetteer": in front there are the main gate and the ceremonial gate (Yimen), with the ceremonial gate connecting to the opera stage, the worship pavilion (not mentioned in the gazetteer), the main hall, and the rear hall; "the system all follows the old," that is, continuing the Zhengde-era layout. The main gate of the City God Temple is three bays wide, with the roof being a recent restoration; the platform, columns, door frames, and beam frames retain ancient artifacts. Inside the gate, the courtyard is deep, facing the ceremonial gate from afar. The ceremonial gate has a single-eave overhanging gable roof, three bays wide, with three doors set on the central columns; the stone door lintels, door frames, and columns have inscriptions. The ceremonial gate connects to an opera stage with four columns and a rolling hip-and-gable roof. Inside the ceremonial gate, there are three side rooms on each side, with ink-line light-colored murals such as "Begging Scene" and "Hundred Arts Scene" on the walls. The worship pavilion has a single-eave hip-and-gable roof, three bays wide; in the left and right side bays, twelve department officials are separately enshrined as standing statues, with murals of the "Eight Scenes of Pinghe" behind the statues, painted by Zhu Longxiang, a county student from the East Gate of Jiufeng during the Jiajing reign of the Ming; the rear eaves of the worship pavilion and the front eaves of the main hall have "opposite drainage." The main hall has a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, five bays wide. What is unique is that the lower eaves of the main hall use four-beam frames, while the upper layer uses seven-beam frames, making the lower layer full and the upper layer smaller; coupled with the obstruction of the worship hall, it is difficult to appreciate the double-eave style in the courtyard. This approach may be a design regret left by successive repairs. The main hall enshrines the Great Emperor of the Eastern Peak, with a worship stone from the Jiajing reign in the center of the hall; four dragon columns stand in the front corridor and inner eaves of the central bay, relics from the Jiaqing reign of the Qing. In the courtyard behind the main hall, the corridors on both sides are respectively painted with "Twenty-four Filial Piety Stories" and "Eighteen Levels of Hell" murals, extremely precious. The rear hall has a single-eave hip-and-gable roof, five bays wide, enshrining the City God and the Inner Palace Lady; the front corridor columns of the central bay have Jiaqing inscriptions, and above the shrine hangs a plaque "Lingyou Jiuhe" (Spiritual Blessing of Nine Harmonies) from the 10th year of Daoguang reign of the Qing (1830). As an ancient temple established by Wang Yangming and praised by Huang Daozhou, the importance of Pinghe City God Temple is particularly prominent, so much so that in 1928 it once served as the office location of the county government. Interestingly, after the founding of New China, the City God Temple was occupied by the Pinghe Tea Factory; we can also smile and nod, understanding the status of tea culture in the hearts of the local people. Come, come, learn to pay homage in a way that nourishes life and calms the spirit.

projects.name: 绳武楼
projects.level: 全国重点文物保护单位
projects.address: 漳州平和县芦溪镇蕉路村
projects.address_en: Jiaolu Village, Luxi Town, Pinghe County, Zhangzhou
highlights: 土楼生活与建造历史
装饰
平和也是土楼遗产丰富的地方绳武楼因其精美的装饰艺术而成为平和土楼的杰出代表
绳武楼是一座圆楼由芦溪叶氏第十八世太学生叶处侯建于清朝嘉庆年间1798至1820年
而深有意味的是此楼的建造装饰改建再装饰密切地和历代主人的生活和审美品位结合在一起这一建就建了一百多年历经嘉庆至光绪五朝算是基本定型
楼内外双环外环直径43.8米三层划分成24间1个大厅墙厚1米内环一层当心设水井一口内外环之间廊屋连缀隔成小天井
整体而言下两层被分为12组带一个小天井的居住单元三楼则为环楼通廊
难得的是自始建之时楼主叶处侯请来各地石木泥雕大师十多人精雕细琢历代装饰不辍
今日随处可见石雕木雕泥塑壁画仅木雕就有超过六百处流连其中能够欣赏到各种装饰雕刻手法
projects.content_zh: 平和也是土楼遗产丰富的地方。绳武楼因其精美的装饰艺术而成为平和土楼的杰出代表。绳武楼是一座圆楼，由芦溪叶氏第十八世太学生叶处侯建于清朝嘉庆年间（1798—1820年）。而深有意味的是，此楼的建造、装饰、改建、再装饰密切地和历代主人的生活和审美品位结合在一起，这一建就建了一百多年，历经嘉庆至光绪五朝，算是基本定型。楼内外双环，外环直径43.8米，三层，划分成24间，1个大厅，墙厚1米；内环一层，当心设水井一口；内外环之间廊屋连缀，隔成小天井。整体而言，下两层被分为12组带一个小天井的居住单元，三楼则为环楼通廊。难得的是自始建之时，楼主叶处侯请来各地石、木、泥雕大师十多人精雕细琢，历代装饰不辍。今日随处可见石雕、木雕、泥塑、壁画，仅木雕就有超过六百处，流连其中，能够欣赏到各种装饰雕刻手法。
projects.content_en: Pinghe is also a place rich in tulou (earthen building) heritage. Shengwu Lou has become an outstanding representative of Pinghe tulou due to its exquisite decorative art. Shengwu Lou is a round building, built by Ye Chuhou, an imperial student of the 18th generation of the Ye clan of Luxi, during the Jiaqing reign of the Qing Dynasty (1798–1820). What is deeply meaningful is that the construction, decoration, reconstruction, and re-decoration of this building were closely combined with the lives and aesthetic tastes of successive owners; this construction lasted over a hundred years, through five reigns from Jiaqing to Guangxu, before it was basically finalized. The building has inner and outer double rings; the outer ring has a diameter of 43.8 meters, three stories, divided into 24 rooms and 1 large hall, with walls 1 meter thick; the inner ring is one story, with a water well in the center; between the inner and outer rings, corridor houses are connected, separated into small courtyards. Overall, the lower two stories are divided into 12 groups of residential units each with a small courtyard, while the third story is a ring-building corridor. What is rare is that from the time of initial construction, the building owner Ye Chuhou invited more than ten master stone, wood, and clay sculptors from various places to carve and polish meticulously, with successive generations continuing decoration without interruption. Today, stone carvings, wood carvings, clay sculptures, and murals can be seen everywhere; there are over six hundred wood carvings alone, and wandering among them, one can appreciate various decorative carving techniques.

projects.address: 漳州平和县九峰镇平和二中

就如海澄文庙在龙海二中平和文庙得以保存至今也多亏了平和二中
但是可惜的是今天平和文庙只留下了大成殿明伦堂棂星门的一些石构件以及御制碑1方重修碑记5方

其后复有明嘉靖万历清康熙年间多次重修道光二十三年1758年时达到规模之巅庙宇轮奂甲于他邑
对比平和县志中更为清晰的记载当初文庙的规模与文庙常规模式相同前有牌坊泮池棂星门大成门之内为大成殿东为教谕斋西为训导斋明伦堂后为启圣公祠等其中更以大成殿为核心
万分庆幸的是大成殿和明伦堂比较完整地保留了下来专家认为两者均应是明代原构
殿是明正德十四年1519年始建明嘉靖万历清康熙年间重修
建筑采用重檐歇山顶副阶周匝殿身面阔五间明三间尤其宽广进深方向配合穿斗屋架也开五间明间左右内柱用盘龙石柱殿内采用石柱形成开敞空间梁架结构简明
明伦堂则为单檐硬山顶面阔三间规模制度朴素
有些担心时人筹备复原整体文庙的努力巫鸿先生说中国人不强调废墟美或许我们没有十足的勇气面对曾经的轻狂和忘却
projects.content_zh: 就如海澄文庙在龙海二中，平和文庙得以保存至今，也多亏了平和二中。但是可惜的是，今天平和文庙只留下了大成殿、明伦堂、棂星门的一些石构件，以及御制碑1方、重修碑记5方。当年王阳明奏疏朝廷添设县治的时候，这里是何等的气派，是属于以府级规格建设的县堂、文庙、武庙、文昌庙和城隍庙中的一员。其后，复有明嘉靖、万历、清康熙年间多次重修，清乾隆二十三年（1758年）时达到规模之巅，"庙宇轮奂，甲于他邑"。对比《平和县志》中更为清晰的记载，当初文庙的规模与文庙常规模式相同：前有牌坊、泮池、棂星门，大成门之内为大成殿，东为教谕斋，西为训导斋、明伦堂，后为启圣公祠等。其中更以大成殿为核心。万分庆幸的是大成殿和明伦堂比较完整地保留了下来，专家认为两者均应是明代原构。殿是明正德十四年（1519年）始建，明嘉靖、万历、清康熙年间重修。建筑采用重檐歇山顶，副阶周匝，殿身面阔五间，明三间尤其宽广；进深方向配合穿斗屋架也开五间；明间左右内柱用盘龙石柱；殿内采用石柱，形成开敞空间，梁架结构简明。明伦堂则为单檐硬山顶，面阔三间，规模制度朴素。有些担心时人筹备复原整体文庙的努力。巫鸿先生说中国人不强调废墟美；或许我们没有十足的勇气面对曾经的轻狂和忘却。
projects.content_en: Just as Haicheng Confucian Temple is in Longhai No. 2 Middle School, Pinghe Confucian Temple has been preserved to this day also thanks to Pinghe No. 2 Middle School. But unfortunately, today Pinghe Confucian Temple only retains some stone components of the Dacheng Hall, Minglun Hall, and Lingxing Gate, as well as 1 imperial stele and 5 reconstruction stele records. When Wang Yangming memorialized the court to add a county seat, how imposing this place was, belonging to the county hall, Confucian Temple, Martial Temple, Wenchang Temple, and City God Temple built at prefectural-level specifications. Thereafter, there were multiple repairs during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns of the Ming and the Kangxi reign of the Qing, reaching the peak of its scale in the 23rd year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1758), with "the temple halls magnificent, surpassing other counties." Comparing with the clearer records in the "Pinghe County Gazetteer," the original scale of the Confucian Temple followed the conventional Confucian Temple pattern: in front there were archways, the Pan Pond, and the Lingxing Gate; inside the Dacheng Gate was the Dacheng Hall; to the east was the Instructor's Studio, to the west the Assistant Instructor's Studio and Minglun Hall, and behind was the Qisheng Ancestral Hall, etc. Among them, the Dacheng Hall was the core. It is extremely fortunate that the Dacheng Hall and Minglun Hall have been preserved relatively completely, and experts believe both should be original Ming structures. The hall was first built in the 14th year of Zhengde reign of the Ming (1519), and repaired during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns of the Ming and the Kangxi reign of the Qing. The building adopts a double-eave hip-and-gable roof with surrounding secondary eaves; the hall body is five bays wide, with the central three bays particularly broad; in the depth direction,配合 the column-and-tie roof frame, it also opens five bays; the left and right inner columns of the central bay use dragon-coiled stone columns; the interior uses stone columns, forming an open space, with a simple beam frame structure. The Minglun Hall has a single-eave flush gable roof, three bays wide, with a simple and plain scale and system. There is some concern about contemporary efforts to prepare for the restoration of the entire Confucian Temple. Mr. Wu Hung said that Chinese people do not emphasize the beauty of ruins; perhaps we do not have sufficient courage to face past frivolity and forgetfulness.

当然坂仔镇宝南村还有重新修建的林语堂故居其父林至诚传教时所建的基督教堂
这里的土楼群被当地冠以七星土楼的美名因为这里七座土楼薰南楼环溪楼宾阳楼庆阳楼五美楼虎耳楼和贵阳楼北斗般点缀在万亩蕉海之中
